declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.pi
declarations.doc:
The product short complex `∏ (S i).X₁ ⟶ ∏ (S i).X₂ ⟶ ∏ (S i).X₃` of a family of short
complexes, with the differentials `Pi.map`. Its `zero` field is the clause of Stacks 060K that
`∏ L_i ⟶ ∏ M_i ⟶ ∏ N_i` is again a complex.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def pi : ShortComplex C
declarations.comment: The product `∏ L_i ⟶ ∏ M_i ⟶ ∏ N_i` is a complex (the `zero` field)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.piHomologyIso
declarations.doc:
**Exactness of products** (Stacks 060K, general version): when `I`-indexed products are
exact in the abelian category `C`, the homology of the product short complex `pi S` is the
product of the homologies of the `S i`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def piHomologyIso : (pi S).homology ≅ ∏ᶜ fun i ↦ (S i).homology
declarations.comment: General version: exact products of short complexes in an abelian category

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.piHomologyIsoAddCommGrpCat
declarations.doc:
**Exactness of products** (Stacks 060K): for a family `L_i ⟶ M_i ⟶ N_i` of complexes of
abelian groups with cohomology `H_i`, the complex `∏ L_i ⟶ ∏ M_i ⟶ ∏ N_i` (`pi S`) has homology
`∏ H_i`. Products of abelian groups are exact by Mathlib's `AB4Star AddCommGrpCat`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def piHomologyIsoAddCommGrpCat :
    (pi S).homology ≅ ∏ᶜ fun i ↦ (S i).homology
declarations.comment: The Stacks statement: products of complexes of abelian groups

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.SheafProducts.isIso_piComparison_cohomology_zero
declarations.doc:
**Degree-zero cohomology commutes with arbitrary products of abelian sheaves**: for a family
`(F i)` of abelian sheaves on a site and an object `U`, the canonical map
`H^0(U, ∏ F) ⟶ ∏ H^0(U, F i)` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_piComparison_cohomology_zero {I : Type x}
    (F : I → Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v}) (U : C) [HasProduct F]
    [HasProduct fun i ↦
      (Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor J 0 ⋙
        (evaluation Cᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{w'}).obj (op U)).obj (F i)] :
    IsIso (piComparison
      (Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor J 0 ⋙
        (evaluation Cᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{w'}).obj (op U)) F)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.SheafProducts.mono_piComparison_cohomology_one
declarations.doc:
**Degree-one cohomology of a product of abelian sheaves injects into the product**: for a
family `(F i)` of abelian sheaves on a site and an object `U`, the canonical map
`H^1(U, ∏ F) ⟶ ∏ H^1(U, F i)` is a monomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem mono_piComparison_cohomology_one {I : Type x}
    (F : I → Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v}) (U : C) [HasProduct F]
    [HasProduct fun i ↦
      (Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor J 1 ⋙
        (evaluation Cᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{w'}).obj (op U)).obj (F i)] :
    Mono (piComparison
      (Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor J 1 ⋙
        (evaluation Cᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{w'}).obj (op U)) F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.pullback_isLocallyProjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 060M.** The pullback of a locally projective quasi-coherent module
along a morphism of schemes is locally projective.
declarations.statement:
theorem pullback_isLocallyProjective {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (G : Y.Modules)
    [G.IsQuasicoherent] (hG : Scheme.Modules.IsLocallyProjective G) :
    Scheme.Modules.IsLocallyProjective ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj G)

declarations.name: Stacks.DiagonalSplitSequence.diagonalBiprodIso
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 060N]: `Δ^* Ω_{X ×_S X/S} = Ω_{X/S} ⊕ Ω_{X/S}`.**  The direct sum
decomposition `Ω_{X ×_S X/S} = pr_1^* Ω_{X/S} ⊕ pr_2^* Ω_{X/S}` of [Stacks, Tag 01V1], pulled
back along the diagonal: the two summands become `Ω_{X/S}` because `Δ ≫ pr_i = id`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def diagonalBiprodIso :
    relativeDifferentials f ⊞ relativeDifferentials f ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.diagonal f)).obj
        (relativeDifferentials (pullback.fst f f ≫ f))
declarations.comment: the middle term: Δ^*Ω_{X ×_S X/S} = Ω_{X/S} ⊕ Ω_{X/S}

declarations.name: Stacks.DiagonalSplitSequence.diagonalBiprodIso_hom_comp_diagonalDifferentialsMap
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 060N]: the right arrow is `(1, 1)`.**  Under the identification
`Δ^* Ω_{X ×_S X/S} = Ω_{X/S} ⊕ Ω_{X/S}` the canonical map `Δ^* Ω_{X ×_S X/S} ⟶ Ω_{X/S}` of
[Stacks, Tag 01UV] — the second arrow of the conormal sequence of `Δ` — is `(1, 1)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem diagonalBiprodIso_hom_comp_diagonalDifferentialsMap :
    (diagonalBiprodIso f).hom ≫ diagonalDifferentialsMap f =
      biprod.desc (𝟙 (relativeDifferentials f)) (𝟙 (relativeDifferentials f))

declarations.name: Stacks.DiagonalSplitSequence.isSplitEpi_diagonalDifferentialsMap
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 060N]: the right arrow is a split surjection.**  The diagonal has the global
left inverse `pr_1` over `S`, so the second arrow of its conormal sequence is a split
epimorphism; this is [Stacks, Tag 0474] for `Δ`.
declarations.statement: instance isSplitEpi_diagonalDifferentialsMap : IsSplitEpi (diagonalDifferentialsMap f)
declarations.comment: the right arrow is a split surjection

declarations.name: Stacks.DiagonalSplitSequence.leftArrow_eq
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 060N]: the left arrow is `(-1, 1)`.**  Written through the identification
`Δ^* Ω_{X ×_S X/S} = Ω_{X/S} ⊕ Ω_{X/S}` it is the difference of the two projection
inclusions.
declarations.statement: theorem leftArrow_eq : leftArrow f = sndInclusion f - fstInclusion f

declarations.name: Stacks.DiagonalSplitSequence.pullbackSection_d_diffSection
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 060N], the footnote.**  The local section `d_{X/S} b = p_2^♯ b - p_1^♯ b` of
the ideal sheaf of the diagonal is carried by `d_{X ×_S X/S}`, pulled back along `Δ`, to
`pr_2^* d_{X/S} b - pr_1^* d_{X/S} b`; that is, to the image of `d_{X/S} b` under the map
`(-1, 1)` of the direct sum decomposition.  This is what fixes the sign of the left arrow.
declarations.statement:
theorem pullbackSection_d_diffSection (U : X.Opens) (b : Γ(X, U)) :
    Scheme.Modules.pullbackSection (pullback.diagonal f)
        (relativeDifferentials (pullback.fst f f ≫ f)) (Stacks.Diagonal.prodOpen f U) U
        (Stacks.Diagonal.le_diagonal_preimage_prodOpen f U)
        ((universalRelativeDerivation (pullback.fst f f ≫ f)).d
          (Stacks.Diagonal.diffSection f U b)) =
      ((leftArrow f).val.app (op U)) ((universalRelativeDerivation f).d b)
declarations.comment: the footnote: the left arrow on sections

declarations.name: Stacks.DiagonalSplitSequence.shortComplex_shortExact
declarations.doc: **[Stacks, Tag 060N]: the canonical short exact sequence.**
declarations.statement: theorem shortComplex_shortExact : (shortComplex f).ShortExact

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_surjective_isLocallyProjective_iff_forall
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 060Q.** The restriction of an `𝒪_F`-module to the Zariski site of an
étale chart scheme is locally projective for *some* chart whose structure morphism is surjective
on points if and only if it is locally projective for *every* étale chart.

The implication from one chart to all of them is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyProjective_restrictToChartScheme_of_isSurjective`; the
converse needs only that an algebraic space has a chart surjective on points at all, namely its
atlas.  Quasi-coherence of `M` is the source's standing hypothesis on the module.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_surjective_isLocallyProjective_iff_forall
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) (M : Modules.{u, u} B S hS F hF)
    (hM : M.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) :
    (∃ U : SmallEtale B S hS F, IsSurjective B S hS U.1.hom ∧
        Scheme.Modules.IsLocallyProjective (restrictToChartScheme B S hS F hF M U)) ↔
      ∀ U : SmallEtale B S hS F,
        Scheme.Modules.IsLocallyProjective (restrictToChartScheme B S hS F hF M U)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsLocallyProjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 060R.** A quasi-coherent module on an algebraic space is locally projective if its
restriction to every étale scheme chart is locally projective.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev IsLocallyProjective (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (F : QuasicoherentSheaves.{u, m} B S hS X hX) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyProjective_restrictToChartScheme_modulePullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 060S.** The pullback of a locally projective `𝒪_Y`-module along a
morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces is locally projective.

The source's reduction: choose an étale chart `V` of `Y` surjective on points and lift it
through `f` to an étale chart `U` of `X` surjective on points together with `ψ : U ⟶ V` making
the square commute (Stacks 02X1).  Then `(f^*G)|_U` is the pullback of `G|_V` along `ψ`, so it
is locally projective by Stacks 060M, and Stacks 060Q propagates that to every chart of `X`.

See the implementation notes for the carried hypotheses: `hqcY` is Zariski quasi-coherence of the
chart restrictions of `G`, `hqcX` is quasi-coherence of `f^*G` on the small étale site of `X`,
and `hsquare` is the base-change identity `(f^*G)|_U ≅ ψ^*(G|_V)` at a commuting square of charts
of `f`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyProjective_restrictToChartScheme_modulePullback
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (G : Modules.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2)
    (hqcY : ∀ V : SmallEtale B S hS Y.1,
      (restrictToChartScheme B S hS Y.1 Y.2 G V).IsQuasicoherent)
    (hqcX : ((modulePullback B S hS f).obj G).IsQuasicoherentOnSite)
    (hsquare : ∀ (U : SmallEtale B S hS X.1) (V : SmallEtale B S hS Y.1)
        (ψ : U.1.left ⟶ V.1.left), U.1.hom ≫ f.hom = yoneda.map ψ ≫ V.1.hom →
      (restrictToChartScheme B S hS X.1 X.2 ((modulePullback B S hS f).obj G) U ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map ψ)).obj
          (restrictToChartScheme B S hS Y.1 Y.2 G V)))
    (hG : ∀ V : SmallEtale B S hS Y.1,
      Scheme.Modules.IsLocallyProjective (restrictToChartScheme B S hS Y.1 Y.2 G V))
    (U : SmallEtale B S hS X.1) :
    Scheme.Modules.IsLocallyProjective
      (restrictToChartScheme B S hS X.1 X.2 ((modulePullback B S hS f).obj G) U)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyProjective_restrictToChartScheme_modulePullback_of_isQuasicoherentOnSite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 060S.**  The inverse image of Stacks 03LU of a quasi-coherent
`𝒪_Y`-module whose chart restrictions are locally projective has locally projective chart
restrictions: local projectivity of a quasi-coherent module on an algebraic space is stable
under pullback along an arbitrary morphism of algebraic spaces.

Choose an étale chart `V` of `Y` surjective on points and lift it through `f` to an étale chart
`U₀` of `X` surjective on points with `ψ : U₀ ⟶ V` making the square commute (Stacks 02X1).
Then `(f^*G)|_{U₀}` is the pullback of `G|_V` along `ψ`, so it is locally projective by
Stacks 060M, and Stacks 060Q propagates that to every chart of `X`; quasi-coherence of `f^*G`,
which the latter step needs, is Stacks 03GA.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyProjective_restrictToChartScheme_modulePullback_of_isQuasicoherentOnSite
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (G : Modules.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2)
    (hG : G.IsQuasicoherentOnSite)
    (hproj : ∀ V : SmallEtale B S hS Y.1,
      Scheme.Modules.IsLocallyProjective (restrictToChartScheme B S hS Y.1 Y.2 G V))
    (U : SmallEtale B S hS X.1) :
    Scheme.Modules.IsLocallyProjective
      (restrictToChartScheme B S hS X.1 X.2 ((modulePullback B S hS f).obj G) U)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteType_of_pullback_fpqc
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 060U.** A quasi-coherent module on an algebraic space whose inverse image along
every member of an fpqc covering is of finite type is itself of finite type, finite type being
read on the restriction to every étale scheme chart.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteType_of_pullback_fpqc
    {I : Type v} {X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (Xᵢ : I → AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (f : ∀ i, Xᵢ i ⟶ X) (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.obj X.property)
    (hF : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite)
    (hf : IsFpqcCovering B S hS fun i ↦ (f i).hom)
    (hft : ∀ (i : I) (W : SmallEtale B S hS (Xᵢ i).obj),
      (restrictToChart B S hS (Xᵢ i).property
        ((modulePullback B S hS (f i)).obj F) W).IsFiniteType) :
    ∀ V : SmallEtale B S hS X.obj,
      (restrictToChart B S hS X.property F V).IsFiniteType
declarations.comment: finite type read on the restriction to every etale scheme chart; at the module universe of the structure rings

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFinitePresentation_of_pullback_fpqc
declarations.doc:
Let `F` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module on an algebraic space `X` and let
`{f_i : X_i → X}` be an fpqc covering such that each `f_i^* F` is an `𝒪_{X_i}`-module of finite
presentation. Then `F` is an `𝒪_X`-module of finite presentation.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFinitePresentation_of_pullback_fpqc {I : Type v} {X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
    (Xᵢ : I → AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) (f : ∀ i, Xᵢ i ⟶ X)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.obj X.property) (hF : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite)
    (hf : IsFpqcCovering B S hS fun i ↦ (f i).hom)
    (hfp : ∀ i, ((modulePullback B S hS (f i)).obj F).IsFinitePresentation) :
    F.IsFinitePresentation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFlat_of_pullback_fpqc
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 060W.** A quasi-coherent module on an algebraic space whose inverse image along
every member of an fpqc covering is flat is itself flat, flatness being read on the restriction
to every étale scheme chart.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFlat_of_pullback_fpqc
    {I : Type v} {X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (Xᵢ : I → AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (f : ∀ i, Xᵢ i ⟶ X) (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.obj X.property)
    (hF : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite)
    (hf : IsFpqcCovering B S hS fun i ↦ (f i).hom)
    (hflat : ∀ (i : I) (W : SmallEtale B S hS (Xᵢ i).obj),
      SheafOfModules.IsFlat.{u, u, u, u} (O := (etaleChartScheme B S hS W).toRingedSpace.sheaf)
        (restrictToChart B S hS (Xᵢ i).property
          ((modulePullback B S hS (f i)).obj F) W)) :
    ∀ V : SmallEtale B S hS X.obj,
      SheafOfModules.IsFlat.{u, u, u, u} (O := (etaleChartScheme B S hS V).toRingedSpace.sheaf)
        (restrictToChart B S hS X.property F V)
declarations.comment: flatness read on the restriction to every etale scheme chart; at the module universe of the structure rings

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_of_pullback_isFpqcCovering_of_isQuasicoherentOnSite
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be an algebraic space over `S`, let `𝓕` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module and let
`{f i : X i ⟶ X}` be an fpqc covering of `X` such that every pullback `(f i)^*𝓕` is finite locally
free. Then `𝓕` is finite locally free.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_of_pullback_isFpqcCovering_of_isQuasicoherentOnSite
    {I : Type v} {X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} {Xi : I → AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
    (f : ∀ i, Xi i ⟶ X) (hf : IsFpqcCovering B S hS fun i ↦ (f i).hom)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.obj X.property) (hF : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite)
    (hFlf : ∀ i, SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite
      ((modulePullback B S hS (f i)).obj F)) :
    SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyProjective_of_pullback_fpqc
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 060Y.** A quasi-coherent module on an algebraic space whose inverse image along
every member of an fpqc covering is locally projective is itself locally projective, in the
chartwise sense of Stacks 060R.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyProjective_of_pullback_fpqc
    {I : Type v} {X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (Xᵢ : I → AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (f : ∀ i, Xᵢ i ⟶ X) (F : QuasicoherentSheaves.{u, u} B S hS X.obj X.property)
    (hf : IsFpqcCovering B S hS fun i ↦ (f i).hom)
    (hproj : ∀ i, IsLocallyProjective B S hS (Xᵢ i).property
      ⟨(modulePullback B S hS (f i)).obj F.obj,
        isQuasicoherentOnSite_modulePullback_of_isQuasicoherentOnSite B S hS (f i)
          F.obj F.property⟩) :
    IsLocallyProjective B S hS X.property F
declarations.comment: local projectivity in the chartwise sense of Tag 060R; at the module universe of the structure rings

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteType_iff_smallBaseChangePushforward_of_isQuasicoherentOnSite
declarations.doc:
For a finite morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module `F` is
of finite type if and only if its direct image `f_*F` is.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteType_iff_smallBaseChangePushforward_of_isQuasicoherentOnSite
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsFinite B S hS f.hom)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (hqc : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) :
    F.IsFiniteType ↔
      ((smallBaseChangeModulePushforward B S hS f
        (relativelyRepresentable_hom_of_isFinite B S hS f hf)).obj F).IsFiniteType

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFinitePresentation_iff_smallBaseChangePushforward_of_isQuasicoherentOnSite
declarations.doc:
For a finite morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of finite presentation of algebraic spaces a quasi-coherent
`𝒪_X`-module `F` is of finite presentation if and only if its direct image `f_*F` is.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFinitePresentation_iff_smallBaseChangePushforward_of_isQuasicoherentOnSite
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsFinite B S hS f.hom) (hfp : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (hqc : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) :
    F.IsFinitePresentation ↔
      ((smallBaseChangeModulePushforward B S hS f
        (relativelyRepresentable_hom_of_isFinite B S hS f hf)).obj F).IsFinitePresentation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormallyEtale.existsUnique_lift_of_firstOrderThickening
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0611.** A formally étale morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over `S` admits
exactly one dotted arrow in a solid square over a first-order thickening `T ⊂ T'` of algebraic
spaces over `S`. No affineness is assumed of either space of the thickening: the affineness of
the test objects in the definition of formal étaleness, Stacks 049S part (2), may be dropped.
declarations.statement:
theorem FormallyEtale.existsUnique_lift_of_firstOrderThickening
    {X Y T' : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : FormallyEtale f.hom)
    (T : Subfunctor T'.obj) (hT : IsFirstOrderThickening B S hS T' T)
    (a : T.toFunctor ⟶ X.obj) (b : T'.obj ⟶ Y.obj) (hsq : a ≫ f.hom = T.ι ≫ b) :
    ∃! c : T'.obj ⟶ X.obj, T.ι ≫ c = a ∧ c ≫ f.hom = b

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallyEtale_of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0613.** A base change of a formally étale morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is
formally étale: if `fst, snd, f, g` is a cartesian square of algebraic spaces over `S` and `f`
is formally étale, then so is `snd`.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallyEtale_iff_sub_eq_top
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0614, the equivalence of (1) and (2).**  A morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces
over `S` admitting a universal first order thickening `X ⊂ X'` over `Y` is formally étale exactly
when that thickening is trivial, that is when the smaller space is the whole of `X'`.

The formal unramifiedness of `f` which clause (2) of the source states alongside the triviality
of the thickening is part of the datum of Stacks 0607 and so does not appear; see the
implementation notes.
declarations.statement:
theorem formallyEtale_iff_sub_eq_top (t : UniversalFirstOrderThickening B S hS f) :
    FormallyEtale f.hom ↔ t.sub = ⊤

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isZero_conormalSheaf_of_sub_eq_top
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0614, (2) implies (3).**  If the smaller space of a universal first order
thickening of `X` over `Y` is the whole ambient space, then the conormal sheaf `𝒞_{X/Y}` of
Stacks 0607 vanishes.

The inclusion of the smaller space is then invertible, so it is retracted by its inverse and the
defining ideal of the smaller space vanishes on every étale chart.  The conormal sheaf is an
inverse image of that ideal sheaf along two morphisms of algebraic spaces, and an inverse image
of modules preserves zero objects, being a left adjoint.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_conormalSheaf_of_sub_eq_top (t : UniversalFirstOrderThickening B S hS f)
    (hsub : t.sub = ⊤) : IsZero (conormalSheaf B S hS t)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sub_eq_top_of_isZero_conormalSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0614, (3) implies (2).**  If the conormal sheaf `𝒞_{X/Y}` of Stacks 0607 vanishes
then the smaller space of the universal first order thickening is the whole ambient space.

This is where Stacks 04CN, part (3) is spent, in the only form the argument needs: for a
*first-order* thickening the unit `𝓘 ⟶ i_*i^*𝓘` of `i^* ⊣ i_*` is an isomorphism — the
identification `𝓘/𝓘² = 𝓘` of the source, which
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.firstOrderConormalModuleIso` supplies from the essential-image clause
of Stacks 04CJ — so the vanishing of the conormal module forces the defining ideal of `X` in
`X'` to vanish on every étale chart.  The injectivity clause of Stacks 03MB
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.le_of_definingIdealSheaf_le`) then returns `t.sub = ⊤`.

It is the converse of `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isZero_conormalSheaf_of_sub_eq_top`, and the two
are the content of the equivalence of clauses (2) and (3) of Stacks 0614.  Composed with
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallyEtale_iff_sub_eq_top` it derives clause (1) from clause (3) as
well, which is what closes the equivalence of (3) with the other clauses.  The formal
unramifiedness that clause (3) states alongside the vanishing of the conormal sheaf is part of
the datum of Stacks 0607 and so does not appear; see the implementation notes.
declarations.statement:
theorem sub_eq_top_of_isZero_conormalSheaf (t : UniversalFirstOrderThickening B S hS f)
    (h : IsZero (conormalSheaf B S hS t)) : t.sub = ⊤

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallyEtale_of_isZero_sheafOfDifferentials_of_isZero_conormalSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0614, (4) implies (1), for the datum of Stacks 0607.**  If the sheaf of
differentials `Ω_{X/Y}` of Stacks 04CT and the conormal sheaf `𝒞_{X/Y}` of Stacks 0607 both
vanish, then `f : X ⟶ Y` is formally étale.

The `formallyUnramified` field of the datum `t` is **not** an extra hypothesis: it is a
consequence of the universal property that the rest of `t` carries, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallyUnramified_of_isUniversal`.  The form of this implication in
which that field never appears is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallyEtale_of_isZero_conormalSheaf_of_isUniversal`, and this
statement follows from it; it is kept because `t` is the shape every other clause of the tag is
stated in.

The `Ω_{X/Y} = 0` conjunct is again not consumed, for the reason recorded there: the datum
already forces it.
declarations.statement:
theorem formallyEtale_of_isZero_sheafOfDifferentials_of_isZero_conormalSheaf
    (t : UniversalFirstOrderThickening B S hS f)
    (h : IsZero (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS f) ∧ IsZero (conormalSheaf B S hS t)) :
    FormallyEtale f.hom
declarations.comment: (4) implies (1), for the datum of Stacks 0607

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isZero_sheafOfDifferentials_and_isZero_conormalSheaf_of_formallyUnramified
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0614, (3) implies (4).**  If `f : X ⟶ Y` is formally unramified and the conormal
sheaf `𝒞_{X/Y}` of Stacks 0607 vanishes, then the sheaf of differentials `Ω_{X/Y}` of
Stacks 04CT vanishes too and so does `𝒞_{X/Y}`.

Since clauses (1), (2) and (3) are mutually equivalent outright — by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallyEtale_iff_sub_eq_top`,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isZero_conormalSheaf_of_sub_eq_top` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sub_eq_top_of_isZero_conormalSheaf` — this is at the same time the
implication from clause (1) and the implication from clause (2).

The content is the forward direction of Stacks 04G9, which is available with no assumed
input as `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isZero_sheafOfDifferentials_of_formallyUnramified`; the second
conjunct is carried through unchanged.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_sheafOfDifferentials_and_isZero_conormalSheaf_of_formallyUnramified
    (t : UniversalFirstOrderThickening B S hS f)
    (h : FormallyUnramified f.hom ∧ IsZero (conormalSheaf B S hS t)) :
    IsZero (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS f) ∧ IsZero (conormalSheaf B S hS t)
declarations.comment:
(3) implies (4), hence also (1) implies (4) and (2) implies (4) through the
  proved equivalence of (1), (2) and (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallyEtale_tfae_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0614, with no hypotheses at all.**  Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic
spaces over `S`.  Then the four conditions

1. `f` is formally étale,
2. `f` is formally unramified and the universal first order thickening of `X` over `Y` is `X`,
3. `f` is formally unramified and `𝒞_{X/Y} = 0`,
4. `Ω_{X/Y} = 0` and `𝒞_{X/Y} = 0`

are equivalent.  Nothing is assumed about `f`: no universal first order thickening is a
parameter, and no formal unramifiedness is a hypothesis.

**How the thickening leaves the hypotheses.**  Stacks 0607 defines `𝒞_{X/Y}` relative to a
universal first order thickening, so `𝒞_{X/Y} = 0` is a statement quantified over those
thickenings; `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.forall_isZero_conormalSheaf_iff_exists` shows the two
quantifiers agree for a formally unramified `f`, which is the source's definite article.  The
quantifier written in each clause is the one the source's own reading of that clause supplies:
clauses (2) and (3) state formal unramifiedness, from which Stacks 0606 produces the thickening,
so they are read with `∀`; clause (4) does not, and the source's remark that it "only makes
sense because `Ω_{X/Y} = 0` implies that `𝒞_{X/Y}` is defined" is exactly the assertion that a
thickening exists, so it is read with `∃`.

**Where Stacks 0606 is spent.**  In the step from (3) to (4), to produce the thickening whose
conormal sheaf the existential of clause (4) names:
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.nonempty_universalFirstOrderThickening` of
`StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Spaces/Thickenings/UniversalExistence.lean`.  This is what the
earlier statements of this file carried as a parameter.

**The backward direction of Stacks 04G9 is still not used, and is not needed.**  The source gets
formal unramifiedness out of clause (4) through it.  Here clause (4) carries a thickening in its
existential instead, and a thickening forces formal unramifiedness by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallyUnramified_of_isUniversal` — which is also why the step from (4)
to (1) needs nothing beyond the equivalence of (1) and (3).
declarations.statement:
theorem formallyEtale_tfae_unconditional :
    List.TFAE
      [FormallyEtale f.hom,
        FormallyUnramified f.hom ∧
          ∀ t : UniversalFirstOrderThickening B S hS f, t.sub = ⊤,
        FormallyUnramified f.hom ∧
          ∀ t : UniversalFirstOrderThickening B S hS f, IsZero (conormalSheaf B S hS t),
        IsZero (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS f) ∧
          ∃ t : UniversalFirstOrderThickening B S hS f, IsZero (conormalSheaf B S hS t)]
declarations.comment:
the equivalence of the four conditions, with no hypotheses: Stacks 0606 supplies
  the universal first order thickening

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallyEtale_iff_isZero_sheafOfDifferentials_and_exists_isZero_conormalSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0614, the equivalence of (1) and (4), with no hypotheses.**  A morphism
`f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over `S` is formally étale exactly when the sheaf of
differentials `Ω_{X/Y}` of Stacks 04CT vanishes and `X` admits a universal first order thickening
over `Y` whose conormal sheaf `𝒞_{X/Y}` of Stacks 0607 vanishes.

The existential is the source's reading of clause (4), whose remark on that clause is that
`𝒞_{X/Y}` has to be defined before the clause says anything; see
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallyEtale_tfae_unconditional`, of which this is the
instance at indices 1 and 4.
declarations.statement:
theorem formallyEtale_iff_isZero_sheafOfDifferentials_and_exists_isZero_conormalSheaf :
    FormallyEtale f.hom ↔
      IsZero (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS f) ∧
        ∃ t : UniversalFirstOrderThickening B S hS f, IsZero (conormalSheaf B S hS t)
declarations.comment: the equivalence of (1) and (4), with no hypotheses

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallyEtale_of_isUnramified_of_isFlat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0615.** A flat unramified morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is formally étale.

Unramifiedness and flatness are conditions on the étale charts of the morphism, and on each
chart Tag 04FF makes the morphism of schemes formally étale; Tag 04GD assembles those into
formal étaleness of the morphism of algebraic spaces.
declarations.statement:
theorem formallyEtale_of_isUnramified_of_isFlat
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hu : IsUnramified B S hS f) (hflat : IsFlat B S hS f) :
    FormallyEtale f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEtale_iff_isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_and_formallyEtale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0616.** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is étale if and only if it is
locally of finite presentation and formally étale.

All three conditions are conditions on the same squares of étale scheme charts — étaleness by
Tag 03XT, local finite presentation by Tag 03XP and formal étaleness by Tag 04GD — so the
statement is the scheme-level equivalence of Tag 02HM quantified over the charts, together
with the distribution of a universal quantifier over a conjunction.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEtale_iff_isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_and_formallyEtale
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    IsEtale B S hS f ↔ (IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f ∧ FormallyEtale f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftDifferenceDerivation
declarations.doc:
**The difference of two lifts, as a bundled derivation.**  For `f, g : R ⟶ 𝒪_X` which agree
after the structure map of a first-order thickening `Z ⊆ X` and which agree on a base sheaf of
rings `R₀`, the sectionwise difference `f - g` is a `Derivation'` of `R` over `R₀` with values in
the defining ideal of `Z`.

Its four fields are `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftDifference_add`,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftDifference_smul_add_smul`,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftDifference_naturality` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftDifference_app_eq_zero`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def liftDifferenceDerivation (hZ : IsFirstOrderThickening B S hS X Z.1)
    (hfg : f ≫ structureSharp B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z) =
      g ≫ structureSharp B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z))
    (hφ : (sheafCompose (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1)
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).map φc ≫ f =
      (sheafCompose (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1)
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).map φc ≫ g) :
    PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.Derivation' (liftDifferenceCoefficients B S hS Z f) φc.hom
declarations.comment: the derivation D of the source, bundled as a `PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.Derivation'`, for two abstract algebra maps

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftPairDerivation
declarations.doc:
**The derivation `D` of [Stacks Project, Tag 0618].**  Let `G ⊂ X'` be a first-order
thickening of algebraic spaces with inclusion `i : X ⟶ X'` and let `a', b' : X' ⟶ Y'` be two
morphisms with `i ≫ a' = i ≫ b'`, both of them maps of `R₀`-algebras for a sheaf of commutative
rings `R₀` on the small étale site of `X'` — for two morphisms of thickenings over `B` the last
condition is that both are maps of `𝒪_B`-algebras.  Then the difference of the two structure maps
`(a')^♯, (b')^♯ : (b')^{-1}𝒪_{Y'} ⟶ 𝒪_{X'}`, the first read through
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.commRingInverseImageIsoOfRestrictEq`, is a derivation of
`(b')^{-1}𝒪_{Y'}` over `R₀` with values in the defining ideal of the thickening.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftDifferenceDerivation` at the pair of structure maps supplied
by `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.inverseImageStructureSharpOfRestrictEq_comp_structureSharp`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def liftPairDerivation (hZ : IsFirstOrderThickening B S hS X' G)
    (hφ : (sheafCompose (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X'.1)
            (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).map φc ≫
          (sheafCompose (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X'.1)
            (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).map
            (inverseImageStructureSharpOfRestrictEq B S hS hG a' b' h) =
      (sheafCompose (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X'.1)
            (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).map φc ≫
          (sheafCompose (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X'.1)
            (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).map
            (structureSharpInverseImage B S hS b')) :
    PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.Derivation' (liftDifferenceCoefficients B S hS ⟨G, hG.1⟩
        ((sheafCompose (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X'.1)
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).map
          (inverseImageStructureSharpOfRestrictEq B S hS hG a' b' h))) φc.hom
declarations.comment: the derivation D of the source, bundled, for the two structure maps of two morphisms of a thickening agreeing on its closed subspace

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftDifference
declarations.doc:
The difference of two maps into the structure sheaf which agree on a closed subspace: if
`f, g : R ⟶ 𝒪_X` become equal after the structure map `i^♯ : 𝒪_X ⟶ i_*𝒪_Z` of the inclusion of
a closed subspace `Z ⊆ X`, the sectionwise difference `f - g`, as a section of the defining ideal
of `Z`, the sectionwise kernel of `i^♯`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def liftDifference
    (hfg : f ≫ structureSharp B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z) =
      g ≫ structureSharp B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z))
    (U : (SmallEtale B S hS X.1)ᵒᵖ) (r : R.obj.obj U) :
    definingIdealAt B S hS X Z U
declarations.comment: the derivation, for two abstract algebra maps; no descent to 𝒪_Y

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftDifference_add
declarations.doc: The difference of two lifts is additive.
declarations.statement:
theorem liftDifference_add
    (hfg : f ≫ structureSharp B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z) =
      g ≫ structureSharp B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z))
    (U : (SmallEtale B S hS X.1)ᵒᵖ) (r s : R.obj.obj U) :
    liftDifference B S hS Z f g hfg U (r + s) =
      liftDifference B S hS Z f g hfg U r + liftDifference B S hS Z f g hfg U s
declarations.comment: the derivation, for two abstract algebra maps; no descent to 𝒪_Y

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftDifference_smul_add_smul
declarations.doc:
The Leibniz rule for the difference `D` of two lifts into a first-order thickening, for the
`R`-action on the defining ideal obtained by restricting scalars along `f`:
`D (r * s) = f r • D s + f s • D r`.
declarations.statement:
theorem liftDifference_smul_add_smul (hZ : IsFirstOrderThickening B S hS X Z.1)
    (hfg : f ≫ structureSharp B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z) =
      g ≫ structureSharp B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z))
    (U : (SmallEtale B S hS X.1)ᵒᵖ) (r s : R.obj.obj U) :
    liftDifference B S hS Z f g hfg U (r * s) =
      f.hom.app U r • liftDifference B S hS Z f g hfg U s +
        f.hom.app U s • liftDifference B S hS Z f g hfg U r
declarations.comment: the derivation, for two abstract algebra maps; no descent to 𝒪_Y

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftDifference_app_eq_zero
declarations.doc: If the two maps agree on `R₀`, their difference vanishes on sections coming from `R₀`.
declarations.statement:
theorem liftDifference_app_eq_zero
    (hfg : f ≫ structureSharp B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z) =
      g ≫ structureSharp B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z))
    (hφ : φ ≫ f = φ ≫ g) (U : (SmallEtale B S hS X.1)ᵒᵖ) (r : R₀.obj.obj U) :
    liftDifference B S hS Z f g hfg U (φ.hom.app U r) = 0
declarations.comment: the derivation, for two abstract algebra maps; no descent to 𝒪_Y

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftDifference_eq_zero_of_apply_eq
declarations.doc: The difference of two lifts annihilates a section on which the two maps agree.
declarations.statement:
theorem liftDifference_eq_zero_of_apply_eq
    (hfg : f ≫ structureSharp B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z) =
      g ≫ structureSharp B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z))
    {U : (SmallEtale B S hS X.1)ᵒᵖ} {r : R.obj.obj U}
    (hr : f.hom.app U r = g.hom.app U r) :
    liftDifference B S hS Z f g hfg U r = 0
declarations.comment: the derivation, for two abstract algebra maps; no descent to 𝒪_Y

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftDifference_naturality
declarations.doc: The difference of two lifts commutes with the restriction maps of the small étale site.
declarations.statement:
theorem liftDifference_naturality
    (hfg : f ≫ structureSharp B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z) =
      g ≫ structureSharp B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z))
    {U V : (SmallEtale B S hS X.1)ᵒᵖ} (h : U ⟶ V) (r : R.obj.obj U) :
    ((structureRingSheaf B S hS X).obj.map h).hom
        ((liftDifference B S hS Z f g hfg U r : definingIdealAt B S hS X Z U) :
          (structureRingSheaf B S hS X).obj.obj U) =
      ((liftDifference B S hS Z f g hfg V ((R.obj.map h).hom r) :
        definingIdealAt B S hS X Z V) : (structureRingSheaf B S hS X).obj.obj V)
declarations.comment: the derivation, for two abstract algebra maps; no descent to 𝒪_Y

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.firstOrderConormalModuleι_liftDifference
declarations.doc:
The difference of two lifts into a first-order thickening, carried into the pushed-forward
conormal module `i_*𝒞_{Z/X}` by `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.firstOrderConormalModuleIso` and
included back into `𝒪_X` by `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.firstOrderConormalModuleι`, is `f - g`.
declarations.statement:
theorem firstOrderConormalModuleι_liftDifference (hZ : IsFirstOrderThickening B S hS X Z.1)
    (hfg : f ≫ structureSharp B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z) =
      g ≫ structureSharp B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z))
    (U : (SmallEtale B S hS X.1)ᵒᵖ) (r : R.obj.obj U) :
    (firstOrderConormalModuleι B S hS Z hZ).val.app U
        ((firstOrderConormalModuleIso B S hS Z hZ).hom.val.app U
          (liftDifference B S hS Z f g hfg U r)) =
      f.hom.app U r - g.hom.app U r
declarations.comment: the derivation, for two abstract algebra maps; no descent to 𝒪_Y

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_derivation_of_conormalMap_eq
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 0618].**  Let `(e₀, c), (e₀, c') : (Z ⊂ X) ⟶ (W₀ ⊂ W)` be two morphisms
of first order thickenings over `T` with the same reduction `e₀` (condition (1)) and the same
map `e₀^*𝒞_{W₀/W} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X}` of [Stacks Project, Tag 04CP] (condition (2)).  Then there is an
`𝒪_T`-derivation `D : 𝒪_{W₀} ⟶ (e₀)_*𝒞_{Z/X}` through which the difference of the comorphisms
factors: read as maps `j^{-1}𝒪_W ⟶ (e₀)_*(i^{-1}𝒪_X)`, `c^♯ − (c')^♯ = ι ∘ D ∘ j^♯`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_derivation_of_conormalMap_eq (c c' : X ⟶ W)
    (hc : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c = e₀ ≫ subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)
    (hc' : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c' = e₀ ≫ subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)
    (p : X ⟶ T) (hcq : c ≫ q = p) (hcq' : c' ≫ q = p)
    (hcon : conormalMap B S hS Z W₀ c e₀ hc = conormalMap B S hS Z W₀ c' e₀ hc') :
    ∃ D : PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.Derivation'
        ((modulePushforward B S hS e₀).obj (conormalModule B S hS X Z)).val
        (structureSharpInverseImage B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀ ≫ q)).hom,
      ∀ (V : (SmallEtale B S hS (⟨W₀.1.toFunctor, W₀.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS).1)ᵒᵖ)
        (x : ToType ((structureRingSheafInverseImage B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS W
            W₀)).obj.obj V)),
        (restrictedSquareZeroValues B S hS Z W₀ e₀ hZ).ι
            (D.d (X := V) ((structureSharpRingInverseImage B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS W
                W₀)).hom.app V x)) =
          (restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z W₀ c e₀ hc).hom.app V x -
            (restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z W₀ c' e₀ hc').hom.app V x
declarations.comment: (a')^♯ − (b')^♯ factors as 𝒪_{Y'} → 𝒪_Y → a_*𝒞_{X/X'} → a_*𝒪_{X'} through an 𝒪_B-derivation D, read on the small étale site of Y

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.descend_restrictedLiftDifferenceData_app_inverseImage_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**The descended difference of two morphisms over a base kills the functions read from that
base.**  For `c, c' : X ⟶ W` agreeing on the thickening `Z ⊂ X` and over `qb : W ⟶ Bas`, the
derivation their difference descends to vanishes on every section of `𝒪_{W₀}` of the form
`j^♯(j^{-1}(qb^♯)(x))`.

The two transported comorphisms agree after `j^{-1}(qb^♯)` — that is
`inverseImage_structureSharpRingInverseImage_comp_restrictedSharpThroughThickening_eq'`
at an arbitrary target `Bas` — and a difference which vanishes after a morphism into the ambient
sheaf of rings descends to one vanishing on the sections that morphism accounts for, which is
`Stacks.Sites.LiftDifferenceData.descend_eq_zero_of_comp_eq`.

This is the pair-of-morphisms counterpart of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivationFamilyOfHom_app_inverseImage_eq_zero`.
declarations.statement:
theorem descend_restrictedLiftDifferenceData_app_inverseImage_eq_zero
    [HasSheafify (SmallEtale.topology B S hS
      (⟨W₀.1.toFunctor, W₀.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS).1) AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    (A : (SmallEtale B S hS
      (⟨W₀.1.toFunctor, W₀.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS).1)ᵒᵖ)
    (x : ToType (((smallEtaleInverseImageRing B S hS
      (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).obj
      (inverseImageStructureSheaf B S hS qb)).obj.obj A)) :
    (restrictedLiftDifferenceData B S hS Z W₀ e₀ hZ c c' h h' hker).toQuotientDerivation.descend
        ((structureSharpRingInverseImage B S hS
            (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).hom.app A
          (((inverseImageRingFunctor (smallToposMorphismTypeU B S hS
              (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀))).map
            (structureSharpRingInverseImage B S hS qb)).hom.app A x)) =
      0
declarations.comment: the descended difference of two morphisms over a base kills the functions read from that base, which is what makes it a derivation over the base

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.descend_restrictedLiftDifferenceData_structureSharpInverseImage_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**The descended difference of two morphisms over a base is a derivation over that base**, in
the shape `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftDifferenceDifferentialsHom` asks for it: it kills every
section of `𝒪_{W₀}` read from `Bas` along the composite `j ≫ qb`.

This is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.descend_restrictedLiftDifferenceData_app_inverseImage_eq_zero`, whose
sections are read through `j^{-1}(qb^♯)` and then `j^♯`, carried onto the structure map of the
composite by `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.app_structureSharpInverseImage_comp`; the two coefficient
readings of the inverse-image structure maps agree on sections by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.app_inverseImage_structureSharpRingInverseImage` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.structureSharpRingInverseImage_eq_forget₂`.

Taking `b := j ≫ qb` for the base datum of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftDifferenceDifferentialsHom`, this is the hypothesis `hz` of that
descent — the second of the two vanishing conditions, the first being hypothesis (2) of
[Stacks Project, Tag 0618].
declarations.statement:
theorem descend_restrictedLiftDifferenceData_structureSharpInverseImage_eq_zero
    [HasSheafify (SmallEtale.topology B S hS
      (⟨W₀.1.toFunctor, W₀.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS).1) AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    (V : (SmallEtale B S hS
      (⟨W₀.1.toFunctor, W₀.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS).1)ᵒᵖ)
    (s : ToType ((inverseImageStructureSheaf B S hS
      (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀ ≫ qb)).obj.obj V)) :
    (restrictedLiftDifferenceData B S hS Z W₀ e₀ hZ c c' h h' hker).toQuotientDerivation.descend
        ((structureSharpInverseImage B S hS
          (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀ ≫ qb)).hom.app V s) =
      0
declarations.comment: the hypothesis hz of the descent, discharged: the descended difference of two morphisms over a base kills the sections read from that base along the composite

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictedLiftDifferenceHom
declarations.doc:
**The linear map `θ : e₀^*Ω_{W₀/Bas} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X}` by which two morphisms agreeing on the
thickening and over `qb` differ.**  This is
[Stacks Project, Tag 0618] together with Equation [Stacks Project, Tag 0619], in the direction
from a pair of morphisms to a linear map.

The pair of comorphisms is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictedLiftDifferenceData` and the descent
is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftDifferenceDifferentialsHom`; its two hypotheses are the datum's
own `hker` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.descend_restrictedLiftDifferenceData_structureSharpInverseImage_eq_zero`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev restrictedLiftDifferenceHom (c c' : X ⟶ W)
    (h : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c = e₀ ≫ subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)
    (h' : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c' = e₀ ≫ subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)
    (hker : ∀ (V : (SmallEtale B S hS
        (⟨W₀.1.toFunctor, W₀.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS).1)ᵒᵖ)
      (x : (structureRingSheafInverseImage B S hS
        (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).obj.obj V),
      (structureSharpRingInverseImage B S hS
          (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).hom.app V x = 0 →
        (restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z W₀ c e₀ h).hom.app V x =
          (restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z W₀ c' e₀ h').hom.app V x)
    (hcc : c ≫ qb = c' ≫ qb) :
    (modulePullback B S hS e₀).obj
        (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀ ≫ qb)) ⟶
      conormalModule B S hS X Z
declarations.comment: the difference of two morphisms agreeing on the thickening and over the base, as a linear map out of the pulled back differentials

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictedLiftDifferenceHom_self
declarations.doc:
**A morphism does not differ from itself:** the linear map of the pair `(c, c)` is zero.

The two maps of `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictedLiftDifferenceData` at that pair are the same
transported comorphism, so `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftDifferenceDifferentialsHom_eq_zero`
applies.

This is the field `equiv_self` of `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.LiftDerivationAction` read at this
difference.
declarations.statement:
theorem restrictedLiftDifferenceHom_self (c : X ⟶ W)
    (h : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c = e₀ ≫ subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)
    (hker : ∀ (V : (SmallEtale B S hS
        (⟨W₀.1.toFunctor, W₀.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS).1)ᵒᵖ)
      (x : (structureRingSheafInverseImage B S hS
        (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).obj.obj V),
      (structureSharpRingInverseImage B S hS
          (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).hom.app V x = 0 →
        (restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z W₀ c e₀ h).hom.app V x =
          (restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z W₀ c e₀ h).hom.app V x)
    (hcc : c ≫ qb = c ≫ qb) :
    restrictedLiftDifferenceHom B S hS Z W₀ hZ e₀ qb c c h h hker hcc = 0
declarations.comment: a morphism does not differ from itself: the linear map of the pair (c, c) is zero

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictedLiftDifferenceHom_add
declarations.doc:
**The cocycle identity:** the linear maps of three morphisms add along the chain,
`θ(c₁, c₂) + θ(c₂, c₃) = θ(c₁, c₃)`.

The three pairs of transported comorphisms are `(f₁, f₂)`, `(f₂, f₃)` and `(f₁, f₃)` inside one
and the same square-zero ideal, so
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftDifferenceDifferentialsHom_add` applies with all three of its
index equations holding by `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictedLiftDifferenceData_f` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictedLiftDifferenceData_g`.

This is the field `equiv_add_equiv` of `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.LiftDerivationAction` read at
this difference.
declarations.statement:
theorem restrictedLiftDifferenceHom_add (c₁ c₂ c₃ : X ⟶ W)
    (h₁ : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c₁ = e₀ ≫ subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)
    (h₂ : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c₂ = e₀ ≫ subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)
    (h₃ : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c₃ = e₀ ≫ subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)
    (hker₁₂ : ∀ (V : (SmallEtale B S hS
        (⟨W₀.1.toFunctor, W₀.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS).1)ᵒᵖ)
      (x : (structureRingSheafInverseImage B S hS
        (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).obj.obj V),
      (structureSharpRingInverseImage B S hS
          (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).hom.app V x = 0 →
        (restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z W₀ c₁ e₀ h₁).hom.app V x =
          (restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z W₀ c₂ e₀ h₂).hom.app V x)
    (hker₂₃ : ∀ (V : (SmallEtale B S hS
        (⟨W₀.1.toFunctor, W₀.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS).1)ᵒᵖ)
      (x : (structureRingSheafInverseImage B S hS
        (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).obj.obj V),
      (structureSharpRingInverseImage B S hS
          (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).hom.app V x = 0 →
        (restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z W₀ c₂ e₀ h₂).hom.app V x =
          (restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z W₀ c₃ e₀ h₃).hom.app V x)
    (hker₁₃ : ∀ (V : (SmallEtale B S hS
        (⟨W₀.1.toFunctor, W₀.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS).1)ᵒᵖ)
      (x : (structureRingSheafInverseImage B S hS
        (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).obj.obj V),
      (structureSharpRingInverseImage B S hS
          (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).hom.app V x = 0 →
        (restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z W₀ c₁ e₀ h₁).hom.app V x =
          (restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z W₀ c₃ e₀ h₃).hom.app V x)
    (hcc₁₂ : c₁ ≫ qb = c₂ ≫ qb) (hcc₂₃ : c₂ ≫ qb = c₃ ≫ qb)
    (hcc₁₃ : c₁ ≫ qb = c₃ ≫ qb) :
    restrictedLiftDifferenceHom B S hS Z W₀ hZ e₀ qb c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂ hker₁₂ hcc₁₂ +
        restrictedLiftDifferenceHom B S hS Z W₀ hZ e₀ qb c₂ c₃ h₂ h₃ hker₂₃ hcc₂₃ =
      restrictedLiftDifferenceHom B S hS Z W₀ hZ e₀ qb c₁ c₃ h₁ h₃ hker₁₃ hcc₁₃
declarations.comment: the cocycle identity: the linear maps of three morphisms agreeing on the thickening and over the base add along the chain

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_derivation_restrictedSharpThroughThickening_sub
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 0618].**  Let `Z ⊆ X` and `W₀ ⊆ W` be first-order thickenings of
algebraic spaces over an algebraic space `T`, and let `(f, c)` and `(f, c')` be two morphisms of
thickenings over `T` with the same restriction `f : Z ⟶ W₀` and equal canonical maps
`f^*𝒞_{W₀/W} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X}` of [Stacks Project, Tag 04CP].  Then there is an `𝒪_T`-derivation `D`
of `𝒪_{W₀}` with values in `f_*𝒞_{Z/X}` through which `c^♯ - c'^♯` factors: for every local
section `x` of `𝒪_W`, read on `W₀`, the difference of the two comorphisms at `x` is the
inclusion `f_*𝒞_{Z/X} ⟶ f_*𝒪_X` applied to `D` of the image of `x` in `𝒪_{W₀}`.

The reading of `𝒪_W`, `f_*𝒪_X` and the comorphisms on the small étale site of `W₀` is the one
of the module documentation.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_derivation_restrictedSharpThroughThickening_sub
    (hZ : IsFirstOrderThickening B S hS X Z.1)
    (hW₀ : IsFirstOrderThickening B S hS W W₀.1) (c' : X ⟶ W)
    (hsq : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c = f ≫ subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)
    (hsq' : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c' = f ≫ subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)
    {T : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (pX : X ⟶ T) (pW : W ⟶ T) (hc : c ≫ pW = pX)
    (hc' : c' ≫ pW = pX)
    (hC : conormalMap B S hS Z W₀ c f hsq = conormalMap B S hS Z W₀ c' f hsq') :
    ∃ D : PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.Derivation'
        ((modulePushforward B S hS f).obj (conormalModule B S hS X Z)).val
        (structureSharpInverseImage B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀ ≫ pW)).hom,
      ∀ (V : (SmallEtale B S hS (⟨W₀.1.toFunctor, W₀.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS).1)ᵒᵖ)
        (x : ToType ((structureRingSheafInverseImage B S hS
          (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).obj.obj V)),
        (restrictedSquareZeroValues B S hS Z W₀ f hZ).ι
            (D.d ((structureSharpRingInverseImage B S hS
              (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).hom.app V x)) =
          (restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z W₀ c f hsq).hom.app V x -
            (restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z W₀ c' f hsq').hom.app V x
declarations.comment: the full statement: for two morphisms of first order thickenings over T with equal restriction f and equal maps f^*C ⟶ C of 04CP, c^♯ - c'^♯, read on the small étale site of the reduced target, factors as j^♯ : j^{-1}O_W ⟶ O_{W₀} followed by an O_T-derivation D into f_*C_{Z/X} and the inclusion f_*C_{Z/X} ⟶ f_*(i^{-1}O_X)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictedSharpThroughThickening_app_eq_of_top
declarations.doc:
**Hypothesis (2) of [Stacks Project, Tag 0618] for an undeformed target.**  For two
morphisms `c, c' : X ⟶ W` whose restrictions to the thickening `Z ⊂ X` are both `e₀` read
through the inclusion of the *top* closed subspace of `W`, the two transported comorphisms
agree on every section killed by the reduction: there are no such sections but zero, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eq_zero_of_app_structureSharpRingInverseImage_top`.

This is the hypothesis `hker` of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictedLiftDifferenceData`, discharged in the case of
Remark [Stacks Project, Tag 061D]: the target of the lifting problem is not deformed, so the
map `A` out of the conormal module `𝒞_{W/W}` is zero.
declarations.statement:
theorem restrictedSharpThroughThickening_app_eq_of_top {X W : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
    (Z : ClosedSubspaces B S hS X.1)
    (e₀ : (⟨Z.1.toFunctor, Z.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) ⟶
      (⟨(⊤ : Subfunctor W.1).toFunctor, (isClosedSubspace_top B S hS W).1⟩ :
        AlgebraicSpaces B S hS))
    (c c' : X ⟶ W)
    (h : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c =
      e₀ ≫ subspaceInclusion B S hS W ⟨⊤, isClosedSubspace_top B S hS W⟩)
    (h' : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c' =
      e₀ ≫ subspaceInclusion B S hS W ⟨⊤, isClosedSubspace_top B S hS W⟩)
    (V : (SmallEtale B S hS
      (⟨(⊤ : Subfunctor W.1).toFunctor, (isClosedSubspace_top B S hS W).1⟩ :
        AlgebraicSpaces B S hS).1)ᵒᵖ)
    (x : (structureRingSheafInverseImage B S hS
      (subspaceInclusion B S hS W ⟨⊤, isClosedSubspace_top B S hS W⟩)).obj.obj V)
    (hx : (structureSharpRingInverseImage B S hS
      (subspaceInclusion B S hS W ⟨⊤, isClosedSubspace_top B S hS W⟩)).hom.app V x = 0) :
    (restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z
        ⟨⊤, isClosedSubspace_top B S hS W⟩ c e₀ h).hom.app V x =
      (restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z
        ⟨⊤, isClosedSubspace_top B S hS W⟩ c' e₀ h').hom.app V x
declarations.comment: hypothesis (2) for two morphisms into an undeformed target: the kernel of the reduction has no nonzero sections, so the two comorphisms agree on it

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.undeformedLiftDiff
declarations.doc:
**The `𝒪_Z`-linear map `a^*Ω_{W/V} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X}` by which two lifts into an undeformed target
differ.**  The sectionwise difference of their two comorphisms, read as a `V`-derivation of
`𝒪_W` with values in `a_*𝒞_{Z/X}` and transposed to a map out of `a^*Ω_{W/V}`.
declarations.statement:
def undeformedLiftDiff (c c' : X ⟶ W)
    (h : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c = a)
    (h' : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c' = a) (hb : c ≫ b = c' ≫ b) :
    (modulePullback B S hS a).obj (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS b) ⟶
      conormalModule B S hS X Z
declarations.comment: the difference of two lifts of a morphism over a base along a first order thickening of the source, for an UNDEFORMED target, where condition (3) of 061A is vacuous

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.structureSharpOfRestrictEq_comp_pushforward_structureSharp
declarations.doc:
**The two structure maps of two lifts agree after the structure map of the thickening**, for
sheaves of rings.  This is the hypothesis which [Stacks Project, Tag 0618] needs of the pair
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.structureSharpOfRestrictEq`, `(b')^♯`: read into the direct image along
`b'` of `i_*𝒪_X` the two homomorphisms coincide, so their difference takes its values in the
defining ideal of the thickening.

It is the set-level statement with the ring operations carried along: the forgetful functor on
sheaves of rings is faithful, and both the comparison and the direct image of a homomorphism are
known on underlying sheaves of sets.
declarations.statement:
theorem structureSharpOfRestrictEq_comp_pushforward_structureSharp :
    structureSharpOfRestrictEq B S hS hG a' b' h ≫
        pullbackRingSheafMap.{u, u, u, u + 1, u, u + 1} (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y'.1)
          (smallEtaleDirectImage B S hS b')
          (structureSharp B S hS (IsThickening.inclusion B S hS hG)) =
      structureSharp B S hS b' ≫
        pullbackRingSheafMap.{u, u, u, u + 1, u, u + 1} (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y'.1)
          (smallEtaleDirectImage B S hS b')
          (structureSharp B S hS (IsThickening.inclusion B S hS hG))
declarations.comment: the two structure maps of two lifts of one morphism become equal after the structure map of the thickening, so their difference lands in the defining ideal

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.inverseImageStructureSharpOfRestrictEq_comp_structureSharp
declarations.doc:
**The hypothesis `hfg` of `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftDifference` at the pair of structure
maps of two lifts.**  The same statement as
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.inverseImageStructureSharpOfRestrictEq_comp_structureSharpCommRing`,
read for sheaves of rings, which is the level at which the defining ideal of the thickening
lives.

The forgetful functor is applied to the whole equation, so nothing has to be known about what it
does to the comparison of the two inverse images — only about the structure map of the
inclusion, which is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.map_structureSharpCommRing`.
declarations.statement:
theorem inverseImageStructureSharpOfRestrictEq_comp_structureSharp :
    (sheafCompose (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X'.1)
            (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).map
          (inverseImageStructureSharpOfRestrictEq B S hS hG a' b' h) ≫
        structureSharp B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS X' ⟨G, hG.1⟩) =
      (sheafCompose (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X'.1)
            (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).map
          (structureSharpInverseImage B S hS b') ≫
        structureSharp B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS X' ⟨G, hG.1⟩)
declarations.comment: the two structure maps of two lifts, as a pair of parallel homomorphisms into the structure sheaf of the thickening which agree after the structure map of the inclusion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftPairDifference
declarations.doc:
**The difference of the two structure maps of two lifts**, as a section of the defining
ideal of the thickening.  This is the derivation `D` of [Stacks Project, Tag 0618] for two
morphisms `a', b' : X' ⟶ Y'` of a thickening `G ⊂ X'` which agree on its closed subspace: it is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftDifference` applied to the pair of parallel homomorphisms
`(a')^♯, (b')^♯ : (b')^{-1}𝒪_{Y'} ⟶ 𝒪_{X'}`.

Its four defining equations are `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftDifference_add`,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftDifference_smul_add_smul`,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftDifference_app_eq_zero` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftDifference_naturality`, which apply to it verbatim.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def liftPairDifference (U : (SmallEtale B S hS X'.1)ᵒᵖ)
    (r : ((sheafCompose (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X'.1)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj
        (inverseImageStructureSheaf B S hS b')).obj.obj U) :
    definingIdealAt B S hS X' ⟨G, hG.1⟩ U
declarations.comment: the derivation, for the two structure maps of two morphisms of a thickening agreeing on its closed subspace

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.Differentials.universalDerivation_isUniversal
declarations.doc:
Every relative derivation with values in a sheaf of modules factors through the universal
derivation by a unique morphism of sheaves of modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem universalDerivation_isUniversal
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (underlyingRingSheaf O₂))
    (D : SheafDerivation O₁ O₂ φ F) :
    ∃! f : moduleOfDifferentials O₁ O₂ φ ⟶ F,
      (universalDerivation O₁ O₂ φ).postcomp f.val = D
declarations.comment: the factorization D = d o theta of a derivation through the universal derivation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivationDirectImageEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0619.** For `a : X ⟶ Y`, `b : Y ⟶ Z` and an `𝒪_X`-module `C`, the `𝒪_X`-linear
maps `θ : a^*Ω_{Y/Z} ⟶ C` correspond bijectively to the `Z`-derivations `D : 𝒪_Y ⟶ a_*C`, by
`D = d_{Y/Z} ∘ θ` with `θ` transposed along the adjunction `a^* ⊣ a_*`.
declarations.statement:
def derivationDirectImageEquiv (a : X ⟶ Y) (b : Y ⟶ Z)
    (C : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) :
    ((modulePullback B S hS a).obj (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS b) ⟶ C) ≃
      PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.Derivation' ((modulePushforward B S hS a).obj C).val
        (structureSharpInverseImage B S hS b).hom
declarations.comment: the bijection `θ ↔ D = d_{Y/B} ∘ θ`, stated at a general target module

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivationDirectImageEquiv_apply
declarations.doc:
**Equation (0619) itself.**  The derivation attached to `θ : a^*Ω_{Y/Z} ⟶ C` is the
universal derivation `d_{Y/Z}` followed by the transpose of `θ` along `a^* ⊣ a_*`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivationDirectImageEquiv_apply (a : X ⟶ Y) (b : Y ⟶ Z)
    (C : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (θ : (modulePullback B S hS a).obj (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS b) ⟶ C) :
    derivationDirectImageEquiv B S hS a b C θ =
      (universalDerivation B S hS b).postcomp
        (((modulePullbackAdjunction B S hS a).homEquiv _ _) θ).val

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictedLiftDifferenceHom
declarations.doc:
**The linear map `θ : e₀^*Ω_{W₀/Bas} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X}` by which two morphisms agreeing on the
thickening and over `qb` differ.**  This is
[Stacks Project, Tag 0618] together with Equation [Stacks Project, Tag 0619], in the direction
from a pair of morphisms to a linear map.

The pair of comorphisms is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictedLiftDifferenceData` and the descent
is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftDifferenceDifferentialsHom`; its two hypotheses are the datum's
own `hker` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.descend_restrictedLiftDifferenceData_structureSharpInverseImage_eq_zero`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev restrictedLiftDifferenceHom (c c' : X ⟶ W)
    (h : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c = e₀ ≫ subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)
    (h' : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c' = e₀ ≫ subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)
    (hker : ∀ (V : (SmallEtale B S hS
        (⟨W₀.1.toFunctor, W₀.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS).1)ᵒᵖ)
      (x : (structureRingSheafInverseImage B S hS
        (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).obj.obj V),
      (structureSharpRingInverseImage B S hS
          (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀)).hom.app V x = 0 →
        (restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z W₀ c e₀ h).hom.app V x =
          (restrictedSharpThroughThickening B S hS Z W₀ c' e₀ h').hom.app V x)
    (hcc : c ≫ qb = c' ≫ qb) :
    (modulePullback B S hS e₀).obj
        (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS W W₀ ≫ qb)) ⟶
      conormalModule B S hS X Z
declarations.comment: the linear map attached to the derivation by which the two comorphisms differ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.undeformedLiftDiff
declarations.doc:
**The `𝒪_Z`-linear map `a^*Ω_{W/V} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X}` by which two lifts into an undeformed target
differ.**  The sectionwise difference of their two comorphisms, read as a `V`-derivation of
`𝒪_W` with values in `a_*𝒞_{Z/X}` and transposed to a map out of `a^*Ω_{W/V}`.
declarations.statement:
def undeformedLiftDiff (c c' : X ⟶ W)
    (h : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c = a)
    (h' : subspaceInclusion B S hS X Z ≫ c' = a) (hb : c ≫ b = c' ≫ b) :
    (modulePullback B S hS a).obj (sheafOfDifferentials B S hS b) ⟶
      conormalModule B S hS X Z
declarations.comment: the difference read as a map out of the pulled back differentials, for an undeformed target

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSheaf_conormalLiftSubfunctor
declarations.doc:
The rule of [Stacks, Tag 061B] — `U' ↦ {a' : U' ⟶ Y'}` satisfying (1) `a'` is a morphism
over `T`, (2) `a'|_U = a|_U` and (3) the map `a^*𝒞_{Y/Y'}|_U ⟶ 𝒞_{X/X'}|_U` induced by `a'` is
the restriction of `A` — is a sheaf of sets on the spaces-étale site of `X'`, for arbitrary
thickenings `X ⊂ X'`, `Y ⊂ Y'`, an arbitrary morphism `a` and an arbitrary map `A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSheaf_conormalLiftSubfunctor :
    Presieve.IsSheaf (SpacesEtale.topology C S hS X')
      (conormalLiftSubfunctor C S hS hG hH pX' pY' a A).toFunctor
declarations.comment: the sheaf property of the rule 061B with all three conditions

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSheaf_liftSubfunctor
declarations.doc:
**The rule of conditions (1) and (2) is a sheaf.**  The rule sending an algebraic space `U'`
étale over `X'` to the set of morphisms `a' : U' ⟶ Y'` over `T` whose restriction to
`U = X ×_{X'} U'` is the restriction of `a` is a sheaf of sets on the spaces-étale site of `X'`.

The conormal condition (3) of the source is not imposed. For `Y = Y'` it holds for every `a'`,
and the rule is then the rule of the source (Remark 061D).
declarations.statement:
theorem isSheaf_liftSubfunctor :
    Presieve.IsSheaf (SpacesEtale.topology C S hS X')
      (liftSubfunctor C S hS hG hH pX' pY' a).toFunctor
declarations.comment: the sheaf property of the rule of lifts, for conditions (1) and (2); the conormal condition (3) is not imposed

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.conormalLiftSubfunctor
declarations.doc:
**The rule of lifts satisfying conditions (1), (2) and (3).** Let `X ⊂ X'` and `Y ⊂ Y'` be
thickenings of algebraic spaces over a base `T`, let `a : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism and let
`A : a^*𝒞_{Y/Y'} ⟶ 𝒞_{X/X'}` be a map of `𝒪_X`-modules. The rule sending an algebraic space
`U'` étale over `X'` to the set of morphisms `a' : U' ⟶ Y'` such that
1. `a'` is a morphism over `T`,
2. `a'|_U = a|_U` on `U = X ×_{X'} U'`, and
3. the map `a^*𝒞_{Y/Y'}|_U ⟶ 𝒞_{X/X'}|_U` induced by `a'` is the restriction of `A` to `U`,

as a subfunctor of the presheaf of morphisms into `Y'` on the spaces-étale site of `X'`, with
restriction along `V' ⟶ U'` given by `a' ↦ a'|_{V'}`.

Conditions (1) and (2) are `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsLiftOver`, the membership condition of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftSubfunctor`, and condition (3) is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsConormalLiftAtSubspace` at the two closed subspaces underlying the
thickenings, the prescribed `a` and the prescribed `A`, over the structure morphism `U' ⟶ X'`.

No hypothesis is placed on the thickenings, on `a` or on `A`; in particular the conormal module
of `Y ⊂ Y'` is not assumed to vanish.
declarations.statement: def conormalLiftSubfunctor : Subfunctor (spacesEtaleHomPresheaf C S hS X' Y')
declarations.comment: the rule U' ↦ {a' : U' → Y' satisfying (1), (2), (3)}, as a subfunctor of the presheaf of morphisms into Y' on the spaces-étale site of X', for arbitrary thickenings, a and A

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.conormalLiftAction_map
declarations.doc:
**The action on the sheaf of lifts commutes with restriction.**  For a morphism
`k : V' ⟶ U'` of the spaces-étale site of `X'`, a section `θ` of the acting sheaf
`SheafHom_{𝒪_X}(a^*Ω_{Y/T}, 𝒞_{X/X'})` over `U'` — an `𝒪_U`-linear map
`(a^*Ω_{Y/T})|_U ⟶ 𝒞_{X/X'}|_U` — and a section `a'` of the sheaf of lifts of
[Stacks Project, Tag 061B] over `U'`: `(θ · a')|_{V'} = θ|_{V'} · a'|_{V'}`.  Here `θ` acts
through its reading `a|_U^*Ω_{Y/T} ⟶ 𝒞_{U/U'}` (Stacks 03LU and [Stacks Project, Tag 04CQ]), and
`θ|_{V'}` is the restriction of `θ` along `V ⟶ U`, read through Stacks 03LU.
declarations.statement:
theorem conormalLiftAction_map {U' V' : SpacesEtale C S hS X'} (k : V' ⟶ U')
    (θ : (modulePullback C S hS
          (preimageProjection C S hS ((SpacesEtale.inclusion C S hS X').obj U').hom ⟨G, hG.1⟩)).obj
          ((modulePullback C S hS (Y := (⟨(⟨H, hH.1⟩ : ClosedSubspaces C S hS Y'.1).1.toFunctor,
            (⟨H, hH.1⟩ : ClosedSubspaces C S hS Y'.1).2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces C S hS)) (X :=
              (⟨(⟨G, hG.1⟩ : ClosedSubspaces C S hS X'.1).1.toFunctor,
                (⟨G, hG.1⟩ : ClosedSubspaces C S hS X'.1).2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces C S hS)) a).obj
            (sheafOfDifferentials C S hS (subspaceInclusion C S hS Y' ⟨H, hH.1⟩ ≫ pY'))) ⟶
        (modulePullback C S hS
          (preimageProjection C S hS ((SpacesEtale.inclusion C S hS X').obj U').hom ⟨G, hG.1⟩)).obj
          (conormalModule C S hS X' ⟨G, hG.1⟩))
    (s : (conormalLiftSubfunctor C S hS hG hH pX' pY' a A).obj (op U')) :
    (conormalLiftSubfunctor C S hS hG hH pX' pY' a A).toFunctor.map k.op
        (conormalLiftAction C S hS pX' pY' a A hG₁ hH₁ U' (Iso.homCongr
          ((modulePullbackCompIso C S hS (Z :=
            (⟨(⟨H, hH.1⟩ : ClosedSubspaces C S hS Y'.1).1.toFunctor,
              (⟨H, hH.1⟩ : ClosedSubspaces C S hS Y'.1).2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces C S hS))
          (preimageProjection C S hS ((SpacesEtale.inclusion C S hS X').obj U').hom ⟨G, hG.1⟩)
            a).app (sheafOfDifferentials C S hS (subspaceInclusion C S hS Y' ⟨H, hH.1⟩ ≫ pY')))
          (conormalRestrictionIso C S hS hG U') θ) s) =
      conormalLiftAction C S hS pX' pY' a A hG₁ hH₁ V'
        (Iso.homCongr ((modulePullbackCompIso C S hS (Z :=
          (⟨(⟨H, hH.1⟩ : ClosedSubspaces C S hS Y'.1).1.toFunctor,
            (⟨H, hH.1⟩ : ClosedSubspaces C S hS Y'.1).2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces C S hS))
          (preimageProjection C S hS ((SpacesEtale.inclusion C S hS X').obj V').hom ⟨G, hG.1⟩)
            a).app (sheafOfDifferentials C S hS (subspaceInclusion C S hS Y' ⟨H, hH.1⟩ ≫ pY')))
          (conormalRestrictionIso C S hS hG V')
          (QuasiCoherentDescent.restrictForm C S hS
            (P := (⟨((⟨G, hG.1⟩ : ClosedSubspaces C S hS X'.1).1.preimage
              ((SpacesEtale.inclusion C S hS X').obj V').hom.hom).toFunctor,
              (isClosedSubspace_preimage C S hS ((SpacesEtale.inclusion C S hS X').obj V').hom.hom
                (⟨G, hG.1⟩ : ClosedSubspaces C S hS X'.1).1 X'.2
                  ((SpacesEtale.inclusion C S hS X').obj V').left.2
                    (⟨G, hG.1⟩ : ClosedSubspaces C S hS X'.1).2).1⟩ :
              AlgebraicSpaces C S hS))
            (Q := (⟨((⟨G, hG.1⟩ : ClosedSubspaces C S hS X'.1).1.preimage
              ((SpacesEtale.inclusion C S hS X').obj U').hom.hom).toFunctor,
              (isClosedSubspace_preimage C S hS ((SpacesEtale.inclusion C S hS X').obj U').hom.hom
                (⟨G, hG.1⟩ : ClosedSubspaces C S hS X'.1).1 X'.2
                  ((SpacesEtale.inclusion C S hS X').obj U').left.2
                    (⟨G, hG.1⟩ : ClosedSubspaces C S hS X'.1).2).1⟩ :
              AlgebraicSpaces C S hS))
            ((SpacesEtale.toSpaces C S hS (IsThickening.space C S hS hG)).map
              ((thickeningPreimage C S hS hG).map k))
            (preimageProjection C S hS ((SpacesEtale.inclusion C S hS X').obj U').hom ⟨G, hG.1⟩)
            (preimageProjection C S hS ((SpacesEtale.inclusion C S hS X').obj V').hom ⟨G, hG.1⟩)
            (SpacesEtale.toSpaces_map_comp_structure C S hS (IsThickening.space C S hS hG)
              ((thickeningPreimage C S hS hG).map k)) θ))
        ((conormalLiftSubfunctor C S hS hG hH pX' pY' a A).toFunctor.map k.op s)
declarations.comment: the action is an action of sheaves: it commutes with the restriction maps of the sheaf SheafHom_{O_X}(a^*Ω_{Y/B}, C_{X/X'}) and of the sheaf 061B

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSheaf_conormalLiftActingPresheaf
declarations.doc:
The acting presheaf `SheafHom_{𝒪_X}(a^*Ω_{Y/T}, 𝒞_{X/X'})`, read through
`U' ↦ X ×_{X'} U'`, is a sheaf on the spaces-étale site of `X'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSheaf_conormalLiftActingPresheaf :
    Presieve.IsSheaf (SpacesEtale.topology C S hS X')
      (conormalLiftActingPresheaf C S hS hG hH pY' a)
declarations.comment: the acting sheaf SheafHom_{O_X}(a^*Ω_{Y/B}, C_{X/X'}), read on (X')_{spaces, étale} through the identification 05ZL, is a sheaf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.conormalLiftSheafAddAction
declarations.doc:
**The action on the sheaf of lifts over `U'`.**  A section `θ` of the acting sheaf
over `U'` acts on a section `a'` of the sheaf of lifts (061B) by the action `θ · a'` of
[Stacks Project, Tag 0CK6], `θ` read as a map `a|_U^*Ω_{Y/T} ⟶ 𝒞_{U/U'}` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.conormalLiftActingEquiv`.
declarations.comment: the action, over every object U' of (X')_{spaces, étale}, of the sections of SheafHom_{O_X}(a^*Ω_{Y/B}, C_{X/X'}) on the sections of the sheaf 061B

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.conormalLiftSheafAddAction_bijective
declarations.doc:
**Simple transitivity of the action on the sheaf of lifts** over every object `U'`
over which the sheaf of lifts (061B) has a section `s`: `θ ↦ θ · s` is a bijection from the
sections of the acting sheaf over `U'` onto the sections of the sheaf of lifts over `U'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem conormalLiftSheafAddAction_bijective (U' : SpacesEtale C S hS X')
    (s : (conormalLiftSubfunctor C S hS hG hH pX' pY' a A).obj (op U')) :
    letI := conormalLiftSheafAddAction C S hS pX' pY' a A hG₁ hH₁ U'
    Function.Bijective (fun θ : conormalLiftActionHom C S hS hG hH pY' a U' => θ +ᵥ s)
declarations.comment: the action is simply transitive over every object U' of (X')_{spaces, étale} over which the sheaf 061B has a section

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.conormalLiftSubfunctor_eq_liftSubfunctor_of_eq_top
declarations.doc:
For `Y = Y'` the rule of [Stacks, Tag 061A] is just the rule
`U' ↦ {a' : U' ⟶ Y' over T with a'|_U = a|_U}`: condition (3) is vacuous, the map `A` being always
zero.
declarations.statement:
theorem conormalLiftSubfunctor_eq_liftSubfunctor_of_eq_top (hHtop : H = ⊤) :
    conormalLiftSubfunctor C S hS hG hH pX' pY' a A = liftSubfunctor C S hS hG hH pX' pY' a
declarations.comment: for Y = Y' the rule of 061A is the rule U' ↦ {a' : U' → Y over B with a'|_U = a|_U}, condition (3) being vacuous

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftSubfunctor_remark_of_eq_top
declarations.doc:
**Deformations of maps into a trivial thickening.**  The special case `Y = Y'` of Lemmas
0618, 04D0, 061A and 061C (the target thickening is the trivial one, `H = ⊤`):
1. the map `A : a^*𝒞_{Y/Y'} ⟶ 𝒞_{X/X'}` is always zero;
2. the sheaf of Lemma 061A is the rule `U' ↦ {a' : U' ⟶ Y over B with a'|_U = a|_U}`
   (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftSubfunctor`);
3. the sheaf `SheafHom_{𝒪_X}(a^*Ω_{Y/B}, 𝒞_{X/X'})` acts on it
   (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftSheafAddActionOfEqTop`, the action of Lemma 061C), simply
   transitively over every `U'` over which it has a section.

Here `B` is the base `T`, `X ⊂ X'` is a first order thickening and `a : X ⟶ Y` is arbitrary; the
target `Y ⊂ Y'` is first order because it is trivial.
declarations.statement:
theorem liftSubfunctor_remark_of_eq_top (hHtop : H = ⊤) :
    (letI := Preadditive.homGroup (C := Modules.{u, u} C S hS (IsThickening.space C S hS hG).1
       (IsThickening.space C S hS hG).2)
       ((modulePullback C S hS a).obj (conormalModule C S hS Y' ⟨H, hH.1⟩))
       (conormalModule C S hS X' ⟨G, hG.1⟩)
     ∀ A' : (modulePullback C S hS a).obj (conormalModule C S hS Y' ⟨H, hH.1⟩) ⟶
        conormalModule C S hS X' ⟨G, hG.1⟩, A' = 0) ∧
    conormalLiftSubfunctor C S hS hG hH pX' pY' a A = liftSubfunctor C S hS hG hH pX' pY' a ∧
    ∀ (U' : SpacesEtale C S hS X') (s : (liftSubfunctor C S hS hG hH pX' pY' a).obj (op U')),
      letI := liftSheafAddActionOfEqTop C S hS pX' pY' a A hG₁ hHtop U'
      Function.Bijective (fun θ : conormalLiftActionHom C S hS hG hH pY' a U' => θ +ᵥ s)
declarations.comment: the special case Y = Y': A = 0, the sheaf of 061A is the rule U' ↦ {a' : U' → Y over B with a'|_U = a|_U}, and SheafHom_{O_X}(a^*Ω_{Y/B}, C_{X/X'}) acts on it (the action of 061C), simply transitively

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftActionAbelianSheaf
declarations.doc:
**The acting sheaf of [Stacks Project, Tag 061D], read on the spaces-étale site of the
ambient space of the thickening.**  This is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftActionSheaf`, the internal hom
`SheafHom_{𝒪_X}(a^*Ω_{Y/B}, 𝒞_{X/X'})` on the small étale site of the subspace `X`, carried to
the spaces-étale site of `X'` by `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.abelianSheafOnAmbient`.

It is on the site of `X'` that the sheaf of lifts of [Stacks Project, Tag 061A] lives, so it is
there that the action of [Stacks Project, Tag 061C] has to be read; its underlying presheaf
`(liftActionAbelianSheaf …).obj` is the shape
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.LiftDerivationAction` takes its acting sheaf `Θ` in.
declarations.comment: the acting sheaf carried to the spaces-etale site of the ambient space of the thickening, which is the site the sheaf of lifts lives on

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftsSubfunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 061D.** The sheaf of lifts of `a : X ⟶ Y` along the subspace `X ⊆ X'`, in the case
where the target is not deformed: the subfunctor of the restriction of `Y` to the small étale site
of `X'` whose sections over a chart `U'` are the morphisms `a' : U' ⟶ Y` over `B` whose
restriction to `X ×_{X'} U'` is the restriction of `a`.
declarations.statement:
def liftsSubfunctor (p : X' ⟶ B) (q : Y ⟶ B) {X : Subfunctor X'.1} (a : X.toFunctor ⟶ Y.1) :
    Subfunctor ((SmallEtale.toOver C S hS X'.1).op ⋙ Y.1)
declarations.comment: the rule `U' ↦ {a' : U' ⟶ Y over B with a'|_U = a|_U}`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSheaf_liftsSubfunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 061D.** The lifts form a sheaf of sets on the small étale site of `X'`: morphisms
into an algebraic space satisfy étale descent, and both clauses of the lifting condition are
local.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSheaf_liftsSubfunctor (p : X' ⟶ B) (q : Y ⟶ B) {X : Subfunctor X'.1}
    (a : X.toFunctor ⟶ Y.1) :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf (SmallEtale.topology C S hS X'.1)
      (liftsSubfunctor C S hS p q a).toFunctor
declarations.comment: the rule of the remark is a sheaf of sets

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eq_zero_of_isZero_conormalModule_top
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 061D.** In the case where the target is not deformed the map `A` of the general
lifting problem is always zero: it is a morphism of `𝒪_X`-modules out of the inverse image of the
conormal module `𝒞_{Y/Y}`, which vanishes.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_isZero_conormalModule_top (Z : ClosedSubspaces C S hS X'.1)
    (a : (⟨Z.1.toFunctor, Z.2.1⟩ : AlgebraicSpaces C S hS) ⟶
      (⟨(⊤ : Subfunctor Y.1).toFunctor, (isClosedSubspace_top C S hS Y).1⟩ :
        AlgebraicSpaces C S hS))
    (A : (modulePullback C S hS a).obj
        (conormalModule C S hS Y ⟨⊤, isClosedSubspace_top C S hS Y⟩) ⟶
      conormalModule C S hS X' Z) :
    A = 0

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.liftActionSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 061D.** The sheaf acting on the lifts: the internal hom
`SheafHom_{𝒪_X}(a^*Ω_{Y/B}, 𝒞_{X/X'})` of `𝒪_X`-modules on the small étale site of the closed
