This is the case at pseudo-coherence of Stacks 0AML, the composition law for an every-étale-chart
property, whose inputs are Stacks 0681 and étale locality on the source and target.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPseudoCoherent_comp (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y Z : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hf : IsPseudoCoherent B S hS f) (hg : IsPseudoCoherent B S hS g) :
    IsPseudoCoherent B S hS (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_of_isPseudoCoherent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06BU.** A pseudo-coherent morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is locally of
finite presentation.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_of_isPseudoCoherent (B : BigFppfSite.{u})
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S) {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (hf : IsPseudoCoherent B S hS f) :
    IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isPseudoCoherent_of_isFlat_of_isLocallyOfFinitePresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06BV.** A flat morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` which is locally of
finite presentation is pseudo-coherent.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPseudoCoherent_of_isFlat_of_isLocallyOfFinitePresentation (B : BigFppfSite.{u})
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S) {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hflat : IsFlat B S hS f) (hfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f) :
    IsPseudoCoherent B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isPseudoCoherent_of_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06BW.** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` between two algebraic spaces
pseudo-coherent over a base algebraic space is pseudo-coherent.

An étale atlas of the base is lifted twice to produce a square of étale charts of `f` whose chart
of the source is surjective, and the scheme-level cancellation of Stacks 0683 applies to the two
factors of the induced chart morphism of `f ≫ g`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPseudoCoherent_of_comp (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y Z : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hfg : IsPseudoCoherent B S hS (f ≫ g)) (hg : IsPseudoCoherent B S hS g) :
    IsPseudoCoherent B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isPseudoCoherent_iff_isLocallyOfFiniteType
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06BX.** For a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` whose target is locally
Noetherian, pseudo-coherence is equivalent to being locally of finite type.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPseudoCoherent_iff_isLocallyOfFiniteType (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (_hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hYNoetherian : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS Y
      (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    IsPseudoCoherent B S hS f ↔ IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsPerfect
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06BZ, part (1).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *perfect* when
every commuting square of étale scheme charts induces a perfect scheme morphism.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsPerfect (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsPerfectAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06BZ, part (2).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *perfect at* a
point `x` of its source when it is perfect on an open subspace of the source containing
`x`.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsPerfectAt (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : points B S hS X) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsPerfect.of_isPullback_of_isFlat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06C0.** A flat base change of a perfect morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is
perfect: in a cartesian square with `g : Y ⟶ Z` perfect and `f : X ⟶ Z` flat, the base change
`g' : Y' ⟶ X` of `g` along `f` is perfect.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsPerfect.of_isPullback_of_isFlat
    {X Y Y' Z : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} {f : X ⟶ Z} {g : Y ⟶ Z} {f' : Y' ⟶ Y} {g' : Y' ⟶ X}
    (sq : IsPullback f' g' g f) (hflat : IsFlat B S hS f.hom) (hf : IsPerfect B S hS g.hom) :
    IsPerfect B S hS g'.hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsPerfect.pullback_snd
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06C0** in the `pullback` spelling: if `f : X ⟶ Y` is a perfect morphism of algebraic
spaces over `S` and `g : Y' ⟶ Y` is flat, then the projection `X ×_Y Y' ⟶ Y'` is perfect.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsPerfect.pullback_snd {X Y Y' : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (hg : IsFlat B S hS g.hom) (hf : IsPerfect B S hS f.hom) :
    IsPerfect B S hS (Limits.pullback.snd f.hom g.hom)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsPerfect.comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06C1.** A composition of perfect morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is
perfect.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsPerfect.comp {X Y Z : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hf : IsPerfect B S hS f) (hg : IsPerfect B S hS g) :
    IsPerfect B S hS (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFlat_and_isPerfect_iff_isFlat_and_isLocallyOfFinitePresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06C2.** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is flat and perfect if and
only if it is flat and locally of finite presentation.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFlat_and_isPerfect_iff_isFlat_and_isLocallyOfFinitePresentation
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (IsFlat B S hS f ∧ IsPerfect B S hS f) ↔
      (IsFlat B S hS f ∧ IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsLocalCompleteIntersection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06C4, part (1).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is a *local complete
intersection morphism*, or a *Koszul morphism*, when every commuting square of étale scheme
charts induces a local complete intersection morphism of schemes.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsLocalCompleteIntersection (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.KoszulAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06C4, part (2).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is *Koszul at* a
point `x` of its source when it is a local complete intersection morphism on an open
subspace of the source containing `x`.
declarations.statement: abbrev KoszulAt (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : points B S hS X) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isKoszulRegularImmersion_of_isLocalCompleteIntersection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06C5.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a local complete intersection morphism of algebraic
spaces over `S`, let `p : P ⟶ Y` be smooth, let `a : U ⟶ X` be étale and let `i : U ⟶ P` be an
immersion over `Y`. Then `i` is a Koszul-regular immersion of algebraic spaces.
declarations.statement:
theorem isKoszulRegularImmersion_of_isLocalCompleteIntersection (B : BigFppfSite.{u})
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S) {X Y U P : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (_hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (_hU : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS U) (_hP : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS P)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (a : U ⟶ X) (i : U ⟶ P) (p : P ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsLocalCompleteIntersection B S hS f) (ha : IsEtale B S hS a)
    (hi : IsImmersion B S hS i) (hp : IsSmooth B S hS p) (hcomm : a ≫ f = i ≫ p) :
    IsKoszulRegularImmersion B S hS i

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_of_isLocalCompleteIntersection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06C6, part (1).** A local complete intersection morphism of algebraic spaces over
`S` is locally of finite presentation.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_of_isLocalCompleteIntersection (B : BigFppfSite.{u})
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S) {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (hf : IsLocalCompleteIntersection B S hS f) :
    IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isPseudoCoherent_of_isLocalCompleteIntersection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06C6, part (2).** A local complete intersection morphism of algebraic spaces over
`S` is pseudo-coherent.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPseudoCoherent_of_isLocalCompleteIntersection (B : BigFppfSite.{u})
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S) {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (hf : IsLocalCompleteIntersection B S hS f) :
    IsPseudoCoherent B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isPerfect_of_isLocalCompleteIntersection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06C6, part (3).** A local complete intersection morphism of algebraic spaces over
`S` is perfect.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPerfect_of_isLocalCompleteIntersection (B : BigFppfSite.{u})
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S) {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (hf : IsLocalCompleteIntersection B S hS f) :
    IsPerfect B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocalCompleteIntersection_pullback_snd
declarations.doc:
A flat base change of a local complete intersection morphism of algebraic spaces is a local
complete intersection morphism: if `f : X ⟶ Y` is Koszul and `g : Y' ⟶ Y` is flat, then the
projection `X ×_Y Y' ⟶ Y'` is Koszul.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isLocalCompleteIntersection_pullback_snd
    {X Y Y' : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (hg : IsFlat B S hS g.hom)
    (hf : IsLocalCompleteIntersection B S hS f.hom) :
    IsLocalCompleteIntersection B S hS (Limits.pullback.snd f.hom g.hom)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocalCompleteIntersection_comp
declarations.doc:
A composition of local complete intersection morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is a
local complete intersection morphism: if `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z` are local complete
intersection morphisms, so is `f ≫ g`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isLocalCompleteIntersection_comp (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y Z : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hf : IsLocalCompleteIntersection B S hS f)
    (hg : IsLocalCompleteIntersection B S hS g) :
    IsLocalCompleteIntersection B S hS (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSyntomic_iff_isFlat_and_isLocalCompleteIntersection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06C9.** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is syntomic if and only if it is
flat and a local complete intersection morphism.

All three properties are the condition of Tag 03MJ on every commuting square of étale charts, so
the statement is the scheme-level equivalence of Tag 069K quantified over the charts.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSyntomic_iff_isFlat_and_isLocalCompleteIntersection (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    IsSyntomic B S hS f ↔ IsFlat B S hS f ∧ IsLocalCompleteIntersection B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.koszulOpenSubspace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06CA, part (1).** The open subspace `U(f) ⊂ X` of the Koszul points of a
morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces: the subfunctor of the source whose sections are
those all of whose points are Koszul points of `f`.
declarations.statement: def koszulOpenSubspace (f : X ⟶ Y) : Subfunctor X
declarations.comment: part (1): the open subspace of Koszul points

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.range_pointsMap_ι_koszulOpenSubspace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06CA, part (1).** The point set of `U(f)` is the set of points at which `f` is
Koszul.
declarations.comment: part (1): the open subspace of Koszul points

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isOpenSubspace_koszulOpenSubspace
declarations.doc: **Stacks 06CA, part (1).** `U(f)` is an open subspace of the source.
declarations.statement:
theorem isOpenSubspace_koszulOpenSubspace (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    IsOpenSubspace B S hS (koszulOpenSubspace B S hS X f)
declarations.comment: part (1): the open subspace of Koszul points

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isOpenSubspace_range_pointsMap_eq_setOf_koszulAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06CA, part (1).** There is an open subspace of the source of a morphism of
algebraic spaces whose point set is exactly the set of points at which the morphism is
Koszul.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isOpenSubspace_range_pointsMap_eq_setOf_koszulAt
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ∃ U : Subfunctor X, IsOpenSubspace B S hS U ∧
      Set.range (pointsMap B S hS U.toFunctor U.ι) = {x | KoszulAt B S hS f x}
declarations.comment: part (1): the open subspace of Koszul points

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.koszulOpenSubspace_pullbackMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06CA, part (2).** The open subspace `U(f')` of the Koszul points of the base change
`f'` of `f` along an arbitrary `Z' ⟶ Z` is the inverse image of `U(f)` under the projection
`X' ⟶ X`.

The one input from the theory of schemes is that the Koszul property of morphisms of schemes is
local on the source for the étale topology — Stacks 069P restricted to étale coverings.
declarations.statement:
theorem koszulOpenSubspace_pullbackMap
    {X Y Z Z' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (hZ' : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z')
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (p : X ⟶ Z) (q : Y ⟶ Z) (hpq : f ≫ q = p)
    (hp : IsFlat B S hS p) (hplfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS p)
    (hq : IsFlat B S hS q) (hqlfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS q)
    (z : Z' ⟶ Z) :
    koszulOpenSubspace B S hS (pullback p z)
        (pullback.map p z q z f (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)
          (by simpa only [Category.comp_id] using hpq.symm) (by simp)) =
      (koszulOpenSubspace B S hS X f).preimage (pullback.fst p z)
declarations.comment: part (2): base change of the Koszul open subspace

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.koszulLocusStableUnderBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**The base-change assertion of Stacks 06CA holds.** For a commutative triangle of algebraic
spaces over `S` with `p` and `q` flat and locally of finite presentation, the base change of `f`
along any `Z' ⟶ Z` is Koszul at a point of `|X ×_Z Z'|` exactly when `f` is Koszul at its image
in `|X|`.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.setOf_koszulAt_pullbackMap` read at one point, its hypothesis of
étale source locality of the Koszul property of morphisms of schemes supplied by
`AlgebraicGeometry.isLocalCompleteIntersectionMorphism_isLocalAtSource_etale`.
declarations.statement: theorem koszulLocusStableUnderBaseChange : KoszulLocusStableUnderBaseChange B S hS
declarations.comment: part (2) in the pointwise form the hypothesis of Stacks 06CE asks for

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_conormalSheaf_of_isLocalCompleteIntersection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06CB, second clause.**  For a local complete intersection morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of
algebraic spaces over `S` which is formally unramified, the conormal sheaf `𝒞_{X/Y}` of
Stacks 0607 is finite locally free on the small étale site of `X`.

Formal unramifiedness is a field of the universal first-order thickening, and the statement is
about an arbitrary one.  The hypothesis `hcmp` is the comparison with the scheme-level
Stacks 06B9 which this library lacks; see the section *What is not proved here* of this file.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_conormalSheaf_of_isLocalCompleteIntersection
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (t : UniversalFirstOrderThickening B S hS f)
    (hf : IsLocalCompleteIntersection B S hS f.hom)
    (hcmp : RepresentableConormalSheafComparison B S hS) :
    SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite (conormalSheaf B S hS t)
declarations.comment: the conormal sheaf is finite locally free

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.unramified_iff_formallyUnramified_and_isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_conormalSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06CB.**  Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a local complete intersection morphism of algebraic
spaces over `S`.  Then `f` is unramified if and only if it is formally unramified, and in this
case the conormal sheaf `𝒞_{X/Y}` is finite locally free on `X`: for every universal first order
thickening `t` of `f` — which exists exactly when `f` is formally unramified, by Stacks 0606 —
the conormal sheaf of Stacks 0607 is finite locally free on the small étale site of `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem unramified_iff_formallyUnramified_and_isFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite_conormalSheaf
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (hf : IsLocalCompleteIntersection B S hS f.hom) :
    (IsUnramified B S hS f.hom ↔ FormallyUnramified f.hom) ∧
      ∀ t : UniversalFirstOrderThickening B S hS f,
        SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOnSite (conormalSheaf B S hS t)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isUnramified_iff_formallyUnramified_of_isLocalCompleteIntersection
declarations.doc:
A local complete intersection morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is unramified if and
only if it is formally unramified.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isUnramified_iff_formallyUnramified_of_isLocalCompleteIntersection
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (hf : IsLocalCompleteIntersection B S hS f) :
    IsUnramified B S hS f ↔ FormallyUnramified f
declarations.comment: the equivalence: unramified iff formally unramified

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.conormalSequence_shortExact_of_isLocalCompleteIntersection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06CC.**  Let `Z ⟶ Y ⟶ X` be formally unramified morphisms of algebraic spaces over a
scheme `S`, presented by universal first-order thickenings `Z ⊂ X₁` and `Y ⊂ X₂` over `X`, let
`g₁ : X₁ ⟶ X₂` be a morphism over `X` restricting to `f₁ : Z ⟶ Y` (by Stacks 060A it is the
canonical one), and let `F = Y ×_{X₂} X₁ ⊆ X₁` be the fibre product, inside which `Z` sits as the
inverse image `W` of `Z ⊆ X₁`; by Stacks 06BF it is the universal first-order thickening of `Z`
over `Y`.  If `f₁` is a local complete intersection morphism then the conormal sequence

`0 ⟶ f₁^*𝒞_{Y/X} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/X} ⟶ 𝒞_{Z/Y} ⟶ 0`

of Stacks 06BD, read on `W`, is short exact: its first arrow is the inverse image along
`W ⟶ Z` of the conormal map of Stacks 04CP of the square over `g₁`, and its second arrow is the
conormal map of the fibre product square of `W ⊆ F` over `Z ⊆ X₁`.
declarations.statement:
theorem conormalSequence_shortExact_of_isLocalCompleteIntersection
    (hZ : IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening B S hS Z.1 p₁)
    (hY : IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening B S hS Y.1 p₂) (hg : g₁ ≫ p₂ = p₁)
    (hlci : IsLocalCompleteIntersection B S hS f₁.hom) :
    ∃ h : (modulePullback B S hS
          (X := ⟨(preimageSubspace B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS X₁
                (preimageSubspace B S hS g₁ Y)) Z).1.toFunctor,
              (preimageSubspace B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS X₁
                (preimageSubspace B S hS g₁ Y)) Z).2.1⟩)
          (preimageProjection B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS X₁
            (preimageSubspace B S hS g₁ Y)) Z)).map (conormalMap B S hS Z Y g₁ f₁ sq₁) ≫
        conormalMap B S hS
          (preimageSubspace B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS X₁ (preimageSubspace B S hS g₁ Y)) Z)
          Z (subspaceInclusion B S hS X₁ (preimageSubspace B S hS g₁ Y))
          (preimageProjection B S hS (subspaceInclusion B S hS X₁
            (preimageSubspace B S hS g₁ Y)) Z)
          (conormalEtaleRestrictionSquare B S hS
            (subspaceInclusion B S hS X₁ (preimageSubspace B S hS g₁ Y)) Z) = 0,
      (ShortComplex.mk _ _ h).ShortExact

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.koszulLocusOnBase
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06CE.** The open subspace `W ⊂ Z` of a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces
over `S` whose source is given over `Z` by `p : X ⟶ Z`: the subspace of the base cut out by
the complement of the image under `p` of the set of points at which `f` is not Koszul, so that
a point of `|Z|` lies in `W` exactly when `f` is Koszul at every point of `|X|` above it.
declarations.statement: public def koszulLocusOnBase (f : X ⟶ Y) (p : X ⟶ Z) : Subfunctor Z
declarations.comment: the open subspace of the base

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.range_pointsMap_ι_koszulLocusOnBase
declarations.doc:
The point set of `W` is the complement of the image under `p` of the non-Koszul locus
of `f`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem range_pointsMap_ι_koszulLocusOnBase (f : X ⟶ Y) (p : X ⟶ Z) :
    Set.range (pointsMap B S hS (koszulLocusOnBase B S hS f p).toFunctor
        (koszulLocusOnBase B S hS f p).ι) =
      (pointsMap B S hS X p '' {x : points B S hS X | KoszulAt B S hS f x}ᶜ)ᶜ
declarations.comment: the point set of the open subspace of the base

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isOpenSubspace_koszulLocusOnBase
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06CE.** `W` is an open subspace of `Z`.

The non-Koszul locus of `f` is closed because the Koszul locus is open by Stacks 06CA, its
image under `p` is closed because `p` is closed, and the complement of a closed set is open,
hence the point set of an open subspace by Stacks 03BZ.
declarations.comment: the subspace of the base is open

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.factorsThrough_koszulLocusOnBase_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06CE, with the open subspace named.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic
spaces over `S` whose source and target are given over a third algebraic space `Z` by morphisms
`p : X ⟶ Z` and `q : Y ⟶ Z` with `f ≫ q = p`. If `p` is flat, locally of finite presentation and
closed and `q` is flat and locally of finite presentation, then a morphism `Z' ⟶ Z` from an
algebraic space factors through `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.koszulLocusOnBase` exactly when the base
change of `f` along it is a local complete intersection morphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem factorsThrough_koszulLocusOnBase_iff
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (p : X ⟶ Z) (q : Y ⟶ Z) (hfq : f ≫ q = p)
    (hpflat : IsFlat B S hS p) (hplfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS p)
    (hpc : IsClosedMorphism B S hS p) (hqflat : IsFlat B S hS q)
    (hqlfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS q)
    (Z' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hZ' : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z') (g : Z' ⟶ Z) :
    (∃ r : Z' ⟶ (koszulLocusOnBase B S hS f p).toFunctor,
        r ≫ (koszulLocusOnBase B S hS f p).ι = g) ↔
      IsLocalCompleteIntersection B S hS (baseChangeOverBase B S hS f p q hfq g)
declarations.comment: with the open subspace named rather than quantified over

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isOpenSubspace_factorsThrough_iff_isLocalCompleteIntersection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06CE.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` whose source and
target are given over a third algebraic space `Z` by morphisms `p : X ⟶ Z` and `q : Y ⟶ Z` with
`f ≫ q = p`. If `p` is flat, locally of finite presentation and closed and `q` is flat and
locally of finite presentation, then there is an open subspace `W` of `Z` through which a
morphism `Z' ⟶ Z` from an algebraic space factors exactly when the base change
`f_{Z'} : X_{Z'} ⟶ Y_{Z'}` of `f` along it is a local complete intersection morphism.

The open subspace is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.koszulLocusOnBase`: the complement of the image
under `p` of the non-Koszul locus of `f`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isOpenSubspace_factorsThrough_iff_isLocalCompleteIntersection
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (p : X ⟶ Z) (q : Y ⟶ Z) (hfq : f ≫ q = p)
    (hpflat : IsFlat B S hS p) (hplfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS p)
    (hpc : IsClosedMorphism B S hS p) (hqflat : IsFlat B S hS q)
    (hqlfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS q) :
    ∃ W : Subfunctor Z, IsOpenSubspace B S hS W ∧
      ∀ (Z' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (_ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z') (g : Z' ⟶ Z),
        (∃ r : Z' ⟶ W.toFunctor, r ≫ W.ι = g) ↔
          IsLocalCompleteIntersection B S hS (baseChangeOverBase B S hS f p q hfq g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.IsAlgebraicMorphism
declarations.doc:
A morphism of stacks is algebraic if every base change along a
scheme-valued point of its target is an algebraic stack.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isAlgebraicMorphism_of_isAlgebraicStack
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06CG.** Let `F : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a 1-morphism of stacks in groupoids over the big fppf
site of `S`. If `𝒳` is an algebraic stack and the diagonal of `𝒴` is representable by algebraic
spaces, then `F` is algebraic in the sense of Stacks 06CF.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicMorphism_of_isAlgebraicStack
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {𝒳 𝒴 : StackInGroupoids.{w, u, u, u + 1, u + 1}
      (BigFppfOver B S hS) (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS)}
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (h𝒴 : 𝒴.toBasedCategory.p.IsStack (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS))
    (h𝒳 : IsAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳.toBasedCategory)
    (hΔ : HasRepresentableDiagonal B S hS
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.mk 𝒴.toBasedCategory
        𝒴.isStackInGroupoids.isFiberedInGroupoids)) :
    IsAlgebraicMorphism.{u, w, w, w} B S hS (𝒳 := 𝒳) (𝒴 := 𝒴) f.hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isLimitPreservingOnObjects_finiteHilbertToTargetCFG
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06CH.** Let `F : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a 1-morphism of stacks in groupoids over the big fppf
site of `S` which is representable by algebraic spaces (Stacks 02ZW) and locally of finite
presentation (every algebraic space representing a base change of `F` along a scheme-valued
point of `𝒴` has locally finitely presented structural morphism, Stacks 03YK). Then
`p : ℋ_d(𝒳/𝒴) ⟶ 𝒴` is limit preserving on objects (Stacks 06CU).

The affine limits `U = lim U_i` of Stacks 06CU are indexed, as in the source, by a set: the
index category lies in the universe of the schemes.

Given an object `Ξ = (U, Z, y, x, α)` of `ℋ_d(𝒳/𝒴)` over the limit and a comparison of `y` with
an object `y_i` of `𝒴` at the stage `i`, the cover `Z`, the object `x` and the identification `α`
composed with that comparison spread out to a cover `Z_{i'}`, an object `x_{i'}` and an
identification `η` at a later stage `i'` (Stacks 01ZM and the degree-`d` form of Stacks 06AC for
the cover, Stacks 06CX for the object and the identification). Lift `y_i`
along `U_{i'} ⟶ U_i` to `y_{i'}`; the lift is strongly cartesian, so `η` factors uniquely
through it, giving the identification `α_{i'}` of `Ξ_{i'}`, and the comparison factors uniquely
through it, giving the morphism of objects of `𝒴` of the morphism `Ξ ⟶ Ξ_{i'}`. The remaining
fields of that morphism are the spread-out data, and its compatibility condition holds because
both of its sides factor the same morphism through the lift.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLimitPreservingOnObjects_finiteHilbertToTargetCFG
    (hFrep : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS F)
    (hFlfp : ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ 𝒴.toBasedCategory.obj),
      y ⋙ 𝒴.toBasedCategory.p = Over.map U.hom →
      ∀ (P : (BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
        (hP : IsAlgebraicSpace B U.left.1 U.left.2 P),
        Nonempty (StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
          (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.map U.hom) 𝒳.toBasedCategory.p 𝒴.toBasedCategory.p y
            F.toFunctor) (presheafOfCategories (P ⋙ typeToCat)).p) →
        Space.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS (algebraicSpaceMap B S hS U
          ((spacesOverSmallerBaseFunctor B U.left.1 S U.left.2 hS U.hom).obj ⟨P, hP⟩)).hom) :
    BigFppfOver.IsLimitPreservingOnObjects.{u, u, u} B S hS
      (finiteHilbertCFG.{u, v, w, ws} B S hS 𝒳 𝒴 F d)
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.mk 𝒴.toBasedCategory
        𝒴.isStackInGroupoids.isFiberedInGroupoids)
      (finiteHilbertToTargetCFG.{u, v, w, ws} B S hS 𝒳 𝒴 F d)
declarations.comment: p : ℋ_d(𝒳/𝒴) ⟶ 𝒴 is limit preserving on objects

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isAlgebraicStack_finiteHilbertFibered
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06CI.** For positive degree `d`, the relative finite Hilbert stack `ℋ_d(𝒳/𝒴)` of a
1-morphism `F : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of stacks in groupoids over the big fppf site of `S` with `𝒳`
representable by an algebraic space and `F` representable by algebraic spaces, surjective, flat
and locally of finite presentation is an algebraic stack.

The hypothesis `hd : 0 < d` is the domain of the statement, not a restriction of it: the source
defines `ℋ_d(𝒳/𝒴)` only for `d ≥ 1` (Examples of Stacks, Section 05WA).

Writing `𝒰` for a scheme atlas of `ℋ_d(𝒳)` and `𝒲 = ℋ_d(𝒳/𝒴) ×_{ℋ_d(𝒳)} 𝒰`, the 1-morphism
`𝒲 ⟶ ℋ_d(𝒳/𝒴)` is a base change of `𝒰 ⟶ ℋ_d(𝒳)`, hence representable by algebraic spaces,
surjective and smooth (Stacks 0302 and Stacks 045C), and `𝒲` is representable by an algebraic
space, so Stacks 05UL applies to it.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicStack_finiteHilbertFibered (hd : 0 < d)
    (h𝒴 : Functor.IsStack 𝒴.toBasedCategory.p (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS))
    (h𝒳 : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace B S hS (targetCFG (𝒴 := 𝒳)))
    (hF : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS F)
    (hFprops : RelativeFlatPresentation (F := F)) :
    IsAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B S hS (finiteHilbertFibered B S hS d 𝒳 𝒴 F).val
declarations.comment: for positive degree d, the domain on which the source defines the finite Hilbert stack

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FiniteHilbert.lciLocus
declarations.doc:
The objects of the relative finite Hilbert category `ℋ_d(𝒳/𝒴)` whose relative map
`x_α : Z ⟶ X_y` of Stacks 06CK is unramified and a local complete intersection morphism, for every
algebraic space representing the relevant 2-fibre product and every equivalence exhibiting it.
declarations.statement: def lciLocus : ObjectProperty (Object B S hS 𝒳 𝒴 F d)
declarations.comment: the objects of ℋ_d(𝒳/𝒴) with unramified Koszul relative map

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.lciFiniteHilbertCategory
declarations.doc:
The local complete intersection locus `ℋ_{d,lci}(𝒳/𝒴)`: the full subcategory of the relative
finite Hilbert category on the objects whose relative map is unramified and a local complete
intersection morphism, regarded as a category over the big fppf site through the restriction of the
canonical projection.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def lciFiniteHilbertCategory : BasedCategory (BigFppfOver B S hS)
declarations.comment: the full subcategory ℋ_{d,lci}(𝒳/𝒴) of ℋ_d(𝒳/𝒴)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.lciFiniteHilbertInclusion
declarations.doc:
The inclusion `ℋ_{d,lci}(𝒳/𝒴) ⊂ ℋ_d(𝒳/𝒴)` of the local complete intersection locus into the
relative finite Hilbert category, as a 1-morphism of categories over the big fppf site.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FiniteHilbert.RelativeMapData.map_hom_ofHom
declarations.doc:
The relative map of the transported data is the restriction of the original relative map
along the base component of the morphism, read through the comparison of the representable
presheaf of the cover of the source quintuple with the restriction of the representable presheaf
of the cover of the target — an isomorphism by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FiniteHilbert.RelativeMapData.isIso_restrictYonedaHom_coverComparison`,
so that the relative map of the source *is* the base change of the relative map of the target.
declarations.statement:
theorem map_hom_ofHom :
    (ofHom φ D).map.hom =
      OverShriek.restrictYonedaHom φ.f.left (coverComparison φ) ≫
        (OverShriek.relocalizeRestrict φ.f.left).map D.map.hom
declarations.comment: the remark preceding the definition of the locus: the relative map of the source of a morphism of quintuples is the base change of the relative map of the target along the base component

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FiniteHilbert.lciLocus_iff
declarations.doc:
A quintuple lies in the local complete intersection locus exactly when the relative map
attached to *one* set of data exhibiting it is unramified and a local complete intersection
morphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem lciLocus_iff {P : Object B S hS 𝒳 𝒴 F d} (D : RelativeMapData P) :
    lciLocus (B := B) (S := S) (hS := hS) (𝒳 := 𝒳) (𝒴 := 𝒴) (F := F) (d := d) P ↔
      (Space.IsUnramified B P.U.left.1 P.U.left.2 D.map.hom ∧
        Space.IsLocalCompleteIntersection B P.U.left.1 P.U.left.2 D.map.hom)
declarations.comment: membership of the locus is testable on a single choice of the data exhibiting the relative map

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.relativeObj
declarations.doc:
The object `ξ = (Z, Z → U, x, α)` of the 2-fibre product
`(Sch/U)_{fppf} ×_{y, 𝒴, F} 𝒳` attached to a scheme `Z` over `U`, an object `x` of `𝒳` over `Z`
and an isomorphism `α : y|_Z ⟶ F(x)` vertical over `Z`. It lies over `Z` for the first
projection.
declarations.statement:
def relativeObj (Z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2) (x : 𝒳.obj)
    (hx : 𝒳.p.obj x = (Over.map U.hom).obj Z) (α : y.obj Z ≅ F.toFunctor.obj x)
    (hα : 𝒴.p.IsHomLift (𝟙 ((Over.map U.hom).obj Z)) α.hom) :
    TwoFibreProductOver (Over.map U.hom) 𝒳.p 𝒴.p y F.toFunctor
declarations.comment: the object (Z, Z → U, x, α) of the 2-fibre product

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.relativeMap
declarations.doc:
The morphism `x_α : Z ⟶ X_y` of algebraic spaces over `U` attached to a
scheme `Z` over `U`, an object `x` of `𝒳` over `Z` and an isomorphism `α : y|_Z ⟶ F(x)` vertical
over `Z`: the morphism of presheaves on the big fppf site of `U` named, under the Yoneda lemma,
by the section of `X_y` over `Z` that `ξ = (Z, Z → U, x, α)` names.
declarations.statement:
def relativeMap (F : 𝒳 ⥤ᵇ 𝒴) (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ 𝒴.obj)
    (e : StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
      (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.map U.hom) 𝒳.p 𝒴.p y F.toFunctor)
      (presheafOfCategories (Xy ⋙ typeToCat)).p)
    (hXy : IsAlgebraicSpace B U.left.1 U.left.2 Xy)
    (Z : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2) (x : 𝒳.obj)
    (hx : 𝒳.p.obj x = (Over.map U.hom).obj Z) (α : y.obj Z ≅ F.toFunctor.obj x)
    (hα : 𝒴.p.IsHomLift (𝟙 ((Over.map U.hom).obj Z)) α.hom) :
    (⟨yoneda.obj Z, isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda B U.left.1 U.left.2 Z⟩ :
        AlgebraicSpaces B U.left.1 U.left.2) ⟶ ⟨Xy, hXy⟩

    IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS
      (lciFiniteHilbertInclusion (B := B) (S := S) (hS := hS) (𝒳 := 𝒳) (𝒴 := 𝒴) (F := F)
        (d := d))
declarations.comment: the inclusion ℋ_{d,lci}(𝒳/𝒴) ⊂ ℋ_d(𝒳/𝒴) is representable by algebraic spaces

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isOpenImmersion_lciFiniteHilbertInclusion_of_flat
declarations.doc:
The inclusion `ℋ_{d,lci}(𝒳/𝒴) ⟶ ℋ_d(𝒳/𝒴)` of the local complete intersection locus is an
open immersion: every algebraic space representing a base change of it along a scheme-valued
point of `ℋ_d(𝒳/𝒴)` has open immersion structural morphism, read as a morphism of algebraic
spaces over `S`. This is the condition of Stacks 04XB at `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsOpenImmersion`,
written out.
declarations.statement:
theorem isOpenImmersion_lciFiniteHilbertInclusion_of_flat
    (hFrep : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS F)
    (hFflat : ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ 𝒴.toBasedCategory.obj),
      y ⋙ 𝒴.toBasedCategory.p = Over.map U.hom →
      ∀ (P : (BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
        (hP : IsAlgebraicSpace B U.left.1 U.left.2 P),
        Nonempty (StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
          (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.map U.hom) 𝒳.toBasedCategory.p 𝒴.toBasedCategory.p y
            F.toFunctor) (presheafOfCategories (P ⋙ typeToCat)).p) →
        Space.IsFlat B S hS (algebraicSpaceMap B S hS U
          ((spacesOverSmallerBaseFunctor B U.left.1 S U.left.2 hS U.hom).obj ⟨P, hP⟩)).hom)
    (hFlfp : ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ 𝒴.toBasedCategory.obj),
      y ⋙ 𝒴.toBasedCategory.p = Over.map U.hom →
      ∀ (P : (BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
        (hP : IsAlgebraicSpace B U.left.1 U.left.2 P),
        Nonempty (StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
          (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.map U.hom) 𝒳.toBasedCategory.p 𝒴.toBasedCategory.p y
            F.toFunctor) (presheafOfCategories (P ⋙ typeToCat)).p) →
        Space.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS (algebraicSpaceMap B S hS U
          ((spacesOverSmallerBaseFunctor B U.left.1 S U.left.2 hS U.hom).obj ⟨P, hP⟩)).hom) :
    ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤
        (finiteHilbertCategory (B := B) (S := S) (hS := hS) (𝒳 := 𝒳) (𝒴 := 𝒴) (F := F)
          (d := d)).obj),
      y ⋙ (finiteHilbertCategory (B := B) (S := S) (hS := hS) (𝒳 := 𝒳) (𝒴 := 𝒴) (F := F)
        (d := d)).p = Over.map U.hom →
      ∀ (P : (BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
        (hP : IsAlgebraicSpace B U.left.1 U.left.2 P),
        Nonempty (StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
          (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.map U.hom)
            (lciFiniteHilbertCategory (B := B) (S := S) (hS := hS) (𝒳 := 𝒳) (𝒴 := 𝒴) (F := F)
              (d := d)).p
            (finiteHilbertCategory (B := B) (S := S) (hS := hS) (𝒳 := 𝒳) (𝒴 := 𝒴) (F := F)
              (d := d)).p y
            (lciFiniteHilbertInclusion (B := B) (S := S) (hS := hS) (𝒳 := 𝒳) (𝒴 := 𝒴) (F := F)
              (d := d)).toFunctor)
          (presheafOfCategories (P ⋙ typeToCat)).p) →
        Space.IsOpenImmersion B S hS (algebraicSpaceMap B S hS U
          ((spacesOverSmallerBaseFunctor B U.left.1 S U.left.2 hS U.hom).obj ⟨P, hP⟩)).hom
declarations.comment: the inclusion ℋ_{d,lci}(𝒳/𝒴) ⊂ ℋ_d(𝒳/𝒴) is an open immersion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isStackInGroupoids_lciFiniteHilbertCategory_of_flat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06CL.** For a 1-morphism `F : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of stacks in groupoids over the big fppf site
of `S` which is representable by algebraic spaces, flat and locally of finite presentation, the
local complete intersection locus `ℋ_{d,lci}(𝒳/𝒴)` is a stack in groupoids over the big fppf site
of `S`.

The ambient `ℋ_d(𝒳/𝒴)` is a stack in groupoids by Stacks 05WB, and the locus is a full
subcategory inherited along morphisms and local on the base by the open locus of Stacks 05X8 and
06CE, `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FiniteHilbert.hasOpenLciLocus`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isStackInGroupoids_lciFiniteHilbertCategory_of_flat
    (hFrep : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS F)
    (hFflat : ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ 𝒴.toBasedCategory.obj),
      y ⋙ 𝒴.toBasedCategory.p = Over.map U.hom →
      ∀ (P : (BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
        (hP : IsAlgebraicSpace B U.left.1 U.left.2 P),
        Nonempty (StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
          (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.map U.hom) 𝒳.toBasedCategory.p 𝒴.toBasedCategory.p y
            F.toFunctor) (presheafOfCategories (P ⋙ typeToCat)).p) →
        Space.IsFlat B S hS (algebraicSpaceMap B S hS U
          ((spacesOverSmallerBaseFunctor B U.left.1 S U.left.2 hS U.hom).obj ⟨P, hP⟩)).hom)
    (hFlfp : ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ 𝒴.toBasedCategory.obj),
      y ⋙ 𝒴.toBasedCategory.p = Over.map U.hom →
      ∀ (P : (BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
        (hP : IsAlgebraicSpace B U.left.1 U.left.2 P),
        Nonempty (StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
          (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.map U.hom) 𝒳.toBasedCategory.p 𝒴.toBasedCategory.p y
            F.toFunctor) (presheafOfCategories (P ⋙ typeToCat)).p) →
        Space.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS (algebraicSpaceMap B S hS U
          ((spacesOverSmallerBaseFunctor B U.left.1 S U.left.2 hS U.hom).obj ⟨P, hP⟩)).hom) :
    (lciFiniteHilbertCategory (B := B) (S := S) (hS := hS) (𝒳 := 𝒳) (𝒴 := 𝒴) (F := F)
      (d := d)).p.IsStackInGroupoids.{w}
      (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS)
declarations.comment: ℋ_{d,lci}(𝒳/𝒴) is a stack in groupoids

declarations.name: Algebra.FormallySmooth.iff_tensorProduct_of_faithfullyFlat
declarations.doc:
Let `R → R'` be faithfully flat. Then `S` is formally smooth over `R` if and only if the
base change `R' ⊗_R S` is formally smooth over `R'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem iff_tensorProduct_of_faithfullyFlat [Module.FaithfullyFlat R R'] :
    FormallySmooth R S ↔ FormallySmooth R' (R' ⊗[R] S)
declarations.comment:
The source's `S' = S ⊗_R R'` is written `R' ⊗[R] S`, Mathlib's order for a base
change.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_of_isOpenImmersion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06CN.** An open immersion of algebraic spaces over `S` is locally of finite
presentation.

An open immersion is relatively étale, so in a commuting square of étale charts the composite
of the chart of the source with the immersion is an étale chart of the target and Stacks 03EC
makes the morphism of the site étale; an étale morphism of schemes is locally of finite
presentation. Neither the source nor the target has to be an algebraic space.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_of_isOpenImmersion {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (hf : IsOpenImmersion B S hS f) : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSyntomic_of_isSmooth
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06CP.** A smooth morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is syntomic.

On each commuting square of étale charts the underlying morphism of schemes is smooth, hence
syntomic by `AlgebraicGeometry.syntomic_of_smooth`, which is Stacks 01VD.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSyntomic_of_isSmooth (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsSmooth B S hS f) :
    IsSyntomic B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isUnramified_of_isImmersion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06CQ.** An immersion of algebraic spaces over `S` is unramified.

An immersion is representable, so an atlas `b` of the target pulls back to a surjective étale
chart `a` of the source over an immersion `α` of schemes; `α` is unramified, and that one
surjective étale square suffices by [Stacks Project, Tag 03MJ].
declarations.statement:
theorem isUnramified_of_isImmersion (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : IsImmersion B S hS f) :
    IsUnramified B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isUnramified_of_isEtale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06CR.** An étale morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is unramified.

In a commuting square of étale charts of `f` the morphism of schemes on top is étale, hence
formally unramified and locally of finite type, hence unramified by
[Stacks Project, Tag 02HE]. Nothing is asked of the target.
declarations.statement:
theorem isUnramified_of_isEtale {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : IsEtale B S hS f) :
    IsUnramified B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallySmooth_isLocalAtTarget_fpqc'
declarations.doc:
Formal smoothness of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is local on the base for the fpqc
topology of Stacks 03YH: for every fpqc covering `{Yᵢ ⟶ Y}` of algebraic spaces, a morphism
`f : X ⟶ Y` is formally smooth if and only if every base change `X ×_Y Yᵢ ⟶ Yᵢ` is.
declarations.statement:
theorem formallySmooth_isLocalAtTarget_fpqc' (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) :
    (formallySmoothProperty B S hS).IsLocalAtTarget
      (Topology.precoverage.{u, v} .fpqc B S hS)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallySmooth_isLocalAtTarget_fpqc_of_chartDescent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06CS, granting the implication (3) ⟹ (1) of Stacks 061K.** Formal smoothness of
morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is local on the base for the fpqc topology of
Stacks 03YH.

The ascent half is Stacks 049U. For the descent half, a lifting problem for `f : X ⟶ Y` is one
for the base change of `f` along a point of `Y` with affine source
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallySmooth_iff_affine_pullback`); over such a point the fpqc
condition of Stacks 03MQ supplies a finite family of affine objects covering it and refining the
given covering, and `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallySmooth_of_affineFpqcPresieve` descends along
that family.
declarations.statement:
theorem formallySmooth_isLocalAtTarget_fpqc_of_chartDescent (B : BigFppfSite.{u})
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S) (hchart : FormallySmoothEtaleChartDescent B S hS) :
    (formallySmoothProperty B S hS).IsLocalAtTarget
      (Topology.precoverage.{u, v} .fpqc B S hS)
declarations.comment: granting the implication (3) ⟹ (1) of Stacks 061K with condition (3) read on affine opens; the library's own Stacks 061K is itself conditional on the implication (3) ⟹ (1) of Stacks 0D0F and on the pseudo-torsor triviality of Stacks 03AJ, and this grant is implied by those two, so it is the weaker assumption

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallySmooth_isLocalAtTarget_fpqc
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06CS.** Formal smoothness of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is local on the
base for the fpqc topology of Stacks 03YH.

The one input not available in this library is the implication (3) ⟹ (1) of Stacks 061K, read on
affine opens, which is carried as the instance hypothesis
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormallySmoothEtaleChartDescent`; see
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.formallySmooth_isLocalAtTarget_fpqc_of_chartDescent`, where it appears
as an explicit hypothesis, for the argument.
declarations.statement:
instance formallySmooth_isLocalAtTarget_fpqc (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) [hchart : FormallySmoothEtaleChartDescent B S hS] :
    (formallySmoothProperty B S hS).IsLocalAtTarget
      (Topology.precoverage.{u, v} .fpqc B S hS)
declarations.comment: granting the implication (3) ⟹ (1) of Stacks 061K with condition (3) read on affine opens; the library's own Stacks 061K is itself conditional on the implication (3) ⟹ (1) of Stacks 0D0F and on the pseudo-torsor triviality of Stacks 03AJ, and this grant is implied by those two, so it is the weaker assumption

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.IsLimitPreservingOnObjects
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06CU.** A morphism of categories fibred in groupoids is limit preserving on
objects: every comparison over an affine inverse limit descends, with the comparison square
commuting.
declarations.statement:
def IsLimitPreservingOnObjects
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (𝒳 𝒴 : CatFiberedInGroupoids (BigFppfOver B S hS)) (p : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isLimitPreservingOnObjects_fibredCategory
declarations.doc:
If every section of `F` over an inverse limit of affine objects of the site descends to a
stage below a prescribed index, then the structure morphism of the category `𝒮_F` fibred in sets
attached to `F` is limit preserving on objects.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isLimitPreservingOnObjects_fibredCategory (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hF : DescendsOnAffineLimits.{u, v, w} B S hS F) :
    BigFppfOver.IsLimitPreservingOnObjects.{u, v, w} B S hS
      (fibredCategory B S hS F)
      (Deformation.Artin.Approximation.baseFiberedCategory B S hS)
      (Deformation.Artin.Approximation.structureMorphism B S hS
        (fibredCategory B S hS F))
declarations.comment: the criterion for the category fibred in sets attached to a set-valued presheaf: limit preservation on objects of its structure morphism follows from descent of the presheaf's sections along inverse limits of affine objects

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.isLimitPreservingOnObjects_baseChange
declarations.doc: **Stacks 06CV.** Limit preservation on objects is stable under base change.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLimitPreservingOnObjects_baseChange
    (hp : IsLimitPreservingOnObjects.{u, v, w} B S hS 𝒳 𝒴 p) :
    IsLimitPreservingOnObjects.{u, v, w} B S hS
      (twoFibreProduct B S hS 𝒳 𝒴 𝒵 p q) 𝒵
      (twoFibreProductSnd B S hS 𝒳 𝒴 𝒵 p q)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.isLimitPreservingOnObjects_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06CW.** The composite of two morphisms of categories fibred in groupoids that are
limit preserving on objects is limit preserving on objects.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLimitPreservingOnObjects_comp
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (𝒳 𝒴 𝒵 : CatFiberedInGroupoids (BigFppfOver B S hS))
    (p : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (q : 𝒴 ⟶ 𝒵)
    (hp : IsLimitPreservingOnObjects.{u, v, w} B S hS 𝒳 𝒴 p)
    (hq : IsLimitPreservingOnObjects.{u, v, w} B S hS 𝒴 𝒵 q) :
    IsLimitPreservingOnObjects.{u, v, w} B S hS 𝒳 𝒵 (p ≫ q)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isLimitPreservingOnObjects_iff_isLocallyOfFinitePresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06CX.** A 1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of `S`
which is representable by algebraic spaces is limit preserving on objects exactly when it is
locally of finite presentation in the sense of Stacks 03YK: every algebraic space representing a
base change of it along a scheme-valued point of the target has locally finitely presented
structural morphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLimitPreservingOnObjects_iff_isLocallyOfFinitePresentation
    (B : AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (𝒳 𝒴 : CatFiberedInGroupoids (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver B S hS))
    (p : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hp : AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS p.hom) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.IsLimitPreservingOnObjects.{u, u, u} B S hS 𝒳 𝒴 p ↔
      ∀ (U : AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver B S hS)
        (y : AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ 𝒴.val.obj)
        (_hy : y ⋙ 𝒴.val.p = Over.map U.hom)
        (F : (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
        (hF : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace B U.left.1 U.left.2 F),
        Nonempty (StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
          (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.map U.hom) 𝒳.val.p 𝒴.val.p y
            (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor p))
          (presheafOfCategories (F ⋙ typeToCat)).p) →
        AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS
          (AlgebraicGeometry.algebraicSpaceMap B S hS U
            ((AlgebraicGeometry.spacesOverSmallerBaseFunctor
              B U.left.1 S U.left.2 hS U.hom).obj ⟨F, hF⟩)).hom
declarations.comment: index categories in the universe of the schemes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isLimitPreservingOnObjects_of_isOpenImmersion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06CY.** A 1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of
`S` which is representable by algebraic spaces and an open immersion in the sense of Stacks 04XB
is limit preserving on objects.

An open immersion of algebraic spaces is locally of finite presentation, so the relative
open-immersion property of Stacks 03YK implies the relative property of being locally of finite
presentation; Stacks 06CX turns the latter into limit preservation on objects.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLimitPreservingOnObjects_of_isOpenImmersion
    (p : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (hp : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS p.hom)
    (hopen : IsOpenImmersion B S hS p) :
    BigFppfOver.IsLimitPreservingOnObjects.{u, u, u} B S hS 𝒳 𝒴 p
declarations.comment: index categories in the universe of the schemes, which is the scope of the formalized form of Tag 06CX that the proof uses. Limit preservation on objects for a larger index universe is a strictly stronger condition, so it does not follow from the pinned form; it is `isLimitPreservingOnObjects_of_isOpenImmersion_of_criterion`, which takes Tag 06CX at those universes as a hypothesis

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.IsFormallySmoothOnObjects
declarations.doc:
The first-order lifting condition for a 1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids, with
the comparison square required to commute: the restriction along a first-order thickening of
affine objects is the chosen pullback `CategoryTheory.Functor.pullbackFiber`.
declarations.statement:
def IsFormallySmoothOnObjects
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (𝒳 𝒴 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, v, u + 1, w}
      (BigFppfOver B S hS)) (p : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.isFormallySmoothOnObjects_baseChange
declarations.doc: **Stacks 06D1.** Formal smoothness on objects is stable under base change.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFormallySmoothOnObjects_baseChange
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (𝒳 𝒴 𝒵 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, max u v, u + 1, max (u + 1) v w}
      (BigFppfOver B S hS))
    (p : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (q : 𝒵 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hp : Stack.IsFormallySmoothOnObjects B S hS 𝒳 𝒴 p) :
    Stack.IsFormallySmoothOnObjects B S hS
      (twoFibreProduct B S hS 𝒳 𝒴 𝒵 p q) 𝒵
      (twoFibreProductSnd B S hS 𝒳 𝒴 𝒵 p q)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.isFormallySmoothOnObjects_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06D2.** A composite of morphisms formally smooth on objects is formally smooth on
objects.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFormallySmoothOnObjects_comp
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (𝒳 𝒴 𝒵 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, v, u + 1, w} (BigFppfOver B S hS))
    (p : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (q : 𝒴 ⟶ 𝒵)
    (hp : Stack.IsFormallySmoothOnObjects B S hS 𝒳 𝒴 p)
    (hq : Stack.IsFormallySmoothOnObjects B S hS 𝒴 𝒵 q) :
    Stack.IsFormallySmoothOnObjects B S hS 𝒳 𝒵 (p ≫ q)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.isRelativelyFormallySmooth_of_isFormallySmoothOnObjects
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06D3**, that (1) implies (2): a 1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids over
the big fppf site of `S` which is formally smooth on objects is formally smooth, that is, every
algebraic space representing a base change of it along a scheme-valued point of the target has
formally smooth structural morphism.

Representability by algebraic spaces, which the source assumes throughout, is not needed for
this implication: the lifting problem of formal smoothness is transported to a lifting problem
for objects of the 2-fibre product through whatever equivalence with the category of elements of
the representing space is supplied.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativelyFormallySmooth_of_isFormallySmoothOnObjects
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {𝒳 𝒴 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, v, u + 1, w} (BigFppfOver B S hS)} (p : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hobj : Stack.IsFormallySmoothOnObjects B S hS 𝒳 𝒴 p) :
    IsRelativelyFormallySmooth B S hS p
declarations.comment: formally smooth on objects implies formally smooth

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.isFormallySmoothOnObjects_of_isRelativelyFormallySmooth
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06D3**, that (2) implies (1): a 1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids over
the big fppf site of `S` which is representable by algebraic spaces and formally smooth is
formally smooth on objects.

Representability is used here, and twice: to produce an algebraic space representing the base
change of `p` along the scheme-valued point of `𝒴` classifying the given object, which is where
the hypothesis is applied, and through the 2-Yoneda classifying functor of Stacks 02Y4 that
turns that object into such a point.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFormallySmoothOnObjects_of_isRelativelyFormallySmooth
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {𝒳 𝒴 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, v, u + 1, w} (BigFppfOver B S hS)} (p : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hp : Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS p.hom)
    (hform : IsRelativelyFormallySmooth B S hS p) :
    Stack.IsFormallySmoothOnObjects B S hS 𝒳 𝒴 p
declarations.comment: formally smooth implies formally smooth on objects

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.isFormallySmoothOnObjects_iff_isRelativelyFormallySmooth
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06D3.** For a 1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site
of `S` which is representable by algebraic spaces, being formally smooth on objects and being
formally smooth — the relative property of Stacks 03YK at formal smoothness, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.isRelativelyFormallySmooth_iff_hasRelativeProperty` — are
equivalent.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFormallySmoothOnObjects_iff_isRelativelyFormallySmooth
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {𝒳 𝒴 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, v, u + 1, w} (BigFppfOver B S hS)} (p : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hp : Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS p.hom) :
    Stack.IsFormallySmoothOnObjects B S hS 𝒳 𝒴 p ↔ IsRelativelyFormallySmooth B S hS p

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isSurjectiveOnObjects_twoFibreProductSnd
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06D5.** Surjectivity on objects is preserved by base change: if `p : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` is
surjective on objects then so is the second projection `𝒳 ×_𝒴 𝒵 ⟶ 𝒵` of its base change along
any `q : 𝒵 ⟶ 𝒴`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSurjectiveOnObjects_twoFibreProductSnd
    (𝒳 𝒴 𝒵 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, max u v, u + 1, max (u + 1) v w}
      (BigFppfOver B S hS))
    (p : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (q : 𝒵 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (h : IsSurjectiveOnObjects B S hS 𝒳.val.p 𝒴.val.p
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor p)) :
    IsSurjectiveOnObjects B S hS
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.twoFibreProductSquare p q).pt.val.p 𝒵.val.p
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor
        (CatFiberedInGroupoids.twoFibreProductSquare p q).snd)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isSurjectiveOnObjects_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06D6.** A composite of two 1-morphisms surjective on objects is surjective on
objects: compose the two field extensions.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSurjectiveOnObjects_comp
    {X : Type uX} [Category.{vX} X] {Y : Type uY} [Category.{vY} Y]
    {Z : Type uZ} [Category.{vZ} Z]
    (pX : X ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS) (pY : Y ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (pZ : Z ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS) (F : X ⥤ Y) (G : Y ⥤ Z) (hG : G ⋙ pZ = pY)
    (hFsurj : IsSurjectiveOnObjects B S hS pX pY F)
    (hGsurj : IsSurjectiveOnObjects B S hS pY pZ G) :
    IsSurjectiveOnObjects B S hS pX pZ (F ⋙ G)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isSurjectiveOnObjects_iff_isRelativelySurjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06D7.** A 1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of `S`
which is representable by algebraic spaces is surjective on objects in the sense of Stacks 06D4
exactly when it has the relative property of Stacks 03YK for surjectivity of morphisms of
algebraic spaces.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSurjectiveOnObjects_iff_isRelativelySurjective
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {𝒳 𝒴 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, v, u + 1, w} (BigFppfOver B S hS)}
    (p : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (hp : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS p.hom) :
    IsSurjectiveOnObjects B S hS 𝒳.val.p 𝒴.val.p (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor p) ↔
      HasRelativeProperty B S hS (Space.surjectiveMorphismProperty B S hS) p hp

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FiniteHilbert.exists_coverDeformation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06D8.** Let `i : U ⟶ U'` be a first-order thickening of objects of the big fppf
site of `S` with `U` affine, let `X'` be an algebraic space over `U'` flat over `U'`, let
`q : Z ⟶ U` be finite locally free of degree `d`, and let `f : Z ⟶ X` be an unramified local
complete intersection morphism into the special fibre `X = U ×_{U'} X'` (the restriction of
`X'` along `U ⟶ U'`). Then there are `q' : Z' ⟶ U'` finite locally free of degree `d`, a
cartesian square `hg` exhibiting `Z = U ×_{U'} Z'`, and `f' : Z' ⟶ X'` restricting to `f`.

The source also assumes `U'` affine; that follows from `U` affine (Stacks 06AD) and is not
used.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_coverDeformation (d : ℕ) {U U' : BigFppfOver B S hS} (i : U ⟶ U')
    (hU : IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U))
    (hi : Stacks.Thickenings.IsFirstOrderThickening ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map i))
    (X' : (BigFppfOver B U'.left.1 U'.left.2)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hX' : IsAlgebraicSpace B U'.left.1 U'.left.2 X')
    (hflat : Space.IsFlat B U'.left.1 U'.left.2 (Space.toYonedaId B U'.left.1 U'.left.2 X'))
    {Z : BigFppfOver B S hS} (q : Z ⟶ U)
    (hq : Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map q) d)
    (f : yoneda.obj (Over.mk q.left : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2) ⟶
      (OverShriek.relocalizeRestrict i.left).obj X')
    (hunr : Space.IsUnramified B U.left.1 U.left.2 f)
    (hlci : Space.IsLocalCompleteIntersection B U.left.1 U.left.2 f) :
    ∃ (Z' : BigFppfOver B S hS) (q' : Z' ⟶ U') (g : Z ⟶ Z') (hg : IsPullback g q q' i),
      Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map q') d ∧
        ∃ f' : yoneda.obj (Over.mk q'.left : BigFppfOver B U'.left.1 U'.left.2) ⟶ X',
          OverShriek.restrictYonedaHom i.left (coverComparisonOfSquare hg.w) ≫
              (OverShriek.relocalizeRestrict i.left).map f' = f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isFormallySmoothOnObjects_lciFiniteHilbertToTarget
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06D9.** Let `F : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a 1-morphism of stacks in groupoids over
`(Sch/S)_fppf` which is representable by algebraic spaces, flat and locally of finite
presentation. Then `p : ℋ_{d,lci}(𝒳/𝒴) ⟶ 𝒴` is formally smooth on objects (Stacks 06D0).

This is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isFormallySmoothOnObjects_lciFiniteHilbertToTarget_of_coverDeformations`
with its deformation problem solved by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FiniteHilbert.hasCoverDeformations`, the space-level Stacks 06D8.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFormallySmoothOnObjects_lciFiniteHilbertToTarget
    (hFrep : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS F)
    (hFflat : ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ 𝒴.toBasedCategory.obj),
      y ⋙ 𝒴.toBasedCategory.p = Over.map U.hom →
      ∀ (P : (BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
        (hP : IsAlgebraicSpace B U.left.1 U.left.2 P),
        Nonempty (StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
          (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.map U.hom) 𝒳.toBasedCategory.p 𝒴.toBasedCategory.p y
            F.toFunctor) (presheafOfCategories (P ⋙ typeToCat)).p) →
        Space.IsFlat B S hS (algebraicSpaceMap B S hS U
          ((spacesOverSmallerBaseFunctor B U.left.1 S U.left.2 hS U.hom).obj ⟨P, hP⟩)).hom)
    (hFlfp : ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ 𝒴.toBasedCategory.obj),
      y ⋙ 𝒴.toBasedCategory.p = Over.map U.hom →
      ∀ (P : (BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
        (hP : IsAlgebraicSpace B U.left.1 U.left.2 P),
        Nonempty (StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
          (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.map U.hom) 𝒳.toBasedCategory.p 𝒴.toBasedCategory.p y
            F.toFunctor) (presheafOfCategories (P ⋙ typeToCat)).p) →
        Space.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS (algebraicSpaceMap B S hS U
          ((spacesOverSmallerBaseFunctor B U.left.1 S U.left.2 hS U.hom).obj ⟨P, hP⟩)).hom) :
    IsFormallySmoothOnObjects B S hS
      (lciFiniteHilbertFibered (isFiberedInGroupoids_lciFiniteHilbertCategory
        (FiniteHilbert.hasOpenLciLocus (d := d) hFrep hFflat hFlfp)))
      (stackFibered B S hS 𝒴)
      (lciFiniteHilbertToTargetFibered (isFiberedInGroupoids_lciFiniteHilbertCategory
        (FiniteHilbert.hasOpenLciLocus (d := d) hFrep hFflat hFlfp)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isSurjectiveOnObjects_lciFiniteHilbertCoproductToTarget
declarations.doc:
Let `F : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a 1-morphism of stacks in groupoids over the big fppf site of `S` which is
representable by algebraic spaces, flat, surjective and locally of finite presentation. Then the
1-morphism `∐_{d ≥ 1} ℋ_{d,lci}(𝒳/𝒴) ⟶ 𝒴` is surjective on objects.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSurjectiveOnObjects_lciFiniteHilbertCoproductToTarget
    (hFrep : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS F)
    (hFflat : ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ 𝒴.toBasedCategory.obj),
      y ⋙ 𝒴.toBasedCategory.p = Over.map U.hom →
      ∀ (P : (BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
        (hP : IsAlgebraicSpace B U.left.1 U.left.2 P),
        Nonempty (StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
          (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.map U.hom) 𝒳.toBasedCategory.p 𝒴.toBasedCategory.p y
            F.toFunctor) (presheafOfCategories (P ⋙ typeToCat)).p) →
        Space.IsFlat B S hS (algebraicSpaceMap B S hS U
          ((spacesOverSmallerBaseFunctor B U.left.1 S U.left.2 hS U.hom).obj ⟨P, hP⟩)).hom)
    (hFsurj : ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ 𝒴.toBasedCategory.obj),
      y ⋙ 𝒴.toBasedCategory.p = Over.map U.hom →
      ∀ (P : (BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
        (hP : IsAlgebraicSpace B U.left.1 U.left.2 P),
        Nonempty (StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
          (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.map U.hom) 𝒳.toBasedCategory.p 𝒴.toBasedCategory.p y
            F.toFunctor) (presheafOfCategories (P ⋙ typeToCat)).p) →
        Space.IsSurjective B S hS (algebraicSpaceMap B S hS U
          ((spacesOverSmallerBaseFunctor B U.left.1 S U.left.2 hS U.hom).obj ⟨P, hP⟩)).hom)
    (hFlfp : ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ 𝒴.toBasedCategory.obj),
      y ⋙ 𝒴.toBasedCategory.p = Over.map U.hom →
      ∀ (P : (BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
        (hP : IsAlgebraicSpace B U.left.1 U.left.2 P),
        Nonempty (StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
          (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.map U.hom) 𝒳.toBasedCategory.p 𝒴.toBasedCategory.p y
            F.toFunctor) (presheafOfCategories (P ⋙ typeToCat)).p) →
        Space.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS (algebraicSpaceMap B S hS U
          ((spacesOverSmallerBaseFunctor B U.left.1 S U.left.2 hS U.hom).obj ⟨P, hP⟩)).hom) :
    IsSurjectiveOnObjects B S hS
      (lciFiniteHilbertCoproductProjection (B := B) (S := S) (hS := hS) (𝒳 := 𝒳) (𝒴 := 𝒴)
        (F := F))
      𝒴.toBasedCategory.p
      (lciFiniteHilbertCoproductToTarget (B := B) (S := S) (hS := hS) (𝒳 := 𝒳) (𝒴 := 𝒴)
        (F := F))
declarations.comment: ∐_{d ≥ 1} ℋ_{d,lci}(𝒳/𝒴) ⟶ 𝒴 is surjective on objects, for F representable by algebraic spaces, flat, surjective and locally of finite presentation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isAlgebraicStack_of_flatCover
declarations.doc:
**Artin's theorem on representability of flat groupoids.** Let `F : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a 1-morphism
of categories fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of `S`, with `𝒴` a stack. If `𝒳` is
representable by an algebraic space and `F` is representable by algebraic spaces, surjective,
flat and locally of finite presentation, then `𝒴` is an algebraic stack.

The source asks `𝒳` and `𝒴` to be stacks in groupoids. `𝒳` is one because it is representable
by an algebraic space (`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isStack_of_isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace`), and
`𝒴` is a stack in groupoids at every descent universe because it is a stack (Stacks 02ZJ).
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicStack_of_flatCover
    {𝒳 𝒴 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, u, u + 1, u + 1} (BigFppfOver B S hS)}
    (F : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hstack : 𝒴.val.p.IsStack (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS))
    (h𝒳 : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace B S hS 𝒳)
    (hF : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS F.hom)
    (hFprops : ∀ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS)
      (y : BigFppfOver B V.left.1 V.left.2 ⥤ 𝒴.val.obj)
      (_hy : y ⋙ 𝒴.val.p = Over.map V.hom)
      (G : (BigFppfOver B V.left.1 V.left.2)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
      (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B V.left.1 V.left.2 G),
      Nonempty (StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
        (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.map V.hom) 𝒳.val.p 𝒴.val.p y
          (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor F))
        (presheafOfCategories (G ⋙ typeToCat)).p) →
      (let g := (algebraicSpaceMap B S hS V
        ((spacesOverSmallerBaseFunctor B V.left.1 S V.left.2 hS V.hom).obj ⟨G, hG⟩)).hom
       Space.IsSurjective B S hS g ∧ Space.IsFlat B S hS g ∧
         Space.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS g)) :
    IsAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒴.val
declarations.comment: stated for categories fibred in groupoids with the target a stack: the source's requirement that `𝒳` and `𝒴` be stacks in groupoids is implied, for `𝒳` by clause (1) and for `𝒴` by Stacks 02ZJ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isAlgebraicStack_of_flatPresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06DC, Artin's theorem on representability of flat groupoids.** Let `F : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a
1-morphism of stacks in groupoids over the big fppf site of `S`. If `𝒳` is representable by an
algebraic space and `F` is representable by algebraic spaces, surjective, flat and locally of
finite presentation, then `𝒴` is an algebraic stack.

Two inputs of the source's proof are not in the library and are carried as hypotheses:
representability of the diagonal of `𝒴`, which the source gets from Stacks 05XW, and the
existence of a smooth surjective cover of `𝒴` by an algebraic stack, which the source gets from
the locally-complete-intersection locus of the relative Hilbert stack of `F`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicStack_of_flatPresentation
    {𝒳 𝒴 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, u, u + 1, u + 1} (BigFppfOver B S hS)}
    (F : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hstack : 𝒴.val.p.IsStack (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS))
    (_h𝒳 : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace B S hS 𝒳)
    (_hF : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS F.hom)
    (_hFprops : ∀ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS)
      (y : BigFppfOver B V.left.1 V.left.2 ⥤ 𝒴.val.obj)
      (_hy : y ⋙ 𝒴.val.p = Over.map V.hom)
      (G : (BigFppfOver B V.left.1 V.left.2)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
      (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B V.left.1 V.left.2 G),
      Nonempty (StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
        (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.map V.hom) 𝒳.val.p 𝒴.val.p y
          (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor F))
        (presheafOfCategories (G ⋙ typeToCat)).p) →
      (let g := (algebraicSpaceMap B S hS V
        ((spacesOverSmallerBaseFunctor B V.left.1 S V.left.2 hS V.hom).obj ⟨G, hG⟩)).hom
       Space.IsSurjective B S hS g ∧ Space.IsFlat B S hS g ∧
         Space.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS g))
    (hdiagonal : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS (diagonalBasedFunctor B S hS 𝒴))
    (hcover : ∃ (𝒲 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, u, u + 1, u + 1} (BigFppfOver B S hS))
      (q : 𝒲 ⟶ 𝒴) (hq : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS q.hom),
      IsAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒲.val ∧
        HasRelativeProperty.{u, u, u + 1, u} B S hS
          (Space.surjectiveMorphismProperty B S hS ⊓ Space.smoothMorphismProperty B S hS)
          q hq) :
    IsAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒴.val
declarations.comment: the bootstrap assembly. Stacks 05XW (representability of the diagonal of the target) and the Hilbert-stack cover of Stacks 06CI, 06CL, 06D9 and 06DA (an algebraic stack with a representable surjective smooth 1-morphism to the target) are carried as the hypotheses `hdiagonal` and `hcover`; neither is in the library. Clause (1) and the flatness and local finite presentation of clause (2) are stated but not used, the carried inputs being exactly what the source draws from them

declarations.name: exists_prod_local_purelyInseparable_not_quasiFiniteAt
declarations.doc:
Let `(R, m, κ)` be a strictly henselian local ring (a
henselian local ring whose residue field is separably closed) and let `S` be a
finite type `R`-algebra. Then `S` decomposes as an `R`-algebra isomorphism
`S ≃ₐ[R] (∏ i, A i) × B`, where:
* each `A i` is a local ring, finite over `R`, with `R → A i` a local
  homomorphism;
* for each `i`, the induced residue field extension `κ → κ(m_{A i})` is finite
  and purely inseparable;
* `R → B` is not quasi-finite at any prime of `B` lying over `m`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_prod_local_purelyInseparable_not_quasiFiniteAt (R : Type) [CommRing R]
    [HenselianLocalRing R] [IsSepClosed (ResidueField R)]
    (S : Type) [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [Algebra.FiniteType R S] :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (A : Fin n → Type) (_ : ∀ i, CommRing (A i)) (_ : ∀ i, Algebra R (A i)) (_ :
      ∀ i, IsLocalRing (A i)) (_ : ∀ i, IsLocalHom (algebraMap R (A i))) (B : Type) (_ :
      CommRing B) (_ : Algebra R B),
      -- the `R`-algebra decomposition `S ≅ (∏ i, A i) × B`
      Nonempty (S ≃ₐ[R] ((Π i, A i) × B)) ∧
        -- (1) each `A i` is finite over `R` (locality and local-hom are recorded
        --     by the instance binders above)
        (∀ i, Module.Finite R (A i)) ∧
          -- (2) each residue extension `κ → κ(m_{A i})` is purely inseparable and
          --     finite, where the `κ`-algebra structure on `κ(m_{A i})` comes from
          --     the residue field map of the local homomorphism `R → A i`
          (∀ i,
              letI : Algebra (ResidueField R) (ResidueField (A i)) :=
                (ResidueField.map (algebraMap R (A i))).toAlgebra
              IsPurelyInseparable (ResidueField R) (ResidueField (A i)) ∧
                Module.Finite (ResidueField R) (ResidueField (A i))) ∧
            -- (3) `R → B` is not quasi-finite at any prime of `B` lying over `m`
            (∀ (q : Ideal B) (hq : q.IsPrime),
              q.LiesOver (maximalIdeal R) → ¬@Algebra.QuasiFiniteAt R B _ _ _ q hq)

declarations.name: Algebra.IsGeometricallyNormal.of_isLocalization
declarations.doc:
A localization of a geometrically normal algebra over a field is geometrically normal: if `A`
is geometrically normal over the field `k` and `A'` is the localization of `A` at a submonoid
`S ⊆ A`, regarded as a `k`-algebra through `A`, then `A'` is geometrically normal over `k`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem IsGeometricallyNormal.of_isLocalization {k : Type u} {A : Type v} {A' : Type w}
    [Field k] [CommRing A] [CommRing A'] [Algebra k A] [Algebra k A'] [Algebra A A']
    [IsScalarTower k A A'] [IsGeometricallyNormal k A] (S : Submonoid A) [IsLocalization S A'] :
    IsGeometricallyNormal k A'
declarations.comment:
The source's `S⁻¹A` is spelled abstractly as an `A`-algebra `A'` with
  `IsLocalization S A'` and `IsScalarTower k A A'`, so that the fraction field of a domain and the
  localizations at primes are instances of the statement rather than transports of it.

declarations.name: Algebra.IsGeometricallyNormal.isNormalRing_tensorProduct_of_isNormalRing
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06DF.** The tensor product over a field `k` of a geometrically normal `k`-algebra and
a normal `k`-algebra is a normal ring.
declarations.statement:
theorem Algebra.IsGeometricallyNormal.isNormalRing_tensorProduct_of_isNormalRing (k : Type u)
    (A : Type v) (B : Type w) [Field k] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra k A] [Algebra k B]
    [Algebra.IsGeometricallyNormal k A] (hB : IsNormalRing B) : IsNormalRing (A ⊗[k] B)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isNormal_pullback_of_isGeometricallyNormal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06DG.** The fibre product over a field of a geometrically normal
scheme and a normal scheme is normal.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isNormal_pullback_of_isGeometricallyNormal {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    (hX : IsGeometricallyNormal f) [IsNormal Y] :
    IsNormal (pullback f g : Scheme.{u})

declarations.name: isReduced_tfae_henselization_strictHenselization
declarations.doc: Reducedness of a local ring, its henselization, and its strict henselization are equivalent.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isReduced_tfae_henselization_strictHenselization
    (R Rh Rsh : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing Rh] [CommRing Rsh]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing Rh] [IsLocalRing Rsh]
    [Algebra R Rh] [Algebra R Rsh]
    [IsLocalRing.IsHenselization R (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) Rh]
    (κsep : Type v) [Field κsep] [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) κsep]
    [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) κsep]
    [IsLocalRing.IsHenselization R κsep Rsh] :
    List.TFAE [IsReduced R, IsReduced Rh, IsReduced Rsh]

declarations.name: isNormalDomain_tfae_henselization_strictHenselization
declarations.doc: Normality of a local ring, its henselization, and its strict henselization are equivalent.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isNormalDomain_tfae_henselization_strictHenselization
    (R Rh Rsh : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing Rh] [CommRing Rsh]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing Rh] [IsLocalRing Rsh]
    [Algebra R Rh] [Algebra R Rsh]
    [IsLocalRing.IsHenselization R (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) Rh]
    (κsep : Type v) [Field κsep] [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) κsep]
    [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) κsep]
    [IsLocalRing.IsHenselization R κsep Rsh] :
    List.TFAE [IsDomain R ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed R,
      IsDomain Rh ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed Rh,
      IsDomain Rsh ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed Rsh]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.uniqueBranch_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06DK.** For a point `x` of an algebraic space `F` the five branch criteria are
equivalent: a unique minimal prime in the local rings of the étale charts above `x`, a unique
irreducible component of those charts through those points, unibranchness and geometric
unibranchness of those local rings, and a unique minimal prime in the étale local ring at
every geometric point above `x`.
declarations.statement:
theorem uniqueBranch_tfae (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) (x : points B S hS F) :
    List.TFAE [HasUniqueMinimalPrimeOnEtaleCharts B S hS F x,
      HasUniqueIrreducibleComponentOnEtaleCharts B S hS F x,
      IsUnibranchOnEtaleCharts B S hS F x,
      IsGeometricallyUnibranchAt B S hS F x,
      HasUniqueMinimalPrimeAtGeometricPoints B S hS F x]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsGeometricallyUnibranchAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06DL, at a point.** The presheaf `F` is geometrically unibranch at a point `x` of
`|F|` when the local ring of every étale chart of `F` at every point above `x` is geometrically
unibranch.  This is condition (4) of Tag 06DK, which for an algebraic space is equivalent to the
four other branch criteria there.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def IsGeometricallyUnibranchAt (x : points B S hS F) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsGeometricallyUnibranch
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06DL, at every point.** The presheaf `F` is geometrically unibranch when it is
geometrically unibranch at every point of `|F|`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable abbrev IsGeometricallyUnibranch : Prop

declarations.name: isGeometricallyUnibranch_iff_strictHenselization_has_unique_minimalPrime
declarations.doc:
A local ring is geometrically unibranch if and only if a strict henselization of it has a
unique minimal prime.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGeometricallyUnibranch_iff_strictHenselization_has_unique_minimalPrime
    (A Ash : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [CommRing Ash] [IsLocalRing Ash]
    [Algebra A Ash]
    (ksep : Type v) [Field ksep] [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ksep]
    [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ksep]
    [IsLocalRing.IsHenselization A ksep Ash] :
    IsGeometricallyUnibranch A ↔
      ∃! p : Ideal Ash, p ∈ minimalPrimes Ash

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.universallyOpen_to_field
declarations.doc:
A morphism from an algebraic space over `S` to a representable presheaf whose representing
scheme is the spectrum of a field is universally open.
declarations.statement:
theorem universallyOpen_to_field (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
