whose left vertical 1-morphism is surjective on objects, and whose top horizontal morphism of
algebraic spaces has `P`.

By **Stacks 06FN** this is what it means for a 1-morphism of algebraic stacks to *have the
property* `P`, for `P` smooth local on the source-and-target: Stacks 06FN defines that notion by
the equivalent conditions of Stacks 06FM, and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.hasPropertyOnEverySmoothDiagram_iff_some` is that equivalence, so either
condition may serve as the definition. The existential one is taken, because it carries the
diagram data its consumers need.
declarations.statement:
abbrev HasPropertyOnSomeSmoothDiagram
    (P : MorphismProperty ((BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u))
    {𝒳 𝒴 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, u, u + 1, u + 1} (BigFppfOver B S hS)} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) :
    Prop
declarations.comment: the definition, as condition (2) of Stacks 06FM

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.hasPropertyOnSomeSmoothDiagram_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06FP.** Let `P` be a property of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` which is
smooth local on the source-and-target and whose restriction to algebraic spaces is stable under
composition. Then the induced property of 1-morphisms of algebraic stacks over `S` — the
existential smooth-diagram criterion of **Stacks 06FM**, which is **Definition 06FN** — is
stable under composition.

The proof is the source's. Choose a smooth presentation `W ⟶ 𝒵`, surjective on objects, by an
algebraic space; then a diagram over `g` whose right vertical 1-morphism is that presentation,
which exists by condition (1) of Stacks 06FM — its left vertical 1-morphism is a smooth
presentation `V ⟶ 𝒴` surjective on objects; then a diagram over `f` whose right vertical
1-morphism is *that* one. The two top horizontal morphisms `U ⟶ V` and `V ⟶ W` have `P` by
condition (1), so their composite has `P` by hypothesis, and the outer square is a diagram over
`f ≫ g` whose left vertical 1-morphism is the one of the diagram over `f` — smooth and
surjective on objects — and whose right vertical 1-morphism is the presentation of `𝒵`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasPropertyOnSomeSmoothDiagram_comp
    (P : MorphismProperty ((BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u))
    (hP : Space.IsSmoothLocalOnSourceAndTarget B S hS P)
    (hcomp : ∀ {U V W : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u},
      IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS U → IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS V → IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS W →
      ∀ (p : U ⟶ V) (q : V ⟶ W), P p → P q → P (p ≫ q))
    {𝒳 𝒴 𝒵 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, u, u + 1, u + 1} (BigFppfOver B S hS)}
    (h𝒳 : IsAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳.val)
    (h𝒴 : IsAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒴.val)
    (h𝒵 : IsAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒵.val)
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒴 ⟶ 𝒵)
    (hf : HasPropertyOnSomeSmoothDiagram B S hS P f)
    (hg : HasPropertyOnSomeSmoothDiagram B S hS P g) :
    HasPropertyOnSomeSmoothDiagram B S hS P (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.hasPropertyOnSomeSmoothDiagram_comp_of_precomp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06FP.** Let `P` be a property of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` which is
stable under precomposition with a smooth morphism, stable under composition, and whose
restriction to algebraic spaces is stable under base change. The property of 1-morphisms of
categories fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of `S` that **Stacks 06FN** attaches to `P`
is stable under composition: if `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` and `g : 𝒴 ⟶ 𝒵` both pass the existential
smooth-diagram test of condition (2) of **Stacks 06FM**, then so does `f ≫ g`.

Stacks 06FP assumes `P` smooth local on the source-and-target, which is what makes the property
of Stacks 06FN well behaved; of its three clauses only precomposition-stability is used here, so
the hypothesis is taken in that weaker form and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsSmoothLocalOnSourceAndTarget.precomp` is what a caller holding the
full condition supplies. No hypothesis is made on the three categories beyond their being fibred
in groupoids: the diagram is built from the two given ones, so no presentation of `𝒵` is chosen.
See the implementation notes of this module, which also compare this with the sibling
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.hasPropertyOnSomeSmoothDiagram_comp`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasPropertyOnSomeSmoothDiagram_comp_of_precomp
    (P : MorphismProperty ((BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u))
    (hprecomp : ∀ {X₀ Y₀ Z₀ : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
      (_hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X₀) (_hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y₀)
      (_hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z₀) (p : X₀ ⟶ Y₀) (q : Y₀ ⟶ Z₀),
      Space.IsSmooth B S hS p → P q → P (p ≫ q))
    (hcomp : ∀ {X₀ Y₀ Z₀ : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
      (_hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X₀) (_hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y₀)
      (_hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z₀) (p : X₀ ⟶ Y₀) (q : Y₀ ⟶ Z₀),
      P p → P q → P (p ≫ q))
    [(spaceProperty B S hS P).IsStableUnderBaseChange]
    {𝒳 𝒴 𝒵 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, u, u + 1, u + 1} (BigFppfOver B S hS)}
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒴 ⟶ 𝒵)
    (hf : HasPropertyOnSomeSmoothDiagram B S hS P f)
    (hg : HasPropertyOnSomeSmoothDiagram B S hS P g) :
    HasPropertyOnSomeSmoothDiagram B S hS P (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.hasPropertyOnSomeSmoothDiagram_baseChange
declarations.doc:
A property of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` which is smooth local on the
source-and-target and whose restriction to algebraic spaces is stable under base change induces,
through the existential smooth-diagram criterion of Stacks 06FM, a property of 1-morphisms of
algebraic stacks over `S` stable under arbitrary 2-fibre-product base change.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasPropertyOnSomeSmoothDiagram_baseChange
    (P : MorphismProperty ((BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u))
    (_hP : Space.IsSmoothLocalOnSourceAndTarget B S hS P)
    [hbase : (spaceProperty B S hS P).IsStableUnderBaseChange]
    {𝒳 𝒴 𝒴' : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS}
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴)
    (Q : Bicategory.TwoCommSq g f)
    (hQ : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct Q)
    (hf : HasPropertyOnSomeSmoothDiagram B S hS P f.hom) :
    HasPropertyOnSomeSmoothDiagram B S hS P Q.fst.hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.IsLocallyOfFiniteType
declarations.doc:
A 1-morphism `f` of algebraic stacks over `S` is *locally of finite type* when every
2-commutative square of algebraic spaces over `f` whose two vertical 1-morphisms are smooth and
whose every comparison 1-morphism to a 2-fibre product is smooth has its top horizontal morphism
locally of finite type.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsLocallyOfFiniteType {𝒳 𝒴 : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.IsFiniteType
declarations.doc:
A 1-morphism of algebraic stacks over `S` is *of finite type* when it is locally of finite
type and quasi-compact.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsFiniteType {𝒳 𝒴 : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isLocallyOfFiniteType_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06FT**, the local assertion. The composite of two 1-morphisms of algebraic stacks
over `S` which are locally of finite type is locally of finite type.

Stacks 06FS part (1) is condition (1) of Stacks 06FM at local finite type of morphisms of
algebraic spaces, so this is Stacks 06FP at that property, transported across the equivalence of
conditions (1) and (2) of Stacks 06FM. Local finite type is smooth local on the
source-and-target by **Stacks 06FC** and stable under composition by **Stacks 03XG**.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyOfFiniteType_comp {𝒳 𝒴 𝒵 : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS}
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒴 ⟶ 𝒵)
    (hf : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f) (hg : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS g) :
    IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isFiniteType_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06FT**, the global assertion. The composite of two finite type 1-morphisms of
algebraic stacks over `S` is of finite type.

Being of finite type is being locally of finite type together with being quasi-compact
(Stacks 06FS, part (2)); the first conjunct composes by the local assertion above and the second
by **Stacks 050W**.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteType_comp {𝒳 𝒴 𝒵 : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS}
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒴 ⟶ 𝒵)
    (hf : IsFiniteType B S hS f) (hg : IsFiniteType B S hS g) :
    IsFiniteType B S hS (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isLocallyOfFiniteType_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06FU**, the local assertion. A base change of a 1-morphism of algebraic stacks over
`S` which is locally of finite type is locally of finite type: if `P` is a 2-fibre product of the
cospan `(g, f)` and `f` is locally of finite type, then the projection `P.fst` is locally of
finite type.

This is the base-change remark **Stacks 06FQ** at local finite type of morphisms of algebraic
spaces, transported across the equivalence of conditions (1) and (2) of **Stacks 06FM**, since
Stacks 06FS part (1) is the universal criterion where Stacks 06FQ concludes about the existential
one. Local finite type is smooth local on the source-and-target by **Stacks 06FC** and stable
under base change by **Stacks 03XH**.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyOfFiniteType_baseChange {𝒳 𝒴 𝒴' : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS}
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴)
    (P : Bicategory.TwoCommSq g f)
    (hP : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct P)
    (hf : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f) :
    IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS P.fst

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isFiniteType_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06FU**, the global assertion. A base change of a finite type 1-morphism of algebraic
stacks over `S` is of finite type.

Being of finite type is being locally of finite type together with being quasi-compact
(Stacks 06FS, part (2)); the first conjunct base changes by the local assertion above and the
second by **Stacks 050V**.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteType_baseChange {𝒳 𝒴 𝒴' : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS}
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴)
    (P : Bicategory.TwoCommSq g f)
    (hP : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct P)
    (hf : IsFiniteType B S hS f) :
    IsFiniteType B S hS P.fst

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isLocallyOfFiniteType_of_isImmersion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06FV.** An immersion of algebraic stacks over `S` is locally of finite type.

By Stacks 04YL the 1-morphism is representable by algebraic spaces and every algebraic space
representing a base change of it along a scheme-valued point of the target has immersion
structural morphism, hence by Stacks 06ED has structural morphism locally of finite type. That
is the relative property of Stacks 03YK at local finite type of morphisms of algebraic spaces,
which Stacks 06FM equates with the universal smooth-diagram test defining local finite type of
the 1-morphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyOfFiniteType_of_isImmersion
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (hf : IsImmersion B S hS f) :
    IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isFiniteTypePoint_of_exists_isClosed_smoothChart
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06FX, condition (2) implies condition (1).** Let `x` be a point of an algebraic stack
`𝒳` over `S`. If there are a scheme `U` of the site, a closed point of `U`, and a smooth
1-morphism from the algebraic stack of `U` to `𝒳` carrying that point to `x`, then some
field-valued point representing `x` has a 1-morphism `Spec k ⟶ 𝒳` which is locally of finite
type, i.e. `x` is a finite type point in the sense of Stacks 06FY.

The point of `U` is the closed point, a smooth 1-morphism is locally of finite type, and
Stacks 06G0 carries finite type points along a 1-morphism locally of finite type.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteTypePoint_of_exists_isClosed_smoothChart
    (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS)
    (x : points B S hS 𝒳.val.val 𝒳.val.property)
    (h : ∃ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (φ : schemeStack.{u, w} B S hS U ⟶ 𝒳)
        (z : points B S hS (schemeFibredCategory B S hS U).val
          (schemeFibredCategory B S hS U).property),
        AlgebraicStacks.IsSmooth B S hS φ ∧
          IsClosed ({pointsHomeomorphScheme B S hS U z} :
            Set ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U)) ∧
          pointsMap B S hS (schemeFibredCategory B S hS U).val
            (schemeFibredCategory B S hS U).property 𝒳.val.property φ.hom.hom z = x) :
    IsFiniteTypePoint.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳 x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exists_isClosed_smoothChart_of_isFiniteTypePoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06FX, condition (1) implies condition (2).** A finite type point `x` of an algebraic
stack `𝒳` over `S` (Stacks 06FY) is the image of a closed point of a scheme of the site carrying
a smooth 1-morphism to `𝒳`.

A smooth surjective scheme chart `a : U ⟶ 𝒳` has a finite type point above `x`, and by
**Stacks 06EF** such a point is the image of a closed point of a scheme `V` étale over `U`. An
étale morphism of schemes is smooth, so the composite `V ⟶ U ⟶ 𝒳` is smooth by **Stacks 075V**,
and it carries that closed point to `x`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isClosed_smoothChart_of_isFiniteTypePoint
    (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS)
    (x : points B S hS 𝒳.val.val 𝒳.val.property)
    (hx : IsFiniteTypePoint.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳 x) :
    ∃ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (φ : schemeStack.{u, w} B S hS U ⟶ 𝒳)
      (z : points B S hS (schemeFibredCategory B S hS U).val
        (schemeFibredCategory B S hS U).property),
      AlgebraicStacks.IsSmooth B S hS φ ∧
        IsClosed ({pointsHomeomorphScheme B S hS U z} :
          Set ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U)) ∧
        pointsMap B S hS (schemeFibredCategory B S hS U).val
          (schemeFibredCategory B S hS U).property 𝒳.val.property φ.hom.hom z = x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exists_isClosed_smoothChart_size_le_of_isFiniteTypePoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06FX, condition (1) implies condition (2), with the chart no larger than a given
smooth surjective chart.** Let `a : U₀ ⟶ 𝒳` be a smooth surjective 1-morphism out of a scheme of
the site. Then a finite type point `x` of `𝒳` is the image of a closed point of a scheme `U` of
the site carrying a smooth 1-morphism to `𝒳` whose **size is at most that of `U₀`** and whose
underlying scheme is **affine**.

The proof of `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exists_isClosed_smoothChart_of_isFiniteTypePoint` run at
the given chart rather than at one chosen for the occasion, and with the affine form of
**Stacks 06EH** (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFiniteTypePoint_iff_exists_isAffine_isClosed_etaleChart`)
in place of the general one: the chart it produces is then an **affine** scheme étale over `U₀`,
so it is quasi-compact and locally of finite type over `U₀`, and **Stacks 04T7**
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.size_le_of_locallyOfFiniteType`) bounds its size by that of `U₀`. The
affineness is recorded in the conclusion as well: the chart construction of **Stacks 06N3** reads
its slicing sequence in the global functions of the chart, and on an affine chart it may do so
with no shrinking, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_global_isRegular_ofList_eq_maximalIdeal_stalk_of_unramifiedAt`.

This is the form the chart construction of **Stacks 06MF** needs: the charts it cuts out of these
are indexed by the finite type points of `𝒳`, a set which need not be below the cofinality of the
site's size cutoff, so their coproduct lies in the site by
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSite.contains_sigma_of_forall_size_le` and that asks for a bound on
their sizes which is *uniform in the point*.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isClosed_smoothChart_size_le_of_isFiniteTypePoint
    (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS) (U₀ : BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (a : schemeStack.{u, w} B S hS U₀ ⟶ 𝒳)
    (hasm : AlgebraicStacks.IsSmooth B S hS a) (hasurj : IsSurjective B S hS a)
    (x : points B S hS 𝒳.val.val 𝒳.val.property)
    (hx : IsFiniteTypePoint.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳 x) :
    ∃ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (φ : schemeStack.{u, w} B S hS U ⟶ 𝒳)
      (z : points B S hS (schemeFibredCategory B S hS U).val
        (schemeFibredCategory B S hS U).property),
      AlgebraicStacks.IsSmooth B S hS φ ∧
        IsClosed ({pointsHomeomorphScheme B S hS U z} :
          Set ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U)) ∧
        pointsMap B S hS (schemeFibredCategory B S hS U).val
          (schemeFibredCategory B S hS U).property 𝒳.val.property φ.hom.hom z = x ∧
        ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U).size ≤
          ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U₀).size ∧
        IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U)
declarations.comment: condition (1) implies condition (2), with the chart's size bounded by that of a given smooth surjective chart

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.IsFiniteTypePoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06FY.** A point of an algebraic stack `𝒳` over `S` is a *finite type point* when
some field-valued point representing it has a locally-of-finite-type 1-morphism `Spec k → 𝒳`.

This is condition (1) of Stacks 06FX.
declarations.statement:
abbrev IsFiniteTypePoint (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS)
    (x : points B S hS 𝒳.val.val 𝒳.val.property) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.finiteTypePoints
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06FY.** The set `𝒳_{ft-pts}` of finite type points of an algebraic stack `𝒳`
over `S`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev finiteTypePoints (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS) :
    Set (points B S hS 𝒳.val.val 𝒳.val.property)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.affineSmoothChartClosedPoints_eq_smoothChartClosedPoints
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06FZ**, the agreement of the two ranges. The union of the images of the closed points
of the schemes of the site smooth over an algebraic stack `𝒳` over `S` is unchanged when the
schemes are restricted to the affine ones.

A closed point of a chart `U` is a closed point of an affine open `V ⊆ U` containing it, the
inclusion of `V` is an open immersion and hence smooth, and the composite of the induced
1-morphism with the chart is smooth by Stacks 075V.
declarations.statement:
theorem affineSmoothChartClosedPoints_eq_smoothChartClosedPoints
    (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS) :
    affineSmoothChartClosedPoints.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳 =
      smoothChartClosedPoints.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳
declarations.comment: the union over all schemes smooth over the stack equals the union over the affine schemes smooth over it

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.smoothChartClosedPoints_subset_finiteTypePoints
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06FZ**, the inclusion of the union in the set of finite type points. Every image of a
closed point of a scheme of the site smooth over an algebraic stack `𝒳` over `S` is a finite type
point of `𝒳` (Stacks 06FY).

This is condition (2) of Stacks 06FX implying condition (1).
declarations.statement:
theorem smoothChartClosedPoints_subset_finiteTypePoints
    (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS) :
    smoothChartClosedPoints.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳 ⊆ finiteTypePoints B S hS 𝒳
declarations.comment: the inclusion of the union over all schemes smooth over the stack in the set of finite type points, i.e. the ⊇ direction of the set equality

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.finiteTypePoints_subset_smoothChartClosedPoints
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06FZ**, the inclusion of the set of finite type points in the union. Every finite
type point of an algebraic stack `𝒳` over `S` (Stacks 06FY) is the image of a closed point of a
scheme of the site smooth over `𝒳`.

This is the restatement as a subset relation of condition (1) of Stacks 06FX implying
condition (2).
declarations.statement:
theorem finiteTypePoints_subset_smoothChartClosedPoints
    (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS) :
    finiteTypePoints B S hS 𝒳 ⊆ smoothChartClosedPoints.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳
declarations.comment: the inclusion of the set of finite type points in the union over all schemes smooth over the stack, i.e. the ⊆ direction of the set equality

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.finiteTypePoints_eq_smoothChartClosedPoints
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06FZ**, the set equality. The set `𝒳_{ft-pts}` of finite type points of an algebraic
stack `𝒳` over `S` is the union `⋃_{φ : U ⟶ 𝒳 smooth} |φ|(U₀)` of the images of the sets of
closed points of the schemes of the site smooth over `𝒳`.
declarations.statement:
theorem finiteTypePoints_eq_smoothChartClosedPoints
    (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS) :
    finiteTypePoints B S hS 𝒳 = smoothChartClosedPoints.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳
declarations.comment: the set equality 𝒳_{ft-pts} = ⋃_{φ : U ⟶ 𝒳 smooth} |φ|(U₀) over all schemes smooth over the stack

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.affineSmoothChartClosedPoints_subset_finiteTypePoints
declarations.doc:
The union over the affine schemes of the site smooth over an algebraic stack `𝒳` over `S` is
contained in the set of finite type points of `𝒳`.
declarations.statement:
theorem affineSmoothChartClosedPoints_subset_finiteTypePoints
    (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS) :
    affineSmoothChartClosedPoints.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳 ⊆ finiteTypePoints B S hS 𝒳
declarations.comment: the inclusion of the union over the affine schemes smooth over the stack in the set of finite type points, i.e. the ⊇ direction of the set equality for the affine range

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.finiteTypePoints_eq_affineSmoothChartClosedPoints
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06FZ**, the set equality for the affine range. The set `𝒳_{ft-pts}` of finite type
points of an algebraic stack `𝒳` over `S` is the union `⋃_{φ : U ⟶ 𝒳 smooth} |φ|(U₀)` of the
images of the sets of closed points of the *affine* schemes of the site smooth over `𝒳`.
declarations.statement:
theorem finiteTypePoints_eq_affineSmoothChartClosedPoints
    (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS) :
    finiteTypePoints B S hS 𝒳 = affineSmoothChartClosedPoints.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳
declarations.comment: the set equality 𝒳_{ft-pts} = ⋃_{φ : U ⟶ 𝒳 smooth} |φ|(U₀) over the affine schemes smooth over the stack

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.mapsTo_finiteTypePoints
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06G0.** A 1-morphism of algebraic stacks over `S` which is locally of finite type
maps the set of finite type points of its source into the set of finite type points of its
target.

A field-valued representative of a finite type point of the source has a locally-of-finite-type
1-morphism, and its image represents the image point; the image's 1-morphism is 2-isomorphic to
the composite of that one with `f`, which is locally of finite type by Stacks 06FT.
declarations.statement:
theorem mapsTo_finiteTypePoints {𝒳 𝒴 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hf : AlgebraicStacks.IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f) :
    Set.MapsTo
      (Stack.pointsMap B S hS 𝒳.val.val 𝒳.val.property 𝒴.val.property f.hom.hom)
      (finiteTypePoints B S hS 𝒳) (finiteTypePoints B S hS 𝒴)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.image_finiteTypePoints_of_isSurjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06G1.** A surjective 1-morphism of algebraic stacks over `S` which is locally of
finite type maps the set of finite type points of its source *onto* the set of finite type points
of its target.

That the image is contained in `𝒴_{ft-pts}` is **Stacks 06G0**. Conversely a finite type point of
`𝒴` is represented by a field-valued point whose 1-morphism out of the algebraic stack of the
spectrum of a field is locally of finite type, and that spectrum has a single point, so
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.mem_image_finiteTypePoints_of_subsingleton` applies to it.
declarations.statement:
theorem image_finiteTypePoints_of_isSurjective {𝒳 𝒴 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hf : AlgebraicStacks.IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f)
    (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS f) :
    Stack.pointsMap B S hS 𝒳.val.val 𝒳.val.property 𝒴.val.property f.hom.hom ''
        finiteTypePoints B S hS 𝒳 = finiteTypePoints B S hS 𝒴

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.closure_inter_finiteTypePoints
declarations.doc:
For a closed subset `T` of the point space of an algebraic stack `𝒳`, the closure of the set
of finite type points lying in `T` is `T` itself; that is, `T ∩ 𝒳_{ft-pts}` is dense in `T`.
declarations.statement:
theorem closure_inter_finiteTypePoints (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS) :
    letI := pointTopology B S hS 𝒳.val
    ∀ T : Set (points B S hS 𝒳.val.val 𝒳.val.property), IsClosed T →
      closure (T ∩ finiteTypePoints B S hS 𝒳) = T
declarations.comment: closed subsets, in the spelling of the scheme-level Stacks 02J4 and the algebraic-space-level Stacks 06EK: for a closed subset of the point space, the closure of its intersection with the set of finite type points is the subset itself

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.nonempty_inter_and_closure_inter_finiteTypePoints
declarations.doc:
Let `𝒳` be an algebraic stack over `S`. Then

* for any locally closed subset `T ⊆ |𝒳|` of its point space, `T ≠ ∅ → T ∩ 𝒳_{ft-pts} ≠ ∅`; and
* in particular, for any closed subset `T ⊆ |𝒳|` the closure of `T ∩ 𝒳_{ft-pts}` is `T`, that
  is, `T ∩ 𝒳_{ft-pts}` is dense in `T`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_inter_and_closure_inter_finiteTypePoints
    (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS) :
    letI := pointTopology B S hS 𝒳.val
    (∀ T : Set (points B S hS 𝒳.val.val 𝒳.val.property), IsLocallyClosed T → T.Nonempty →
        (T ∩ finiteTypePoints B S hS 𝒳).Nonempty) ∧
      ∀ T : Set (points B S hS 𝒳.val.val 𝒳.val.property), IsClosed T →
        closure (T ∩ finiteTypePoints B S hS 𝒳) = T
declarations.comment: both assertions: for a locally closed subset T of the point space of an algebraic stack, T nonempty implies that T meets the set of finite type points; and in particular, for a closed subset T, the intersection of T with the set of finite type points is dense in T

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.nonempty_inter_finiteTypePoints
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06G2, first clause.** A nonempty locally closed subset of the point space of an
algebraic stack contains a finite type point.

The reduced induced substack `𝒵` of `T` is nonempty because its image on points is `T`, so it
has a finite type point by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exists_isFiniteTypePoint_of_nonempty`; the image of that point is a
finite type point of `𝒳` by **Stacks 06G0** and lies in `T`.

The substack is carried as `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.HasReducedInducedSubstacks`, which stands for
**Stacks 06FK**; everything else is proved.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_inter_finiteTypePoints (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS)
    (hsub : HasReducedInducedSubstacks.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳) :
    letI := pointTopology B S hS 𝒳.val
    ∀ T : Set (points B S hS 𝒳.val.val 𝒳.val.property), IsLocallyClosed T → T.Nonempty →
      (T ∩ finiteTypePoints B S hS 𝒳).Nonempty
declarations.comment: the first clause: a nonempty locally closed subset of the point space meets the set of finite type points. The reduced induced substack structure of Stacks 06FK on a locally closed subset is carried as the hypothesis `hsub`, since Stacks 06FK is absent from this library; the rest of the proof, including the existence of a finite type point on a nonempty algebraic stack, is proved

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.subset_closure_inter_finiteTypePoints
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06G2, second clause.** For a closed subset `T` of the point space of an algebraic
stack, the finite type points lying in `T` are dense in `T`.

This follows from the first clause by pure topology: given `x ∈ T` and an open `V` containing
`x`, the set `T ∩ V` is locally closed and nonempty, so it meets the set of finite type points,
which is exactly the statement that `V` meets `T ∩ 𝒳_{ft-pts}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem subset_closure_inter_finiteTypePoints (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS)
    (hsub : HasReducedInducedSubstacks.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳) :
    letI := pointTopology B S hS 𝒳.val
    ∀ T : Set (points B S hS 𝒳.val.val 𝒳.val.property), IsClosed T →
      T ⊆ closure (T ∩ finiteTypePoints B S hS 𝒳)
declarations.comment: the second clause: for a closed subset of the point space, its intersection with the set of finite type points is dense in it. Derived from the first clause by topology alone, so it carries exactly the same Stacks 06FK hypothesis `hsub` and nothing further

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exists_mem_finiteTypePoints_of_isLocallyClosed
declarations.doc:
A nonempty locally closed subset of the point space of an algebraic stack contains a finite
type point.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_mem_finiteTypePoints_of_isLocallyClosed (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS) :
    letI := pointTopology B S hS 𝒳.val
    ∀ T : Set (points B S hS 𝒳.val.val 𝒳.val.property), IsLocallyClosed T → T.Nonempty →
      (T ∩ finiteTypePoints B S hS 𝒳).Nonempty
declarations.comment: the first clause: a nonempty locally closed subset of the point space meets the set of finite type points

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.subset_closure_inter_finiteTypePoints_of_isClosed
declarations.doc:
For a closed subset `T` of the point space of an algebraic stack, the finite type points
lying in `T` are dense in `T`.
declarations.statement:
theorem subset_closure_inter_finiteTypePoints_of_isClosed (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS) :
    letI := pointTopology B S hS 𝒳.val
    ∀ T : Set (points B S hS 𝒳.val.val 𝒳.val.property), IsClosed T →
      T ⊆ closure (T ∩ finiteTypePoints B S hS 𝒳)
declarations.comment: the second clause: for a closed subset of the point space, its intersection with the set of finite type points is dense in it

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isFiniteTypePoint_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06G3.** For a point `x` of the point space of an algebraic stack `𝒳` over `S`, the
following are equivalent: `x` is a finite type point; there is a one-point algebraic stack with a
locally-of-finite-type 1-morphism to `𝒳` whose image on points is `{x}`; the residual gerbe of
`𝒳` at `x` exists and its inclusion is locally of finite type.

The implication (1) ⟹ (3) is carried as the hypothesis `hForward`; see
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.ExistsLocallyOfFiniteTypeResidualGerbeOfIsFiniteTypePoint` for what it
stands for and why. The other two implications are proved.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteTypePoint_tfae (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS)
    (hForward : ExistsLocallyOfFiniteTypeResidualGerbeOfIsFiniteTypePoint.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳)
    (x : points B S hS 𝒳.val.val 𝒳.val.property) :
    [IsFiniteTypePoint.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳 x,
      HasSingletonLocallyOfFiniteTypeCoverAt.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳 x,
      HasLocallyOfFiniteTypeResidualGerbeAt.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳 x].TFAE
declarations.comment: the equivalence of (1) being a finite type point, (2) admitting a locally-of-finite-type 1-morphism from a one-point algebraic stack with image the point, and (3) the residual gerbe existing with locally-of-finite-type inclusion. The implications (3) => (2) and (2) => (1) are proved; (1) => (3) is carried as the hypothesis `hForward`, since Stacks 06FI, 04ZZ and 06MX are absent from this library and it has no construction of a residual gerbe

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isFiniteTypePoint_tfae_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06G3.** For a point `x` of the point space of an algebraic stack `𝒳` over `S`, the
following are equivalent: `x` is a finite type point; there is a one-point algebraic stack with a
locally-of-finite-type 1-morphism to `𝒳` whose image on points is `{x}`; the residual gerbe of
`𝒳` at `x` exists and its inclusion is locally of finite type.

All three implications are proved. (1) ⟹ (3) is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.existsLocallyOfFiniteTypeResidualGerbe`, which builds the one-point
algebraic stack as the strictly full subcategory of the objects of `𝒳` fppf-locally in the image
of the field-valued point of condition (1) of **Stacks 06FX**; (3) ⟹ (2) is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.hasSingletonLocallyOfFiniteTypeCoverAt_of_residualGerbe` and (2) ⟹ (1) is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isFiniteTypePoint_of_hasSingletonLocallyOfFiniteTypeCoverAt`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiniteTypePoint_tfae_unconditional (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS)
    (x : points B S hS 𝒳.val.val 𝒳.val.property) :
    [IsFiniteTypePoint.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳 x,
      HasSingletonLocallyOfFiniteTypeCoverAt.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳 x,
      HasLocallyOfFiniteTypeResidualGerbeAt.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳 x].TFAE
declarations.comment: the equivalence of (1) being a finite type point, (2) admitting a locally-of-finite-type 1-morphism from a one-point algebraic stack with image the point, and (3) the residual gerbe existing with locally-of-finite-type inclusion. All three implications are proved and nothing is assumed: (1) => (3) cuts the one-point algebraic stack out of the target as the strictly full subcategory of the objects fppf-locally in the image of the field-valued point, whose inclusion is fully faithful and, by Stacks 05UM at the bootstrap theorem Stacks 04S6 part (3), representable by algebraic spaces

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_of_isLocallyOfFiniteType
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06G4, part (1).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` which is locally of
finite type and whose target is locally Noetherian is locally of finite presentation.

The surjective étale atlas of the target witnessing its local Noetherianity lifts, by Stacks
02X1, to a surjective étale chart of the source together with a morphism of the site making
the square commute. Local finite type of the morphism tests exactly such squares, so the
underlying scheme morphism is locally of finite type with locally Noetherian target and hence
locally of finite presentation; one surjective chart square suffices by Stacks 03MJ.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyOfFinitePresentation_of_isLocallyOfFiniteType
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hN : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS Y (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (hf : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f) :
    IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFinitePresentation_of_isFiniteType
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06G4, part (2).** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` which is of finite type
and quasi-separated and whose target is locally Noetherian is of finite presentation.

Finite presentation is local finite presentation, quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness
(Stacks 03XP, part (3)) and finite type is local finite type together with quasi-compactness
(Stacks 03XF, part (3)), so only the first conjunct has content and that is part (1).
declarations.statement:
theorem isFinitePresentation_of_isFiniteType
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hN : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS Y (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (hf : IsFiniteType B S hS f) (hqs : IsQuasiSeparated B S hS f) :
    IsFinitePresentation B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.qcqs_of_isFinitePresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06G5.** If `Y` is a quasi-compact and quasi-separated algebraic space over `S`
and `X` is of finite presentation over `Y`, then `X` is quasi-compact and quasi-separated.

The two conclusions are independent of each other and each comes from one conjunct of finite
presentation (Stacks 03XP, part (3)): quasi-compactness of `X` from quasi-compactness of `f`,
and quasi-separatedness of `X` from quasi-separatedness of `f`. As everywhere in this
development, a quasi-compact and quasi-separated algebraic space is one which is quasi-compact
in the sense of Stacks 03E3 and quasi-separated in the absolute sense of Stacks 03BS, part
(3), that is, quasi-separated over the terminal scheme.
declarations.statement:
theorem qcqs_of_isFinitePresentation (hZ : B.Contains (⊤_ Scheme.{u})) {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hYqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS Y)
    (hYqs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ Y)
    (hf : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f) :
    IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X ∧ IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isUnramified_of_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06G6.** If a composite of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is unramified,
then so is its first factor.

Lift a surjective étale atlas of `Z` through `g` and the resulting chart of `Y` through `f`,
by [Stacks Project, Tag 02X1]. The scheme morphism on top of the outer square is unramified
by hypothesis, hence so is its first factor by [Stacks Project, Tag 02GG]; that is one
surjective étale square for `f`, which suffices by [Stacks Project, Tag 03MJ].
declarations.statement:
theorem isUnramified_of_comp (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hfg : IsUnramified B S hS (f ≫ g)) : IsUnramified B S hS f

declarations.name: Deformation.ArtinianLocalAlgCat
declarations.doc:
An Artinian local `Λ`-algebra together with a specified `Λ`-algebra isomorphism from
its residue field to `k`. These are the objects of the category `𝒞_Λ` of Stacks Project,
Tag 06GC.
declarations.statement:
structure ArtinianLocalAlgCat (Λ : Type u) (k : Type w) [CommRing Λ] [Field k]
    [Algebra Λ k]

declarations.name: Deformation.ArtinianLocalAlgCat.Hom
declarations.doc:
A morphism of Artinian local `Λ`-algebras with fixed residue field is a local
`Λ`-algebra homomorphism whose induced map on residue fields respects the specified
identifications with `k`.
declarations.statement: structure Hom (A B : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)

declarations.name: Deformation.ArtinianLocalAlgCat.instCategory
declarations.doc:
The category structure on Artinian local `Λ`-algebras with the fixed residue field `k`.
Composition is composition of the underlying local algebra homomorphisms.
declarations.statement: instance instCategory : Category (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)

declarations.name: Deformation.IsClassical
declarations.doc:
The classical case of `𝒞_Λ`: `Λ` is a Noetherian complete local ring and the given
`Λ`-algebra `k` is its residue field.
declarations.statement: def IsClassical (Λ : Type u) (k : Type w) [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k] : Prop

declarations.name: Deformation.surjective_factors_into_smallExtensions
declarations.doc:
A surjective morphism in `\mathcal{C}_\Lambda` is a finite composite of small
extensions.
declarations.statement:
theorem surjective_factors_into_smallExtensions
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {B A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k} (f : B ⟶ A)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f.hom) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (F : ComposableArrows (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k) n)
      (hB : F.left = B) (e : F.right ≅ A),
      eqToHom hB.symm ≫ F.hom ≫ e.hom = f ∧
        ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n),
          InfinitesimalLifting.IsSmallExtension
            (CommRingCat.ofHom (F.map' i (i + 1)).hom.toRingHom)

declarations.name: Deformation.IsEssentialSurjection
declarations.doc:
A surjective morphism in `𝒞_Λ` is essential if, whenever its composite with a
morphism into its source is surjective, that morphism is already surjective.
declarations.statement:
abbrev IsEssentialSurjection
    {B A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k} (f : B ⟶ A) : Prop

declarations.name: Deformation.finrank_residueImageField_mul_length_eq_length
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06GG.** Restricting scalars from a local `Λ`-algebra
with residue field `k` to `Λ` multiplies module length by the degree of `k` over
the image field of `Λ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem finrank_residueImageField_mul_length_eq_length
    (Λ : Type u) (k : Type w) (A : Type v) (M : Type x)
    [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k] [Module.Finite Λ k]
    [CommRing A] [Algebra Λ A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M]
    (_ : ResidueField A ≃ₐ[Λ] k) :
    letI : Module Λ M := Module.compHom M (algebraMap Λ A)
    (Module.finrank (residueImageField Λ k) k : ℕ∞) * Module.length A M =
      Module.length Λ M

declarations.name: Deformation.length_eq_length_of_isClassical
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06GG.** In the classical case, module length is unchanged
by restriction of scalars from a local `Λ`-algebra with residue field `k` to `Λ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem length_eq_length_of_isClassical
    (Λ : Type u) (k : Type w) (A : Type v) (M : Type x)
    [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k] [Module.Finite Λ k]
    [CommRing A] [Algebra Λ A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M]
    (_ : ResidueField A ≃ₐ[Λ] k) (h : IsClassical Λ k) :
    letI : Module Λ M := Module.compHom M (algebraMap Λ A)
    Module.length A M = Module.length Λ M

declarations.name: Deformation.ArtinianLocalAlgCat.hasPullback_of_surjective
declarations.doc:
If either morphism is surjective, the ring of compatible pairs is a pullback in `𝒞_Λ`; in
particular the pullback exists.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasPullback_of_surjective (f₁ : A₁ ⟶ A) (f₂ : A₂ ⟶ A)
    (h : Function.Surjective f₁.hom ∨ Function.Surjective f₂.hom) :
    IsConcretePullback f₁ f₂ ∧ HasPullback f₁ f₂

declarations.name: Deformation.ArtinianLocalAlgCat.isConcretePullback_of_isSeparable
declarations.doc:
The algebraic fibre product has its canonical object structure in `𝒞_Λ`
when `k` is separable over the image field of `Λ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isConcretePullback_of_isSeparable
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (residueImageField Λ k) k]
    {A₁ A₂ A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k} (f₁ : A₁ ⟶ A) (f₂ : A₂ ⟶ A) :
    IsConcretePullback f₁ f₂

declarations.name: Deformation.ArtinianLocalAlgCat.isSmallExtension_pullback_fst
declarations.doc:
The first projection from the pullback of a small extension in `𝒞_Λ` is a small
extension.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSmallExtension_pullback_fst
    {A₁ A₂ A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k}
    (f₁ : A₁ ⟶ A) (f₂ : A₂ ⟶ A) [Limits.HasPullback f₁ f₂]
    (h₂ : IsSmallExtension (CommRingCat.ofHom f₂.hom.toRingHom)) :
    IsSmallExtension
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (Limits.pullback.fst f₁ f₂).hom.toRingHom)

declarations.name: Deformation.IsCofiberedInGroupoids
declarations.doc:
A functor `p : F ⥤ C` is *cofibered in groupoids* when the opposite
functor `p.op : Fᵒᵖ ⥤ Cᵒᵖ` is fibered in groupoids.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev IsCofiberedInGroupoids {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    {C : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} C] (p : F ⥤ C) : Prop

declarations.name: Deformation.isCofiberedInGroupoids_twoFibreProductBasedCategory
declarations.doc:
A `2`-fibre product of categories cofibered in groupoids over `𝒞_Λ` is cofibered in
groupoids: the construction of the `2`-fibre product as categories over `𝒞_Λ` serves as the
`2`-fibre product in the `(2, 1)`-category of categories cofibered in groupoids over `𝒞_Λ`.
declarations.statement:
public lemma isCofiberedInGroupoids_twoFibreProductBasedCategory
    (p₁ : BasedFunctor 𝓗₁ 𝓖) (p₂ : BasedFunctor 𝓗₂ 𝓖)
    (h𝓗₁ : IsCofiberedInGroupoids 𝓗₁.p) (h𝓗₂ : IsCofiberedInGroupoids 𝓗₂.p)
    (h𝓖 : IsCofiberedInGroupoids 𝓖.p) :
    IsCofiberedInGroupoids (twoFibreProductBasedCategory p₁ p₂).p
declarations.comment: (13) the 2-fibre product of categories cofibered in groupoids over 𝒞_Λ is given by the construction of their 2-fibre product as categories over 𝒞_Λ

declarations.name: Deformation.cofiberedProduct
declarations.doc:
The *product* of two categories cofibered in groupoids `𝓕` and `𝓖` over `𝒞_Λ` is their
`2`-fibre product `𝓕 ×_{𝒞_Λ} 𝓖`, taken over `𝒞_Λ` itself: the `2`-fibre product of the two
structure morphisms of `𝓕` and `𝓖` into the base category read through the identity functor as a
category cofibered in groupoids over itself.
declarations.comment: (14) products of categories cofibered in groupoids

declarations.name: Deformation.isCofiberedInGroupoids_cofiberedProduct
declarations.doc:
The product of two categories cofibered in groupoids over `𝒞_Λ` is again cofibered in
groupoids.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isCofiberedInGroupoids_cofiberedProduct
    (h𝓕 : IsCofiberedInGroupoids 𝓕.p) (h𝓖 : IsCofiberedInGroupoids 𝓖.p) :
    IsCofiberedInGroupoids (cofiberedProduct 𝓕 𝓖).p
declarations.comment: (14) the product is again a category cofibered in groupoids

declarations.name: Deformation.IsPredeformationCategory
declarations.doc:
A functor to `𝒞_Λ` presents a predeformation category when it is cofibered in
groupoids and its fibre over the residue field `k` is equivalent to the category with one
object and one morphism.
declarations.statement:
structure IsPredeformationCategory {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ]
  [Field k] [Algebra Λ k] {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F] (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w,
    w} Λ k) : Prop

declarations.name: Deformation.isPredeformationFunctor_isomorphismClasses
declarations.doc:
The associated functor of isomorphism classes of a predeformation category is a
predeformation functor.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isPredeformationFunctor_isomorphismClasses
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    (𝓕 : BasedCategory.{v₁, u₁}
      (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k))
    (h𝓕 : IsPredeformationCategory 𝓕.p) :
    IsPredeformationFunctor
      (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.cofibered)

declarations.name: Deformation.IsPredeformationFunctor
declarations.doc:
A set-valued functor on `𝒞_Λ` is a predeformation functor when its value at
the residue field `k` is a one-element set.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev IsPredeformationFunctor
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    (F : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k ⥤ Type t) : Prop

declarations.name: Deformation.isPredeformationCategory_iff
declarations.doc:
A functor is a predeformation functor exactly when its associated cofibered
set, the category of elements, is a predeformation category.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isPredeformationCategory_iff
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    (F : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k ⥤ Type t) :
    IsPredeformationCategory (Functor.Elements.π F) ↔
      IsPredeformationFunctor F

declarations.name: Deformation.objectsOverFunctor
declarations.doc:
The structure functor on the category of arrows in `F` with target `x`, obtained by
forgetting the arrow to `x` and then applying `p`.
declarations.statement:
def objectsOverFunctor (p : F ⥤ C)
  (x : F) : Over x ⥤ C

declarations.name: Deformation.isPredeformationCategory_objectsOverFunctor
declarations.doc:
Localizing a category cofibered in groupoids at an object of its special
fibre gives a predeformation category.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isPredeformationCategory_objectsOverFunctor
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k)
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (x : p.Fiber (residueFieldObject.{u, v, w} Λ k)) :
    IsPredeformationCategory
      (objectsOverFunctor p x.1)

declarations.name: Deformation.CompleteLocalAlgCat
declarations.doc:
A Noetherian complete local `Λ`-algebra together with a specified `Λ`-algebra
isomorphism from its residue field to `k`. These are the objects of
`\widehat{\mathcal C}_Λ` in Stacks Project, Tag 06GW.
declarations.statement:
structure CompleteLocalAlgCat (Λ : Type u) (k : Type w) [CommRing Λ] [Field k]
    [Algebra Λ k]

declarations.name: Deformation.CompleteLocalAlgCat.Hom
declarations.doc:
A morphism of Noetherian complete local `Λ`-algebras with fixed residue field is a
local `Λ`-algebra homomorphism whose induced map on residue fields respects the specified
identifications with `k`.
declarations.statement: structure Hom (A B : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)

declarations.name: Deformation.CompleteLocalAlgCat.instCategory
declarations.doc:
The category structure on Noetherian complete local `Λ`-algebras with fixed residue
field. Composition is composition of the underlying local algebra homomorphisms.
declarations.statement: instance instCategory : Category (CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)

declarations.name: Deformation.IsProrepresentable
declarations.doc:
A functor on Artinian local `Λ`-algebras is prorepresentable if it is
naturally isomorphic to the restriction of the covariant representable functor
of some Noetherian complete local `Λ`-algebra.
declarations.statement:
abbrev IsProrepresentable {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k]
    [Algebra Λ k] (F : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k ⥤ Type v) : Prop

declarations.name: Deformation.relativeCotangentSpace
declarations.doc:
The relative cotangent space of a local homomorphism `f : R → S`, namely
`m_S / (m_R S + m_S²)`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev relativeCotangentSpace
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing S] (f : R →+* S) [IsLocalHom f] : Type v

declarations.name: Deformation.surjective_iff_surjective_cotangentSpaceMap
declarations.doc:
A morphism of Noetherian complete local algebras is surjective if and only if its
canonical map `m_R / m_R² → m_S / m_S²` is surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem surjective_iff_surjective_cotangentSpaceMap
    {R S : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k} (f : R ⟶ S) :
    Function.Surjective f.hom ↔
      Function.Surjective
        (Ideal.mapCotangent (maximalIdeal R) (maximalIdeal S) f.hom
          (by
            let _ : IsLocalHom f.hom.toRingHom := f.isLocal
            intro x hx
            change x ∈ (maximalIdeal S).comap f.hom.toRingHom
            simpa only [maximalIdeal_comap] using hx))

declarations.name: Deformation.surjective_iff_surjective_relativeCotangentSpaceMap
declarations.doc:
A morphism of Noetherian complete local algebras is surjective if and only if its map
`m_R / (m_Λ R + m_R²) → m_S / (m_Λ S + m_S²)` is surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem surjective_iff_surjective_relativeCotangentSpaceMap
    {R S : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k} (f : R ⟶ S) :
    Function.Surjective f.hom ↔ Function.Surjective (relativeCotangentSpaceMap f)

declarations.name: Deformation.ArtinianLocalAlgCat.isEssentialSurjection_iff_bijective_differentialsBaseChangeMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06H0, part (2), conditions (a) and (c)**, with the cotangent space written as the
base-change map of differentials. A morphism `f : B ⟶ A` of `𝒞_Λ` is an essential surjection
exactly when the canonical map `k ⊗_B Ω_{B/Λ} ⟶ k ⊗_A Ω_{A/Λ}` is bijective.

This is
`Deformation.ArtinianLocalAlgCat.isEssentialSurjection_iff_cotangentSpaceMap_bijective`
composed with `Deformation.Artin.differentialsBaseChangeMap_eq_cotangentSpaceMap`. It is the
form in which the criterion meets Stacks 07YL, which produces its square-zero extension
together with the bijectivity of exactly this map.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isEssentialSurjection_iff_bijective_differentialsBaseChangeMap
    {B A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, u, u} Λ k} (f : B ⟶ A) :
    letI : Algebra (B : Type u) (A : Type u) := f.hom.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower Λ (B : Type u) (A : Type u) :=
      .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => (f.hom.commutes x).symm
    letI : IsScalarTower (B : Type u) (A : Type u) k :=
      .of_algebraMap_eq fun b => (f.residue_comm b).symm
    (IsEssentialSurjection f ↔
      Function.Bijective
        (Deformation.Artin.differentialsBaseChangeMap Λ (B : Type u) (A : Type u) k))
declarations.comment: part (2), conditions (a) and (c), through the base-change map of differentials

declarations.name: Deformation.ArtinianLocalAlgCat.surjective_iff_imageDMap_surjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06H0**, part (1)(a). A morphism `f : B ⟶ A` of `𝒞_Λ` is surjective — equivalently,
satisfies the conditions of [Stacks, Tag 06S3] — exactly when `Im(d_B) → Im(d_A)` is
surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem surjective_iff_imageDMap_surjective (f : B ⟶ A) :
    Function.Surjective f.hom ↔ Function.Surjective (imageDMap f)
declarations.comment: part (1)(a), the image of the differential

declarations.name: Deformation.ArtinianLocalAlgCat.surjective_iff_cotangentSpaceMap_residueExtHom_surjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06H0**, part (1)(b). A morphism `f : B ⟶ A` of `𝒞_Λ` is surjective — equivalently,
satisfies the conditions of [Stacks, Tag 06S3] — exactly when
`Ω_{B/Λ} ⊗_B k → Ω_{A/Λ} ⊗_A k` is surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem surjective_iff_cotangentSpaceMap_residueExtHom_surjective (f : B ⟶ A) :
    Function.Surjective f.hom ↔
      Function.Surjective (Algebra.Extension.CotangentSpace.map (residueExtHom f))

declarations.name: Deformation.ArtinianLocalAlgCat.imageDMap_bijective_iff_cotangentSpaceMap_bijective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06H0**, part (2), equivalence of conditions (b) and (c). For a morphism of `𝒞_Λ`
the map `Im(d_B) → Im(d_A)` is an isomorphism exactly when
`Ω_{B/Λ} ⊗_B k → Ω_{A/Λ} ⊗_A k` is one.
declarations.statement:
theorem imageDMap_bijective_iff_cotangentSpaceMap_bijective (f : B ⟶ A) :
    Function.Bijective (imageDMap f) ↔
      Function.Bijective (Algebra.Extension.CotangentSpace.map (residueExtHom f))

declarations.name: Deformation.ArtinianLocalAlgCat.isEssentialSurjection_iff_cotangentSpaceMap_bijective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06H0**, part (2), equivalence of conditions (a) and (c). A morphism of `𝒞_Λ` is an
essential surjection exactly when `Ω_{B/Λ} ⊗_B k → Ω_{A/Λ} ⊗_A k` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEssentialSurjection_iff_cotangentSpaceMap_bijective (f : B ⟶ A) :
    IsEssentialSurjection f ↔
      Function.Bijective (Algebra.Extension.CotangentSpace.map (residueExtHom f))

declarations.name: Deformation.ArtinianLocalAlgCat.isEssentialSurjection_iff_imageDMap_bijective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06H0**, part (2), equivalence of conditions (a) and (b). A morphism of `𝒞_Λ` is an
essential surjection exactly when `Im(d_B) → Im(d_A)` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEssentialSurjection_iff_imageDMap_bijective (f : B ⟶ A) :
    IsEssentialSurjection f ↔ Function.Bijective (imageDMap f)

declarations.name: Deformation.ArtinianLocalAlgCat.isEssentialSurjection_iff_relativeCotangentSpaceMap_bijective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06H0**, part (3). If `k` is separable over the image field `k'` — presented as a
field `S` with `Λ → S` surjective and `S → k` separable — then a morphism `f : B ⟶ A` of `𝒞_Λ`
is an essential surjection exactly when
`𝔪_B/(𝔪_Λ B + 𝔪_B²) → 𝔪_A/(𝔪_Λ A + 𝔪_A²)` is an isomorphism.

In that case `Im(d_A) = 𝔪_A/(𝔪_Λ A + 𝔪_A²)` for every object `A`, by
`cotangentComplex_mk_eq_zero_of_mem_relative` and
`mem_relative_of_cotangentComplex_mk_eq_zero`, and the statement follows from part (2). Only
the forward implication uses separability: the converse is
`isEssentialSurjection_of_relativeCotangentSpaceMap_bijective`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEssentialSurjection_iff_relativeCotangentSpaceMap_bijective
    {S : Type*} [Field S] [Algebra Λ S] [Algebra S k] [IsScalarTower Λ S k]
    (hS : Function.Surjective (algebraMap Λ S)) [Algebra.IsSeparable S k] (f : B ⟶ A) :
    IsEssentialSurjection f ↔ Function.Bijective (relativeCotangentSpaceMap f)

declarations.name: Deformation.not_isEssentialSurjection_iff_exists_section
declarations.doc:
A small extension in `𝒞_Λ` is nonessential if and only if it has a section in
`𝒞_Λ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem not_isEssentialSurjection_iff_exists_section
    {B A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k} (f : B ⟶ A)
    (hf : InfinitesimalLifting.IsSmallExtension
      (CommRingCat.ofHom f.hom.toRingHom)) :
    ¬ IsEssentialSurjection f ↔ ∃ s : A ⟶ B, s ≫ f = 𝟙 A

declarations.name: Deformation.instHasBinaryCoproducts
declarations.doc:
The category of Noetherian complete local `Λ`-algebras with residue field `k`
admits coproducts of pairs of objects.

declarations.name: Deformation.FormalObject
declarations.doc:
A formal object of a category `F` over `𝒞_Λ` consists of a complete local algebra `R`,
an object of `F` over each positive adic truncation of `R`, and transition maps lying over the
quotient projections.
declarations.statement:
structure FormalObject {F : Type uF} [Category.{vF} F]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)

declarations.name: Deformation.FormalObject.Hom
declarations.doc:
A morphism of formal objects is a morphism of their complete local bases together with a
compatible family of morphisms over its maps on all adic truncations.
declarations.statement: structure Hom (X Y : FormalObject p)

declarations.name: Deformation.FormalObject.instCategory
declarations.doc: Formal objects and their compatible families of morphisms form a category.
declarations.statement: instance instCategory : Category (FormalObject p)

declarations.name: Deformation.formalObjectProjection_isCofiberedInGroupoids
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06H4.** The projection from the category of formal objects of a
category cofibered in groupoids to the category of complete local algebras is cofibered in
groupoids.
declarations.statement:
public theorem formalObjectProjection_isCofiberedInGroupoids
    {F : Type uF} [Category.{vF} F]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p) :
    IsCofiberedInGroupoids (FormalObject.projection (p := p))

declarations.name: Deformation.FormalObject.projection
declarations.doc: The canonical functor from formal objects to their underlying complete local algebras.
declarations.statement: def projection : FormalObject p ⥤ CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k
declarations.comment: the completion of a category cofibered in groupoids

declarations.name: Deformation.filteredFormalObjectsEquivalence
declarations.doc:
A cofinal ideal filtration gives the same category of formal objects over `R` as the
maximal-ideal filtration.
declarations.statement:
theorem filteredFormalObjectsEquivalence {F : Type uF} [Category.{vF} F]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (R : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k) (I : IdealFiltration R)
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p) :
    Nonempty
      (FilteredFormalObject p R I ≌
        (FormalObject.projection (p := p)).Fiber R)

declarations.name: Deformation.cofiberedCompletion_obj_equiv_formalObject
declarations.doc:
A section of the completed cofibered set at `S` is a formal object of the
category of elements of `F` whose base is `S`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def cofiberedCompletion_obj_equiv_formalObject
    (F : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k ⥤ Type (max v z))
    (S : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k) :
    (cofiberedCompletion.obj F).obj S ≃
      {X : FormalObject (CategoryOfElements.π F) // X.base = S}
declarations.comment: the completion of a set-valued functor is the limit over the adic truncations

declarations.name: Deformation.completionMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06H9.** A functor over the category of Artinian local algebras
induces a functor on formal objects by application at every level.
declarations.statement:
public def completionMap
    (φ : BasedFunctor (BasedCategory.ofFunctor p) (BasedCategory.ofFunctor q)) :
    BasedFunctor
      (BasedCategory.ofFunctor (FormalObject.projection (p := p)))
      (BasedCategory.ofFunctor (FormalObject.projection (p := q)))

declarations.name: Deformation.completionMap_obj_base
declarations.doc: The induced functor does not change the complete local algebra underlying a formal object.
declarations.statement:
public theorem completionMap_obj_base
    (φ : BasedFunctor (BasedCategory.ofFunctor p) (BasedCategory.ofFunctor q))
    (X : FormalObject p) :
    ((completionMap φ).obj X).base = X.base

declarations.name: Deformation.completionMap_obj_level
declarations.doc: On objects, the induced completion functor applies the original functor at every level.
declarations.statement:
public theorem completionMap_obj_level
    (φ : BasedFunctor (BasedCategory.ofFunctor p) (BasedCategory.ofFunctor q))
    (X : FormalObject p) (n : ℕ) :
    ((completionMap φ).obj X).level n = φ.obj (X.level n)

declarations.name: Deformation.completionMap_obj_transition
declarations.doc:
On objects, the induced completion functor applies the original functor to every transition
map.
declarations.statement:
public theorem completionMap_obj_transition
    (φ : BasedFunctor (BasedCategory.ofFunctor p) (BasedCategory.ofFunctor q))
    (X : FormalObject p) (n : ℕ) :
    ((completionMap φ).obj X).transition n =
      eqToHom (completionMap_obj_level φ X (n + 1)) ≫ φ.map (X.transition n) ≫
        eqToHom (completionMap_obj_level φ X n).symm

declarations.name: Deformation.completionMap_map_base
declarations.doc:
The induced functor does not change the morphism of complete local algebras underlying a
morphism of formal objects.
declarations.statement:
public theorem completionMap_map_base
    (φ : BasedFunctor (BasedCategory.ofFunctor p) (BasedCategory.ofFunctor q))
    {X Y : FormalObject p} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ((completionMap φ).map f).base =
      eqToHom (completionMap_obj_base φ X) ≫ f.base ≫
        eqToHom (completionMap_obj_base φ Y).symm

declarations.name: Deformation.completionMap_map_app
declarations.doc:
On morphisms, the induced completion functor applies the original functor to every level
map.
declarations.statement:
public theorem completionMap_map_app
    (φ : BasedFunctor (BasedCategory.ofFunctor p) (BasedCategory.ofFunctor q))
    {X Y : FormalObject p} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ) :
    ((completionMap φ).map f).app n =
      eqToHom (completionMap_obj_level φ X n) ≫ φ.map (f.app n) ≫
        eqToHom (completionMap_obj_level φ Y n).symm

declarations.name: Deformation.completionMap_id
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06H9.** Completion takes the identity morphism of a category cofibered
in groupoids to the identity morphism of its completion. Together with `completionMap_comp`,
`completionNatTrans_id` and `completionNatTrans_comp` this is the statement that completion is a
functor of two-categories; the equality is strict, not merely up to isomorphism.

declarations.name: Deformation.completionMap_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06H9.** Completion takes a composite of morphisms of categories
cofibered in groupoids to the composite of the completions. Together with `completionMap_id`,
`completionNatTrans_id` and `completionNatTrans_comp` this is the statement that completion is a
functor of two-categories; the equality is strict, not merely up to isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem completionMap_comp {H : Type uH} [Category.{vH} H]
    {r : H ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k}
    (φ : BasedFunctor (BasedCategory.ofFunctor p) (BasedCategory.ofFunctor q))
    (ψ : BasedFunctor (BasedCategory.ofFunctor q) (BasedCategory.ofFunctor r)) :
    completionMap (φ.comp ψ) = (completionMap φ).comp (completionMap ψ)

declarations.name: Deformation.completionNatTrans
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06H9.** The natural transformation induced levelwise on formal
objects by a two-morphism over the Artinian base.
declarations.statement:
public def completionNatTrans
    {φ ψ : BasedFunctor (BasedCategory.ofFunctor p) (BasedCategory.ofFunctor q)}
    (t : BasedNatTrans φ ψ) :
    BasedNatTrans (completionMap φ) (completionMap ψ)

declarations.name: Deformation.completionNatTrans_app_base
declarations.doc: The induced component is the identity on the complete local algebra.
declarations.statement:
public theorem completionNatTrans_app_base
    {φ ψ : BasedFunctor (BasedCategory.ofFunctor p) (BasedCategory.ofFunctor q)}
    (t : BasedNatTrans φ ψ) (X : FormalObject p) :
    ((completionNatTrans t).toNatTrans.app X).base =
      eqToHom (completionMap_obj_base φ X) ≫
        eqToHom (completionMap_obj_base ψ X).symm

declarations.name: Deformation.completionNatTrans_app_level
declarations.doc: At every Artinian quotient, the induced component is the original two-morphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem completionNatTrans_app_level
    {φ ψ : BasedFunctor (BasedCategory.ofFunctor p) (BasedCategory.ofFunctor q)}
    (t : BasedNatTrans φ ψ) (X : FormalObject p) (n : ℕ) :
    ((completionNatTrans t).toNatTrans.app X).app n =
      eqToHom (completionMap_obj_level φ X n) ≫
        t.toNatTrans.app (X.level n) ≫
          eqToHom (completionMap_obj_level ψ X n).symm

declarations.name: Deformation.completionNatTrans_id
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06H9.** Levelwise completion takes an identity two-morphism to an
identity. This is half of the statement that completion is a functor of two-categories on
two-morphisms.
declarations.statement:
public theorem completionNatTrans_id
    (φ : BasedFunctor (BasedCategory.ofFunctor p) (BasedCategory.ofFunctor q)) :
    completionNatTrans (𝟙 φ) = 𝟙 (completionMap φ)

declarations.name: Deformation.completionNatTrans_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06H9.** Levelwise completion is compatible with composition of
two-morphisms. This is the other half of the statement that completion is a functor of
two-categories on two-morphisms.
declarations.statement:
public theorem completionNatTrans_comp
    {φ ψ χ : BasedFunctor (BasedCategory.ofFunctor p) (BasedCategory.ofFunctor q)}
    (t : φ ⟶ ψ) (s : ψ ⟶ χ) :
    completionNatTrans (t ≫ s) =
      BasedNatTrans.comp (completionNatTrans t) (completionNatTrans s)

declarations.name: Deformation.completionHomEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06HA (hom equivalence).** Completion and restriction
induce quasi-inverse equivalences on hom categories, with the forward and
backward formulas specified above.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def completionHomEquivalence
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (hq : IsCofiberedInGroupoids q) :
    CompletionHomEquivalence p q hp hq

declarations.name: Deformation.completionUnit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06HA (unit).** Chosen pushforwards along all adic quotient maps
assemble canonically into a morphism from a category cofibered in groupoids to the category
of formal objects of its restriction.  It sends an object to its tower of chosen
pushforwards, with the induced transition maps.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def completionUnit
    {G : Type uG} [Category.{vG} G]
    (p : G ⥤ CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p) :
    CompletionUnit p (adicPushforwardChoice p hp)

declarations.name: Deformation.cofiberedCompletion
declarations.doc:
Completion of a cofibered set, viewed as a covariant set-valued functor.
Its sections over a complete local algebra are the compatible families of values
on the Artinian truncations.

declarations.name: Deformation.cofiberedCompletionAdjunction
declarations.doc:
Completion is right adjoint to restriction; its hom equivalence is the
functorial bijection from maps out of a restriction to maps into a completion.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def cofiberedCompletionAdjunction :
    (Functor.whiskeringLeft
      (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
      (CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
      (Type (max v z))).obj
      (artinianToComplete (Λ := Λ) (k := k)) ⊣
      cofiberedCompletion (Λ := Λ) (k := k)

declarations.name: Deformation.cofiberedCompletion_isRightKanExtension
declarations.doc:
Completion is the right Kan extension of a set-valued functor along the
inclusion of Artinian local algebras, with the comparison supplied by the
adjunction counit.
declarations.statement:
public theorem cofiberedCompletion_isRightKanExtension
    (F : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k ⥤ Type (max v z)) :
    (cofiberedCompletion (Λ := Λ) (k := k) |>.obj F).IsRightKanExtension
      ((cofiberedCompletionAdjunction (Λ := Λ) (k := k)).counit.app F)

declarations.name: Deformation.cofiberedCompletion_obj_equiv_formalObject
declarations.doc:
A section of the completed cofibered set at `S` is a formal object of the
category of elements of `F` whose base is `S`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def cofiberedCompletion_obj_equiv_formalObject
    (F : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k ⥤ Type (max v z))
    (S : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k) :
    (cofiberedCompletion.obj F).obj S ≃
      {X : FormalObject (CategoryOfElements.π F) // X.base = S}

declarations.name: Deformation.cofiberedCompletion_restriction_isIso
declarations.doc:
The canonical map from the restriction of a completion to the original
cofibered set is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem cofiberedCompletion_restriction_isIso
    (F : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k ⥤ Type (max v z)) :
    IsIso ((cofiberedCompletionAdjunction (Λ := Λ) (k := k)).counit.app F)

declarations.name: Deformation.associatedMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06HC.** After choosing pushforwards, a formal object `ξ` over `R`
determines a morphism from the restriction of the cofibered set represented by `R` to `F`.
On an Artinian point `α : R → A`, it is the pushforward of the level indexed by the
least nilpotence exponent of the maximal ideal of `A`, minus one.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def associatedMorphism
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p) (ξ : FormalObject p)
    (pushforwards : ChosenPushforwards p) : AssociatedMorphism ξ pushforwards

declarations.name: Deformation.formalObjectsYonedaEquivalence
declarations.doc:
Morphisms over the Artinian base from the restriction of the functor represented by `R`
to a category cofibered in groupoids form a category equivalent to the category of formal
objects over `R`, with the quasi-inverse `Ψ ∘ ι`. The forward direction is the equivalence
constructed in Tag 06SK by `representableMorphismFormalObjectEquivalence`, so it carries that
construction's explicit description at the Artinian quotient points of `R` and its
factorization through `Φ` followed by 2-Yoneda evaluation.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def formalObjectsYonedaEquivalence
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (R : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (P : ChosenCompletePushforwards (FormalObject.projection (p := p))) :
    BasedFunctor
        (BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Functor.Elements.π (restrictedCoyoneda R)))
        (BasedCategory.ofFunctor p) ≌
      (FormalObject.projection (p := p)).Fiber R

declarations.name: Deformation.formalObjectsYonedaEquivalence_functor
declarations.doc:
The forward direction of the Yoneda equivalence is the equivalence constructed in Tag
06SK. Its `levelIso` and `transition_comm` give the explicit description sending `φ` to the
formal object `(R, φ(R → R/𝔪_R^n), φ(f_n))`, and its `completionComparison` exhibits it as
`Φ` followed by 2-Yoneda evaluation.
declarations.statement:
public theorem formalObjectsYonedaEquivalence_functor
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (R : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (P : ChosenCompletePushforwards (FormalObject.projection (p := p))) :
    (formalObjectsYonedaEquivalence hp R P).functor =
      (representableMorphismFormalObjectEquivalence p hp R).equivalence.functor

declarations.name: Deformation.formalObjectsYonedaEquivalence_inverse
declarations.doc:
The quasi-inverse of the Yoneda equivalence is the composite `Ψ ∘ ι` specified in the
source.
declarations.statement:
public theorem formalObjectsYonedaEquivalence_inverse
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (R : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (P : ChosenCompletePushforwards (FormalObject.projection (p := p))) :
    (formalObjectsYonedaEquivalence hp R P).inverse = iotaCompPsi hp R P

declarations.name: Deformation.associatedMorphism_maps_to_canonicalEquivalence
declarations.doc:
The explicit morphism `ξ̲` associated to a formal object `ξ` maps to `ξ` under the Yoneda
equivalence: evaluating the equivalence constructed in Tag 06SK on
`associatedMorphism hp ξ pushforwards` returns `ξ`, up to an isomorphism over its complete
local base.
declarations.statement:
public theorem associatedMorphism_maps_to_canonicalEquivalence
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type uF} [Category.{vF} F]
    {p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k}
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (ξ : FormalObject p)
    (pushforwards : ChosenPushforwards p) :
    Nonempty
      ((representableMorphismFormalObjectEquivalence p hp ξ.base).equivalence.functor.obj
        (associatedMorphism hp ξ pushforwards).toBasedFunctor ≅
          (Functor.Fiber.mk rfl : (FormalObject.projection (p := p)).Fiber ξ.base))

declarations.name: Deformation.psiIotaIsoAssociatedMorphism
declarations.doc:
The explicit `Ψ(ι(ξ))` is isomorphic, over the Artinian base, to the morphism `ξ̲`
associated to `ξ` using any chosen pushforwards in the original category.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def psiIotaIsoAssociatedMorphism
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type uF} [Category.{vF} F]
    {p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k}
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (ξ : FormalObject p)
    (pushforwards : ChosenPushforwards p)
    (P : ChosenCompletePushforwards (FormalObject.projection (p := p))) :
    (psi hp ξ.base).obj ((iota ξ.base P).obj
        (Functor.Fiber.mk rfl : (FormalObject.projection (p := p)).Fiber ξ.base)) ≅
      (associatedMorphism hp ξ pushforwards).toBasedFunctor

declarations.name: Deformation.iotaIsoCompletionAssociatedMorphism
declarations.doc:
Under the canonical represented-completion identification, `ι(ξ)` is the completion of the
associated morphism `ξ̲`: `Φ` is the unit followed by levelwise completion, as in 06HA.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def iotaIsoCompletionAssociatedMorphism
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type uF} [Category.{vF} F]
    {p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k}
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (ξ : FormalObject p)
    (pushforwards : ChosenPushforwards p)
    (P : ChosenCompletePushforwards (FormalObject.projection (p := p))) :
    (iota ξ.base P).obj
        (Functor.Fiber.mk rfl : (FormalObject.projection (p := p)).Fiber ξ.base) ≅
      (unitBasedFunctor (representedProjection ξ.base)
        (representedProjection_cofibered ξ.base)).comp
          (completionMap
            ((extendRepresentedHom p ξ.base).obj
              (associatedMorphism hp ξ pushforwards).toBasedFunctor))

declarations.name: Deformation.ProrepresentableMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06HD.** A prorepresentable functor on `𝒞_Λ` together with a morphism from its
category of elements to a category cofibered over `𝒞_Λ`. This is the data Stacks 06HD
exhibits as equivalent to a formal object.
declarations.statement: structure ProrepresentableMorphism (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
declarations.comment: the data equivalent to a formal object

declarations.name: Deformation.ProrepresentableMorphism.Hom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06HD.** A morphism of prorepresentable pairs: a natural transformation of the
functors in the Yoneda direction, together with a morphism over `𝒞_Λ` from the restriction of
the source's morphism along it to the target's morphism.
declarations.statement:
structure Hom {p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k}
    (X Y : ProrepresentableMorphism p)

declarations.name: Deformation.restrictedCoyonedaMap_bijective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06HD.** Yoneda for `𝒞_Λ`: precomposition is a bijection from maps `R ⟶ S` of
complete local algebras onto natural transformations of the restricted representable functors
in the opposite direction. The inverse reads off the compatible system of quotient points
determined by a natural transformation and uses the completion description of Stacks 06HE.
declarations.statement:
theorem restrictedCoyonedaMap_bijective (R S : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k) :
    Function.Bijective (restrictedCoyonedaMap (R := R) (S := S))
declarations.comment: Yoneda for the restricted representable functors

declarations.name: Deformation.formalObjectsProrepresentableMorphismEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06HD.** Spelling out Stacks 06HC: the prorepresentable pairs over `p` carry a
category structure whose morphisms are `ProrepresentableMorphism.Hom`, and the category of
formal objects of `p` is equivalent to it. The hom equivalence is for the total categories, so
it pins down the morphisms between pairs with *different* prorepresentable functors, not only
those over a fixed one.
declarations.statement:
theorem formalObjectsProrepresentableMorphismEquivalence
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k) (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p) :
    ∃ c : Category (ProrepresentableMorphism p),
      letI := c
      c.Hom = (fun X Y => ProrepresentableMorphism.Hom X Y) ∧
      Nonempty (FormalObject p ≌ ProrepresentableMorphism p)

declarations.name: Deformation.coyonedaIsoAdicCompletion
declarations.doc:
The covariant functor represented by `R` is canonically the adic completion
of its restriction to Artinian local algebras.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def coyonedaIsoAdicCompletion
    (R : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k) :
    coyoneda.obj (Opposite.op R) ≅
      adicCompletion (artinianToComplete ⋙
        coyoneda.obj (Opposite.op R))

declarations.name: Deformation.coyonedaIsoAdicCompletion_hom_apply
declarations.doc:
At level `n`, the canonical isomorphism sends `f : R ⟶ S` to the composite
of `f` with the quotient homomorphism `S → S / m_S ^ (n + 1)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem coyonedaIsoAdicCompletion_hom_apply
    (R S : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k) (f : R ⟶ S) (n : ℕ) :
    (((coyonedaIsoAdicCompletion R).hom.app S f).value n).hom =
      (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ Λ (AdicTruncation.ideal S n)).comp f.hom

declarations.name: Deformation.adicCompletionRestrictionIso
declarations.doc:
A limit-preserving functor on complete local algebras is canonically the
completion of its restriction to Artinian local algebras.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def adicCompletionRestrictionIso
    (G : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k ⥤ Type v)
    [PreservesLimits G] :
    G ≅ adicCompletion (artinianToComplete ⋙ G)

declarations.name: Deformation.adicCompletionRestrictionIso_hom_apply
declarations.doc:
The canonical isomorphism sends a value to its image on each adic quotient.
The formula is independent of the chosen morphism representing that quotient.
declarations.statement:
public theorem adicCompletionRestrictionIso_hom_apply
    (G : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k ⥤ Type v)
    [PreservesLimits G]
    (S : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k) (x : G.obj S) (n : ℕ)
    (q : S ⟶ artinianToComplete.obj (AdicTruncation.obj S n))
    (hq : q.hom = Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ Λ (AdicTruncation.ideal S n)) :
    ((adicCompletionRestrictionIso G).hom.app S x).value n = G.map q x

declarations.name: Deformation.IsSmooth
declarations.doc:
A morphism of categories over `\mathcal C_\Lambda` is smooth if every
lifting problem over a surjective map `B \to A` has a compatible solution over
`B`.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev IsSmooth {𝓕 : BasedCategory.{v₁, u₁} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ
  k)} {𝓖 : BasedCategory.{v₂, u₂} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)} (φ : BasedFunctor 𝓕 𝓖) : Prop

declarations.name: Deformation.isSmooth_of_lifts_smallExtensions
declarations.statement:
theorem isSmooth_of_lifts_smallExtensions
    {𝓕 : BasedCategory.{v₁, u₁} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)}
    {𝓖 : BasedCategory.{v₂, u₂} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)}
    (h𝓕 : IsCofiberedInGroupoids 𝓕.p)
    (h𝓖 : IsCofiberedInGroupoids 𝓖.p)
    (φ : BasedFunctor 𝓕 𝓖)
    (h : ∀ ⦃B A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k⦄ (f : B ⟶ A),
      IsSmallExtension (CommRingCat.ofHom f.hom.toRingHom) →
        ∀ (y : 𝓖.obj) (x : 𝓕.obj) (g : y ⟶ φ.obj x),
