          𝓖.p.IsHomLift f g →
            ∃ (x' : 𝓕.obj) (lift : x' ⟶ x) (a : φ.obj x' ⟶ y),
              𝓕.p.IsHomLift f lift ∧
                𝓖.p.IsHomLift (𝟙 B) a ∧ φ.map lift = a ≫ g) :
    IsSmooth φ

declarations.name: Deformation.pushforwardFunctorsFormTwoCommutativeSquare
declarations.doc:
Chosen pushforwards along an arrow in the base give functors between the
fibres, and a morphism of categories cofibered in groupoids intertwines these
functors up to a natural isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem pushforwardFunctorsFormTwoCommutativeSquare
    {C : Type uC} [Category.{vC} C]
    {F : Type uF} [Category.{vF} F] {G : Type uG} [Category.{vG} G]
    (pF : F ⥤ C) (pG : G ⥤ C)
    (hG : IsCofiberedInGroupoids pG)
    (φ : F ⥤ G) (hφ : φ ⋙ pG = pF)
    {B A : C} {f : B ⟶ A}
    (PF : PushforwardChoice pF f) (PG : PushforwardChoice pG f) :
    Nonempty (PushforwardSquare φ hφ PF PG)

declarations.name: Deformation.inducedFunctorToPullback
declarations.doc:
The functor from the source fibre to the categorical pullback induced by a
chosen two-commutative pushforward square.
declarations.statement:
public def inducedFunctorToPullback
    {C : Type uC} [Category.{vC} C]
    {F : Type uF} [Category.{vF} F] {G : Type uG} [Category.{vG} G]
    {pF : F ⥤ C} {pG : G ⥤ C} {φ : F ⥤ G} {hφ : φ ⋙ pG = pF}
    {B A : C} {f : B ⟶ A}
    {PF : PushforwardChoice pF f}
    {PG : PushforwardChoice pG f}
    (Q : PushforwardSquare φ hφ PF PG) :
    pF.Fiber B ⥤
      Limits.CategoricalPullback
        (Functor.Fiber.inducedFunctor (p := pG) (S := A)
          (F := Functor.Fiber.fiberInclusion (p := pF) (S := A) ⋙ φ)
          (by simpa only [Functor.assoc, hφ] using
            (Functor.Fiber.fiberInclusion_comp_eq_const (p := pF) (S := A))))
        Q.target.toFunctor

declarations.name: Deformation.essSurj_inducedFunctorToPullback_of_isSmooth
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06HI.** For a smooth morphism of categories cofibered in groupoids,
the functor to the 2-fibre product determined by any choice of pushforwards along a surjection
of the base is essentially surjective.
declarations.statement:
public lemma essSurj_inducedFunctorToPullback_of_isSmooth
    (h𝓕 : IsCofiberedInGroupoids 𝓕.p) (h𝓖 : IsCofiberedInGroupoids 𝓖.p)
    (φ : BasedFunctor 𝓕 𝓖) (hsm : IsSmooth φ)
    {B A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k} (f : B ⟶ A)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f.hom)
    (PF : PushforwardChoice 𝓕.p f) (PG : PushforwardChoice 𝓖.p f) :
    (inducedFunctorToPullback
      (pushforwardSquareOfChoices 𝓕.p 𝓖.p h𝓖 φ.toFunctor φ.w PF PG)).EssSurj

declarations.name: Deformation.exists_lift_of_inducedFunctorToPullback_essSurj
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06HI.** If the functor to the 2-fibre product determined by some
choice of pushforwards along an arrow `f` of the base is essentially surjective, then every
lifting problem over `f` has a compatible solution.
declarations.statement:
public lemma exists_lift_of_inducedFunctorToPullback_essSurj
    (h𝓕 : IsCofiberedInGroupoids 𝓕.p) (h𝓖 : IsCofiberedInGroupoids 𝓖.p)
    (φ : BasedFunctor 𝓕 𝓖)
    {B A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k} (f : B ⟶ A)
    (hes : ∀ (PF : PushforwardChoice 𝓕.p f) (PG : PushforwardChoice 𝓖.p f),
      (inducedFunctorToPullback
        (pushforwardSquareOfChoices 𝓕.p 𝓖.p h𝓖 φ.toFunctor φ.w PF PG)).EssSurj)
    (y : 𝓖.obj) (x : 𝓕.obj) (g : y ⟶ φ.obj x) (hg : 𝓖.p.IsHomLift f g) :
    ∃ (x' : 𝓕.obj) (lift : x' ⟶ x) (a : φ.obj x' ⟶ y),
      𝓕.p.IsHomLift f lift ∧ 𝓖.p.IsHomLift (𝟙 B) a ∧ φ.map lift = a ≫ g

declarations.name: Deformation.isSmooth_iff_inducedFunctorToPullback_essSurj
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06HI.** A morphism of categories cofibered in groupoids over `𝒞_Λ`
is smooth if and only if, for every surjection `B → A` of the base and every choice of
pushforwards along it, the functor `𝓕(B) ⟶ 𝓕(A) ×_{𝓖(A)} 𝓖(B)` determined by those choices is
essentially surjective.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isSmooth_iff_inducedFunctorToPullback_essSurj
    (h𝓕 : IsCofiberedInGroupoids 𝓕.p) (h𝓖 : IsCofiberedInGroupoids 𝓖.p)
    (φ : BasedFunctor 𝓕 𝓖) :
    IsSmooth φ ↔
      ∀ ⦃B A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k⦄ (f : B ⟶ A),
        Function.Surjective f.hom →
        ∀ (PF : PushforwardChoice 𝓕.p f) (PG : PushforwardChoice 𝓖.p f),
          (inducedFunctorToPullback
            (pushforwardSquareOfChoices 𝓕.p 𝓖.p h𝓖 φ.toFunctor φ.w PF PG)).EssSurj

declarations.name: Deformation.isSmooth_iff_inducedFunctorToPullback_essSurj_smallExtension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06HI.** The same equivalence, tested only on small extensions: by
Tag 06HH the lifting property for small extensions already implies smoothness.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isSmooth_iff_inducedFunctorToPullback_essSurj_smallExtension
    (h𝓕 : IsCofiberedInGroupoids 𝓕.p) (h𝓖 : IsCofiberedInGroupoids 𝓖.p)
    (φ : BasedFunctor 𝓕 𝓖) :
    IsSmooth φ ↔
      ∀ ⦃B A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k⦄ (f : B ⟶ A),
        IsSmallExtension (CommRingCat.ofHom f.hom.toRingHom) →
        ∀ (PF : PushforwardChoice 𝓕.p f) (PG : PushforwardChoice 𝓖.p f),
          (inducedFunctorToPullback
            (pushforwardSquareOfChoices 𝓕.p 𝓖.p h𝓖 φ.toFunctor φ.w PF PG)).EssSurj

declarations.name: Deformation.isSmooth_elementsBasedFunctor_iff
declarations.doc:
Smoothness of a morphism between categories of elements is equivalent to
surjectivity of the usual map to the fibre product for every surjection in
`𝒞_Λ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSmooth_elementsBasedFunctor_iff
    {F G : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k ⥤ Type t} (α : F ⟶ G) :
    IsSmooth (elementsBasedFunctor α) ↔
      ∀ ⦃B A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k⦄ (f : B ⟶ A),
        Function.Surjective f.hom →
          ∀ (xA : F.obj A) (yB : G.obj B),
            α.app A xA = G.map f yB →
            ∃ xB : F.obj B, F.map f xB = xA ∧ α.app B xB = yB

declarations.name: Deformation.isSmooth_toIsomorphismClasses
declarations.doc:
The canonical morphism from a category cofibered in groupoids to its associated functor of
isomorphism classes is smooth.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isSmooth_toIsomorphismClasses
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    (𝓕 : BasedCategory.{v₁, u₁} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k))
    (h𝓕 : IsCofiberedInGroupoids 𝓕.p) :
    IsSmooth (toIsomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕)

declarations.name: Deformation.restrictedRepresentableMap_isSmooth_iff_isPowerSeriesOver
declarations.doc:
The morphism between restricted representable categories induced by `f : R ⟶ S` is smooth
if and only if `f` exhibits `S` as a formal power series ring in finitely many variables over
`R`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem restrictedRepresentableMap_isSmooth_iff_isPowerSeriesOver
    {R S : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k} (f : R ⟶ S) :
    IsSmooth (restrictedRepresentableMap f) ↔ IsPowerSeriesOver f
declarations.comment: smooth if and only if a power series ring

declarations.name: Deformation.isSmooth_comp
declarations.doc:
The composite of two smooth morphisms of categories over
`\mathcal C_\Lambda` is smooth.

declarations.name: Deformation.isSmooth_twoFibreProductSnd
declarations.doc: A base change of a smooth morphism of categories cofibered in groupoids is smooth.

declarations.name: Deformation.isSmooth_of_essSurj_comp
declarations.doc:
If the first of two morphisms of categories cofibered in groupoids is
essentially surjective and their composite is smooth, then the second morphism
is smooth.

declarations.name: Deformation.essSurj_of_isSmooth_of_fiber_essSurj
declarations.doc:
A smooth morphism of categories over `\mathcal C_\Lambda` with cofibered
target is essentially surjective whenever its special-fibre functor is.
declarations.statement:
public theorem essSurj_of_isSmooth_of_fiber_essSurj
    {𝓕 : BasedCategory.{v₁, u₁} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, w, w} Λ k)}
    {𝓖 : BasedCategory.{v₂, u₂} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, w, w} Λ k)}
    (φ : BasedFunctor 𝓕 𝓖)
    (h𝓖 : IsCofiberedInGroupoids 𝓖.p)
    (hφ : IsSmooth φ)
    (h₀ : (fiberFunctor φ (residueFieldObject Λ k)).EssSurj) :
    φ.toFunctor.EssSurj

declarations.name: Deformation.completionMap_essSurj_of_isSmooth_of_fiber_essSurj
declarations.doc:
A smooth morphism, essentially surjective over the residue field, is
essentially surjective after completion.
declarations.statement:
public theorem completionMap_essSurj_of_isSmooth_of_fiber_essSurj
    {F : Type uF} [Category.{vF} F] {G : Type uG} [Category.{vG} G]
    {p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k}
    {q : G ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k}
    (φ : BasedFunctor (BasedCategory.ofFunctor p) (BasedCategory.ofFunctor q))
    (hq : IsCofiberedInGroupoids q)
    (hφ : IsSmooth φ)
    (h₀ : (fiberFunctor φ (residueFieldObject Λ k)).EssSurj) :
    (completionMap φ).toFunctor.EssSurj

declarations.name: Deformation.IsSmooth
declarations.doc:
A morphism of categories over `\mathcal C_\Lambda` is smooth if every
lifting problem over a surjective map `B \to A` has a compatible solution over
`B`.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev IsSmooth {𝓕 : BasedCategory.{v₁, u₁} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ
  k)} {𝓖 : BasedCategory.{v₂, u₂} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)} (φ : BasedFunctor 𝓕 𝓖) : Prop
declarations.comment: smoothness of the structure morphism, i.e. an unobstructed cofibered category

declarations.name: Deformation.IsVersal
declarations.doc:
A formal object is versal when its associated morphism from the represented
functor is smooth, independently of the auxiliary pushforward choices.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev IsVersal (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (ξ : FormalObject p) : Prop

declarations.name: Deformation.isVersal_iff_lifts_artinian
declarations.doc:
Versality is equivalent to solving every lifting triangle in the completion
whose lower arrow is a surjective map of Artinian local algebras.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isVersal_iff_lifts_artinian
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p) (ξ : FormalObject p) :
    IsVersal hp ξ ↔
      ∀ {B A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k} (f : B ⟶ A),
        Function.Surjective f.hom →
          ∀ {y x : FormalObject p} (g : y ⟶ x),
            (FormalObject.projection (p := p)).IsHomLift
              (artinianToComplete.map f) g →
              ∀ (a : ξ ⟶ x), ∃ b : ξ ⟶ y, b ≫ g = a

declarations.name: Deformation.isVersal_iff_lifts_smallExtensions
declarations.doc:
In the intrinsic lifting criterion, it suffices to test small extensions
of Artinian local algebras.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isVersal_iff_lifts_smallExtensions
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p) (ξ : FormalObject p) :
    IsVersal hp ξ ↔
      ∀ {B A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k} (f : B ⟶ A),
        InfinitesimalLifting.IsSmallExtension
          (CommRingCat.ofHom f.hom.toRingHom) →
          ∀ {y x : FormalObject p} (g : y ⟶ x),
            (FormalObject.projection (p := p)).IsHomLift
              (artinianToComplete.map f) g →
              ∀ (a : ξ ⟶ x), ∃ b : ξ ⟶ y, b ≫ g = a

declarations.name: Deformation.isSmooth_associatedMorphism_iff_isVersal
declarations.doc:
Smoothness of the morphism associated to a formal object is independent of
the choices of pushforwards used to construct that morphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isSmooth_associatedMorphism_iff_isVersal
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p) (ξ : FormalObject p)
    (pushforwards : ChosenPushforwards p) :
    IsSmooth (associatedMorphism hp ξ pushforwards).toBasedFunctor ↔
      IsVersal hp ξ

declarations.name: Deformation.nonempty_hom_of_isVersal
declarations.doc: A versal formal object admits a morphism to every formal object.

declarations.name: Deformation.SchlessingerConditionS1
declarations.doc:
Schlessinger's condition (S1): every cospan whose second base map is
surjective has a completion over a pullback square in `C_Λ`.
declarations.statement:
public structure SchlessingerConditionS1
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k] {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
      (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k) : Prop

declarations.name: Deformation.SchlessingerConditionS2
declarations.doc:
Schlessinger's condition (S2): completions exist when the second map is
the dual-number projection, and any two completions over the same base square
admit the required fibrewise comparison morphism.
declarations.statement:
public structure SchlessingerConditionS2
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k] {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
      (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k) : Prop

declarations.name: Deformation.schlessingerConditionS1_of_smallExtensions
declarations.doc:
The small-extension cases of the completion property suffice for
Schlessinger's condition (S1).
declarations.statement:
theorem schlessingerConditionS1_of_smallExtensions
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    {p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k}
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (h : ∀ {x₁ x₂ x : F} (f₁ : x₁ ⟶ x) (f₂ : x₂ ⟶ x),
      IsSmallExtension (CommRingCat.ofHom (p.map f₂).hom.toRingHom) →
        ∀ {A₁₂ : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k}
          (g₁ : A₁₂ ⟶ p.obj x₁) (g₂ : A₁₂ ⟶ p.obj x₂),
          IsPullback g₂ g₁ (p.map f₂) (p.map f₁) →
            Nonempty (PullbackCompletion p f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂)) :
    SchlessingerConditionS1 p

declarations.name: Deformation.schlessingerConditionS1_elements_iff
declarations.doc:
For the category of elements of `F : 𝒞_Λ ⥤ Type t`, Schlessinger's condition (S1) says
that the map `F(A₁ ×_A A₂) → F(A₁) ×_{F(A)} F(A₂)` is surjective whenever `A₂ → A` is
surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem schlessingerConditionS1_elements_iff
    (F : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k ⥤ Type t) :
    SchlessingerConditionS1 (Functor.Elements.π F) ↔
      ∀ ⦃A₁ A₂ A A₁₂ : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k⦄ (f₁ : A₁ ⟶ A) (f₂ : A₂ ⟶ A),
        Function.Surjective f₂.hom →
          ∀ (g₁ : A₁₂ ⟶ A₁) (g₂ : A₁₂ ⟶ A₂) (hPB : IsPullback g₂ g₁ f₂ f₁),
            Function.Surjective (fibreProductComparison F g₁ g₂ f₁ f₂ hPB.w)

declarations.name: Deformation.schlessingerConditionS2_elements_iff
declarations.doc:
For the category of elements of `F : 𝒞_Λ ⥤ Type t`, Schlessinger's condition (S2) says
that the map `F(A ×_k k[ε]) → F(A) ×_{F(k)} F(k[ε])` is bijective.
declarations.statement:
theorem schlessingerConditionS2_elements_iff
    (F : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k ⥤ Type t) :
    SchlessingerConditionS2 (Functor.Elements.π F) ↔
      ∀ ⦃A A₀ Aε B : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k⦄ (d : A ⟶ A₀) (e : Aε ⟶ A₀),
        IsDualNumberProjection e →
          ∀ (g : B ⟶ A) (gε : B ⟶ Aε) (hPB : IsPullback gε g e d),
            Function.Bijective (fibreProductComparison F g gε d e hPB.w)

declarations.name: Deformation.schlessingerConditionS2_completion_squareZero
declarations.doc:
The existence clause of (S2) extends from dual numbers to `k[V]` for
finite-dimensional `V`.
declarations.statement:
theorem schlessingerConditionS2_completion_squareZero
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {V : Type z} [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] [FiniteDimensional k V]
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p) (hS2 : SchlessingerConditionS2 p)
    {x xV x₀ : F} (d : x ⟶ x₀) (e : xV ⟶ x₀)
    (he : IsSquareZeroProjection (V := V) (p.map e))
    {AV : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k}
    (g : AV ⟶ p.obj x) (gV : AV ⟶ p.obj xV)
    (hpb : IsPullback gV g (p.map e) (p.map d)) :
    Nonempty (PullbackCompletion p d e g gV)

declarations.name: Deformation.schlessingerConditionS2_comparison_squareZero
declarations.doc:
The comparison clause of (S2) extends from dual numbers to `k[V]` for
finite-dimensional `V`.
declarations.statement:
theorem schlessingerConditionS2_comparison_squareZero
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {V : Type z} [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] [FiniteDimensional k V]
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p) (hS2 : SchlessingerConditionS2 p)
    {x xV x₀ : F} (d : x ⟶ x₀) (e : xV ⟶ x₀)
    (he : IsSquareZeroProjection (V := V) (p.map e))
    {AV : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k}
    (g : AV ⟶ p.obj x) (gV : AV ⟶ p.obj xV)
    (hpb : IsPullback gV g (p.map e) (p.map d))
    (P Q : PullbackCompletion p d e g gV) :
    ∃ b : P.apex ⟶ Q.apex,
      (P.toFirst = b ≫ Q.toFirst) ∧
        (p.map b = eqToHom P.apex_eq ≫ eqToHom Q.apex_eq.symm)

declarations.name: Deformation.schlessingerConditionS2_of_isIsomorphismClasses
declarations.doc:
The associated functor of isomorphism classes of a category cofibered in
groupoids inherits (S2) if the special fibre is a setoid or automorphisms
over the residue field lift along dual-number projections. In particular this
holds for a predeformation category.
declarations.statement:
public theorem schlessingerConditionS2_of_isIsomorphismClasses
    (𝓕 : BasedCategory.{v₁, u₁} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k))
    (h𝓕 : IsCofiberedInGroupoids 𝓕.p)
    (hS2 : SchlessingerConditionS2 𝓕.p)
    (hSpecial :
      (IsPredeformationCategory 𝓕.p) ∨
      (IsSetoidCategory (𝓕.p.Fiber (residueFieldObject Λ k))) ∨
      (∀ {xε x₀ : 𝓕.obj} (e : xε ⟶ x₀),
        IsDualNumberProjection (𝓕.p.map e) →
        ∀ a : x₀ ≅ x₀, 𝓕.p.map a.hom = 𝟙 (𝓕.p.obj x₀) →
          ∃ b : xε ≅ xε,
            (𝓕.p.map b.hom = 𝟙 (𝓕.p.obj xε)) ∧
              (b.hom ≫ e = e ≫ a.hom))) :
    SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕))

declarations.name: Deformation.schlessingerConditionS1_of_isIsomorphismClasses
declarations.doc:
The associated functor of isomorphism classes of a category cofibered in
groupoids inherits Schlessinger's condition (S1).
declarations.statement:
public theorem schlessingerConditionS1_of_isIsomorphismClasses
    {𝓕 : BasedCategory.{v₁, u₁} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)}
    {𝓖 : BasedCategory.{v₂, u₂} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)}
    (φ : BasedFunctor 𝓕 𝓖)
    (hφ : IsIsomorphismClasses φ)
    (hS1 : SchlessingerConditionS1 𝓕.p) :
    SchlessingerConditionS1 𝓖.p

declarations.name: Deformation.linearFunctorLift_unique
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06I6, general source category.** A finite-product-preserving
set-valued functor on any preadditive `R`-linear category with a terminal object, binary
products and a zero object has a unique `R`-linear lift to `R`-modules. The two cases of the
source are the instances of this for the category of all modules and for the category of
finitely generated ones; it is also what applies to the full subcategories of the module
category that arise as the domain of a tangent functor.
declarations.statement:
theorem linearFunctorLift_unique
    (R : Type uR) [CommRing R]
    {C : Type uC} [Category.{vC} C] [Preadditive C] [Linear R C]
    [HasTerminal C] [HasBinaryProducts C] [HasZeroObject C]
    (F : C ⥤ Type uM) [PreservesFiniteProducts F] :
    Nonempty (Unique (LinearFunctorLift R F))

declarations.name: Deformation.fgModuleCat_linearFunctorLift_unique
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06I6, finitely generated case.** A finite-product-preserving
set-valued functor on finitely generated `R`-modules which takes the zero module to a singleton
has a unique `R`-linear lift to `R`-modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem fgModuleCat_linearFunctorLift_unique
    (R : Type uR) [CommRing R] (F : FGModuleCat.{vM} R ⥤ Type uM)
    [PreservesFiniteProducts F] [Unique (F.obj (FGModuleCat.of R PUnit))] :
    Nonempty (Unique (LinearFunctorLift R F))

declarations.name: Deformation.moduleCat_linearFunctorLift_unique
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06I6, unrestricted case.** A finite-product-preserving set-valued
functor on `R`-modules which takes the zero module to a singleton has a unique `R`-linear lift
to `R`-modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem moduleCat_linearFunctorLift_unique
    (R : Type uR) [CommRing R] (F : ModuleCat.{vM} R ⥤ Type uM)
    [PreservesFiniteProducts F] [Unique (F.obj (ModuleCat.of R PUnit))] :
    Nonempty (Unique (LinearFunctorLift R F))

declarations.name: Deformation.fgModuleCat_linearFunctorLift_natTrans
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06I7.** A natural transformation between product-preserving
set-valued functors on finitely generated modules uniquely lifts to a natural transformation
between their canonical linear lifts. Its underlying natural transformation is the original
one.
declarations.statement:
theorem fgModuleCat_linearFunctorLift_natTrans
    (R : Type uR) [CommRing R]
    (F G : FGModuleCat.{vM} R ⥤ Type uM)
    [PreservesFiniteProducts F] [Unique (F.obj (FGModuleCat.of R PUnit))]
    [PreservesFiniteProducts G] [Unique (G.obj (FGModuleCat.of R PUnit))]
    (t : F ⟶ G) :
    ∃! τ : (fgModuleCatLinearFunctorLift R F).functor ⟶
        (fgModuleCatLinearFunctorLift R G).functor,
      Functor.whiskerRight τ (forget (ModuleCat.{uM} R)) =
        eqToHom (fgModuleCatLinearFunctorLift R F).forget_comp ≫
          t ≫
            eqToHom (fgModuleCatLinearFunctorLift R G).forget_comp.symm

declarations.name: Deformation.linearFunctor_iso_tensorLeft
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06I8.** A linear functor from finite-dimensional vector spaces over
a field to vector spaces is naturally isomorphic to tensoring with its value on the ground
field.
declarations.statement:
theorem linearFunctor_iso_tensorLeft (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (L : FGModuleCat.{u} K ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} K) [L.Additive] [L.Linear K] :
    Nonempty
      (((forget₂ (FGModuleCat.{u} K) (ModuleCat.{u} K)) ⋙
          MonoidalCategory.tensorLeft (L.obj (FGModuleCat.of K K))) ≅ L)

declarations.name: Deformation.trivSqZeroExtFunctor_preservesFiniteProducts
declarations.doc:
The trivial square-zero extension functor from `R`-modules to
`S`-algebras over `R` preserves finite products.
declarations.statement:
theorem trivSqZeroExtFunctor_preservesFiniteProducts :
    PreservesFiniteProducts (trivSqZeroExtFunctor S R)

declarations.name: Deformation.tangentSpaceModuleStructure
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06IA.** A set-valued functor on a strictly full
subcategory of `S`-algebras over `R` which takes the zero square-zero extension
and products of square-zero extensions to the corresponding products of sets
has a natural `R`-linear module-valued lift on all finitely generated
`R`-modules.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def tangentSpaceModuleStructure
    (P : ObjectProperty (Over (CommAlgCat.of S R))) [P.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms]
    (hP : ∀ M : FGModuleCat.{u} R, P ((squareZeroExtensionFunctor S R).obj M))
    (F : P.FullSubcategory ⥤ Type v)
    (hF : TangentSpaceFunctorConditions S R P hP F) :
    LinearFunctorLift R (tangentSpaceSetFunctor S R P hP F)

declarations.name: Deformation.TangentSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06IB.** The tangent space of a set-valued functor is its value on the
dual numbers.
declarations.statement:
abbrev TangentSpace
    (P : ObjectProperty (Over (CommAlgCat.of S R)))
    (hε : P (dualNumbersOver S R))
    (F : P.FullSubcategory ⥤ Type w) : Type w

declarations.name: Deformation.isProrepresentable_preservesFiniteLimits
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06IC.** A prorepresentable functor on Artinian local
`Λ`-algebras preserves finite limits.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProrepresentable_preservesFiniteLimits
    (F : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k ⥤ Type v) (hF : IsProrepresentable F) :
    PreservesFiniteLimits F

declarations.name: Deformation.tangentSpaceDerivationsLinearEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06IC.** The tangent space of the functor represented by `S`
is canonically linearly equivalent to the `Λ`-derivations from `S` to its residue field.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def tangentSpaceDerivationsLinearEquiv
    (S : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k) :
    letI : Algebra S k := (residueHom S).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    tangentSpaceArtinian Λ k (restrictedCoyoneda S) ≃ₗ[k] Derivation Λ S k

declarations.name: Deformation.tangentSpaceDerivationsLinearEquiv_apply
declarations.doc: A tangent vector corresponds to the downlifted square-zero component.
declarations.statement:
theorem tangentSpaceDerivationsLinearEquiv_apply
    (S : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k)
    (f : tangentSpaceArtinian Λ k (restrictedCoyoneda S)) (s : S) :
    letI : Algebra S k := (residueHom S).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    tangentSpaceDerivationsLinearEquiv S f s = (f.hom s).snd.down

declarations.name: Deformation.tangentSpaceDerivationsLinearEquiv_precomp
declarations.doc:
The identification commutes with precomposition by morphisms of representing
algebras.
declarations.statement:
theorem tangentSpaceDerivationsLinearEquiv_precomp
    (T S : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k) (g : T ⟶ S)
    (f : tangentSpaceArtinian Λ k (restrictedCoyoneda S)) (t : T) :
    tangentSpaceDerivationsLinearEquiv T (g ≫ f) t =
      tangentSpaceDerivationsLinearEquiv S f (g.hom t)

declarations.name: Deformation.tangentSpace_finiteDimensional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06IC.** The tangent space of a prorepresentable functor is
finite-dimensional, under the chapter's standing assumption that `Λ → k` is finite.
declarations.statement:
theorem tangentSpace_finiteDimensional [Module.Finite Λ k]
    (S : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k) :
    FiniteDimensional k (tangentSpaceArtinian Λ k (restrictedCoyoneda S))

declarations.name: Deformation.squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquiv
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquiv
    (S : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (V : Type x) [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] :
    SquareZeroPoint S V ≃ Derivations S V

declarations.name: Deformation.squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquiv_apply
declarations.doc:
In the forward identification, the derivation associated to `f` is the square-zero
component of `f`, i.e. `s ↦ f(s) - q(s)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquiv_apply
    (S : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (V : Type x) [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]
    (f : SquareZeroPoint S V) (s : S) :
    squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquiv S V f s = (f.1 s).snd

declarations.name: Deformation.squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquiv_symm_apply
declarations.doc:
In the inverse identification, a derivation `D` is sent to the map
`s ↦ q(s) + D(s)` into `k[V]`.
declarations.statement:
theorem squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquiv_symm_apply
    (S : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (V : Type x) [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]
    (D : Derivations S V) (s : S) :
    ((squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquiv S V).symm D).1 s =
      (residueHom S s, D s)

declarations.name: Deformation.squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquiv_naturality
declarations.doc: The canonical identification is functorial in the finite-dimensional vector space.
declarations.statement:
theorem squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquiv_naturality
    (S : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    {V : Type x} {W : Type y} [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module k W] (l : V →ₗ[k] W)
    (f : SquareZeroPoint S V) (s : S) :
    squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquiv S W (f.map S l) s =
      l (squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquiv S V f s)

declarations.name: Deformation.squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquiv_precomp
declarations.doc:
The canonical identification is natural under precomposition in the representing
complete local algebra.
declarations.statement:
theorem squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquiv_precomp
    (S : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (T : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, y, w} Λ k)
    (g : T →ₐ[Λ] S) (hg : (residueHom S).comp g = residueHom T)
    (V : Type x) [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]
    (f : SquareZeroPoint S V) (t : T) :
    squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquiv T V (f.precomp S T g hg V) t =
      squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquiv S V f (g t)

declarations.name: Deformation.squareZeroExtensionObject
declarations.doc:
A finite-dimensional trivial square-zero extension, as an object of the category
of complete local `Λ`-algebras, with its algebra coordinates and residue augmentation.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def squareZeroExtensionObject
    (V : Type x) [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] [FiniteDimensional k V] :
    { A : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, max w x, w} Λ k //
      ∃ e : A ≃+* TrivSqZeroExt k V,
        (∀ r : Λ, e (algebraMap Λ A r) = (algebraMap Λ k r, 0)) ∧
        (∀ a : A, (e a).fst = residueHom A a) }

declarations.name: Deformation.squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquivHom
declarations.doc:
The identification for the actual morphism type of the category of complete local
`Λ`-algebras. The equivalence `e` identifies the chosen object `A` with `k[V]`, and
`he` says that its residue map is the square-zero augmentation.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquivHom
    (S A : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (V : Type x) [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]
    (e : A ≃+* TrivSqZeroExt k V)
    (hΛ : ∀ r : Λ, e (algebraMap Λ A r) = (algebraMap Λ k r, 0))
    (he : ∀ a : A, (e a).fst = residueHom A a) :
    (S ⟶ A) ≃ Derivations S V

declarations.name: Deformation.squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquivHom_apply
declarations.doc:
A categorical morphism `f : S ⟶ k[V]` determines the derivation given by its
square-zero component.
declarations.statement:
theorem squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquivHom_apply
    (S A : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (V : Type x) [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]
    (e : A ≃+* TrivSqZeroExt k V)
    (hΛ : ∀ r : Λ, e (algebraMap Λ A r) = (algebraMap Λ k r, 0))
    (he : ∀ a : A, (e a).fst = residueHom A a)
    (f : S ⟶ A) (s : S) :
    squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquivHom S A V e hΛ he f s =
      (e (f.hom s)).snd

declarations.name: Deformation.squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquivHom_symm_apply
declarations.doc:
Conversely, the categorical morphism determined by `D` is `s ↦ q(s) + D(s)`
in square-zero coordinates.
declarations.statement:
theorem squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquivHom_symm_apply
    (S A : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (V : Type x) [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]
    (e : A ≃+* TrivSqZeroExt k V)
    (hΛ : ∀ r : Λ, e (algebraMap Λ A r) = (algebraMap Λ k r, 0))
    (he : ∀ a : A, (e a).fst = residueHom A a)
    (D : Derivations S V) (s : S) :
    e (((squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquivHom S A V e hΛ he).symm D).hom s) =
      (residueHom S s, D s)

declarations.name: Deformation.squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquivHom_naturality
declarations.doc: The categorical identification commutes with maps between square-zero extensions.
declarations.statement:
theorem squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquivHom_naturality
    (S A B : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (V : Type x) (W : Type y)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module k W]
    (eA : A ≃+* TrivSqZeroExt k V)
    (hΛA : ∀ r : Λ, eA (algebraMap Λ A r) = (algebraMap Λ k r, 0))
    (heA : ∀ a : A, (eA a).fst = residueHom A a)
    (eB : B ≃+* TrivSqZeroExt k W)
    (hΛB : ∀ r : Λ, eB (algebraMap Λ B r) = (algebraMap Λ k r, 0))
    (heB : ∀ b : B, (eB b).fst = residueHom B b)
    (g : A ⟶ B) (l : V →ₗ[k] W)
    (hg : ∀ a : A, (eB (g.hom a)).snd = l (eA a).snd)
    (f : S ⟶ A) (s : S) :
    squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquivHom S B W eB hΛB heB (f ≫ g) s =
      l (squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquivHom S A V eA hΛA heA f s)

declarations.name: Deformation.squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquivHom_precomp
declarations.doc: The categorical identification is natural in the representing algebra.
declarations.statement:
theorem squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquivHom_precomp
    (T S A : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (V : Type x) [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]
    (e : A ≃+* TrivSqZeroExt k V)
    (hΛ : ∀ r : Λ, e (algebraMap Λ A r) = (algebraMap Λ k r, 0))
    (he : ∀ a : A, (e a).fst = residueHom A a)
    (g : T ⟶ S) (f : S ⟶ A) (t : T) :
    squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquivHom T A V e hΛ he (g ≫ f) t =
      squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquivHom S A V e hΛ he f (g.hom t)

declarations.name: Deformation.naturalTransformation_linearMapOnSquareZeroExtensions
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06ID.** A natural transformation between functors
satisfying the tangent-space hypotheses is `R`-linear on every trivial
square-zero extension `R[M]`, with respect to the natural module structures of
Tag 06IA.  The case `M = R` is the induced linear map on tangent spaces.
declarations.statement:
theorem naturalTransformation_linearMapOnSquareZeroExtensions
    (P : ObjectProperty (Over (CommAlgCat.of S R))) [P.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms]
    (hP : ∀ M : FGModuleCat.{u} R,
      P ((squareZeroExtensionFunctor S R).obj M))
    (F G : P.FullSubcategory ⥤ Type v)
    (hF : TangentSpaceFunctorConditions S R P hP F)
    (hG : TangentSpaceFunctorConditions S R P hP G)
    (t : F ⟶ G) (M : FGModuleCat.{u} R) :
    let LF := tangentSpaceModuleStructure S R P hP F hF
    let LG := tangentSpaceModuleStructure S R P hP G hG
    let eF := congrArg (fun H : FGModuleCat.{u} R ⥤ Type v ↦ H.obj M) LF.forget_comp
    let eG := congrArg (fun H : FGModuleCat.{u} R ⥤ Type v ↦ H.obj M) LG.forget_comp
    ∃ l : LF.functor.obj M ⟶ LG.functor.obj M, ∀ x : LF.functor.obj M,
      cast eG (l x) =
        t.app ((squareZeroExtensionRestriction S R P hP).obj M) (cast eF x)

declarations.name: Deformation.tangentSpaceFunctor_iso_tensorLeft
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06IE.** Over a field, the functor
`V ↦ F(K[V])`, with its natural linear structure, is naturally isomorphic
to tensoring `V` with the tangent space `F(K[ε])`.
declarations.statement:
theorem tangentSpaceFunctor_iso_tensorLeft
    (S : Type s) (K : Type u) [CommRing S] [Field K] [Algebra S K]
    (P : ObjectProperty (Over (CommAlgCat.of S K)))
    [P.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms]
    (hP : ∀ V : FGModuleCat.{u} K,
      P ((squareZeroExtensionFunctor S K).obj V))
    (F : P.FullSubcategory ⥤ Type u)
    (hF : TangentSpaceFunctorConditions S K P hP F) :
    let L := (tangentSpaceModuleStructure S K P hP F hF).functor
    Nonempty
      (L ≅
        (forget₂ (FGModuleCat.{u} K) (ModuleCat.{u} K) ⋙
          MonoidalCategory.tensorLeft (L.obj (FGModuleCat.of K K))))

declarations.name: Deformation.predeformationTangentSpace
declarations.doc:
The tangent space of a predeformation category, formed from its associated functor of
isomorphism classes.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev predeformationTangentSpace
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k)
    (hp : IsPredeformationCategory p) : Type u₁

declarations.name: Deformation.associatedTangentSpaceModuleStructure
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06IH.** The natural `k`-linear structure on the values of the
associated functor at finite-dimensional square-zero extensions. In particular its value on
`k[ε]` is the tangent space of the predeformation category.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def associatedTangentSpaceModuleStructure
    (hS2 : SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.cofibered))) :
    LinearFunctorLift k
      (squareZeroExtensionArtinian.{u, w, max v w} Λ k ⋙
        isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.cofibered)

declarations.name: Deformation.associatedTangentSpaceFunctor_iso_tensorLeft
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06IH.** The canonical equivalence from tangent vectors tensored
with `V` to the associated functor evaluated on `k[V]`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def associatedTangentSpaceFunctor_iso_tensorLeft
    (hS2 : SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.cofibered))) :
    let L := (associatedTangentSpaceModuleStructure.{u, v, w} 𝓕 h𝓕 hS2).functor
    letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory.{u, v, w} 𝓕.p) := ⟨h𝓕⟩
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.cofibered))) := ⟨hS2⟩
    let T := tangentSpaceArtinian.{u, w, v} Λ k (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.cofibered)
    ∀ V : FGModuleCat.{max v w} k,
      LinearEquiv (RingHom.id k) (TensorProduct k T V)
        ((L.obj V : ModuleCat.{u₁} k) : Type u₁)

declarations.name: Deformation.associatedTangentSpaceFunctor_iso_tensorLeft_pure
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06IH.** On pure tensors, the canonical equivalence is induced by the
map `ULift k → V` carrying `1` to `v`.
declarations.statement:
theorem associatedTangentSpaceFunctor_iso_tensorLeft_pure
    (hS2 : SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.cofibered))) :
    let L := (associatedTangentSpaceModuleStructure.{u, v, w} 𝓕 h𝓕 hS2).functor
    letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory.{u, v, w} 𝓕.p) := ⟨h𝓕⟩
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.cofibered))) := ⟨hS2⟩
    let T := tangentSpaceArtinian.{u, w, v} Λ k (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.cofibered)
    ∀ (V : FGModuleCat.{max v w} k) (t : T) (v : V),
      associatedTangentSpaceFunctor_iso_tensorLeft.{u, v, w} 𝓕 h𝓕 hS2 V (t ⊗ₜ[k] v) =
        (L.map (FGModuleCat.ofHom
          (LinearMap.smulRight (ULift.moduleEquiv : ULift.{v} k ≃ₗ[k] k).toLinearMap v))).hom
          (cast (associatedTangentSpaceModuleStructure_carrier.{u, v, w}
            𝓕 h𝓕 hS2).symm t)

declarations.name: Deformation.associatedTangentSpaceFunctor_iso_tensorLeft_naturality
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06IH.** The canonical tensor equivalences commute with every linear
map between finite-dimensional vector spaces.
declarations.statement:
theorem associatedTangentSpaceFunctor_iso_tensorLeft_naturality
    (hS2 : SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.cofibered))) :
    let L := (associatedTangentSpaceModuleStructure.{u, v, w} 𝓕 h𝓕 hS2).functor
    letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory.{u, v, w} 𝓕.p) := ⟨h𝓕⟩
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.cofibered))) := ⟨hS2⟩
    let T := tangentSpaceArtinian.{u, w, v} Λ k (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.cofibered)
    ∀ (V W : FGModuleCat.{max v w} k) (f : V ⟶ W) (z : TensorProduct k T V),
      (L.map f).hom
          (associatedTangentSpaceFunctor_iso_tensorLeft.{u, v, w} 𝓕 h𝓕 hS2 V z) =
        associatedTangentSpaceFunctor_iso_tensorLeft.{u, v, w} 𝓕 h𝓕 hS2 W
          (TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id : T →ₗ[k] T) f.hom.hom z)

declarations.name: Deformation.associatedTangentSpaceFunctorConditions
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06IH.** Schlessinger's condition (S2) for the associated functor
of a predeformation category supplies the singleton and binary-product conditions that the
natural module structure of Stacks 06IA requires.
declarations.statement:
theorem associatedTangentSpaceFunctorConditions
    (𝓕 : BasedCategory.{v₁, u₁} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, w, w} Λ k))
    (h𝓕 : IsPredeformationCategory 𝓕.p)
    (hS2 : SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.cofibered))) :
    TangentSpaceFunctorConditions Λ k (artinianLocalOver Λ k)
      (squareZeroExtension_mem_artinianLocalOver Λ k)
      (artinianLocalOverToArtinian Λ k ⋙ isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.cofibered)

declarations.name: Deformation.differential
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06II.** The differential is the map on associated
isomorphism-class functors evaluated at the dual numbers.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev differential
    {𝓕 : BasedCategory.{v₁, u₁} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, w, w} Λ k)}
    {𝓖 : BasedCategory.{v₂, u₂} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, w, w} Λ k)}
    (h𝓕 : IsCofiberedInGroupoids 𝓕.p)
    (h𝓖 : IsCofiberedInGroupoids 𝓖.p)
    (φ : BasedFunctor 𝓕 𝓖) :
    artinianTangentSpace Λ k (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕) →
      artinianTangentSpace Λ k (isomorphismClasses 𝓖 h𝓖)

declarations.name: Deformation.differential_isLinearMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06IJ.** The differential of a morphism of predeformation categories
is `k`-linear for the natural tangent-space vector structures when both associated functors
satisfy (S2).
declarations.statement:
theorem differential_isLinearMap
    (𝓕 : BasedCategory.{v₁, u₁} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, w, w} Λ k))
    (𝓖 : BasedCategory.{v₂, u₂} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, w, w} Λ k))
    (h𝓕 : IsPredeformationCategory 𝓕.p)
    (h𝓖 : IsPredeformationCategory 𝓖.p)
    (hS2𝓕 : SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.cofibered)))
    (hS2𝓖 : SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓖 h𝓖.cofibered)))
    (φ : BasedFunctor 𝓕 𝓖) :
    letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory 𝓕.p) := ⟨h𝓕⟩
    letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory 𝓖.p) := ⟨h𝓖⟩
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.cofibered))) := ⟨hS2𝓕⟩
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓖 h𝓖.cofibered))) := ⟨hS2𝓖⟩
    IsLinearMap k (differential h𝓕.cofibered h𝓖.cofibered φ)

declarations.name: Deformation.mapIsomorphismClasses_isLinearMap_artinianDualNumbers
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06IJ.** The map induced on associated functors of isomorphism classes
by a morphism of predeformation categories is `k`-linear at the universe-lifted dual numbers,
when both associated functors satisfy (S2).

This is `Deformation.differential_isLinearMap` for the universe-lifted presentation of the
dual numbers used by the tangent space at a point.
declarations.statement:
theorem mapIsomorphismClasses_isLinearMap_artinianDualNumbers
    (𝓕 : BasedCategory.{v₁, u₁} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k))
    (𝓖 : BasedCategory.{v₂, u₂} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k))
    (h𝓕 : IsPredeformationCategory.{u, v, w} 𝓕.p)
    (h𝓖 : IsPredeformationCategory.{u, v, w} 𝓖.p)
    (hS2𝓕 : SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.cofibered)))
    (hS2𝓖 : SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓖 h𝓖.cofibered)))
    (φ : BasedFunctor 𝓕 𝓖) :
    letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory.{u, v, w} 𝓕.p) := ⟨h𝓕⟩
    letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory.{u, v, w} 𝓖.p) := ⟨h𝓖⟩
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.cofibered))) := ⟨hS2𝓕⟩
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓖 h𝓖.cofibered))) := ⟨hS2𝓖⟩
    IsLinearMap k (mapIsomorphismClasses h𝓕.cofibered h𝓖.cofibered φ
      (artinianDualNumbers.{u, w, v} Λ k))

declarations.name: Deformation.tangentSpaceAtPoint
declarations.doc:
The tangent space of a category cofibered over `𝒞_Λ` at a point over `k`:
the tangent space of its slice predeformation category.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev tangentSpaceAtPoint
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k)
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (x : p.Fiber (residueFieldObject.{u, v, w} Λ k)) : Type (max u₁ v₁)

declarations.name: Deformation.sliceBasedFunctorAtPoint
declarations.doc:
The morphism of slice predeformation categories induced by a based functor:
it sends an arrow `y ⟶ x` to its image arrow `φ(y) ⟶ φ(x)`.
declarations.statement:
def sliceBasedFunctorAtPoint
    (φ : BasedFunctor (BasedCategory.ofFunctor p) (BasedCategory.ofFunctor q))
    (x : p.Fiber (residueFieldObject.{u, v, w} Λ k)) :
    BasedFunctor
      (BasedCategory.ofFunctor
        (objectsOverFunctor p x.1))
      (BasedCategory.ofFunctor
        (objectsOverFunctor q (imagePoint φ x).1))

declarations.name: Deformation.differentialAtPoint
declarations.doc:
The differential of a morphism of cofibered categories at a point over `k`:
the differential of its induced morphism between slice predeformation categories.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev differentialAtPoint
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (hq : IsCofiberedInGroupoids q)
    (φ : BasedFunctor (BasedCategory.ofFunctor p) (BasedCategory.ofFunctor q))
    (x : p.Fiber (residueFieldObject.{u, v, w} Λ k)) :
    tangentSpaceAtPoint p hp x →
      tangentSpaceAtPoint q hq (imagePoint φ x)

declarations.name: Deformation.tangentSpaceAtPointAddCommGroup
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06IK.** The additive group underlying the natural `k`-vector space
structure on the tangent space of a category cofibered in groupoids at a point over the
residue field, available when the category satisfies Schlessinger's condition (S2).
declarations.statement:
noncomputable instance tangentSpaceAtPointAddCommGroup
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k)
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    [hS2 : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2 p)]
    (x : p.Fiber (residueFieldObject.{u, v, w} Λ k)) :
    AddCommGroup (tangentSpaceAtPoint.{u, v, w} p hp x)

declarations.name: Deformation.tangentSpaceAtPointModule
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06IK.** The natural action of the residue field on the tangent space
of a category cofibered in groupoids at a point over the residue field, available when the
category satisfies Schlessinger's condition (S2).
declarations.statement:
noncomputable instance tangentSpaceAtPointModule
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k)
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    [hS2 : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2 p)]
    (x : p.Fiber (residueFieldObject.{u, v, w} Λ k)) :
    Module k (tangentSpaceAtPoint.{u, v, w} p hp x)

declarations.name: Deformation.differentialAtPoint_isLinearMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06IK.** If both categories cofibered in groupoids satisfy
Schlessinger's condition (S2), then the differential of a morphism between them at a point over
the residue field is `k`-linear for the natural vector space structures on the tangent spaces
at that point and its image.
declarations.statement:
theorem differentialAtPoint_isLinearMap
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (hq : IsCofiberedInGroupoids q)
    (hS2p : SchlessingerConditionS2 p)
    (hS2q : SchlessingerConditionS2 q)
    (φ : BasedFunctor (BasedCategory.ofFunctor p) (BasedCategory.ofFunctor q))
    (x : p.Fiber (residueFieldObject.{u, v, w} Λ k)) :
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2 p) := ⟨hS2p⟩
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2 q) := ⟨hS2q⟩
    IsLinearMap k (differentialAtPoint.{u, v, w} hp hq φ x)

declarations.name: Deformation.HasBijectiveDifferential
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06IM.** The differential of the morphism associated
to a formal object is bijective from `Λ`-derivations to its tangent space.
declarations.statement:
public def HasBijectiveDifferential
    (hp : Deformation.IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (ξ : Deformation.FormalObject p) : Prop

declarations.name: Deformation.isMinimalVersal_of_hasBijectiveDifferentialOnDerivationOrbits
declarations.doc:
A versal formal object of a predeformation category whose
differential is bijective on derivation orbits is a minimal versal formal object.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isMinimalVersal_of_hasBijectiveDifferentialOnDerivationOrbits
    (hp : IsPredeformationCategory p) (ξ : FormalObject p) (hξ : IsVersal hp.cofibered ξ)
    (hd : HasBijectiveDifferentialOnDerivationOrbits.{u, v, w} p hp ξ) :
    IsMinimalVersal hp.cofibered ξ

declarations.name: Deformation.isomorphic_of_hasBijectiveDifferentialOnDerivationOrbits
declarations.doc:
Any two versal formal objects whose differentials are bijective on derivation orbits are
isomorphic.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isomorphic_of_hasBijectiveDifferentialOnDerivationOrbits
    (hp : IsPredeformationCategory p) (ξ η : FormalObject p)
    (hξ : IsVersal hp.cofibered ξ) (hη : IsVersal hp.cofibered η)
    (hdξ : HasBijectiveDifferentialOnDerivationOrbits.{u, v, w} p hp ξ)
    (hdη : HasBijectiveDifferentialOnDerivationOrbits.{u, v, w} p hp η) :
    Nonempty (ξ ≅ η)

declarations.name: Deformation.exists_section_iff_exists_dualNumberLift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06IS.** In a square over the pullback of an
Artinian local algebra and the dual numbers over the residue field, a section
of the first projection exists precisely when the bottom arrow lifts across
the dual-number projection.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_section_iff_exists_dualNumberLift
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (hS2 : SchlessingerConditionS2 p)
    {y xε x x₀ : F} (b : y ⟶ xε) (a : y ⟶ x)
    (e : xε ⟶ x₀) (d : x ⟶ x₀)
    (hcomm : b ≫ e = a ≫ d)
    (hdual : IsDualNumberProjection (p.map e))
    (hPB : IsPullback (p.map b) (p.map a) (p.map e) (p.map d)) :
    (∃ s : x ⟶ y, s ≫ a = 𝟙 x) ↔
      (∃ sε : x ⟶ xε, sε ≫ e = d)

declarations.name: Deformation.exists_lift_of_pushforward_map
declarations.doc:
A map from `x₁` to the pushforward of `y` along the canonical
infinitesimal-coordinate map produces a lift `x₁ → x₂`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_lift_of_pushforward_map
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k)
    (hp : IsPredeformationCategory p)
    (hS2 : SchlessingerConditionS2 p)
    {y x₁ x₂ x z : F}
    (a : y ⟶ x₁) (c : y ⟶ x₂) (a₁ : x₁ ⟶ x) (a₂ : x₂ ⟶ x)
    (hcomm : c ≫ a₂ = a ≫ a₁)
    (hPB : IsPullback (p.map c) (p.map a) (p.map a₂) (p.map a₁))
    (hsmall : InfinitesimalLifting.IsSmallExtension
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (p.map a₂).hom.toRingHom))
    (h : p.obj x₁ ⟶ p.obj x₂)
    (hh : h ≫ p.map a₂ = p.map a₁)
    (target_eq : p.obj z =
      (infinitesimalMap (p.map a₁) (p.map a₂) hsmall h hh
        (p.map a) (p.map c) hPB).target)
    (q : y ⟶ z)
    (hqmap : p.map q =
      (infinitesimalMap (p.map a₁) (p.map a₂) hsmall h hh
        (p.map a) (p.map c) hPB).g ≫ eqToHom target_eq.symm)
    (_hq : p.IsCocartesian (p.map q) q)
    (lift : x₁ ⟶ z) :
    ∃ b : x₁ ⟶ x₂, b ≫ a₂ = a₁

declarations.name: Deformation.isVersal_iff_differential_surjective_and_base_lifts
declarations.doc:
Surjectivity on tangent spaces together with lifting the map of underlying
complete local algebras across every small-extension triangle characterizes
versality for a predeformation category satisfying (S1) and (S2).
declarations.statement:
public theorem isVersal_iff_differential_surjective_and_base_lifts
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    (𝓕 : BasedCategory.{vF, uF} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k))
    (hpre : IsPredeformationCategory 𝓕.p)
    (hS1 : SchlessingerConditionS1 𝓕.p)
    (hS2 : SchlessingerConditionS2 𝓕.p)
    (ξ : FormalObject 𝓕.p)
    (pushforwards : ChosenPushforwards 𝓕.p) :
    IsVersal hpre.cofibered ξ ↔
      (Function.Surjective
        (mapIsomorphismClasses
          (categoryOfElements_projection_isCofibered
            (restrictedCoyoneda ξ.base))
          hpre.cofibered
          (associatedMorphism
            hpre.cofibered ξ pushforwards).toBasedFunctor
          (artinianDualNumbers Λ k)) ∧
       ∀ ⦃B A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k⦄ (f : B ⟶ A),
         InfinitesimalLifting.IsSmallExtension
           (CommRingCat.ofHom f.hom.toRingHom) →
         ∀ ⦃y x : FormalObject 𝓕.p⦄ (g : y ⟶ x),
           (FormalObject.projection (p := 𝓕.p)).IsHomLift
             (artinianToComplete.map f) g →
         ∀ (a : ξ ⟶ x), ∃ b : ξ.base ⟶ y.base,
             b ≫ g.base = a.base)

declarations.name: Deformation.schlessingerConditionS1_of_versal_bijectiveDifferential
declarations.doc:
A versal formal object with bijective differential forces Schlessinger's
condition (S1). The bijectivity of the differential is not used.
declarations.statement:
public theorem schlessingerConditionS1_of_versal_bijectiveDifferential
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type uF} [Category.{vF} F]
    (p : F ⥤ Deformation.ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k)
    (hp : Deformation.IsPredeformationCategory p)
    (ξ : Deformation.FormalObject p)
    (hversal : Deformation.IsVersal hp.cofibered ξ)
    (_hbij : Deformation.HasBijectiveDifferential hp.cofibered ξ) :
    Deformation.SchlessingerConditionS1 p

declarations.name: Deformation.schlessingerConditionS2_of_versal_bijectiveDifferential
declarations.doc:
A versal formal object with bijective differential forces Schlessinger's
condition (S2).
declarations.statement:
public theorem schlessingerConditionS2_of_versal_bijectiveDifferential
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type uF} [Category.{vF} F]
    (p : F ⥤ Deformation.ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k)
    (hp : Deformation.IsPredeformationCategory p)
    (ξ : Deformation.FormalObject p)
    (hversal : Deformation.IsVersal hp.cofibered ξ)
    (hbij : Deformation.HasBijectiveDifferential hp.cofibered ξ) :
    Deformation.SchlessingerConditionS2 p

declarations.name: Deformation.finiteDimensional_tangentSpace_of_versal_bijectiveDifferential
declarations.doc:
A versal formal object with bijective differential has a
finite-dimensional tangent space.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finiteDimensional_tangentSpace_of_versal_bijectiveDifferential
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    [Module.Finite Λ k]
    (𝓕 : BasedCategory.{vF, uF} (Deformation.ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k))
    (hp : Deformation.IsPredeformationCategory 𝓕.p)
    (ξ : Deformation.FormalObject 𝓕.p)
    (hversal : Deformation.IsVersal hp.cofibered ξ)
    (hbij : Deformation.HasBijectiveDifferential hp.cofibered ξ) :
    let hS2 := schlessingerConditionS2_of_versal_bijectiveDifferential
      𝓕.p hp ξ hversal hbij
    let hAssocS2 :=
      Deformation.schlessingerConditionS2_of_isIsomorphismClasses
        𝓕 hp.cofibered hS2 (Or.inl hp)
    letI : Fact (Deformation.IsPredeformationCategory 𝓕.p) := ⟨hp⟩
    letI : Fact (Deformation.SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (Deformation.isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hp.cofibered))) :=
      ⟨hAssocS2⟩
    FiniteDimensional k
      (Deformation.tangentSpaceArtinian Λ k
        (Deformation.isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hp.cofibered))

declarations.name: Deformation.exists_versalFormalObject
declarations.doc:
**Schlessinger's existence theorem.** A predeformation category over `𝒞_Λ` which satisfies
his conditions (S1) and (S2) and whose tangent space is finite dimensional has a versal formal
object. The formal object is the limit of the tower of presentations of Stacks 06SZ over a
power series algebra on a basis of the tangent space, taken over a complete local algebra which
is formally smooth over `Λ`; versality is checked through the criterion of Stacks 06IU, whose
condition (1) comes from the choice of the bottom stage of the tower and whose condition (2) is
the key lifting step.

The finite-dimensionality hypothesis speaks about the canonical `k`-vector space structure of
Stacks 06IH on the tangent space, which is available as soon as `𝓕` is a predeformation
category whose functor of isomorphism classes satisfies (S2); both of those are consequences
of the hypotheses — the second is `Deformation.schlessingerConditionS2_of_isIsomorphismClasses`
applied to `hS2` — so they are installed by the `letI` prefix of `hfin` rather than assumed.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_versalFormalObject
    (Λ : Type u) (k : Type w) [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    [Module.Finite Λ k]
    (𝓕 : BasedCategory.{vF, uF} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k))
    (hpre : IsPredeformationCategory.{u, v, w} 𝓕.p)
    (hS1 : SchlessingerConditionS1 𝓕.p)
    (hS2 : SchlessingerConditionS2 𝓕.p)
    (hfin :
      letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory.{u, v, w} 𝓕.p) := ⟨hpre⟩
      letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2
          (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hpre.cofibered))) :=
        ⟨schlessingerConditionS2_of_isIsomorphismClasses 𝓕 hpre.cofibered hS2 (Or.inl hpre)⟩
      FiniteDimensional k (tangentSpaceArtinian.{u, w, v} Λ k
        (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hpre.cofibered))) :
    ∃ ξ : FormalObject 𝓕.p, IsVersal hpre.cofibered ξ
declarations.comment: existence of a versal formal object

declarations.name: Deformation.schlessingerConditionS1_of_minimalVersal_hasBijectiveDifferential
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06IX,** the implication (1) ⟹ (3a). Condition (1) of that theorem is
that the predeformation category have a minimal versal formal object whose differential is
bijective, Stacks 06IM; condition (3a) is Schlessinger's condition (S1). Neither the minimality
nor the bijectivity of the differential is used: versality alone gives (S1), by Stacks 06SY.
declarations.statement:
public theorem schlessingerConditionS1_of_minimalVersal_hasBijectiveDifferential
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k)
    (hp : IsPredeformationCategory p)
    (hξ : ∃ ξ : FormalObject p,
      IsMinimalVersal hp.cofibered ξ ∧ HasBijectiveDifferential hp.cofibered ξ) :
    SchlessingerConditionS1 p

declarations.name: Deformation.exists_minimalVersal_hasBijectiveDifferentialOnDerivationOrbits
declarations.doc:
A predeformation category satisfying Schlessinger's conditions (S1) and (S2) whose tangent
space is finite dimensional has a minimal versal formal object whose differential is bijective
on `Der_Λ(k, k)`-orbits.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_minimalVersal_hasBijectiveDifferentialOnDerivationOrbits
    (Λ : Type u) (k : Type w) [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    [Module.Finite Λ k]
    (𝓕 : BasedCategory.{vF, uF} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k))
    (hpre : IsPredeformationCategory.{u, v, w} 𝓕.p)
    (hS1 : SchlessingerConditionS1 𝓕.p)
    (hS2 : SchlessingerConditionS2 𝓕.p)
    (hfin :
      letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory.{u, v, w} 𝓕.p) := ⟨hpre⟩
      letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2
          (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hpre.cofibered))) :=
        ⟨schlessingerConditionS2_of_isIsomorphismClasses 𝓕 hpre.cofibered hS2 (Or.inl hpre)⟩
      FiniteDimensional k (tangentSpaceArtinian.{u, w, v} Λ k
        (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hpre.cofibered))) :
    ∃ ξ : FormalObject 𝓕.p,
      IsMinimalVersal hpre.cofibered ξ ∧
        HasBijectiveDifferentialOnDerivationOrbits.{u, v, w} 𝓕.p hpre ξ

declarations.name: Deformation.schlessingerConditionS2_of_minimalVersal_hasBijectiveDifferential
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06IX,** the implication (1) implies (3b). A predeformation category
with a minimal versal formal object whose differential is bijective — that is, one satisfying
the condition of Stacks 06IM — satisfies Schlessinger's condition (S2).

This is part (2) of Stacks 06IV, which asks only for versality, restated under the hypothesis
(1) of Stacks 06IX.
declarations.statement:
public theorem schlessingerConditionS2_of_minimalVersal_hasBijectiveDifferential
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    (𝓕 : BasedCategory.{vF, uF} (Deformation.ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k))
    (hpre : Deformation.IsPredeformationCategory 𝓕.p)
    (hξ : ∃ ξ : Deformation.FormalObject 𝓕.p,
      Deformation.IsMinimalVersal hpre.cofibered ξ ∧
        Deformation.HasBijectiveDifferential hpre.cofibered ξ) :
    Deformation.SchlessingerConditionS2 𝓕.p

declarations.name: Deformation.finiteDimensional_tangentSpace_of_minimalVersal_hasBijectiveDifferential
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06IX,** the implication (1) implies (3c). The tangent space of a
predeformation category with a minimal versal formal object whose differential is bijective —
that is, one satisfying the condition of Stacks 06IM — is finite dimensional.

This is part (3) of Stacks 06IV, which asks only for versality, restated under the hypothesis
(1) of Stacks 06IX. The canonical `k`-vector-space structure of Stacks 06IH on the tangent
space needs the predeformation property of `𝓕` and condition (S2) for its functor of
isomorphism classes; the first is `hpre` and the second comes from
`Deformation.schlessingerConditionS2_of_minimalVersal_hasBijectiveDifferential`, the
implication (1) implies (3b), so both are installed by the `letI` prefix of the conclusion and
neither is assumed.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finiteDimensional_tangentSpace_of_minimalVersal_hasBijectiveDifferential
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k] [Module.Finite Λ k]
    (𝓕 : BasedCategory.{vF, uF} (Deformation.ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k))
    (hpre : Deformation.IsPredeformationCategory 𝓕.p)
    (hξ : ∃ ξ : Deformation.FormalObject 𝓕.p,
      Deformation.IsMinimalVersal hpre.cofibered ξ ∧
        Deformation.HasBijectiveDifferential hpre.cofibered ξ) :
    letI : Fact (Deformation.IsPredeformationCategory 𝓕.p) := ⟨hpre⟩
    letI : Fact (Deformation.SchlessingerConditionS2 (CategoryOfElements.π
        (Deformation.isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hpre.cofibered))) :=
      ⟨Deformation.schlessingerConditionS2_of_isIsomorphismClasses 𝓕 hpre.cofibered
        (schlessingerConditionS2_of_minimalVersal_hasBijectiveDifferential 𝓕 hpre hξ)
        (Or.inl hpre)⟩
    FiniteDimensional k
      (Deformation.tangentSpaceArtinian Λ k
        (Deformation.isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hpre.cofibered))

declarations.name: Deformation.exists_minimalVersal_hasBijectiveDifferential_of_separable
declarations.doc:
If `k` is separable over the image field of `Λ`, orbitwise bijectivity
of a minimal versal formal object's differential is ordinary bijectivity.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_minimalVersal_hasBijectiveDifferential_of_separable
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (Deformation.residueImageField Λ k) k]
    (𝓕 : BasedCategory.{vF, uF} (Deformation.ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k))
    (hpre : Deformation.IsPredeformationCategory 𝓕.p)
    (hξ : ∃ ξ : Deformation.FormalObject 𝓕.p,
      Deformation.IsMinimalVersal hpre.cofibered ξ ∧
        Deformation.HasBijectiveDifferentialOnDerivationOrbits 𝓕.p hpre ξ) :
    ∃ ξ : Deformation.FormalObject 𝓕.p,
      Deformation.IsMinimalVersal hpre.cofibered ξ ∧
        Deformation.HasBijectiveDifferential hpre.cofibered ξ

declarations.name: Deformation.IsHull
declarations.doc:
A *hull* of a category cofibered in groupoids over `𝒞_Λ` is a versal formal object whose
differential `dξ : T\underline{R}|_{𝒞_Λ} → T𝓕` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev IsHull {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type uF} [Category.{vF} F]
    {p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k}
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p) (ξ : FormalObject p) : Prop

declarations.name: Deformation.exists_hull_of_schlessingerConditions
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06IY.** A set-valued predeformation functor on `𝒞_Λ` satisfying
Schlessinger's conditions (H1), (H2) and (H3) has a hull, provided `k` is separable over the
image field of `Λ`: a versal formal object whose differential is an isomorphism.

This is Schlessinger's theorem on the existence of hulls. It is Stacks 06IX read through the
identifications of Stacks 06GT and 06HY, exactly as
`Deformation.exists_versalFormalObject_of_schlessingerConditions` is Stacks 06IW, and (H3) is
stated and discharged in the same way: about `TF = F(k[ε])` itself, transported inside the
proof by `Deformation.finiteDimensional_tangentSpace_isomorphismClasses_of_setValued`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_hull_of_schlessingerConditions
    (Λ : Type u) (k : Type w) [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    [Module.Finite Λ k] [Algebra.IsSeparable (residueImageField Λ k) k]
    (F : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k ⥤ Type t)
    (hpre : IsPredeformationFunctor.{u, v, w, t} F)
    (hH1 : ∀ ⦃A₁ A₂ A A₁₂ : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k⦄
      (f₁ : A₁ ⟶ A) (f₂ : A₂ ⟶ A), Function.Surjective f₂.hom →
        ∀ (g₁ : A₁₂ ⟶ A₁) (g₂ : A₁₂ ⟶ A₂) (hPB : IsPullback g₂ g₁ f₂ f₁),
          Function.Surjective (fibreProductComparison F g₁ g₂ f₁ f₂ hPB.w))
    (hH2 : ∀ ⦃A A₀ Aε B : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k⦄
      (d : A ⟶ A₀) (e : Aε ⟶ A₀), IsDualNumberProjection e →
        ∀ (g : B ⟶ A) (gε : B ⟶ Aε) (hPB : IsPullback gε g e d),
          Function.Bijective (fibreProductComparison F g gε d e hPB.w))
    (hH3 :
      letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory.{u, v, w}
          (BasedCategory.ofFunctor (CategoryOfElements.π F)).p) :=
        ⟨(isPredeformationCategory_iff F).2 hpre⟩
      letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2 (CategoryOfElements.π
          (isomorphismClasses (BasedCategory.ofFunctor (CategoryOfElements.π F))
            ((isPredeformationCategory_iff F).2 hpre).cofibered))) :=
        ⟨schlessingerConditionS2_of_isIsomorphismClasses
          (BasedCategory.ofFunctor (CategoryOfElements.π F))
          ((isPredeformationCategory_iff F).2 hpre).cofibered
          ((schlessingerConditionS2_elements_iff F).2 hH2)
          (Or.inl ((isPredeformationCategory_iff F).2 hpre))⟩
      letI := setValuedTangentSpaceAddCommGroup.{u, v, w, t} F
        ((isPredeformationCategory_iff F).2 hpre)
      letI := setValuedTangentSpaceModule.{u, v, w, t} F
        ((isPredeformationCategory_iff F).2 hpre)
      FiniteDimensional k (tangentSpaceArtinian.{u, w, v} Λ k F)) :
    ∃ ξ : FormalObject (CategoryOfElements.π F),
      IsHull ((isPredeformationCategory_iff F).2 hpre).cofibered ξ

declarations.name: Deformation.exists_hull_of_schlessingerConditions_isClassical
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06IY.** In the classical case — `Λ` a Noetherian complete local ring
whose residue field is identified with `k` — a set-valued predeformation functor satisfying
Schlessinger's conditions (H1), (H2) and (H3) has a hull.

A classical base satisfies the three standing hypotheses of
`Deformation.exists_hull_of_schlessingerConditions`: it is Noetherian, `k` is a finite
`Λ`-module, and `k` is separable over the image field of `Λ` because that image field is all
of `k`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_hull_of_schlessingerConditions_isClassical
    (Λ : Type u) (k : Type w) [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k] (hΛ : IsClassical Λ k)
    (F : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k ⥤ Type t)
    (hpre : IsPredeformationFunctor.{u, v, w, t} F)
    (hH1 : ∀ ⦃A₁ A₂ A A₁₂ : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k⦄
      (f₁ : A₁ ⟶ A) (f₂ : A₂ ⟶ A), Function.Surjective f₂.hom →
        ∀ (g₁ : A₁₂ ⟶ A₁) (g₂ : A₁₂ ⟶ A₂) (hPB : IsPullback g₂ g₁ f₂ f₁),
          Function.Surjective (fibreProductComparison F g₁ g₂ f₁ f₂ hPB.w))
    (hH2 : ∀ ⦃A A₀ Aε B : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k⦄
      (d : A ⟶ A₀) (e : Aε ⟶ A₀), IsDualNumberProjection e →
        ∀ (g : B ⟶ A) (gε : B ⟶ Aε) (hPB : IsPullback gε g e d),
          Function.Bijective (fibreProductComparison F g gε d e hPB.w))
    (hH3 :
      letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory.{u, v, w}
          (BasedCategory.ofFunctor (CategoryOfElements.π F)).p) :=
        ⟨(isPredeformationCategory_iff F).2 hpre⟩
      letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2 (CategoryOfElements.π
          (isomorphismClasses (BasedCategory.ofFunctor (CategoryOfElements.π F))
            ((isPredeformationCategory_iff F).2 hpre).cofibered))) :=
        ⟨schlessingerConditionS2_of_isIsomorphismClasses
          (BasedCategory.ofFunctor (CategoryOfElements.π F))
          ((isPredeformationCategory_iff F).2 hpre).cofibered
          ((schlessingerConditionS2_elements_iff F).2 hH2)
          (Or.inl ((isPredeformationCategory_iff F).2 hpre))⟩
      letI := setValuedTangentSpaceAddCommGroup.{u, v, w, t} F
        ((isPredeformationCategory_iff F).2 hpre)
      letI := setValuedTangentSpaceModule.{u, v, w, t} F
        ((isPredeformationCategory_iff F).2 hpre)
      FiniteDimensional k (tangentSpaceArtinian.{u, w, v} Λ k F)) :
    ∃ ξ : FormalObject (CategoryOfElements.π F),
      IsHull ((isPredeformationCategory_iff F).2 hpre).cofibered ξ
declarations.comment: (H1) + (H2) + (H3) implies a hull exists, classical case

declarations.name: Deformation.mapIsomorphismClasses_bijective_of_isIsomorphismClasses
declarations.doc:
A based functor realizing the functor of isomorphism classes is bijective on isomorphism
classes over every object of the base: injective because its fibres are skeletal and identify
exactly the isomorphism classes upstairs, surjective because it is essentially surjective on
each fibre.
declarations.statement:
public theorem mapIsomorphismClasses_bijective_of_isIsomorphismClasses
    {𝓐 : BasedCategory.{v₁, u₁} C} {𝓑 : BasedCategory.{v₂, u₂} C}
    (h𝓐 : IsCofiberedInGroupoids 𝓐.p) (h𝓑 : IsCofiberedInGroupoids 𝓑.p)
    (φ : BasedFunctor 𝓐 𝓑) (hφ : IsIsomorphismClasses φ) (A : C) :
    Function.Bijective (mapIsomorphismClasses h𝓐 h𝓑 φ A)

declarations.name: Deformation.isSmooth_associatedMorphism_toIsomorphismClasses
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06IZ.** The composite of the morphism associated to a versal formal
object with the canonical morphism to the functor of isomorphism classes is smooth.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isSmooth_associatedMorphism_toIsomorphismClasses
    (ξ : FormalObject 𝓕.p) (hξ : IsVersal hpre.cofibered ξ)
    (pushforwards : ChosenPushforwards 𝓕.p) :
    IsSmooth (BasedFunctor.comp
      (associatedMorphism hpre.cofibered ξ pushforwards).toBasedFunctor
      (toIsomorphismClasses 𝓕 hpre.cofibered))

declarations.name: Deformation.isVersal_imageInIsomorphismClasses
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06IZ.** The image of a versal formal object in the functor of
isomorphism classes is versal.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isVersal_imageInIsomorphismClasses
    (ξ : FormalObject 𝓕.p) (hξ : IsVersal hpre.cofibered ξ) :
    IsVersal
      (categoryOfElements_projection_isCofibered (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hpre.cofibered))
      (imageInIsomorphismClasses 𝓕 hpre ξ)

declarations.name: Deformation.hasBijectiveDifferential_imageInIsomorphismClasses
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06IZ.** The image in the functor of isomorphism classes of a formal
object with bijective differential has bijective differential: the canonical morphism
identifies the two tangent spaces.
declarations.statement:
public theorem hasBijectiveDifferential_imageInIsomorphismClasses
    (ξ : FormalObject 𝓕.p) (hξ : HasBijectiveDifferential hpre.cofibered ξ) :
    HasBijectiveDifferential
      (categoryOfElements_projection_isCofibered (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hpre.cofibered))
      (imageInIsomorphismClasses 𝓕 hpre ξ)

declarations.name: Deformation.differential_toIsomorphismClasses_bijective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06IZ.** The canonical morphism from a predeformation category to its
functor of isomorphism classes identifies tangent spaces.
declarations.statement:
public theorem differential_toIsomorphismClasses_bijective :
    Function.Bijective
      (differential hpre.cofibered
        (categoryOfElements_projection_isCofibered (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hpre.cofibered))
        (toIsomorphismClasses 𝓕 hpre.cofibered))
declarations.comment: tangent spaces of the canonical morphism

declarations.name: Deformation.exists_hull_isomorphismClasses
declarations.doc:
A predeformation category satisfying Schlessinger's conditions (S1) and (S2), with
finite-dimensional tangent space and separable residue field extension, has a versal formal
object with bijective differential whose image in the associated functor of isomorphism classes
is again versal with bijective differential, hence a hull of that functor.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_hull_isomorphismClasses
    (Λ : Type u) (k : Type w) [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    [Module.Finite Λ k] [Algebra.IsSeparable (residueImageField Λ k) k]
    (𝓕 : BasedCategory.{vF, uF} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k))
    (hpre : IsPredeformationCategory.{u, v, w} 𝓕.p)
    (hS1 : SchlessingerConditionS1 𝓕.p)
    (hS2 : SchlessingerConditionS2 𝓕.p)
    (hfin :
      letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory.{u, v, w} 𝓕.p) := ⟨hpre⟩
      letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2
          (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hpre.cofibered))) :=
        ⟨schlessingerConditionS2_of_isIsomorphismClasses 𝓕 hpre.cofibered hS2 (Or.inl hpre)⟩
      FiniteDimensional k (tangentSpaceArtinian.{u, w, v} Λ k
        (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hpre.cofibered))) :
    ∃ ξ : FormalObject 𝓕.p,
      IsHull hpre.cofibered ξ ∧
      IsHull
        (categoryOfElements_projection_isCofibered (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hpre.cofibered))
        (imageInIsomorphismClasses 𝓕 hpre ξ)

declarations.name: Deformation.SatisfiesRS
declarations.doc:
Condition (RS): every cospan over a cospan of Artinian local algebras whose second
morphism is surjective has a pullback cone which remains a pullback cone in the base.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev SatisfiesRS {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ
  k] {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F] (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k) : Prop

declarations.name: Deformation.isLimit_of_map_isLimit
declarations.doc:
Under condition (RS), a square over a pullback square is a pullback square when the
second morphism in the base cospan is surjective.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isLimit_of_map_isLimit
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    {p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k}
    (hp : SatisfiesRS p)
    {x₁ x₂ x : F} (f₁ : x₁ ⟶ x) (f₂ : x₂ ⟶ x)
    (c : PullbackCone f₁ f₂)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (p.map f₂).hom)
    (hc : Nonempty (IsLimit (c.map p))) :
    Nonempty (IsLimit c)

declarations.name: Deformation.satisfiesRS_of_small_extensions
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06J4.** To verify condition (RS) for a category cofibered in
groupoids, it suffices to consider cospans whose second base morphism is a small
extension.
declarations.statement:
public theorem satisfiesRS_of_small_extensions
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    {p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k}
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (hsmall : ∀ {x₁ x₂ x : F} (f₁ : x₁ ⟶ x) (f₂ : x₂ ⟶ x),
      InfinitesimalLifting.IsSmallExtension
          (CommRingCat.ofHom (p.map f₂).hom.toRingHom) →
        ∃ c : PullbackCone f₁ f₂,
          (Nonempty (IsLimit c) ∧ Nonempty (IsLimit (c.map p)))) :
    SatisfiesRS p

declarations.name: Deformation.satisfiesRS_iff_comparison_isEquivalence_of_surjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06J5.** Condition (RS) holds precisely when the canonical functor
from the fibre over a pullback to the 2-fibre product of fibres is an equivalence for every
square whose second map is surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem satisfiesRS_iff_comparison_isEquivalence_of_surjective
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k) (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p) :
    SatisfiesRS p ↔
      ∀ {P A₁ A₂ A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k}
        (p₁ : P ⟶ A₁) (p₂ : P ⟶ A₂) (f₁ : A₁ ⟶ A) (f₂ : A₂ ⟶ A)
        (hP : IsPullback p₁ p₂ f₁ f₂)
        (hf₂ : Function.Surjective f₂.hom)
        (P₁ : PushforwardChoice p p₁) (P₂ : PushforwardChoice p p₂)
        (F₁ : PushforwardChoice p f₁) (F₂ : PushforwardChoice p f₂)
        (Qp₁ : PushforwardFunctor P₁) (Qp₂ : PushforwardFunctor P₂)
        (Qf₁ : PushforwardFunctor F₁) (Qf₂ : PushforwardFunctor F₂),
        (squareComparisonFunctor p hp p₁ p₂ f₁ f₂ hP hf₂
          P₁ P₂ F₁ F₂ Qp₁ Qp₂ Qf₁ Qf₂).toFunctor.IsEquivalence

declarations.name: Deformation.satisfiesRS_iff_comparison_isEquivalence_of_smallExtension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06J5.** It is enough to test the comparison functor on squares whose
second map is a small extension.
declarations.statement:
theorem satisfiesRS_iff_comparison_isEquivalence_of_smallExtension
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k) (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p) :
    SatisfiesRS p ↔
      ∀ {P A₁ A₂ A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k}
        (p₁ : P ⟶ A₁) (p₂ : P ⟶ A₂) (f₁ : A₁ ⟶ A) (f₂ : A₂ ⟶ A)
        (hP : IsPullback p₁ p₂ f₁ f₂)
        (hsmall : InfinitesimalLifting.IsSmallExtension
          (CommRingCat.ofHom f₂.hom.toRingHom))
        (P₁ : PushforwardChoice p p₁) (P₂ : PushforwardChoice p p₂)
        (F₁ : PushforwardChoice p f₁) (F₂ : PushforwardChoice p f₂)
        (Qp₁ : PushforwardFunctor P₁) (Qp₂ : PushforwardFunctor P₂)
        (Qf₁ : PushforwardFunctor F₁) (Qf₂ : PushforwardFunctor F₂),
        (squareComparisonFunctor p hp p₁ p₂ f₁ f₂ hP
          hsmall.2.2.2.2.1 P₁ P₂ F₁ F₂ Qp₁ Qp₂ Qf₁ Qf₂).toFunctor.IsEquivalence

declarations.name: Deformation.satisfiesRS_elementsProjection_iff_bijective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06J6.** For a set-valued functor `F` on the category of Artinian local
`Λ`-algebras, condition (RS) for the associated category cofibered in sets holds exactly when
the canonical map `F(A₁ ×_A A₂) → F(A₁) ×_{F(A)} F(A₂)` is bijective for every fibre-product
square whose second map is surjective; this is Schlessinger's condition (H4).
declarations.statement:
theorem satisfiesRS_elementsProjection_iff_bijective
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    (G : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k ⥤ Type t) :
    SatisfiesRS (Functor.Elements.π G) ↔
      ∀ {P A₁ A₂ A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k}
        (p₁ : P ⟶ A₁) (p₂ : P ⟶ A₂) (f₁ : A₁ ⟶ A) (f₂ : A₂ ⟶ A)
        (hP : IsPullback p₁ p₂ f₁ f₂), Function.Surjective f₂.hom →
          Function.Bijective (fibreProductComparison G p₁ p₂ f₁ f₂ hP.w.symm)

declarations.name: Deformation.schlessingerConditionS1_of_satisfiesRS
declarations.doc: Condition (RS) implies Schlessinger's condition (S1).
declarations.statement:
public theorem schlessingerConditionS1_of_satisfiesRS
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    {p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k}
    (hp : SatisfiesRS p) :
    SchlessingerConditionS1 p

declarations.name: Deformation.schlessingerConditionS2_of_satisfiesRS
declarations.doc: Condition (RS) implies Schlessinger's condition (S2).
declarations.statement:
public theorem schlessingerConditionS2_of_satisfiesRS
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    {p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k}
    (hp : SatisfiesRS p) :
    SchlessingerConditionS2 p

declarations.name: Deformation.associatedSatisfiesRS_iff_gluingClassesInjective
declarations.doc:
For a category cofibered in groupoids satisfying (RS), the associated functor of isomorphism
classes satisfies (RS) exactly when the comparison on isomorphism classes of gluing data is
injective.
declarations.statement:
theorem associatedSatisfiesRS_iff_gluingClassesInjective
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k) (hp : SatisfiesRS p) :
    SatisfiesRS (CategoryOfElements.π
        (isomorphismClassesData (BasedCategory.ofFunctor p) hp.1).classes) ↔
      IsInjectiveOnGluingClasses p

declarations.name: Deformation.gluingClassesInjective_iff_automorphismsLift
declarations.doc:
For a category cofibered in groupoids, injectivity on isomorphism classes of gluing data is
equivalent to lifting automorphisms along every surjection of Artinian local algebras.
declarations.statement:
theorem gluingClassesInjective_iff_automorphismsLift
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k) (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p) :
    IsInjectiveOnGluingClasses p ↔
      (∀ {A' A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k} (f : A' ⟶ A),
        Function.Surjective f.hom → AutomorphismsLiftAlong p f)

declarations.name: Deformation.automorphismsLift_iff_smallExtensions
declarations.doc:
For a category cofibered in groupoids, automorphisms lift along every surjection of Artinian
local algebras exactly when they lift along every small extension.
declarations.statement:
