theorem automorphismsLift_iff_smallExtensions
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k) (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p) :
    (∀ {A' A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k} (f : A' ⟶ A),
      Function.Surjective f.hom → AutomorphismsLiftAlong p f) ↔
      (∀ {A' A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k} (f : A' ⟶ A),
        InfinitesimalLifting.IsSmallExtension
          (CommRingCat.ofHom f.hom.toRingHom) → AutomorphismsLiftAlong p f)

declarations.name: Deformation.IsDeformationCategory
declarations.doc: A predeformation category over `𝒞_Λ` satisfying condition (RS).
declarations.statement:
structure IsDeformationCategory {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k]
    [Algebra Λ k] {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k) : Prop

declarations.name: Deformation.IsDeformationFunctor
declarations.doc:
A set-valued functor is a deformation functor if its value at the residue
field is a singleton and its associated cofibered set satisfies (RS).
declarations.statement:
public abbrev IsDeformationFunctor
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    (F : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k ⥤ Type t) : Prop

declarations.name: Deformation.isDeformationCategory_iff
declarations.doc:
A functor is a deformation functor exactly when its associated cofibered set
is a deformation category.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isDeformationCategory_iff
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    (F : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k ⥤ Type t) :
    IsDeformationCategory (CategoryOfElements.π F) ↔
      IsDeformationFunctor F

declarations.name: Deformation.restrictedCoyoneda_isPredeformationFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06JB.** A functor represented by a complete local algebra takes the
residue-field object to a one-element set.
declarations.statement:
theorem restrictedCoyoneda_isPredeformationFunctor
    (R : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k) :
    IsPredeformationFunctor (restrictedCoyoneda R)
declarations.comment: singleton value at the residue field

declarations.name: Deformation.restrictedCoyoneda_satisfiesRS
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06JB.** A functor represented by a complete local algebra satisfies
(RS), since maps out of the representing object preserve the relevant fibre products.
declarations.statement:
theorem restrictedCoyoneda_satisfiesRS
    (R : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k) :
    SatisfiesRS (Functor.Elements.π (restrictedCoyoneda R))

declarations.name: Deformation.isDeformationFunctor_of_isProrepresentable
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06JB.** Every prorepresentable functor on Artinian local algebras is
a deformation functor.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDeformationFunctor_of_isProrepresentable
    (F : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k ⥤ Type (max v w))
    (hF : IsProrepresentable F) :
    IsDeformationFunctor F

declarations.name: Deformation.satisfiesRS_objectsOverFunctor
declarations.doc:
The category localized at an object of the special fibre inherits the
Rim–Schlessinger condition.
declarations.statement:
public theorem satisfiesRS_objectsOverFunctor
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k)
    (hp : SatisfiesRS p)
    (x : p.Fiber (residueFieldObject.{u, v, w} Λ k)) :
    SatisfiesRS
      (objectsOverFunctor p x.1)

declarations.name: Deformation.isDeformationCategory_objectsOverFunctor
declarations.doc:
The category localized at an object of the special fibre is a deformation
category when the original category satisfies the Rim–Schlessinger condition.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isDeformationCategory_objectsOverFunctor
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k)
    (hp : SatisfiesRS p)
    (x : p.Fiber (residueFieldObject.{u, v, w} Λ k)) :
    IsDeformationCategory
      (objectsOverFunctor p x.1)

declarations.name: Deformation.Lift
declarations.doc:
The category of lifts of `x` along `f`. Its objects are arrows to `x` lying over `f`; its
arrows are commuting triangles whose remaining side lies over the identity.
declarations.statement:
public structure Lift
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {F : Type uF} [Category.{vF} F]
    (p : F ⥤ C) {A' A : C} (f : A' ⟶ A) (x : p.Fiber A)

declarations.name: Deformation.Lift.Hom
declarations.doc:
A morphism of lifts is a morphism over the identity which makes the triangle of
lifting arrows commute.
declarations.statement:
public structure Lift.Hom
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {F : Type uF} [Category.{vF} F]
    {p : F ⥤ C} {A' A : C} {f : A' ⟶ A} {x : p.Fiber A}
    (a b : Lift p f x)

declarations.name: Deformation.LiftClasses
declarations.doc: The set of isomorphism classes of lifts of `x` along `f`.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev LiftClasses
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {F : Type uF} [Category.{vF} F]
    (p : F ⥤ C) {A' A : C} (f : A' ⟶ A) (x : p.Fiber A)

declarations.name: Deformation.Lift.over
declarations.doc:
The category of lifts of `x` to an object `A'` of the base category given together with
its morphism to `A`: the lifts of `x` along that morphism, which the name leaves implicit.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev Lift.over
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {F : Type uF} [Category.{vF} F]
    (p : F ⥤ C) {A : C} (A' : Over A) (x : p.Fiber A)
declarations.comment: the category of lifts named by the source object

declarations.name: Deformation.LiftClasses.over
declarations.doc:
The set of isomorphism classes of lifts of `x` to an object `A'` of the base category
given together with its morphism to `A`, that morphism being left implicit.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev LiftClasses.over
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {F : Type uF} [Category.{vF} F]
    (p : F ⥤ C) {A : C} (A' : Over A) (x : p.Fiber A)
declarations.comment: the set of lifts named by the source object

declarations.name: Deformation.liftClassesEquivObjectsOver
declarations.doc:
A lift of `x₀` along a square-zero augmentation is an object of the localized category over
`x₀` in the source fibre, up to isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def liftClassesEquivObjectsOver
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    {A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, w, w} Λ k}
    (e : A ⟶ residueFieldObject Λ k)
    (x₀ : p.Fiber (residueFieldObject Λ k)) :
    let q := objectsOverFunctor p x₀.1
    let hq := (isPredeformationCategory_objectsOverFunctor p hp x₀).cofibered
    { comparison : LiftClasses p e x₀ ≃
        (isomorphismClasses (BasedCategory.ofFunctor q) hq).obj A //
      ∀ a : Lift p e x₀, comparison (ThinSkeleton.mk a) =
        classOf (BasedCategory.ofFunctor q) hq
          (⟨Over.mk a.hom,
            IsHomLift.domain_eq p e a.hom⟩ : q.Fiber A) }

declarations.name: Deformation.liftClassesTangentSpace
declarations.doc:
Under (S2), the lifts to `k[V]` are the tangent space of the category localized at `x₀`,
tensored with `V`, as vector spaces.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def liftClassesTangentSpace
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (hS2 : SchlessingerConditionS2 p)
    (x₀ : p.Fiber (residueFieldObject Λ k))
    (V : FGModuleCat.{w} k)
    (e : (squareZeroExtensionArtinian Λ k).obj V ⟶ residueFieldObject Λ k) :
    LiftTangentSpaceData p hp hS2 x₀ V e

declarations.name: Deformation.liftClassesTangentSpace_naturality
declarations.doc:
The tensor identification of lifts commutes with every linear map of finite-dimensional vector
spaces, using the induced map on localized lifts.
declarations.statement:
public theorem liftClassesTangentSpace_naturality
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (hS2 : SchlessingerConditionS2 p)
    (x₀ : p.Fiber (residueFieldObject Λ k))
    (V W : FGModuleCat.{w} k)
    (eV : (squareZeroExtensionArtinian Λ k).obj V ⟶ residueFieldObject Λ k)
    (eW : (squareZeroExtensionArtinian Λ k).obj W ⟶ residueFieldObject Λ k)
    (f : V ⟶ W) :
    let q := objectsOverFunctor p x₀.1
    let hpq := isPredeformationCategory_objectsOverFunctor p hp x₀
    let H := isomorphismClasses (BasedCategory.ofFunctor q) hpq.cofibered
    let DV := liftClassesTangentSpace p hp hS2 x₀ V eV
    let DW := liftClassesTangentSpace p hp hS2 x₀ W eW
    letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory (BasedCategory.ofFunctor q).p) := ⟨hpq⟩
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2 (CategoryOfElements.π H)) := ⟨DV.associatedS2⟩
    letI : AddCommGroup (artinianTangentSpace Λ k H) :=
      associatedTangentSpaceAddCommGroupUnlifted (BasedCategory.ofFunctor q)
    letI : Module k (artinianTangentSpace Λ k H) :=
      associatedTangentSpaceModuleUnlifted (BasedCategory.ofFunctor q)
    ∀ z : TensorProduct k (artinianTangentSpace Λ k H) V,
      (liftClassesEquivObjectsOver p hp eW x₀).1
          (DW.equiv (TensorProduct.map
            (LinearMap.id : artinianTangentSpace Λ k H →ₗ[k]
              artinianTangentSpace Λ k H) f.hom.hom z)) =
        H.map ((squareZeroExtensionArtinian Λ k).map f)
          ((liftClassesEquivObjectsOver p hp eV x₀).1 (DV.equiv z))

declarations.name: Deformation.liftClassesProdEquivPullback
declarations.doc:
Isomorphism classes of lifts to a fibre product are in bijection with pairs of
isomorphism classes of lifts to the two factors when one structural map is surjective.
declarations.statement:
public theorem liftClassesProdEquivPullback
    {Λ : Type*} {k : Type*} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type uF} [Category.{vF} F]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat Λ k)
    (hRS : SatisfiesRS p)
    {A₁ A₂ A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat Λ k}
    {f₁ : A₁ ⟶ A} {f₂ : A₂ ⟶ A}
    (c : PullbackCone f₁ f₂) (hc : IsLimit c)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective f₁.hom ∨ Function.Surjective f₂.hom)
    (x : p.Fiber A) :
    Nonempty (LiftProductEquiv p c x)

declarations.name: Deformation.liftClassesEquivOfFixedLift
declarations.doc:
After fixing a lift over the first factor, pushing along the second projection gives
a bijection from lifts of the fixed object to lifts over the second factor.
declarations.statement:
public theorem liftClassesEquivOfFixedLift
    {Λ : Type*} {k : Type*} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type uF} [Category.{vF} F]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat Λ k)
    (hRS : SatisfiesRS p)
    {A₁ A₂ A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat Λ k}
    {f₁ : A₁ ⟶ A} {f₂ : A₂ ⟶ A}
    (c : PullbackCone f₁ f₂) (hc : IsLimit c)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective f₁.hom ∨ Function.Surjective f₂.hom)
    (x : p.Fiber A) (a₁ : Lift p f₁ x) :
    Nonempty (FixedLiftEquiv p c x a₁)

declarations.name: Deformation.liftClassesEquivProdOfCompositePullback
declarations.doc:
Let `left` be a fibre square of a surjection `g : A₁' ⟶ A₁` and the first projection of
`right`. Isomorphism classes of lifts of the source of `a₁` along `left.fst ≫ g` are in
bijection with pairs of isomorphism classes of lifts of it along `g` and along `right.fst`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem liftClassesEquivProdOfCompositePullback
    {Λ : Type*} {k : Type*} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type uF} [Category.{vF} F]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat Λ k)
    (hRS : SatisfiesRS p)
    {A₁' A₁ A₂ A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat Λ k}
    {f₁ : A₁ ⟶ A} {f₂ : A₂ ⟶ A} {g : A₁' ⟶ A₁}
    (right : PullbackCone f₁ f₂)
    (left : PullbackCone g right.fst)
    (hleft : IsLimit left)
    (hg : Function.Surjective g.hom)
    (x : p.Fiber A) (a₁ : Lift p f₁ x) :
    Nonempty (LiftClasses p (left.fst ≫ g) (liftSourceFiber a₁) ≃
      LiftClasses p g (liftSourceFiber a₁) ×
        LiftClasses p right.fst (liftSourceFiber a₁))

declarations.name: Deformation.liftClassesEquivOuterProdOfCompositePullback
declarations.doc:
Let `right` be a fibre square of `f₁` and `f₂` with `f₁` surjective, and `left` a fibre
square of a surjection `g : A₁' ⟶ A₁` and the first projection of `right`. Isomorphism classes
of lifts of the source of `a₁` along `left.fst ≫ g` are in bijection with pairs of an
isomorphism class of lifts of it along `g` and an isomorphism class of lifts of `x` along
`f₂`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem liftClassesEquivOuterProdOfCompositePullback
    {Λ : Type*} {k : Type*} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type uF} [Category.{vF} F]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat Λ k)
    (hRS : SatisfiesRS p)
    {A₁' A₁ A₂ A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat Λ k}
    {f₁ : A₁ ⟶ A} {f₂ : A₂ ⟶ A} {g : A₁' ⟶ A₁}
    (right : PullbackCone f₁ f₂)
    (hright : IsLimit right)
    (left : PullbackCone g right.fst)
    (hleft : IsLimit left)
    (hg : Function.Surjective g.hom)
    (hf₁ : Function.Surjective f₁.hom)
    (x : p.Fiber A) (a₁ : Lift p f₁ x) :
    Nonempty (LiftClasses p (left.fst ≫ g) (liftSourceFiber a₁) ≃
      LiftClasses p g (liftSourceFiber a₁) × LiftClasses p f₂ x)

declarations.name: Deformation.liftAction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06JI.** The canonical additive action of tangent vectors tensored
with the infinitesimal kernel on the classes of lifts.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def liftAction
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    (𝓕 : BasedCategory.{vF, uF} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, w, w} Λ k))
    (h𝓕 : IsDeformationCategory 𝓕.p)
    {A' A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, w, w} Λ k}
    (f : A' ⟶ A) (hf : Function.Surjective f.hom)
    (hann : ∀ a : A', a ∈ maximalIdeal A' →
      ∀ i : RingHom.ker f.hom.toRingHom, a * (i : A') = 0)
    (x : 𝓕.p.Fiber A) :
    letI : Module k (RingHom.ker f.hom.toRingHom) := kernelModule f hann
    let hS2 := schlessingerConditionS2_of_isIsomorphismClasses
      𝓕 h𝓕.predeformation.cofibered
      (schlessingerConditionS2_of_satisfiesRS h𝓕.satisfiesRS)
      (.inl h𝓕.predeformation)
    letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory 𝓕.p) := ⟨h𝓕.predeformation⟩
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.predeformation.cofibered))) := ⟨hS2⟩
    AddAction
      (TensorProduct k
        (artinianTangentSpace Λ k
          (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.predeformation.cofibered))
        (RingHom.ker f.hom.toRingHom))
      (LiftClasses 𝓕.p f x)

declarations.name: Deformation.liftDifference_isPushforward
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06JI.** The infinitesimal difference of any two lifts is exactly the
canonical tangent coordinate of the cocartesian pushforward of their fibre product along
`(a₁, a₂) ↦ (ā₁, a₂ - a₁)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem liftDifference_isPushforward
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    (𝓕 : BasedCategory.{vF, uF} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, w, w} Λ k))
    (h𝓕 : IsDeformationCategory 𝓕.p)
    {A' A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, w, w} Λ k}
    (f : A' ⟶ A) (hf : Function.Surjective f.hom)
    (hann : ∀ a : A', a ∈ maximalIdeal A' →
      ∀ i : RingHom.ker f.hom.toRingHom, a * (i : A') = 0)
    (x : 𝓕.p.Fiber A) :
    letI : Module k (RingHom.ker f.hom.toRingHom) := kernelModule f hann
    let hS2 := schlessingerConditionS2_of_isIsomorphismClasses
      𝓕 h𝓕.predeformation.cofibered
      (schlessingerConditionS2_of_satisfiesRS h𝓕.satisfiesRS)
      (.inl h𝓕.predeformation)
    letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory 𝓕.p) := ⟨h𝓕.predeformation⟩
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.predeformation.cofibered))) := ⟨hS2⟩
    ∀ a b : LiftClasses 𝓕.p f x,
      IsPushforwardDifference 𝓕 h𝓕 f hf hann x a b
        (liftDifference 𝓕 h𝓕 f hf hann x a b)

declarations.name: Deformation.liftAction_difference
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06JI.** The action is the unique lift whose infinitesimal difference
from the given lift is the prescribed tangent vector.
declarations.statement:
public theorem liftAction_difference
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    (𝓕 : BasedCategory.{vF, uF} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, w, w} Λ k))
    (h𝓕 : IsDeformationCategory 𝓕.p)
    {A' A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, w, w} Λ k}
    (f : A' ⟶ A) (hf : Function.Surjective f.hom)
    (hann : ∀ a : A', a ∈ maximalIdeal A' →
      ∀ i : RingHom.ker f.hom.toRingHom, a * (i : A') = 0)
    (x : 𝓕.p.Fiber A) :
    letI : Module k (RingHom.ker f.hom.toRingHom) := kernelModule f hann
    let hS2 := schlessingerConditionS2_of_isIsomorphismClasses
      𝓕 h𝓕.predeformation.cofibered
      (schlessingerConditionS2_of_satisfiesRS h𝓕.satisfiesRS)
      (.inl h𝓕.predeformation)
    letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory 𝓕.p) := ⟨h𝓕.predeformation⟩
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.predeformation.cofibered))) := ⟨hS2⟩
    letI := liftAction 𝓕 h𝓕 f hf hann x
    ∀ (a : LiftClasses 𝓕.p f x)
      (t : TensorProduct k
        (artinianTangentSpace Λ k
          (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.predeformation.cofibered))
        (RingHom.ker f.hom.toRingHom)),
      liftDifference 𝓕 h𝓕 f hf hann x a (t +ᵥ a) = t

declarations.name: Deformation.liftAction_bijective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06JI.** From any fixed lift, addition of tangent vectors is a
bijection onto all isomorphism classes of lifts; equivalently, the action is free and
transitive.
declarations.statement:
public theorem liftAction_bijective
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    (𝓕 : BasedCategory.{vF, uF} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, w, w} Λ k))
    (h𝓕 : IsDeformationCategory 𝓕.p)
    {A' A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, w, w} Λ k}
    (f : A' ⟶ A) (hf : Function.Surjective f.hom)
    (hann : ∀ a : A', a ∈ maximalIdeal A' →
      ∀ i : RingHom.ker f.hom.toRingHom, a * (i : A') = 0)
    (x : 𝓕.p.Fiber A) :
    letI : Module k (RingHom.ker f.hom.toRingHom) := kernelModule f hann
    let hS2 := schlessingerConditionS2_of_isIsomorphismClasses
      𝓕 h𝓕.predeformation.cofibered
      (schlessingerConditionS2_of_satisfiesRS h𝓕.satisfiesRS)
      (.inl h𝓕.predeformation)
    letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory 𝓕.p) := ⟨h𝓕.predeformation⟩
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.predeformation.cofibered))) := ⟨hS2⟩
    letI := liftAction 𝓕 h𝓕 f hf hann x
    ∀ a : LiftClasses 𝓕.p f x,
      Function.Bijective
        (fun t : TensorProduct k
          (artinianTangentSpace Λ k
            (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.predeformation.cofibered))
          (RingHom.ker f.hom.toRingHom) => t +ᵥ a)

declarations.name: Deformation.mapLiftClasses_vadd
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06JJ.** The map on lift classes commutes with the torsor actions,
with tangent vectors mapped by the differential tensored with the identity of the kernel.
declarations.statement:
public theorem mapLiftClasses_vadd
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    (𝓕 : BasedCategory.{vF, uF} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, w, w} Λ k))
    (𝓖 : BasedCategory.{vG, uG} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, w, w} Λ k))
    (h𝓕 : IsDeformationCategory 𝓕.p)
    (h𝓖 : IsDeformationCategory 𝓖.p)
    (φ : BasedFunctor 𝓕 𝓖)
    {A' A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, w, w} Λ k}
    (f : A' ⟶ A) (hf : Function.Surjective f.hom)
    (hann : ∀ a : A', a ∈ maximalIdeal A' →
      ∀ i : RingHom.ker f.hom.toRingHom, a * (i : A') = 0)
    (x : 𝓕.p.Fiber A) :
    letI : Module k (RingHom.ker f.hom.toRingHom) := kernelModule f hann
    let hS2𝓕 := schlessingerConditionS2_of_isIsomorphismClasses
      𝓕 h𝓕.predeformation.cofibered
      (schlessingerConditionS2_of_satisfiesRS h𝓕.satisfiesRS)
      (.inl h𝓕.predeformation)
    let hS2𝓖 := schlessingerConditionS2_of_isIsomorphismClasses
      𝓖 h𝓖.predeformation.cofibered
      (schlessingerConditionS2_of_satisfiesRS h𝓖.satisfiesRS)
      (.inl h𝓖.predeformation)
    letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory 𝓕.p) := ⟨h𝓕.predeformation⟩
    letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory 𝓖.p) := ⟨h𝓖.predeformation⟩
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.predeformation.cofibered))) := ⟨hS2𝓕⟩
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓖 h𝓖.predeformation.cofibered))) := ⟨hS2𝓖⟩
    letI := liftAction 𝓕 h𝓕 f hf hann x
    letI := liftAction 𝓖 h𝓖 f hf hann ((fiberFunctor φ A).obj x)
    let dφ := IsLinearMap.mk' (differential h𝓕.predeformation.cofibered
      h𝓖.predeformation.cofibered φ)
      (differential_isLinearMap 𝓕 𝓖 h𝓕.predeformation h𝓖.predeformation hS2𝓕 hS2𝓖 φ)
    ∀ (a : LiftClasses 𝓕.p f x)
      (t : TensorProduct k
        (artinianTangentSpace Λ k
          (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.predeformation.cofibered))
        (RingHom.ker f.hom.toRingHom)),
      mapLiftClasses φ f x (t +ᵥ a) =
        (TensorProduct.map dφ (LinearMap.id :
          RingHom.ker f.hom.toRingHom →ₗ[k] RingHom.ker f.hom.toRingHom) t) +ᵥ
          mapLiftClasses φ f x a

declarations.name: Deformation.isIso_of_isSmooth_of_tangent_bijective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06JL.** A smooth morphism of deformation functors whose differential
is bijective is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_of_isSmooth_of_tangent_bijective
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F G : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, w, w} Λ k ⥤ Type t}
    (hF : IsDeformationFunctor F)
    (hG : IsDeformationFunctor G)
    (φ : F ⟶ G)
    (hφ : IsSmooth (elementsBasedFunctor φ))
    (hdφ : Function.Bijective
      (φ.app (augmentedDualNumbers (Λ := Λ) (k := k)))) :
    IsIso φ

declarations.name: Deformation.isProrepresentable_iff_isDeformationFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Schlessinger's theorem.** A set-valued functor on the category of Artinian local
`Λ`-algebras with residue field `k` is prorepresentable exactly when it is a deformation
functor, its tangent space is a finite-dimensional `k`-vector space, and the canonical map
from the `Λ`-derivations of `k` to that tangent space is injective.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isProrepresentable_iff_isDeformationFunctor
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    [Field k] [Algebra Λ k] [Module.Finite Λ k]
    (F : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k ⥤ Type (max v w)) :
    IsProrepresentable F ↔
      ∃ hF : IsDeformationFunctor F,
        let p := CategoryOfElements.π F
        let 𝓕 := BasedCategory.ofFunctor p
        let hD := (isDeformationCategory_iff F).2 hF
        let hS2 := Artin.schlessingerConditionS2_isomorphismClasses_of_isDeformationCategory
          𝓕 hD
        letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory 𝓕.p) := ⟨hD.predeformation⟩
        letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2
          (CategoryOfElements.π
            (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hD.predeformation.cofibered))) := ⟨hS2⟩
        let T := tangentSpaceArtinian Λ k
          (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hD.predeformation.cofibered)
        letI : AddCommGroup T := associatedTangentSpaceAddCommGroup 𝓕
        letI : Module k T := associatedTangentSpaceModule 𝓕
        FiniteDimensional k T ∧
          Function.Injective (derivationToTangentSpace p hD.predeformation)

declarations.name: Deformation.relativeInfinitesimalAutomorphisms
declarations.doc:
The group of infinitesimal automorphisms of `x'` relative to `x` along
`f : x' ⟶ x`: the kernel of the canonical homomorphism between the two fibre
automorphism groups.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def relativeInfinitesimalAutomorphisms
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p) (g : A' ⟶ A) (f : x'.1 ⟶ x.1)
    (hf : p.IsHomLift g f) : Subgroup (Aut x')

declarations.name: Deformation.infinitesimalAutomorphisms
declarations.doc:
The group of infinitesimal automorphisms at a point, for a chosen pushforward
along the constant inclusion into the dual numbers.

declarations.name: Deformation.existsUnique_retraction
declarations.doc:
A chosen pushforward along the constant inclusion into the dual numbers has a
unique retraction, without a restriction on the image of that retraction in the base.

declarations.name: Deformation.existsUnique_pushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
Pushforwards of isomorphic objects along the same arrow have a unique
isomorphism commuting with their structure maps.
declarations.statement:
public theorem existsUnique_pushforwardIso
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    {C : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} C] {p : F ⥤ C}
    {A₀ A : C} {x₀ y₀ : p.Fiber A₀} {x y : p.Fiber A}
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (g : A₀ ⟶ A) (h₀ : x₀ ≅ y₀)
    (i : x₀.1 ⟶ x.1) (hi : p.IsHomLift g i)
    (j : y₀.1 ⟶ y.1) (hj : p.IsHomLift g j) :
    ∃! h : x ≅ y, i ≫ h.hom.val = h₀.hom.val ≫ j

declarations.name: Deformation.existsUnique_infinitesimalAutomorphismsEquiv
declarations.doc:
An isomorphism of the original objects canonically identifies their
infinitesimal automorphism groups, by conjugation through the unique
comparison of their pushforwards.
declarations.statement:
public theorem existsUnique_infinitesimalAutomorphismsEquiv
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    {p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k}
    {A₀ Aε : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k}
    {x₀ y₀ : p.Fiber A₀} {xε yε : p.Fiber Aε}
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (g : A₀ ⟶ Aε) (e : Aε ⟶ A₀)
    (hpair : IsCanonicalDualNumberPair g e)
    (h₀ : x₀ ≅ y₀)
    (i : x₀.1 ⟶ xε.1) (hi : p.IsHomLift g i)
    (j : y₀.1 ⟶ yε.1) (hj : p.IsHomLift g j) :
    ∃! φ : infinitesimalAutomorphisms hp g e hpair i hi ≃*
        infinitesimalAutomorphisms hp g e hpair j hj,
      ∃ h : xε ≅ yε,
        (i ≫ h.hom.val = h₀.hom.val ≫ j) ∧
        (∀ a, (φ a).1 = h.conjAut a.1)
declarations.comment: invariance under isomorphism of the original object

declarations.name: Deformation.existsUnique_infinitesimalAutomorphismAction
declarations.doc:
The automorphism group of the original object acts on its infinitesimal
automorphism group by conjugation through pushed-forward automorphisms.
declarations.statement:
public theorem existsUnique_infinitesimalAutomorphismAction
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    {p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k}
    {A₀ Aε : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k}
    {x₀ : p.Fiber A₀} {xε : p.Fiber Aε}
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (g : A₀ ⟶ Aε) (e : Aε ⟶ A₀)
    (hpair : IsCanonicalDualNumberPair g e)
    (i : x₀.1 ⟶ xε.1) (hi : p.IsHomLift g i) :
    ∃! ρ : Aut x₀ →* MulAut
        (infinitesimalAutomorphisms hp g e hpair i hi),
      ∀ (a : Aut x₀)
        (b : infinitesimalAutomorphisms hp g e hpair i hi),
        ((ρ a) b).1 =
          (pushforwardAutomorphism hp g i hi a).asIso.conjAut b.1
declarations.comment: action of automorphisms of the original object

declarations.name: Deformation.subsingleton_aut_residueField
declarations.doc:
The automorphism group of an object over the residue field in a predeformation
category is trivial.
declarations.statement:
public theorem subsingleton_aut_residueField
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    {p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k}
    (hp : IsPredeformationCategory p)
    (x₀ : p.Fiber (residueFieldObject Λ k)) :
    Subsingleton (Aut x₀)

declarations.name: Deformation.infinitesimalAutomorphisms_eq_top
declarations.doc: Every automorphism of a pushforward to the dual numbers is infinitesimal.
declarations.statement:
public theorem infinitesimalAutomorphisms_eq_top
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    {p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k}
    (hp : IsPredeformationCategory p)
    {Aε : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k}
    (x₀ : p.Fiber (residueFieldObject Λ k)) (xε : p.Fiber Aε)
    (g : residueFieldObject Λ k ⟶ Aε)
    (e : Aε ⟶ residueFieldObject Λ k)
    (hpair : IsCanonicalDualNumberPair g e)
    (i : x₀.1 ⟶ xε.1) (hi : p.IsHomLift g i) :
    infinitesimalAutomorphisms hp.cofibered g e hpair i hi = ⊤

declarations.name: Deformation.existsUnique_pointIso
declarations.doc:
Any two points over the residue field in a predeformation category have exactly
one isomorphism between them.
declarations.statement:
public theorem existsUnique_pointIso
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    {p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k}
    (hp : IsPredeformationCategory p)
    (x₀ y₀ : p.Fiber (residueFieldObject.{u, v, w} Λ k)) :
    ∃! _ : x₀ ≅ y₀, True

declarations.name: Deformation.existsUnique_infinitesimalAutomorphismsEquiv_of_isPredeformationCategory
declarations.doc:
The unique isomorphism of points induces the canonical group isomorphism on
infinitesimal automorphisms. Its action is conjugation by any compatible
isomorphism between chosen pushforwards to the dual numbers.
declarations.statement:
public theorem existsUnique_infinitesimalAutomorphismsEquiv_of_isPredeformationCategory
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    {p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k}
    (hp : IsPredeformationCategory p)
    {Aε : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k}
    (g : residueFieldObject.{u, v, w} Λ k ⟶ Aε)
    (e : Aε ⟶ residueFieldObject.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (hpair : IsCanonicalDualNumberPair g e)
    (x₀ y₀ : p.Fiber (residueFieldObject.{u, v, w} Λ k))
    (xε yε : p.Fiber Aε)
    (iₓ : x₀.1 ⟶ xε.1) (hiₓ : p.IsHomLift g iₓ)
    (iᵧ : y₀.1 ⟶ yε.1) (hiᵧ : p.IsHomLift g iᵧ) :
    ∃! φ : ↥(infinitesimalAutomorphisms hp.cofibered g e hpair iₓ hiₓ) ≃*
        ↥(infinitesimalAutomorphisms hp.cofibered g e hpair iᵧ hiᵧ),
      ∀ (f : x₀ ≅ y₀) (j : xε ≅ yε),
        (iₓ ≫ j.hom.val = f.hom.val ≫ iᵧ) →
          ∀ a, (φ a).val.asIso.hom.val = j.inv.val ≫ a.val.asIso.hom.val ≫ j.hom.val

declarations.name: Deformation.infinitesimalAutomorphismGroup
declarations.doc:
The infinitesimal automorphism group of a predeformation category, formed using a
chosen object over the residue field and its pushforward to the dual numbers.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable abbrev infinitesimalAutomorphismGroup
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    {p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k}
    (hp : IsPredeformationCategory p)
    {Aε : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k}
    {x₀ : p.Fiber (residueFieldObject Λ k)} {xε : p.Fiber Aε}
    (g : residueFieldObject Λ k ⟶ Aε)
    (e : Aε ⟶ residueFieldObject Λ k)
    (hpair : IsCanonicalDualNumberPair g e)
    (i : x₀.1 ⟶ xε.1) (hi : p.IsHomLift g i) : Type _

declarations.name: Deformation.infinitesimalAutomorphismGroup_uniqueEquiv
declarations.doc:
Changing the chosen object over the residue field, and its pushforward, gives a unique
identification of infinitesimal automorphism groups. On automorphisms it is conjugation by
the isomorphism between the pushforwards.
declarations.statement:
public theorem infinitesimalAutomorphismGroup_uniqueEquiv
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    {p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k}
    (hp : IsPredeformationCategory p)
    {Aε : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k}
    {x₀ y₀ : p.Fiber (residueFieldObject Λ k)}
    {xε yε : p.Fiber Aε}
    (g : residueFieldObject Λ k ⟶ Aε)
    (e : Aε ⟶ residueFieldObject Λ k)
    (hpair : IsCanonicalDualNumberPair g e)
    (i : x₀.1 ⟶ xε.1) (hi : p.IsHomLift g i)
    (j : y₀.1 ⟶ yε.1) (hj : p.IsHomLift g j) :
    ∃! E : infinitesimalAutomorphismGroup hp g e hpair i hi ≃*
        infinitesimalAutomorphismGroup hp g e hpair j hj,
      ∃ (f₀ : x₀ ≅ y₀) (fε : xε ≅ yε),
        f₀.hom.val ≫ j = i ≫ fε.hom.val ∧
        (∀ a, (E a).val = fε.conjAut a.val)

declarations.name: Deformation.infinitesimalAutomorphismGroup_objectsOverFunctor
declarations.doc:
Infinitesimal automorphisms of objects over `x₀` are the infinitesimal
automorphisms of `x₀`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem infinitesimalAutomorphismGroup_objectsOverFunctor
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    {p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k}
    (hp : IsPredeformationCategory p)
    {Aε : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k}
    {x₀ : p.Fiber (residueFieldObject Λ k)} {xε : p.Fiber Aε}
    (g : residueFieldObject Λ k ⟶ Aε)
    (e : Aε ⟶ residueFieldObject Λ k)
    (hpair : IsCanonicalDualNumberPair g e)
    (i : x₀.1 ⟶ xε.1) (hi : p.IsHomLift g i)
    {y₀ : (objectsOverFunctor p x₀.1).Fiber
      (residueFieldObject Λ k)}
    {yε : (objectsOverFunctor p x₀.1).Fiber Aε}
    (j : y₀.1 ⟶ yε.1)
    (hj : (objectsOverFunctor p x₀.1).IsHomLift g j)
    (h₀ : y₀.1.left = x₀.1) (hε : yε.1.left = xε.1)
    (h₀hom : y₀.1.hom = eqToHom h₀)
    (hεhom : yε.1.hom = eqToHom hε ≫
      (canonicalRetraction hp.cofibered g e hpair.split i hi).1)
    (hjleft : j.left ≫ eqToHom hε = eqToHom h₀ ≫ i) :
    ∃! E :
      infinitesimalAutomorphismGroup
        (isPredeformationCategory_objectsOverFunctor p hp.cofibered x₀)
        g e hpair j hj ≃* infinitesimalAutomorphismGroup hp g e hpair i hi,
      ∀ a, (E a).val.asIso.hom.val =
        eqToHom hε.symm ≫ a.val.asIso.hom.val.left ≫ eqToHom hε

declarations.name: Deformation.automorphismFunctor
declarations.doc:
The automorphism functor of `x`: at `f : p.obj x ⟶ V` it is the type
of automorphisms over `V` of the chosen pushforward `f_* x`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def automorphismFunctor
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F] {C : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} C]
    {p : F ⥤ C} {x : F} (P : ChosenPushforwardsAt p x) : Under (p.obj x) ⥤ Type v₁

declarations.name: Deformation.automorphismFunctor_satisfiesRS
declarations.doc:
The automorphism functor of an object in a category cofibered in groupoids
satisfying (RS) itself satisfies (RS).
declarations.statement:
public theorem automorphismFunctor_satisfiesRS
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    {p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k}
    (hp : SatisfiesRS p) (x : F)
    (P : ChosenPushforwardsAt p x) :
    SatisfiesRSUnder (p.obj x) (automorphismFunctor P)

declarations.name: Deformation.exists_naturalLocalizedAutomorphismTangentVectorSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06JV (1).** On the tangent space at the identity of the
automorphism functor of `x`, addition is composition of automorphisms and scalar
multiplication is induced by the canonical scaling of the dual-number coordinate; in
particular composition there is commutative.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_naturalLocalizedAutomorphismTangentVectorSpace
    (hp : SatisfiesRS p) :
    ∃ V : AddCommGroup (localizedAutomorphismFunctorTangent P),
      letI := V
      ∃ M : Module k (localizedAutomorphismFunctorTangent P),
        letI := M
        (∀ a b, localizedTangentEquivKernel P (a + b) =
          localizedTangentEquivKernel P a * localizedTangentEquivKernel P b) ∧
        (∀ (c : k) a, (localizedTangentEquivKernel P (c • a)).1 =
          P.transportAutHom (tangentScaling c) (localizedTangentEquivKernel P a).1)

declarations.name: Deformation.existsUnique_localizedTangentAutomorphismLinearEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06JV (2).** Pushforward to the special fibre canonically
identifies the tangent spaces at the identity of the two automorphism functors. The
comparison is conjugation by the unique isomorphism of dual-number pushforwards lying over
the identity of the dual-number ring.
declarations.statement:
public theorem existsUnique_localizedTangentAutomorphismLinearEquiv
    (_hbase : p.obj x₀ = residueFieldObject.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (P : ChosenPushforwardsAt p x)
    (Q : ChosenPushforwardsAt p x₀) :
    letI := naturalLocalizedTangentAddCommGroup P hp
    letI := naturalLocalizedTangentModule P hp
    letI := naturalLocalizedTangentAddCommGroup Q hp
    letI := naturalLocalizedTangentModule Q hp
    let U₀ := specialFibreUnder (p := p) (x := x)
    let Uε := dualNumbersUnder (p := p) (x := x)
    let V₀ := specialFibreUnder (p := p) (x := x₀)
    let Vε := dualNumbersUnder (p := p) (x := x₀)
    ∃! E : localizedAutomorphismFunctorTangent P ≃ₗ[k]
        localizedAutomorphismFunctorTangent Q,
      ∃ (H₀ : (P.obj U₀).1 ≅ (Q.obj V₀).1)
          (Hε : (P.obj Uε).1 ≅ (Q.obj Vε).1),
        (P.inclusion U₀ ≫ H₀.hom = j ≫ Q.inclusion V₀) ∧
        (P.inclusion Uε ≫ Hε.hom = j ≫ Q.inclusion Vε) ∧
        (∀ t : Uε.right,
          (eqToHom (P.obj Uε).2.symm ≫ p.map Hε.hom ≫
            eqToHom (Q.obj Vε).2).hom t = t) ∧
        (∀ a, (localizedTangentEquivKernel P a).1.asIso.hom.val ≫ Hε.hom =
          Hε.hom ≫ (localizedTangentEquivKernel Q (E a)).1.asIso.hom.val)

declarations.name: Deformation.relativeInfinitesimalAutomorphismsEquivIdentityLifts
declarations.doc:
Relative infinitesimal automorphisms are precisely lifts of the identity
automorphism along the given morphism.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def relativeInfinitesimalAutomorphismsEquivIdentityLifts
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F] {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    {p : F ⥤ C} {A' A : C} {x' : p.Fiber A'} {x : p.Fiber A}
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (g : A' ⟶ A) (f : x'.1 ⟶ x.1) (hf : p.IsHomLift g f) :
    relativeInfinitesimalAutomorphisms hp g f hf ≃
      identityAutomorphismLifts hp g f hf

declarations.name: Deformation.infinitesimalAutomorphismsEquivIdentityLifts
declarations.doc:
Infinitesimal automorphisms at a residue-field object are lifts of its
identity automorphism to the dual numbers.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def infinitesimalAutomorphismsEquivIdentityLifts
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    {p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k}
    {A₀ Aε : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k}
    {x₀ : p.Fiber A₀} {xε : p.Fiber Aε}
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (g : A₀ ⟶ Aε) (e : Aε ⟶ A₀)
    (hpair : IsCanonicalDualNumberPair g e)
    (i : x₀.1 ⟶ xε.1) (hi : p.IsHomLift g i) :
    let r := canonicalRetraction hp g e hpair.split i hi
    infinitesimalAutomorphisms hp g e hpair i hi ≃
      identityAutomorphismLifts hp e r.1 r.2.1

declarations.name: Deformation.infinitesimalAutomorphisms_eq_tangentFiber
declarations.doc:
At a point over the residue field, infinitesimal automorphisms are the
fibre over the identity of the automorphism functor at the dual numbers.

declarations.name: Deformation.infinitesimalAutomorphismsEquivTangentSpaceAtIdentity
declarations.doc:
Infinitesimal automorphisms at a residue-field object are the tangent
space at the identity of its automorphism functor.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def infinitesimalAutomorphismsEquivTangentSpaceAtIdentity
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    {p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k}
    {x : F}
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (P : ChosenPushforwardsAt p x)
    (hbase : p.obj x = residueFieldObject.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (Aε : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k)
    (g : residueFieldObject.{u, v, w} Λ k ⟶ Aε)
    (e : Aε ⟶ residueFieldObject.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (hpair : IsCanonicalDualNumberPair g e) :
    let U₀ : Under (p.obj x) := Under.mk (eqToHom hbase)
    let Uε : Under (p.obj x) := Under.mk (eqToHom hbase ≫ g)
    let j : U₀ ⟶ Uε := Under.homMk g (by simp [U₀, Uε])
    let baseChange := residueAlgebrasToUnder.{u, v, w} Λ k ⋙
      Under.map (eqToHom hbase)
    let AutFunctor := baseChange ⋙ automorphismFunctor P
    let q := CategoryOfElements.π AutFunctor
    let k₀ := residueFieldObject.{w, v, w} k k
    let identityPoint : q.Fiber k₀ :=
      ⟨AutFunctor.elementsMk k₀ (1 : Aut (P.obj (baseChange.obj k₀))), rfl⟩
    (infinitesimalAutomorphisms hp g e hpair (P.map j)
      (P.map_isHomLift j)) ≃
    tangentSpaceAtPoint q
        (automorphismFunctorCategory_isCofiberedInGroupoids P baseChange)
        identityPoint

declarations.name: Deformation.exists_naturalLocalizedAutomorphismTangentVectorSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06JV (1).** On the tangent space at the identity of the
automorphism functor of `x`, addition is composition of automorphisms and scalar
multiplication is induced by the canonical scaling of the dual-number coordinate; in
particular composition there is commutative.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_naturalLocalizedAutomorphismTangentVectorSpace
    (hp : SatisfiesRS p) :
    ∃ V : AddCommGroup (localizedAutomorphismFunctorTangent P),
      letI := V
      ∃ M : Module k (localizedAutomorphismFunctorTangent P),
        letI := M
        (∀ a b, localizedTangentEquivKernel P (a + b) =
          localizedTangentEquivKernel P a * localizedTangentEquivKernel P b) ∧
        (∀ (c : k) a, (localizedTangentEquivKernel P (c • a)).1 =
          P.transportAutHom (tangentScaling c) (localizedTangentEquivKernel P a).1)
declarations.comment: Inf_{x_0}(F) as the tangent space, with addition composition

declarations.name: Deformation.exists_localizedTangentEquiv_infinitesimalAutomorphismKernel
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06JY.** The two descriptions of the acting group agree: for a
morphism `j : y ⟶ y₀` of a category cofibered in groupoids over `𝒞_Λ` satisfying (RS) whose
target lies over the residue field, the `k`-vector space `T_{id_{y₀}} Aut(y)` is linearly
isomorphic to `T_{id_{y₀}} Aut(y₀)`, and the latter is the group `Inf_{y₀}(𝓕)` of
infinitesimal automorphisms of the dual-number pushforward of `y₀` by an equivalence taking
addition to composition. Tensoring with the kernel therefore gives the same space either
way.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_localizedTangentEquiv_infinitesimalAutomorphismKernel
    (hrs : SatisfiesRS p) {y y₀ : F} (j : y ⟶ y₀)
    (hbase : p.obj y₀ = residueFieldObject.{u, w, w} Λ k)
    (P : ChosenPushforwardsAt p y) (Q : ChosenPushforwardsAt p y₀) :
    letI := naturalLocalizedTangentAddCommGroup P hrs
    letI := naturalLocalizedTangentModule P hrs
    letI := naturalLocalizedTangentAddCommGroup Q hrs
    letI := naturalLocalizedTangentModule Q hrs
    ∃ (_ : localizedAutomorphismFunctorTangent P ≃ₗ[k]
        localizedAutomorphismFunctorTangent Q)
      (G : localizedAutomorphismFunctorTangent Q ≃
        infinitesimalAutomorphismKernel Q (tangentReduction (p := p) (x := y₀))),
      ∀ a b, G (a + b) = G a * G b
declarations.comment: the two descriptions of the acting group

declarations.name: Deformation.exists_freeTransitiveAction_tangentTensor_relativeInfinitesimalAutomorphisms
declarations.doc:
For a category cofibered in groupoids over `𝒞_Λ` satisfying (RS) and a morphism
`φ : x' ⟶ x` lying over a surjection `g : A' → A` whose kernel `I` is annihilated by the maximal
ideal of `A'`, the group `Inf(x'/x)` of infinitesimal automorphisms of `x'` over `x` carries a
free and transitive action by `T_{id_{x₀}} Aut(x') ⊗_k I`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_freeTransitiveAction_tangentTensor_relativeInfinitesimalAutomorphisms
    (hrs : SatisfiesRS p) {A' A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, w, w} Λ k}
    {x' : p.Fiber A'} {x : p.Fiber A}
    (g : A' ⟶ A) (φ : x'.1 ⟶ x.1) (hφ : p.IsHomLift g φ)
    (hg : Function.Surjective g.hom)
    (hann : ∀ a : A', a ∈ maximalIdeal A' →
      ∀ i : RingHom.ker g.hom.toRingHom, a * (i : A') = 0)
    {x₀ : p.Fiber (residueFieldObject.{u, w, w} Λ k)}
    (ψ₀ : x.1 ⟶ x₀.1) (hψ₀ : p.IsHomLift (residueMorphism A) ψ₀)
    (P : ChosenPushforwardsAt p x'.1) :
    letI : Module k (RingHom.ker g.hom.toRingHom) := kernelModule g hann
    letI := naturalLocalizedTangentAddCommGroup P hrs
    letI := naturalLocalizedTangentModule P hrs
    ∃ act : TensorProduct k (localizedAutomorphismFunctorTangent P)
          (RingHom.ker g.hom.toRingHom) →
        ↥(relativeInfinitesimalAutomorphisms hrs.1 g φ hφ) →
        ↥(relativeInfinitesimalAutomorphisms hrs.1 g φ hφ),
      (∀ s, act 0 s = s) ∧
      (∀ t u s, act (t + u) s = act t (act u s)) ∧
      (∀ s t, act t s = s → t = 0) ∧
      (∀ s s', ∃ t, act t s = s') ∧
      (∀ s, Function.Bijective fun t => act t s)

declarations.name: Deformation.relativeInfinitesimalAutomorphisms_eq_bot
declarations.doc:
Let `𝓕` be a category cofibered in groupoids over `𝒞_Λ` satisfying (RS), let `x' ⟶ x` be a
morphism of `𝓕` lying over a surjection, and let `x₀` be a pushforward of `x` to the special
fibre. If the infinitesimal automorphisms of `x₀` vanish, then so do the infinitesimal
automorphisms of `x'` over `x`.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativeInfinitesimalAutomorphisms_eq_bot
    (hrs : SatisfiesRS p)
    {B A A₀ Aε : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k}
    {x' : p.Fiber B} {x : p.Fiber A} {x₀ : p.Fiber A₀} {xε : p.Fiber Aε}
    (g : B ⟶ A) (f : x'.1 ⟶ x.1) (hf : p.IsHomLift g f)
    (hg : Function.Surjective g.hom)
    (g₀ : A ⟶ A₀) (f₀ : x.1 ⟶ x₀.1) (hf₀ : p.IsHomLift g₀ f₀)
    (i : A₀ ⟶ Aε) (e : Aε ⟶ A₀)
    (hpair : IsCanonicalDualNumberPair i e)
    (fi : x₀.1 ⟶ xε.1) (hfi : p.IsHomLift i fi)
    (htriv : infinitesimalAutomorphisms hrs.1 i e hpair fi hfi = ⊥) :
    relativeInfinitesimalAutomorphisms hrs.1 g f hf = ⊥

declarations.name: Deformation.infinitesimalAutomorphisms_eq_bot_iff_isEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06K0.** For a category cofibered in groupoids over `𝒞_Λ` satisfying (RS) and an
object `x₀` of the fibre over the residue field, the infinitesimal automorphisms of `x₀`
vanish exactly when the canonical morphism `ℱ_{x₀} ⟶ ℱ̄_{x₀}` to the functor of fibrewise
isomorphism classes is an equivalence.
declarations.statement:
theorem infinitesimalAutomorphisms_eq_bot_iff_isEquivalence (hrs : SatisfiesRS p)
    {A₀ Aε : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k} {x₀ : p.Fiber A₀} {xε : p.Fiber Aε}
    (g : A₀ ⟶ Aε) (e : Aε ⟶ A₀) (hpair : IsCanonicalDualNumberPair g e)
    (i : x₀.1 ⟶ xε.1) (hi : p.IsHomLift g i) :
    infinitesimalAutomorphisms hrs.1 g e hpair i hi = ⊥ ↔
      (toIsomorphismClasses (pointLocalization p x₀.1)
        (isCofiberedInGroupoids_objectsOverFunctor hrs.1
          (maximalIdeal_eq_bot_of_isCanonicalDualNumberPair hpair)
            x₀)).toFunctor.IsEquivalence

declarations.name: Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors
declarations.doc:
A groupoid in functors on `C`: functors of objects and arrows with natural source, target,
and composition maps which give a groupoid after evaluation at every object of `C`.
declarations.statement: structure GroupoidInFunctors (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C]

declarations.name: Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.Hom
declarations.doc: A morphism of groupoids in functors.
declarations.statement:
structure Hom {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    (G H : GroupoidInFunctors C)

declarations.name: Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.evaluationEquivalence
declarations.doc:
A groupoid in functors on `C` is the same data as a functor `C ⥤ Grpd`, and a morphism of
groupoids in functors is the same data as a morphism of the associated functors: evaluation is
an equivalence of categories.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def evaluationEquivalence :
    GroupoidInFunctors.{u, v, w} C ≌ (C ⥤ Grpd.{w, w})

declarations.name: Deformation.existsUnique_identity
declarations.doc:
Pointwise identities uniquely assemble into a natural transformation from objects
to arrows.
declarations.statement:
public theorem existsUnique_identity {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    (G : GroupoidInFunctors.{u, v, w} C) :
    ∃! e : G.objects ⟶ G.arrows,
      ∀ (T : C) (x : G.Evaluation T), e.app T x = G.identity T x

declarations.name: Deformation.existsUnique_inverse
declarations.doc:
Pointwise inverses uniquely assemble into a natural transformation of the arrow
functor.
declarations.statement:
public theorem existsUnique_inverse {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    (G : GroupoidInFunctors.{u, v, w} C) :
    ∃! i : G.arrows ⟶ G.arrows,
      ∀ (T : C) (a : G.arrows.obj T), i.app T a = inverseArrow G T a

declarations.name: Deformation.IsRepresentable
declarations.doc:
A groupoid in functors is representable if it is isomorphic to one presented by
covariant representable functors of objects and arrows, and the pushout of the two morphisms
representing source and target exists.
declarations.statement:
public def IsRepresentable {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (G : GroupoidInFunctors.{u,
  v, max w v} C) : Prop

declarations.name: Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.restrict
declarations.doc:
Restriction of a groupoid in functors along a functor of source categories. The restriction
`(U, R, s, t, c)|_{C'}` of a groupoid in functors to a subcategory `C' ⊆ C` is the case where the
functor is the inclusion of `C'`.
declarations.statement:
public def restrict {C : Type u} {D : Type v} [Category.{w} C] [Category.{x} D]
    (G : GroupoidInFunctors.{v, x, y} D) (F : C ⥤ D) :
    GroupoidInFunctors.{u, w, y} C

declarations.name: Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.restrict_source
declarations.doc:
The source of a restriction is the source of the original groupoid in functors,
whiskered by the restricting functor.
declarations.statement: public theorem restrict_source : (G.restrict F).source = F.whiskerLeft G.source

declarations.name: Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.restrict_target
declarations.doc:
The target of a restriction is the target of the original groupoid in functors,
whiskered by the restricting functor.
declarations.statement: public theorem restrict_target : (G.restrict F).target = F.whiskerLeft G.target

declarations.name: Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.restrict_comp
declarations.doc:
The composition of a restriction is the composition of the original groupoid in functors,
whiskered by the restricting functor.
declarations.statement: public theorem restrict_comp : (G.restrict F).comp = F.whiskerLeft G.comp

declarations.name: Deformation.evaluationFunctor
declarations.doc:
The covariant functor of groupoids obtained by evaluating a groupoid in
functors at each object of the base category.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def evaluationFunctor {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    (G : GroupoidInFunctors.{u, v, w} C) : C ⥤ Cat.{w, w}

declarations.name: Deformation.quotientMorphism
declarations.doc:
The canonical quotient map from the category of elements of the object
functor to the Grothendieck construction of the evaluated groupoids.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def quotientMorphism {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    (G : GroupoidInFunctors.{u, v, w} C) :
    G.objects.Elements ⥤ Grothendieck (evaluationFunctor G)

declarations.name: Deformation.quotientProjection_cofibered
declarations.doc:
The projection of the Grothendieck construction of a groupoid in functors
is cofibered in groupoids.
declarations.statement:
public theorem quotientProjection_cofibered {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    (G : GroupoidInFunctors.{u, v, w} C) :
    IsCofiberedInGroupoids
      (Grothendieck.forget (evaluationFunctor G))

declarations.name: Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.IsProrepresentable
declarations.doc:
A groupoid in functors on Artinian local `Λ`-algebras is prorepresentable
if it is isomorphic to the restriction of a representable groupoid in functors
on Noetherian complete local `Λ`-algebras.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev GroupoidInFunctors.IsProrepresentable {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ]
    [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    (G : GroupoidInFunctors.{_, v, max v z}
      (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)) : Prop

declarations.name: Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.completion
declarations.doc: Completion of a groupoid in functors on Artinian local algebras.

declarations.name: Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.completionRestrictIso
declarations.doc:
The canonical isomorphism from a completed groupoid, restricted back to
Artinian local algebras, to the original groupoid. Its two components are the
completion--restriction counits.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def completionRestrictIso
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    (G : GroupoidInFunctors.{_, v, max v z}
      (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)) :
    { e : GroupoidInFunctors.restrict
          (GroupoidInFunctors.completion G)
          (artinianToComplete (Λ := Λ) (k := k)) ≅ G //
      e.hom.mapObjects =
        (cofiberedCompletionAdjunction
          (Λ := Λ) (k := k)).counit.app G.objects ∧
      e.hom.mapArrows =
        (cofiberedCompletionAdjunction
          (Λ := Λ) (k := k)).counit.app G.arrows }

declarations.name: Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.completionRestrictionIso
declarations.doc:
The canonical groupoid isomorphism from the completion of a restricted
limit-preserving groupoid to the original groupoid.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def completionRestrictionIso
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    (G : GroupoidInFunctors.{_, v, max v z}
      (CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k))
    [PreservesLimits G.objects] [PreservesLimits G.arrows] :
    { i : GroupoidInFunctors.completion
        (GroupoidInFunctors.restrict G
          (artinianToComplete (Λ := Λ) (k := k))) ≅ G //
      i.inv.mapObjects =
        (cofiberedCompletionAdjunction (Λ := Λ) (k := k)).unit.app
          G.objects ∧
      i.inv.mapArrows =
        (cofiberedCompletionAdjunction (Λ := Λ) (k := k)).unit.app
          G.arrows }

declarations.name: Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.isProrepresentable_iff_isRepresentable_completion
declarations.doc:
A groupoid in functors on Artinian local algebras is prorepresentable if
and only if its completion is representable on complete local algebras.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isProrepresentable_iff_isRepresentable_completion
    (G : GroupoidInFunctors.{_, v, max v z}
      (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)) :
    GroupoidInFunctors.IsProrepresentable G ↔
      IsRepresentable (GroupoidInFunctors.completion G)

declarations.name: Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.isProrepresentable_iff_objects_arrows
declarations.doc:
A groupoid in functors is prorepresentable if and only if both its object
and arrow functors are prorepresentable.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isProrepresentable_iff_objects_arrows
    (G : GroupoidInFunctors.{_, v, v}
      (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)) :
    GroupoidInFunctors.IsProrepresentable G ↔
      (_root_.Deformation.IsProrepresentable G.objects ∧
        _root_.Deformation.IsProrepresentable G.arrows)

declarations.name: Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.IsSmooth
declarations.doc: A groupoid in functors is smooth when both its source and target morphisms are smooth.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev GroupoidInFunctors.IsSmooth (G : GroupoidInFunctors
  (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)) : Prop

declarations.name: Deformation.smooth_groupoid_quotient_not_smooth
declarations.doc:
A smooth groupoid in functors can have a quotient category that is not smooth
over the base.
declarations.statement:
public theorem smooth_groupoid_quotient_not_smooth :
    ∃ G : GroupoidInFunctors (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{0, 0, 0} ℚ ℚ),
      GroupoidInFunctors.IsSmooth G ∧
        ¬ IsSmooth (quotientProjectionBasedFunctor G)
declarations.comment: smooth groupoid with nonsmooth quotient category

registrations.name: source_isSmooth_iff_quotient
registrations.comment: smooth source iff smooth quotient morphism

declarations.name: Deformation.isSmooth_iff_source
declarations.doc: A groupoid in functors is smooth exactly when its source morphism is smooth.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isSmooth_iff_source
    (G : GroupoidInFunctors (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)) :
      GroupoidInFunctors.IsSmooth G ↔
      Deformation.IsSmooth (elementsBasedFunctor G.source)

declarations.name: Deformation.source_isSmooth_iff_target
declarations.doc: Smoothness of the source and target morphisms of a groupoid in functors are equivalent.
declarations.statement:
public theorem source_isSmooth_iff_target
    (G : GroupoidInFunctors (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)) :
    Deformation.IsSmooth (elementsBasedFunctor G.source) ↔
      Deformation.IsSmooth (elementsBasedFunctor G.target)

declarations.name: Deformation.source_isSmooth_iff_quotient
declarations.doc: The source morphism is smooth exactly when the quotient morphism is smooth.
declarations.statement:
public theorem source_isSmooth_iff_quotient
    (G : GroupoidInFunctors (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)) :
    Deformation.IsSmooth (elementsBasedFunctor G.source) ↔
      Deformation.IsSmooth (quotientBasedFunctor G)
declarations.comment: smooth source iff smooth quotient morphism

declarations.name: Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.IsNormalized
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06KM, part (1).** A smooth prorepresentable groupoid in functors
`(U, R, s, t, c)` is *normalized* when the groupoid `(U(k[ε]), R(k[ε]), s, t, c)` obtained by
evaluating at the dual numbers `k[ε]` is totally disconnected: there are no arrows between
distinct objects.

Total disconnection is stated here in the equivalent pointwise form: every element of
`R(k[ε])`, i.e. every arrow of the evaluated groupoid, has equal source and target.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev IsNormalized (G : GroupoidInFunctors
  (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k)) : Prop

declarations.name: Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.IsMinimal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06KM, part (2).** A smooth prorepresentable groupoid in functors
`(U, R, s, t, c)` is *minimal* when the quotient morphism `U → [U/R]` is given by a minimal
versal formal object of `[U/R]`.

Here `p : [U/R] ⥤ 𝒞_Λ` is the structure morphism of the quotient category, realized as
`Grothendieck.forget (evaluationFunctor G)`, and the data asserted to exist are:

* `ξ`, a formal object of `[U/R]`, required by the first conjunct to be minimal versal
  (`IsMinimalVersal`, Tag 06T4): this is the source's "minimal versal formal object
  of `[U/R]`";
* `pushforwards`, a choice of cocartesian pushforwards in `[U/R]`. This is the auxiliary
  data needed to build the morphism `ξ^#` associated to `ξ` (`associatedMorphism`, Tag
  06HC), which goes from the category of elements of `restrictedCoyoneda ξ.base` to
  `[U/R]`; "the morphism given by `ξ`" means `ξ^#`;
* `e`, an equivalence from the category of elements of the object functor `U` to that of
  `restrictedCoyoneda ξ.base`. The second conjunct, `e.functor ⋙ π = π`, says that `e`
  commutes with the projections to `𝒞_Λ`, i.e. that it is an equivalence *over* `𝒞_Λ`;
  it is this that lets `ξ^#` be read as a morphism `e.functor ⋙ ξ^#` out of `U`;
* the third conjunct: a natural isomorphism `α` from `quotientMorphism G`, which is the
  quotient morphism `U → [U/R]`, to `e.functor ⋙ ξ^#`, every component of which lies over
  an identity arrow of `𝒞_Λ` (`Functor.IsHomLift p (𝟙 X.1)`). Being isomorphic by such a
  vertical natural isomorphism is the sense in which `U → [U/R]` *is* given by `ξ`.

declarations.name: Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.exists_isMinimalVersal_of_isMinimal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06KM, part (2).** A minimal groupoid in functors has a minimal versal
formal object of its quotient: the object `ξ` whose associated morphism the quotient morphism
`U → [U/R]` is given by. This states the first conjunct of `IsMinimal` on its own, so that the
content of part (2) is available as a theorem and not only inside the definition.
declarations.comment: minimal: the quotient has a minimal versal formal object

declarations.name: Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.exists_quotientMorphism_iso_associatedMorphism_of_isMinimal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06KM, part (2).** For a minimal groupoid in functors, the quotient
morphism `U → [U/R]` is, up to a vertical natural isomorphism and the equivalence
prorepresenting `U`, the morphism associated to a minimal versal formal object of `[U/R]`. This
is part (2) in full, stated as a theorem.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_quotientMorphism_iso_associatedMorphism_of_isMinimal
    {G : GroupoidInFunctors.{_, max v w, max (max v w) z}
      (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k)}
    (hG : IsMinimal.{u, v, w, z} G) :
    ∃ (ξ : FormalObject (Grothendieck.forget (evaluationFunctor G)))
      (pushforwards : ChosenPushforwards (Grothendieck.forget (evaluationFunctor G)))
      (e : G.objects.Elements ≌ (restrictedCoyoneda ξ.base).Elements),
      IsMinimalVersal (quotientProjection_cofibered G) ξ ∧
      (e.functor ⋙ CategoryOfElements.π (restrictedCoyoneda ξ.base) =
        CategoryOfElements.π G.objects) ∧
      Nonempty
        { α : quotientMorphism G ≅
            e.functor ⋙ (associatedMorphism (quotientProjection_cofibered G) ξ
              pushforwards).toBasedFunctor.toFunctor //
          ∀ X : G.objects.Elements,
            CategoryTheory.Functor.IsHomLift
              (Grothendieck.forget (evaluationFunctor G)) (𝟙 X.1) (α.hom.app X) }
declarations.comment: minimal: the quotient morphism is the one associated to that object

declarations.name: Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.isNormalized_iff_bijective_quotientDifferential
declarations.doc:
A groupoid in functors is normalized precisely when the quotient morphism `U → [U/R]` induces
an isomorphism on tangent spaces.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isNormalized_iff_bijective_quotientDifferential
    (G : GroupoidInFunctors (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k)) :
    IsNormalized.{u, v, w} G ↔ Function.Bijective (quotientDifferential.{u, v, w} G)
declarations.comment: part (1): normalized iff isomorphism on tangent spaces

declarations.name: Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.isMinimal_iff_quotientDifferential_ker_le_derivationRange
declarations.doc:
A smooth prorepresentable groupoid in functors is minimal precisely when the kernel of the
differential of `U → [U/R]` is contained in the image of the canonical map `Der_Λ(k, k) → TU`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isMinimal_iff_quotientDifferential_ker_le_derivationRange
    [IsNoetherianRing Λ] [Module.Finite Λ k]
    (hpro : IsProrepresentable G) (hsmooth : IsSmooth G) :
    IsMinimal.{u, v, w, v} G ↔
      ∀ x : tangentSpaceArtinian.{u, w, v} Λ k
          (isomorphismClasses (BasedCategory.ofFunctor (CategoryOfElements.π G.objects))
            (categoryOfElements_projection_isCofibered G.objects)),
        quotientDifferential.{u, v, w} G x =
            quotientDifferential.{u, v, w} G
              (derivationToTangentSpace (CategoryOfElements.π G.objects)
                (objects_isPredeformationCategory_of_isProrepresentable G hpro) 0) →
          x ∈ Set.range (derivationToTangentSpace (CategoryOfElements.π G.objects)
            (objects_isPredeformationCategory_of_isProrepresentable G hpro))
declarations.comment: part (2): minimal iff the kernel of the differential lies in the image of Der

declarations.name: Deformation.isIso_of_tangentSpace_bijective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06KP.** An endomorphism of a prorepresentable functor on Artinian
local `Λ`-algebras whose differential — its component at the dual numbers — is bijective is an
isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_of_tangentSpace_bijective
    (U : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k ⥤ Type (max v w))
    (hU : IsProrepresentable U) (φ : U ⟶ U)
    (hφ : Function.Bijective (φ.app (artinianDualNumbers Λ k))) :
    IsIso φ

declarations.name: Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.isIso_quotientMap_of_isEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06KQ.** Let `(U, R, s, t, c)` be a minimal smooth prorepresentable
groupoid in functors on `𝒞_Λ`. An equivalence `[U/R] → [U/R]` of categories cofibered in
groupoids induced by an endomorphism of the groupoid is an isomorphism of categories.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_quotientMap_of_isEquivalence [IsNoetherianRing Λ] [Module.Finite Λ k]
    (hpro : IsProrepresentable G) (hsmooth : IsSmooth G) (hmin : IsMinimal.{u, v, w, v} G)
    (f : G ⟶ G) [(quotientMap f).IsEquivalence] :
    IsIso (quotientMap f).toCatHom
declarations.comment: equivalence taken as induced by an endomorphism of the groupoid, and the conclusion read as strict isomorphism of categories. Neither is the source's reading, so this is an auxiliary and not the tag's covering declaration: the tag is carried outright by `Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.exists_isIso_hom_of_isEquivalence_endo`, which takes an arbitrary 1-morphism of the quotients over 𝒞_Λ whose functor is an equivalence of categories and concludes that it is isomorphic to the one induced by an isomorphism of groupoids in functors. What this auxiliary adds is that the induced functor is then an isomorphism of categories on the nose, which is stronger than the source's conclusion and not invariant under isomorphism of functors

declarations.name: Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.exists_isIso_hom_of_isEquivalence_endo
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06KQ.** Let `(U, R, s, t, c)` be a minimal smooth prorepresentable
groupoid in functors on `𝒞_Λ`. A `1`-morphism `[U/R] → [U/R]` over `𝒞_Λ` whose functor is an
equivalence of categories is an isomorphism: it is isomorphic to the functor induced by an
**isomorphism** of groupoids in functors, and therefore has a two-sided inverse `1`-morphism
over `𝒞_Λ` up to `2`-isomorphism, by
`Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.exists_inverse_morphismOver_of_isIso`.

The `1`-morphism is realised by a morphism `F` of groupoids in functors, which is the assertion
opening the source proof and is
`Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.exists_hom_of_morphismOver`; the functor induced by `F` is then
an equivalence, so `F` is an isomorphism by
`Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.isIso_of_quotientMap_isEquivalence`, which is the differential
argument of the source proof.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isIso_hom_of_isEquivalence_endo [IsNoetherianRing Λ] [Module.Finite Λ k]
    (hpro : IsProrepresentable G) (hsmooth : IsSmooth G) (hmin : IsMinimal.{u, v, w, v} G)
    (Φ : StacksRepresentableCFG.MorphismOver
      (Grothendieck.forget (evaluationFunctor G))
      (Grothendieck.forget (evaluationFunctor G))) [Φ.functor.IsEquivalence] :
    ∃ F : G ⟶ G, IsIso F ∧ Nonempty (quotientMap F ≅ Φ.functor)

declarations.name: Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.isIso_quotientMap_of_quotientMaps_isEquivalence
declarations.doc:
An equivalence `[U/R] → [U'/R']` of minimal smooth prorepresentable quotients induced by a
morphism of groupoids in functors, and admitting a quasi-inverse induced by one in the opposite
direction, induces an isomorphism of categories on the nose.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_quotientMap_of_quotientMaps_isEquivalence
    [IsNoetherianRing Λ] [Module.Finite Λ k]
    (hproG : IsProrepresentable G) (hsmoothG : IsSmooth G) (hminG : IsMinimal.{u, v, w, v} G)
    (hproH : IsProrepresentable H) (hsmoothH : IsSmooth H) (hminH : IsMinimal.{u, v, w, v} H)
    (F : G ⟶ H) (F' : H ⟶ G)
    [(quotientMap F).IsEquivalence] [(quotientMap F').IsEquivalence] :
    IsIso (quotientMap F).toCatHom
declarations.comment: equivalence and quasi-inverse taken as induced by morphisms of groupoids, and the conclusion read as strict isomorphism of categories. Neither is the source's reading, so this is an auxiliary and not the tag's covering declaration: the tag is carried outright by `Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.exists_isIso_hom_of_isEquivalence` below, which takes an arbitrary 1-morphism of the quotients over 𝒞_Λ whose functor is an equivalence of categories. What this auxiliary adds is that the induced functor is then an isomorphism of categories on the nose, which is stronger than the source's conclusion and not invariant under isomorphism of functors

declarations.name: Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.exists_isIso_hom_of_isEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06KR.** Let `(U, R, s, t, c)` and `(U', R', s', t', c')` be minimal
smooth prorepresentable groupoids in functors on `𝒞_Λ`. A `1`-morphism `[U/R] → [U'/R']` over
`𝒞_Λ` whose functor is an equivalence of categories is an isomorphism: it is isomorphic to the
functor induced by an **isomorphism** of groupoids in functors, and therefore has a two-sided
inverse `1`-morphism over `𝒞_Λ` up to `2`-isomorphism, by
`Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.exists_inverse_morphismOver_of_isIso`.

This is the source's proof: a quasi-inverse of the given `1`-morphism, corrected to lie over
`𝒞_Λ` by `Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.inverseMorphismOver`, is realised by a morphism of
groupoids in functors in the opposite direction, and the two composites are autoequivalences of
the two quotients, hence isomorphisms by Tag 06KQ.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isIso_hom_of_isEquivalence [IsNoetherianRing Λ] [Module.Finite Λ k]
    (hproG : IsProrepresentable G) (hsmoothG : IsSmooth G) (hminG : IsMinimal.{u, v, w, v} G)
    (hproH : IsProrepresentable H) (hsmoothH : IsSmooth H) (hminH : IsMinimal.{u, v, w, v} H)
    (Φ : StacksRepresentableCFG.MorphismOver
      (Grothendieck.forget (evaluationFunctor G))
      (Grothendieck.forget (evaluationFunctor H))) [Φ.functor.IsEquivalence] :
    ∃ F : G ⟶ H, IsIso F ∧ Nonempty (quotientMap F ≅ Φ.functor)

declarations.name: Deformation.quotient_satisfiesRS
declarations.doc:
The quotient of a smooth groupoid in functors whose object and arrow functors satisfy
condition (RS) also satisfies condition (RS).
declarations.statement:
public theorem quotient_satisfiesRS
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    (G : GroupoidInFunctors (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k))
    (hG : GroupoidInFunctors.IsSmooth G)
    (hU : SatisfiesRS (Functor.Elements.π G.objects))
    (hR : SatisfiesRS (Functor.Elements.π G.arrows)) :
    SatisfiesRS (Grothendieck.forget (evaluationFunctor G))

declarations.name: Deformation.quotient_isDeformationCategory
declarations.doc: The quotient of a smooth groupoid of deformation functors is a deformation category.
declarations.statement:
public theorem quotient_isDeformationCategory
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    (G : GroupoidInFunctors.{_, _, t} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k))
    (hG : GroupoidInFunctors.IsSmooth G)
    (hU : IsDeformationFunctor G.objects)
    (hR : IsDeformationFunctor G.arrows) :
    IsDeformationCategory (Grothendieck.forget (evaluationFunctor G))

declarations.name: Deformation.quotientInfinitesimalBoundary_exact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06KU, part (3).** Let `(U, R, s, t, c)` be a smooth groupoid in
functors on `𝒞_Λ` whose functors of objects and of arrows are deformation functors. Then the
space of infinitesimal automorphisms of the quotient is the kernel of the differential of the
source-and-target map,

`Inf([U/R]) = Ker(ds ⊕ dt : TR → TU ⊕ TU)`,

in the form of the exact sequence of `k`-vector spaces

`0 → Inf([U/R]) → TR → TU ⊕ TU`:

the boundary map is injective and its image is the kernel of the pair of the two differentials.

The identification is the one of Tag 06L6 part (2) for the quotient morphism `q : U → [U/R]`,
whose self `2`-fibre product `U ×_{q, [U/R], q} U` is the arrow functor: an arrow of the groupoid
over `A` with source `x` and target `y` is an isomorphism over `A` between the images of `x` and
of `y` in the quotient, and that comparison is an equivalence on every strict fibre, hence an
isomorphism of tangent modules.
declarations.statement:
public theorem quotientInfinitesimalBoundary_exact
    (hG : GroupoidInFunctors.IsSmooth G)
    (hU : IsDeformationFunctor.{u, v, w} G.objects)
    (hR : IsDeformationFunctor.{u, v, w} G.arrows) {y₀ : G.objects.Elements}
    (PF : ChosenPushforwardsAt (Grothendieck.forget (evaluationFunctor G))
      ((quotientMorphism G).obj y₀))
    (M : FGModuleCat.{max v w} k) :
    Function.Injective (quotientInfinitesimalBoundary.{u, v, w, t} G hG hU hR PF M) ∧
      Function.Exact (quotientInfinitesimalBoundary.{u, v, w, t} G hG hU hR PF M)
        (LinearMap.prod
          (tangentMapAt.{u, v, w} (arrowsBasedDeformationCategory G hR)
            (objectsBasedDeformationCategory G hU) (elementsBasedFunctor G.source) M)
          (tangentMapAt.{u, v, w} (arrowsBasedDeformationCategory G hR)
            (objectsBasedDeformationCategory G hU)
            (elementsBasedFunctor G.target) M))
declarations.comment: part (3): Inf([U/R]) = Ker(ds ⊕ dt : TR → TU ⊕ TU), as the exactness of 0 → Inf([U/R]) → TR → TU ⊕ TU. The two differentials are the maps on tangent modules induced by s and t at an arbitrary coordinate module M, and Inf([U/R]) is the value at M of the k-linear lift of the infinitesimal automorphisms of the image in [U/R] of a point y₀ of U, taken with an arbitrary choice PF of pushforwards there. No hypothesis is carried beyond the tag's own: G smooth, U and R deformation functors

declarations.name: Deformation.quotientTangentEquiv
declarations.doc:
The canonical tangent space of a smooth quotient is the cokernel of
the source-minus-target differential.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def quotientTangentEquiv
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    (G : GroupoidInFunctors (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, w, w} Λ k))
    (hG : GroupoidInFunctors.IsSmooth G)
    (hU : IsDeformationFunctor G.objects)
    (hR : IsDeformationFunctor G.arrows) :
    let 𝓡 := BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Functor.Elements.π G.arrows)
    let 𝓤 := BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Functor.Elements.π G.objects)
    let 𝓠 := BasedCategory.ofFunctor (Grothendieck.forget (evaluationFunctor G))
    let h𝓡 := ((isDeformationCategory_iff G.arrows).2 hR).predeformation
    let h𝓤 := ((isDeformationCategory_iff G.objects).2 hU).predeformation
    let h𝓠 := quotient_isPredeformationCategory G hU hR
    let s2𝓡 := schlessingerConditionS2_of_isIsomorphismClasses
      𝓡 h𝓡.cofibered (schlessingerConditionS2_of_satisfiesRS hR.2) (Or.inl h𝓡)
    let s2𝓤 := schlessingerConditionS2_of_isIsomorphismClasses
      𝓤 h𝓤.cofibered (schlessingerConditionS2_of_satisfiesRS hU.2) (Or.inl h𝓤)
    let s2𝓠 := schlessingerConditionS2_of_isIsomorphismClasses
      𝓠 h𝓠.cofibered
      (schlessingerConditionS2_of_satisfiesRS (quotient_satisfiesRS G hG hU.2 hR.2))
      (Or.inl h𝓠)
    letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory 𝓡.p) := ⟨h𝓡⟩
    letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory 𝓤.p) := ⟨h𝓤⟩
    letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory 𝓠.p) := ⟨h𝓠⟩
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓡 h𝓡.cofibered))) := ⟨s2𝓡⟩
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓤 h𝓤.cofibered))) := ⟨s2𝓤⟩
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓠 h𝓠.cofibered))) := ⟨s2𝓠⟩
    let TR := artinianTangentSpace Λ k (isomorphismClasses 𝓡 h𝓡.cofibered)
    let TU := artinianTangentSpace Λ k (isomorphismClasses 𝓤 h𝓤.cofibered)
    let TQ := artinianTangentSpace Λ k (isomorphismClasses 𝓠 h𝓠.cofibered)
    let ds : TR →ₗ[k] TU := IsLinearMap.mk'
      (differential h𝓡.cofibered h𝓤.cofibered (elementsBasedFunctor G.source))
      (differential_isLinearMap 𝓡 𝓤 h𝓡 h𝓤 s2𝓡 s2𝓤 (elementsBasedFunctor G.source))
    let dt : TR →ₗ[k] TU := IsLinearMap.mk'
      (differential h𝓡.cofibered h𝓤.cofibered (elementsBasedFunctor G.target))
      (differential_isLinearMap 𝓡 𝓤 h𝓡 h𝓤 s2𝓡 s2𝓤 (elementsBasedFunctor G.target))
    let dq : TU →ₗ[k] TQ := IsLinearMap.mk'
      (differential h𝓤.cofibered h𝓠.cofibered
        (⟨quotientMorphism G, quotientMorphism_over G⟩ : BasedFunctor 𝓤 𝓠))
      (differential_isLinearMap 𝓤 𝓠 h𝓤 h𝓠 s2𝓤 s2𝓠
        (⟨quotientMorphism G, quotientMorphism_over G⟩ : BasedFunctor 𝓤 𝓠))
    { e : (TU ⧸ LinearMap.range (ds - dt)) ≃ₗ[k] TQ //
      ∀ x : TU, e (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = dq x }

declarations.name: Deformation.Presentation
declarations.doc:
An equivalence over `C` from the quotient of `G` to a category over `C`.
When the latter is cofibered in groupoids, this is a presentation in the
sense of Stacks Project, Tag 06KX.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev Presentation {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (G : GroupoidInFunctors.{u, v, w} C)
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F] (p : F ⥤ C)

declarations.name: Deformation.presentationGroupoid
declarations.doc:
A morphism from a set-valued functor to a category cofibered in groupoids canonically
produces a groupoid in functors, whose arrows are the two-fibre product with source, target, and
composition given by the second, first, and first-and-last projections respectively.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def presentationGroupoid
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p) : PresentationGroupoid p U f over

declarations.name: Deformation.presentationMorphism
declarations.doc:
The canonical morphism from the quotient of a presentation to the category
being presented, together with its compatibility with the projection and the
original presentation functor.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def presentationMorphism :
    {g : Grothendieck (evaluationFunctor P.toGroupoidInFunctors) ⥤ F //
      (g ⋙ p = Grothendieck.forget
        (evaluationFunctor P.toGroupoidInFunctors)) ∧
      ((uliftElementsEquivalence U).functor ⋙
        quotientMorphism P.toGroupoidInFunctors ⋙ g = f)}

declarations.name: Deformation.presentationMorphism_full
declarations.doc: The morphism from a presentation quotient is full.
declarations.statement:
theorem presentationMorphism_full
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p) :
    (presentationMorphism p U f over P).1.Full

declarations.name: Deformation.presentationMorphism_faithful
declarations.doc: The morphism from a presentation quotient is faithful.
declarations.statement:
theorem presentationMorphism_faithful :
    (presentationMorphism p U f over P).1.Faithful

declarations.name: Deformation.presentationMorphism_isEquivalence_iff
declarations.doc:
The quotient morphism is an equivalence exactly when the original
presentation functor is essentially surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem presentationMorphism_isEquivalence_iff
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p) :
    (presentationMorphism p U f over P).1.IsEquivalence ↔ f.EssSurj

declarations.name: Deformation.presentationMorphism_isEquivalence_of_isSmooth_of_fiber_essSurj
declarations.doc:
The canonical quotient morphism associated to a smooth presentation is an equivalence if
the presentation is essentially surjective over the residue field.
declarations.statement:
theorem presentationMorphism_isEquivalence_of_isSmooth_of_fiber_essSurj
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (hf : IsSmooth f)
    (h₀ : (fiberFunctor f (residueFieldObject Λ k)).EssSurj) :
    (presentationMorphism p U f.toFunctor f.w
      (presentationGroupoid p U f.toFunctor f.w hp)).1.IsEquivalence

declarations.name: Deformation.isSmooth_presentationGroupoid
declarations.doc:
A smooth presentation has a smooth associated groupoid in functors.

This is one of the two covering declarations of Stacks 06L1; the other is the equivalence
criterion for the quotient morphism,
`Deformation.presentationMorphism_isEquivalence_of_isSmooth_of_fiber_essSurj`. See the
implementation notes.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSmooth_presentationGroupoid
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (hf : IsSmooth f) :
    GroupoidInFunctors.IsSmooth
      ((presentationGroupoid p U f.toFunctor f.w hp).toGroupoidInFunctors)

declarations.name: Deformation.exists_minimalPresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06L2.** Let `ℱ` be a deformation category over `𝒞_Λ` with
`dim_k Tℱ < ∞` and `dim_k Inf(ℱ) < ∞`. Then there is a minimal versal formal object `ξ` of
`ℱ`, say over `R`, and, with `U = R̲|_{𝒞_Λ}` and `f = ξ : U → ℱ` the associated morphism, the
groupoid in functors `(U, R, s, t, c)` constructed from `f` in Tag 06KY is a minimal smooth
prorepresentable groupoid in functors on `𝒞_Λ` with `[U/R] → ℱ` an equivalence.

The two `Fact` instances carry no content beyond `hp`; they make Tag 06IH's canonical
