**Stacks 06R4.** Let `G` be a groupoid in algebraic spaces whose source and target
morphisms are both coverings for a topology `τ` other than the fpqc topology, and let `P` be a
property of morphisms of algebraic spaces local on the target for `τ`. A greatest open
subspace of the object space over which the restriction of the stabilizer has `P` is invariant
under `G`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isInvariantOpen_of_isGreatest_stabilizer (τ : Space.Topology) (hτ : τ ≠ .fpqc)
    (P : MorphismProperty (AlgebraicSpaces C S hS))
    [P.IsLocalAtTarget (Space.Topology.precoverage.{u, u + 1} τ C S hS)]
    (hs : τ.IsCovering C S hS (fun _ : Unit => G.arrows.obj) (fun _ => G.source.hom))
    (ht : τ.IsCovering C S hS (fun _ : Unit => G.arrows.obj) (fun _ => G.target.hom))
    (W : {W : Subfunctor G.objects.obj // Space.IsOpenSubspace C S hS W})
    (hW : IsGreatest {V : {V : Subfunctor G.objects.obj // Space.IsOpenSubspace C S hS V} |
      P (stabilizerProjectionOverOpen G V)} W) :
    IsInvariantOpen G W.1
declarations.comment: invariance of the maximal open stabilizer-property locus

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.inertiaPullbackComparison_isEquivalenceOver
declarations.doc:
For a fully faithful morphism, the inertia square is a 2-fibre product
over the base, with its canonical comparison functor and vertical coherence.
declarations.statement:
public theorem inertiaPullbackComparison_isEquivalenceOver
    (hFF : F.FullyFaithful) :
    Nonempty (IsEquivalenceOver (RelativeInertia.toBase pX)
      (TwoFibreProductOver.structureFunctor (RelativeInertia.toBase pY) pX pY
        (RelativeInertia.π pY) F)
      (inertiaPullbackComparison pX pY F hF))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isLocallyNoetherian_of_isLocallyOfFiniteType
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06R6.** Let `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a 1-morphism of algebraic stacks over `S`. If `f` is
locally of finite type and `𝒴` is locally Noetherian, then `𝒳` is locally Noetherian. Local
Noetherianity of an algebraic stack over `S` is the smooth-scheme-atlas criterion of
**Stacks 04YG** at `AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocallyNoetherian`.

The source argues with scheme charts; here the whole argument runs on algebraic-space charts,
which is what the chapter's vocabulary already supports, and the scheme criterion is reached at
the two ends by **Stacks 04YF**. A smooth diagram over `f` is a pair of algebraic-space charts
`a : U ⟶ 𝒳` and `b : V ⟶ 𝒴` whose top horizontal morphism `h : U ⟶ V` is locally of finite
type, with `a` moreover surjective on objects; `V` is then a smooth algebraic-space chart of
`𝒴`, so it has the étale-local property of **Stacks 03E6** at local Noetherianity, and
**Stacks 04ZK** carries that along `h` to `U`. Since `a` is a smooth surjective algebraic-space
atlas of `𝒳`, that is the third criterion of Stacks 04YF for `𝒳`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyNoetherian_of_isLocallyOfFiniteType
    {𝒳 𝒴 : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS}
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (hf : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f)
    (hY : HasPropertyOnSomeSchemeAtlas B S hS
      (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T) 𝒴) :
    HasPropertyOnSomeSchemeAtlas B S hS
      (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T) 𝒳

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isOpenMap_pointsMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06R7.** A flat 1-morphism of algebraic stacks over `S` which is locally of finite
presentation induces an open map on the topological spaces of points of Stacks 04XG and
Stacks 04XL.
declarations.statement:
theorem isOpenMap_pointsMap {𝒳 𝒴 : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hflat : IsFlat B S hS f) (hlfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f) :
    @IsOpenMap _ _ (Stack.pointTopology B S hS 𝒳.val) (Stack.pointTopology B S hS 𝒴.val)
      (Stack.pointsMap B S hS 𝒳.val.val 𝒳.val.property 𝒴.val.property f.hom.hom)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.universalHomeomorphism_of_isGerbeOver
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06R9.** A 1-morphism `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of algebraic stacks over `S` which exhibits `𝒳` as
a gerbe over `𝒴` is a universal homeomorphism in the sense of Stacks 0CI7.

The gerbe condition base changes (Stacks 06QE), so each projection `|𝒵 ×_𝒴 𝒳| → |𝒵|` is a
homeomorphism by `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isHomeomorph_pointsMap_of_isGerbeOver`.
declarations.statement:
theorem universalHomeomorphism_of_isGerbeOver {𝒳 𝒴 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hf : AlgebraicStacks.IsGerbeOver B S hS f) :
    UniversalHomeomorphism B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.hasSingletonPointMonomorphism_of_isGerbe
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RA.** An algebraic stack over `S` which is a gerbe (**Stacks 06QC**) satisfies
condition (1) of **Stacks 06MT** at every point of its space of points; that is, its residual
gerbe exists at every point.

A gerbe comes with a 1-morphism `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` to an algebraic stack representable by an algebraic
space which makes `𝒳` a gerbe over `𝒴`. Condition (1) holds for `𝒴` at the image of the point by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.hasSingletonPointMonomorphism_of_isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace`, and
transports back along `f` by the existence clause of **Stacks 0H24**.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasSingletonPointMonomorphism_of_isGerbe
    (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS)
    (h𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.IsGerbe B S hS 𝒳)
    (x : points B S hS 𝒳.val.val (Classical.choose 𝒳.property)) :
    HasSingletonPointMonomorphism B S hS 𝒳 x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exists_openSubstack_dense_isGerbe
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RC.** Let `𝒳` be a reduced algebraic stack over `S` whose inertia projection
`I_𝒳 ⟶ 𝒳` is quasi-compact. Then there is a dense open substack `𝒰 ⊆ 𝒳` which is a gerbe.

The proof is the source's. Choose a presentation `[U/R] ⟶ 𝒳` whose chart `U ⟶ 𝒳` is smooth and
surjective (Stacks 04T3); `U` is reduced (Stacks 04YF) and the stabilizer `G ⟶ U` is the base
change of `I_𝒳 ⟶ 𝒳` (Stacks 06PR), hence of finite type (Stacks 050Q). Generic flatness
(Stacks 06QS) gives a dense open `W ⊆ U` over which `G` is flat and locally of finite
presentation. The image `Ω` of `|W|` in `|𝒳|` is open, `W ⟶ 𝒳` being smooth, and dense; `𝒰` is the
open substack with `|𝒰| = Ω` (Stacks 06FJ), through which `W ⟶ 𝒳` factors by a smooth surjective
1-morphism. By Stacks 06R5 and Stacks 06PR the base change of `I_𝒰 ⟶ 𝒰` along `W ⟶ 𝒰` is
`G ×_U W ⟶ W`, so `I_𝒰 ⟶ 𝒰` is flat and locally of finite presentation, and `𝒰` is a gerbe by
Stacks 06QJ.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_openSubstack_dense_isGerbe (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS)
    (hred : IsReducedStack B S hS 𝒳)
    (hqc : IsQuasiCompactMorphism.{u, w} B S hS (inertiaProjectionAlgebraicStacks B S hS 𝒳)) :
    ∃ W : OpenSubstack 𝒳, @Dense _ (pointTopology B S hS 𝒳.val) (W.pointSet B S hS) ∧
      AlgebraicStacks.IsGerbe B S hS
        (fullSubcategoryAlgebraicStack 𝒳 W.property W.isAlgebraic)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.hasReducedSingletonPointMonomorphism_of_isQuasiCompact_inertia
declarations.doc:
Let `𝒳` be an algebraic stack over `S` whose inertia projection `I_𝒳 ⟶ 𝒳` is
quasi-compact. Then the residual gerbe of `𝒳` exists at every point `x` of `|𝒳|`, in the sense
of Stacks 06MU (1), condition (2) of Stacks 06MT: there is a reduced algebraic stack `𝒵` with a
monomorphism `𝒵 ⟶ 𝒳` whose space of points is a single point lying over `x`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasReducedSingletonPointMonomorphism_of_isQuasiCompact_inertia
    (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS)
    (hqc : IsQuasiCompactMorphism.{u, w} B S hS (inertiaProjectionAlgebraicStacks B S hS 𝒳))
    (x : points B S hS 𝒳.val.val (Classical.choose 𝒳.property)) :
    HasReducedSingletonPointMonomorphism B S hS 𝒳 x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.action
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RE.** The action of the multiplicative group scheme on
`U = Spec(k[x_0, x_1, x_2, …])` attached to the grading giving `x_i` the degree `p^i`, namely
`t · (x_0, x_1, x_2, …) = (t x_0, t^p x_1, t^{p^2} x_2, …)`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def action (k : Type u) [CommRing k] (p : ℕ) : GradedGmAction (grading k p)
declarations.comment: the weighted multiplicative-group action on Spec k[x_0, x_1, x_2, ...]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.action_μ_X
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RE.** The coaction of the action sends the variable `x_i` to `x_i ⊗ T^{p^i}`:
the group element `t` scales the coordinate `x_i` by `t^{p^i}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem action_μ_X (k : Type u) [CommRing k] (p i : ℕ) :
    (action k p).μ (MvPolynomial.X i) =
      (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial ℕ k) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] LaurentPolynomial.T ((p : ℤ) ^ i)
declarations.comment: the coaction on the variables: x_i goes to x_i tensor T^{p^i}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.pointEval_action_μ_X
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RE.** The action on points is the action the registered coaction defines:
evaluating the coaction of `x_i` at a point `φ` of `U` and a unit `t` gives the `i`-th
coordinate `t^{p^i} φ(x_i)` of `t · φ`.  So `smulPoint` is the action of
`AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.action` and not a second one.
declarations.statement:
theorem pointEval_action_μ_X (k : Type u) [CommRing k] (p i : ℕ)
    (φ : MvPolynomial ℕ k →+* R) (t : Rˣ) :
    pointEval φ t ((action k p).μ (MvPolynomial.X i)) =
      smulPoint p t (fun j => φ (MvPolynomial.X j)) i
declarations.comment: the action on points is the one the coaction defines

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.pointStabilizer_eq_rootsUnitsSubgroup
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RE.** On the `i`-th stratum the stabilizer of the weighted action is `μ_{p^i}`:
a unit `t` fixes a point whose first nonvanishing coordinate is the `i`-th exactly when
`t^{p^i} = 1`.  The subgroup `AlgebraicGeometry.rootsUnitsSubgroup n` of the units is the value
at `R` of the functor of points of the group scheme `μ_n`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.rootsOfUnitySections_representableBy_rootsOfUnity`).
declarations.statement:
theorem pointStabilizer_eq_rootsUnitsSubgroup (p i : ℕ) (a : ℕ → R)
    (ha : IsPointInStratum i a) :
    pointStabilizer p a = rootsUnitsSubgroup (p ^ i)
declarations.comment: the stabilizer along the stratum X_i is mu_{p^i}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.pointStabilizer_eq_top
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RE.** On the last stratum, where all the coordinates vanish, the stabilizer of
the weighted action is all of `G_m`: the unit group of `R` is the value at `R` of the functor of
points of the multiplicative group scheme
(`AlgebraicGeometry.unitsOfGlobalSections_representableBy_multiplicativeGroup`).
declarations.statement:
theorem pointStabilizer_eq_top (p : ℕ) (a : ℕ → R) (ha : IsPointInStratumInf a) :
    pointStabilizer p a = ⊤
declarations.comment: the stabilizer along the stratum X_infinity is G_m

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.isPointInStratum_smulPoint
declarations.doc: **Stacks 06RE.** The `i`-th stratum is invariant under the action.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPointInStratum_smulPoint (p i : ℕ) (t : Rˣ) (a : ℕ → R) :
    IsPointInStratum i (smulPoint p t a) ↔ IsPointInStratum i a
declarations.comment: the stratum X_i is invariant under the action

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.isPointInStratumInf_smulPoint
declarations.doc: **Stacks 06RE.** The last stratum is invariant under the action.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPointInStratumInf_smulPoint (p : ℕ) (t : Rˣ) (a : ℕ → R) :
    IsPointInStratumInf (smulPoint p t a) ↔ IsPointInStratumInf a
declarations.comment: the stratum X_infinity is invariant under the action

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.isPointInStratumInf_or_exists_isPointInStratum
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RE.** The strata cover `U`: a point with values in a field either has all its
coordinates zero, or lies in the stratum indexed by the first index where it does not vanish.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPointInStratumInf_or_exists_isPointInStratum {K : Type*} [Field K] (a : ℕ → K) :
    IsPointInStratumInf a ∨ ∃ i, IsPointInStratum i a
declarations.comment: the strata cover: every point lies in exactly one stratum

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.isLocallyClosed_stratum
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RE.** The `i`-th stratum is locally closed: it is the intersection of the open
where `x_i` is invertible with the closed subscheme where `x_0, …, x_{i-1}` vanish.
declarations.statement: theorem isLocallyClosed_stratum (i : ℕ) : IsLocallyClosed (stratum k i)
declarations.comment: the stratum X_i is locally closed

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.isClosed_stratumInf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RE.** The last stratum is closed, being the vanishing locus of all the
coordinates.
declarations.statement: theorem isClosed_stratumInf : IsClosed (stratumInf k)
declarations.comment: the stratum X_infinity is closed, hence locally closed

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.iUnion_stratum_union_stratumInf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RE.** The strata cover `U`: a point of the spectrum either kills all the
coordinates, or lies in the stratum indexed by the first coordinate it does not kill.
declarations.statement:
theorem iUnion_stratum_union_stratumInf :
    (⋃ i, stratum k i) ∪ stratumInf k = Set.univ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.mem_stratum_ker_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RE.** The two readings of the `i`-th stratum agree: a point of `U` with values in
a field lies in the `i`-th stratum in the sense of `IsPointInStratum` exactly when the prime it
defines lies in `stratum`.
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_stratum_ker_iff {K : Type*} [Field K] (φ : MvPolynomial ℕ k →+* K) (i : ℕ) :
    (⟨RingHom.ker φ, RingHom.ker_isPrime φ⟩ : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial ℕ k)) ∈
        stratum k i ↔
      IsPointInStratum i (fun j => φ (MvPolynomial.X j))
declarations.comment: the strata on points and on the spectrum are the same

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.mem_stratumInf_ker_iff
declarations.doc: **Stacks 06RE.** The two readings of the last stratum agree.
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_stratumInf_ker_iff {K : Type*} [Field K] (φ : MvPolynomial ℕ k →+* K) :
    (⟨RingHom.ker φ, RingHom.ker_isPrime φ⟩ : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial ℕ k)) ∈
        stratumInf k ↔
      IsPointInStratumInf (fun j => φ (MvPolynomial.X j))
declarations.comment: the last stratum on points and on the spectrum is the same

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.isDomain_stratumRing
declarations.doc: **Stacks 06RE.** The `i`-th stratum is integral, in particular reduced.
declarations.statement: theorem isDomain_stratumRing [IsDomain k] (i : ℕ) : IsDomain (stratumRing k i)
declarations.comment: the stratum X_i is reduced, being integral

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.isReduced_stratumRing
declarations.doc: **Stacks 06RE.** The `i`-th stratum is reduced.
declarations.statement: theorem isReduced_stratumRing [IsDomain k] (i : ℕ) : IsReduced (stratumRing k i)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.isDomain_quotient_coordinateIdeal_univ
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RE.** The last stratum is reduced: it is the origin, cut out by the prime ideal
generated by all the coordinates.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDomain_quotient_coordinateIdeal_univ [IsDomain k] :
    IsDomain (MvPolynomial ℕ k ⧸ coordinateIdeal k Set.univ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.rootsUnitsSubgroup_pow_ne
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RE.** Distinct strata have distinct groups: for `1 < p` and `i < j` the group
`μ_{p^i}` of the stratum `X_i` is not the group `μ_{p^j}` of the stratum `X_j`.  So no two strata
can be merged into a single locus along which the stabilizer is one group, which is why there is
no coarser stratification with the same properties.
declarations.statement:
theorem rootsUnitsSubgroup_pow_ne (p i j : ℕ) (hp : 1 < p) (hij : i < j) :
    rootsUnitsSubgroup (A := rootsOfUnityCoordinateRing.{u} (p ^ j)) (p ^ i) ≠
      rootsUnitsSubgroup (p ^ j)
declarations.comment: distinct strata have distinct groups mu_{p^i}: no coarser stratification

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.rootsUnitsSubgroup_ne_top
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RE.** The group of a stratum `X_i` is never the group `G_m` of the last stratum
`X_∞`: already in the units of the rationals the `n`-th roots of unity are not everything, since
`2` is a unit with `2^n ≠ 1`.  So the last stratum cannot be merged with any other one either.
declarations.statement:
theorem rootsUnitsSubgroup_ne_top {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    rootsUnitsSubgroup (A := ℚ) n ≠ ⊤
declarations.comment: the group mu_{p^i} of X_i differs from the group G_m of X_infinity

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.pointStabilizer_ne_pointStabilizer_basisPoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RE.** The strata `X_i` and `X_j` with `i < j` cannot be merged: already over the
coordinate ring of `μ_{p^j}` the stabilizer of a point of `X_i` differs from the stabilizer of a
point of `X_j`, being `μ_{p^i}` against `μ_{p^j}`.  Together with
`AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.pointStabilizer_ne_pointStabilizer_basisPoint_zero` this is the
source's last assertion, that there is no coarser stratification with the same properties: a
stratum of a coarser stratification would contain points of two of the strata below and so could
not be a gerbe with a single group.
declarations.statement:
theorem pointStabilizer_ne_pointStabilizer_basisPoint (p i j : ℕ) (hp : 1 < p) (hij : i < j) :
    pointStabilizer p (basisPoint (rootsOfUnityCoordinateRing.{u} (p ^ j)) i) ≠
      pointStabilizer p (basisPoint (rootsOfUnityCoordinateRing.{u} (p ^ j)) j)
declarations.comment: the strata X_i and X_j cannot be merged: their stabilizers differ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.pointStabilizer_ne_pointStabilizer_basisPoint_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RE.** The stratum `X_i` cannot be merged with the last stratum `X_∞`: already over
the rationals the stabilizer of the point of `X_i` with `i`-th coordinate one is `μ_{p^i}`, while
the stabilizer of the origin is all of `G_m`.
declarations.statement:
theorem pointStabilizer_ne_pointStabilizer_basisPoint_zero (p i : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    pointStabilizer p (basisPoint ℚ i) ≠ pointStabilizer p (0 : ℕ → ℚ)
declarations.comment: the stratum X_i cannot be merged with X_infinity: their stabilizers differ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.quotientStack
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RE.** The quotient stack `[U/𝐆_m]` of the multiplicative-group action on
`U = Spec(k[x_0, x_1, x_2, …])` in which `x_i` has weight `p^i`.  It is the quotient stack of
Stacks 044Q, part (2), for that action, read at the terminal algebraic space of the big fppf
site over `Spec ℤ`.  The hypothesis is that the site contain `U`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def quotientStack (hU : 𝒞.Contains (Spec (.of (MvPolynomial ℕ k)))) :
    BasedCategory
      (BigFppfOver 𝒞 (Spec (.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))) (Space.contains_specULiftZ 𝒞))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.isAlgebraicStack_quotientStack
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RE.** The quotient stack `[U/𝐆_m]` is an algebraic stack over `Spec ℤ`.  This is
Stacks 04TK for the action: the structure morphism of the group algebraic space
`B ×_{Spec ℤ} 𝐆_m ⟶ B` is smooth because the Laurent polynomial ring is a smooth algebra, and
04TK carries nothing beyond that smoothness.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicStack_quotientStack
    (hU : 𝒞.Contains (Spec (.of (MvPolynomial ℕ k)))) :
    Stack.IsAlgebraicStack.{u, w} 𝒞 (Spec (.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))
      (Space.contains_specULiftZ 𝒞) (quotientStack 𝒞 k p hU)
declarations.comment: the quotient stack [U/G_m] is an algebraic stack

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.weightedQuotientStack_presentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RE**, assertion (1): `𝒳 = [U/𝐆_m]` is an algebraic stack. The algebraic stack
`weightedQuotientStack` is presented, in the sense of Stacks 04TI, by the action groupoid of `𝐆_m`
on `U`, whose quotient stack is the `[U/𝐆_m]` of `quotientStack`.
declarations.statement:
theorem weightedQuotientStack_presentation :
    ∃ P : Stack.GroupoidPresentation 𝒞 𝒵 (Space.contains_specULiftZ 𝒞)
        (weightedQuotientStack.{u, w} 𝒞 k p hU).val.val,
      Stack.quotientStack P.groupoid = quotientStack 𝒞 k p hU
declarations.comment: X = [U/G_m] is an algebraic stack: the object of the 2-category of algebraic stacks presented by the action groupoid

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.stratumProperty_chart_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RE**, assertion (2), the strata: the stratum of index `i` is the locus where
`x_0, …, x_{i-1}` vanish and `x_i` does not, and the stratum of index `∞` the locus where all
`x_j` vanish. Precisely, a point `h : W ⟶ U` with values in any scheme `W` of the site lands in
`𝒳_i` if and only if `x_0, …, x_{i-1}` pull back to `0` and `x_i` to a unit of `Γ(W, 𝒪_W)`, and in
`𝒳_∞` if and only if every `x_j` pulls back to `0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem stratumProperty_chart_iff {W : BigFppfOver 𝒞 𝒵 (Space.contains_specULiftZ 𝒞)}
    (h : W ⟶ totalSiteObject 𝒞 k hU) :
    (∀ i : ℕ, stratumProperty.{u, w} 𝒞 k p hU i (chartObj.{u, w} p h) ↔
      (∀ j < i, coord h j = 0) ∧ IsUnit (coord h i)) ∧
    (stratumProperty.{u, w} 𝒞 k p hU ⊤ (chartObj.{u, w} p h) ↔ ∀ j, coord h j = 0)
declarations.comment: the strata X_i (x_0 = ... = x_{i-1} = 0, x_i invertible) and X_infinity (all x_j = 0)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.isAlgebraicStack_stratum
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RE: each stratum is an algebraic stack.** The full subcategory of `𝒳` on the
objects of the stratum `𝒳_a` is an algebraic stack, being a locally closed substack of `𝒳`: this
is the algebraicity component of `isLocallyClosedSubstack_stratumProperty`. It is the algebraic
stack structure on `𝒳_a` that assertions (2), (3) and (4) below are stated for.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicStack_stratum (a : WithTop ℕ) :
    Stack.IsAlgebraicStack.{u, w} 𝒞 𝒵 (Space.contains_specULiftZ 𝒞)
      (Stack.fullSubcategoryBased (weightedQuotientStack.{u, w} 𝒞 k p hU)
        (stratumProperty.{u, w} 𝒞 k p hU a))
declarations.comment: each stratum is an algebraic stack (locally closed substack)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.exists_stratification
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RE**, assertion (2), the stratification: the point sets `|𝒳_a|` of the strata form a
stratification of `|𝒳|` (Stacks 09Y1) indexed by `ℕ ∪ {∞}` with the reverse order: they are
pairwise disjoint, cover `|𝒳|`, and the closure of `|𝒳_i|` lies in
`|𝒳_i| ∪ |𝒳_{i+1}| ∪ ⋯ ∪ |𝒳_∞|`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_stratification :
    letI := Stack.pointTopology 𝒞 𝒵 (Space.contains_specULiftZ 𝒞)
      (weightedQuotientStack.{u, w} 𝒞 k p hU).val
    ∃ σ : Stratification (Stack.AlgebraicStacks.points 𝒞 𝒵 (Space.contains_specULiftZ 𝒞)
        (weightedQuotientStack.{u, w} 𝒞 k p hU)) (WithTop ℕ)ᵒᵈ,
      ∀ a : WithTop ℕ,
        σ.strata (OrderDual.toDual a) =
          Set.range (Stack.AlgebraicStacks.pointsMap 𝒞 𝒵 (Space.contains_specULiftZ 𝒞)
            (Stack.fullSubcategoryInclusion (weightedQuotientStack.{u, w} 𝒞 k p hU)
              (stratumProperty.{u, w} 𝒞 k p hU a)
              (isAlgebraicStack_stratum.{u, w} 𝒞 k p hU a)))
declarations.comment: the strata form a stratification of |X|

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.isReduced_isLocallyClosedSubstack_stratum
declarations.doc: **Stacks 06RE**, assertion (4): every stratum is a reduced locally closed substack of `𝒳`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isReduced_isLocallyClosedSubstack_stratum (a : WithTop ℕ) :
    Stack.IsLocallyClosedSubstack (weightedQuotientStack.{u, w} 𝒞 k p hU)
        (stratumProperty.{u, w} 𝒞 k p hU a) ∧
      Stack.IsReducedStack 𝒞 𝒵 (Space.contains_specULiftZ 𝒞)
        (Stack.fullSubcategoryAlgebraicStack (weightedQuotientStack.{u, w} 𝒞 k p hU)
          (stratumProperty.{u, w} 𝒞 k p hU a) (isAlgebraicStack_stratum.{u, w} 𝒞 k p hU a))
declarations.comment: the strata are reduced locally closed substacks

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.isGerbeOverSchemeWithGroup_algebraicStratum
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RE**, assertion (3): each stratum is a gerbe over a scheme, with group `μ_{p^i}`
for `𝒳_i` and `𝐆_m` for `𝒳_∞`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGerbeOverSchemeWithGroup_algebraicStratum (a : WithTop ℕ) :
    haveI : NeZero p := ⟨hp.out.ne_zero⟩
    Stack.AlgebraicStacks.IsGerbeOverSchemeWithGroup 𝒞 𝒵 (Space.contains_specULiftZ 𝒞)
      (Stack.fullSubcategoryAlgebraicStack (weightedQuotientStack.{u, w} 𝒞 k p hU)
        (stratumProperty.{u, w} 𝒞 k p hU a) (isAlgebraicStack_stratum.{u, w} 𝒞 k p hU a))
      (stratumGroup.{u} p a)
declarations.comment: each stratum is a gerbe over a scheme with group mu_{p^i} for X_i and G_m for X_infinity

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.PPowerWeighted.stratification_minimal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RE**, assertion (5): there is no coarser stratification with the same properties.
If a topological partition of `|𝒳|` (Stacks 09XZ) consists of the point sets of reduced locally
closed substacks of `𝒳` each of which is a gerbe over a scheme, and the strata `|𝒳_a|` refine it,
then it is the partition by the strata.
declarations.statement:
theorem stratification_minimal :
    letI := Stack.pointTopology 𝒞 𝒵 (Space.contains_specULiftZ 𝒞)
      (weightedQuotientStack.{u, w} 𝒞 k p hU).val
    ∀ Qs : Set (Set (Stack.AlgebraicStacks.points 𝒞 𝒵 (Space.contains_specULiftZ 𝒞)
        (weightedQuotientStack.{u, w} 𝒞 k p hU))),
      IsTopologicalPartition Qs →
      (∀ s ∈ Qs, ∃ (W : ObjectProperty (weightedQuotientStack.{u, w} 𝒞 k p hU).val.val.obj)
          (_ : Stack.IsLocallyClosedSubstack (weightedQuotientStack.{u, w} 𝒞 k p hU) W),
        (∀ hA, Stack.IsReducedStack 𝒞 𝒵 (Space.contains_specULiftZ 𝒞)
            (Stack.fullSubcategoryAlgebraicStack (weightedQuotientStack.{u, w} 𝒞 k p hU) W hA) ∧
          Stack.AlgebraicStacks.IsGerbeOverScheme 𝒞 𝒵 (Space.contains_specULiftZ 𝒞)
            (Stack.fullSubcategoryAlgebraicStack (weightedQuotientStack.{u, w} 𝒞 k p hU) W hA)) ∧
        ∀ hA, Set.range (Stack.AlgebraicStacks.pointsMap 𝒞 𝒵 (Space.contains_specULiftZ 𝒞)
          (Stack.fullSubcategoryInclusion (weightedQuotientStack.{u, w} 𝒞 k p hU) W hA)) = s) →
      local_Refines (Set.range (stratumPoints.{u, w} 𝒞 k p hU)) Qs →
      Qs = Set.range (stratumPoints.{u, w} 𝒞 k p hU)
declarations.comment: there is no coarser stratification by reduced locally closed gerbes over schemes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exists_gerbe_stratification
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RF, the stratifications (a) and (b).** Let `𝒳` be an algebraic stack over `S`
whose inertia projection `I_𝒳 ⟶ 𝒳` is quasi-compact. Then there are a well-ordered index set
`I` and for every `i ∈ I` a reduced locally closed substack `𝒰ᵢ ⊆ 𝒳` such that

1. each `𝒰ᵢ` is a gerbe,
2. `|𝒳| = ⋃ᵢ |𝒰ᵢ|`,
3. `Tᵢ = |𝒳| \ ⋃_{i' < i} |𝒰ᵢ'|` is closed in `|𝒳|`, and
4. `|𝒰ᵢ|` is open in `Tᵢ`,

and this can be arranged so that (a) `|𝒰ᵢ|` is dense in `Tᵢ` for every `i`, with `𝒰ᵢ` chosen as
large as possible: `|𝒰ᵢ|` is the set of points of `Tᵢ` lying in an open substack, which is a
gerbe, of the reduced closed substack with points `Tᵢ` (`maximalGerbePointSet`); and also so that
(b) every `𝒰ᵢ` is quasi-compact. Here `|𝒰ᵢ|` is the image of the points of `𝒰ᵢ` in `|𝒳|`. The
stratification of case (a) is canonical: `exists_gerbe_stratification_unique`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_gerbe_stratification
    (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS)
    (hqc : IsQuasiCompactMorphism.{u, w} B S hS (inertiaProjectionAlgebraicStacks B S hS 𝒳)) :
    (∃ (I : Type (u + 2)) (_ : LinearOrder I) (_ : WellFoundedLT I)
      (Q : I → ObjectProperty 𝒳.val.val.obj)
      (hQ : ∀ i, IsAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B S hS (fullSubcategoryBased 𝒳 (Q i))),
      (∀ i, IsLocallyClosedSubstack 𝒳 (Q i) ∧
        IsReducedStack B S hS (fullSubcategoryAlgebraicStack 𝒳 (Q i) (hQ i)) ∧
        AlgebraicStacks.IsGerbe B S hS (fullSubcategoryAlgebraicStack 𝒳 (Q i) (hQ i))) ∧
      (⋃ i, Set.range (AlgebraicStacks.pointsMap B S hS
        (fullSubcategoryInclusion 𝒳 (Q i) (hQ i)))) = Set.univ ∧
      (∀ i, @IsClosed _ (pointTopology B S hS 𝒳.val) (Set.univ \ ⋃ (j : I) (_ : j < i),
        Set.range (AlgebraicStacks.pointsMap B S hS (fullSubcategoryInclusion 𝒳 (Q j) (hQ j))))) ∧
      (∀ i, ∃ O, @IsOpen _ (pointTopology B S hS 𝒳.val) O ∧
        Set.range (AlgebraicStacks.pointsMap B S hS (fullSubcategoryInclusion 𝒳 (Q i) (hQ i))) =
          (Set.univ \ ⋃ (j : I) (_ : j < i), Set.range (AlgebraicStacks.pointsMap B S hS
            (fullSubcategoryInclusion 𝒳 (Q j) (hQ j)))) ∩ O) ∧
      (∀ i, (Set.univ \ ⋃ (j : I) (_ : j < i), Set.range (AlgebraicStacks.pointsMap B S hS
          (fullSubcategoryInclusion 𝒳 (Q j) (hQ j)))) ⊆
        @closure _ (pointTopology B S hS 𝒳.val) (Set.range (AlgebraicStacks.pointsMap B S hS
          (fullSubcategoryInclusion 𝒳 (Q i) (hQ i)))) ∧
        Set.range (AlgebraicStacks.pointsMap B S hS (fullSubcategoryInclusion 𝒳 (Q i) (hQ i))) =
          maximalGerbePointSet B S hS 𝒳 (Set.univ \ ⋃ (j : I) (_ : j < i),
            Set.range (AlgebraicStacks.pointsMap B S hS
              (fullSubcategoryInclusion 𝒳 (Q j) (hQ j)))))) ∧
    (∃ (I : Type (u + 2)) (_ : LinearOrder I) (_ : WellFoundedLT I)
      (Q : I → ObjectProperty 𝒳.val.val.obj)
      (hQ : ∀ i, IsAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B S hS (fullSubcategoryBased 𝒳 (Q i))),
      (∀ i, IsLocallyClosedSubstack 𝒳 (Q i) ∧
        IsReducedStack B S hS (fullSubcategoryAlgebraicStack 𝒳 (Q i) (hQ i)) ∧
        AlgebraicStacks.IsGerbe B S hS (fullSubcategoryAlgebraicStack 𝒳 (Q i) (hQ i))) ∧
      (⋃ i, Set.range (AlgebraicStacks.pointsMap B S hS
        (fullSubcategoryInclusion 𝒳 (Q i) (hQ i)))) = Set.univ ∧
      (∀ i, @IsClosed _ (pointTopology B S hS 𝒳.val) (Set.univ \ ⋃ (j : I) (_ : j < i),
        Set.range (AlgebraicStacks.pointsMap B S hS (fullSubcategoryInclusion 𝒳 (Q j) (hQ j))))) ∧
      (∀ i, ∃ O, @IsOpen _ (pointTopology B S hS 𝒳.val) O ∧
        Set.range (AlgebraicStacks.pointsMap B S hS (fullSubcategoryInclusion 𝒳 (Q i) (hQ i))) =
          (Set.univ \ ⋃ (j : I) (_ : j < i), Set.range (AlgebraicStacks.pointsMap B S hS
            (fullSubcategoryInclusion 𝒳 (Q j) (hQ j)))) ∩ O) ∧
      (∀ i, IsQuasiCompactStack.{u, w} B S hS (fullSubcategoryAlgebraicStack 𝒳 (Q i) (hQ i)).val
        (fullSubcategoryAlgebraicStack 𝒳 (Q i) (hQ i)).property))
declarations.comment: existence of the stratification, arranged as in (a), with strata as large as possible, and as in (b)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exists_gerbe_stratification_unique
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RF, the canonical stratification (a).** A stratification of `|𝒳|` as in Stacks
06RF whose strata are chosen as large as possible is unique: if two well-ordered families of
nonempty sets of points `Wᵢ` cover `|𝒳|` and each `Wᵢ` is the largest gerbe
(`maximalGerbePointSet`) in `Tᵢ = |𝒳| \ ⋃_{j < i} Wⱼ`, then the index sets are order-isomorphic
with the same sets.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_gerbe_stratification_unique (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS)
    {I : Type*} [LinearOrder I] [WellFoundedLT I] (W : I → Set (AlgebraicStacks.points B S hS 𝒳))
    (hW : ∀ i, W i = maximalGerbePointSet B S hS 𝒳 (Set.univ \ ⋃ (j : I) (_ : j < i), W j))
    (hWne : ∀ i, (W i).Nonempty) (hWcov : (⋃ i, W i) = Set.univ)
    {I' : Type*} [LinearOrder I'] [WellFoundedLT I']
    (W' : I' → Set (AlgebraicStacks.points B S hS 𝒳))
    (hW' : ∀ i, W' i = maximalGerbePointSet B S hS 𝒳 (Set.univ \ ⋃ (j : I') (_ : j < i), W' j))
    (hW'ne : ∀ i, (W' i).Nonempty) (hW'cov : (⋃ i, W' i) = Set.univ) :
    ∃ e : I ≃o I', ∀ i, W' (e i) = W i
declarations.comment: canonicity of the stratification (a) with strata as large as possible

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.CanonicalGerbeStratificationIndexCountable
declarations.doc:
**The question of Stacks 06RG.** For every algebraic stack `𝒳` over a scheme `S` whose inertia
projection `I_𝒳 ⟶ 𝒳` is quasi-compact (the setting of Stacks 06RF), the well-ordered index set `I`
of the canonical stratification of type (a) (`canonicalGerbeStratificationIndex`) has cardinality
at most `ℵ₀`.

This is the "natural guess" of the remark Stacks 06RG about the order type of the canonical
stratifications. The Stacks project does not know whether it is true or false; it is stated here
as a proposition, and neither it nor its negation is proved. By
`canonicalGerbeStratificationIndexCountable_iff` it says equally that every stratification of type
(a) with strata as large as possible has a countable index set.
declarations.statement: def CanonicalGerbeStratificationIndexCountable : Prop
declarations.comment: the open question of the remark, stated as a proposition; neither it nor its negation is proved

declarations.name: Stacks.Examples.exists_epi_localRing_not_surjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RI.** There is a nonsurjective epimorphism of zero-dimensional local
rings.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_epi_localRing_not_surjective :
    ∃ (A B : Type u) (_ : CommRing A) (_ : CommRing B)
      (_ : IsLocalRing A) (_ : IsLocalRing B) (f : A →+* B),
      ringKrullDim A = 0 ∧
        ringKrullDim B = 0 ∧
        IsLocalHom f ∧
        Epi (CommRingCat.ofHom f) ∧
        ¬ Function.Surjective f

declarations.name: Stacks.Examples.exists_groupScheme_flat_identityComponent_not_flat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06RK.** A group scheme can fail to be flat over its base even when its
identity component is flat over the base.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_groupScheme_flat_identityComponent_not_flat :
    ∃ (S : Scheme.{u}) (G : CategoryTheory.Over S) (hG : GrpObj G),
      letI : GrpObj G := hG
      ¬ Flat G.hom ∧
        ∃ U : G.left.Opens,
          Flat (U.ι ≫ G.hom) ∧
            IsClosed (U : Set G.left) ∧
              Set.range (η[G]).left = (U : Set G.left) ∧
                ∀ s : S,
                  _root_.IsConnected {g : {g : G.left // G.hom g = s} |
                    (g.1 : G.left) ∈ (U : Set G.left)}

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Limits.CategoricalPullback.Quintuple
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RL.** The symmetric model of the 2-fibre product `𝒜 ×_𝒞 ℬ`: an object is a
quintuple `(A, B, C, a, b)` with `A : 𝒜`, `B : ℬ`, `C : 𝒞` and isomorphisms `a : F A ≅ C`,
`b : G B ≅ C`.
declarations.statement: structure Quintuple

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Limits.CategoricalPullback.Quintuple.toCategoricalPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RL.** The comparison functor from the symmetric model to the standard 2-fibre
product: on objects it sends `(A, B, C, a, b)` to `(A, B, a ≪≫ b.symm)`, whose structural
morphism is `b⁻¹ ∘ a`, and on morphisms it sends `(f, g, h)` to `(f, g)`.
declarations.statement: def toCategoricalPullback : Quintuple F G ⥤ CategoricalPullback F G

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Limits.CategoricalPullback.Quintuple.isEquivalence_toCategoricalPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RL.** The comparison functor from the symmetric quintuple model of the 2-fibre
product to the standard model `CategoricalPullback F G` is an equivalence of categories.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquivalence_toCategoricalPullback :
    (toCategoricalPullback (F := F) (G := G)).IsEquivalence

declarations.name: IsIsolatedPoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RM.** A point `x` of a topological space `X` is *isolated* if `{x}` is open in
`X`.
declarations.statement: def IsIsolatedPoint {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (x : X) : Prop

declarations.name: surjective_endomorphism_noetherian_isomorphism
declarations.doc:
The bijective endomorphism above is genuinely a ring isomorphism: there is a
`RingEquiv` `e : R ≃+* R` that agrees with `φ` on every element.
declarations.statement:
theorem surjective_endomorphism_noetherian_isomorphism
    (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (φ : R →+* R)
    (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) : ∃ e : R ≃+* R, ∀ x, e x = φ x

declarations.name: Ideal.trdeg_residueField_lt_trdeg_residueField_of_lt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RP.** Let `k` be a field, let `S` be a finite type `k`-algebra, and let
`𝔮 ⊊ 𝔮'` be prime ideals of `S`. Then the transcendence degree over `k` of the residue field
`κ(𝔮')` is strictly smaller than that of `κ(𝔮)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem Ideal.trdeg_residueField_lt_trdeg_residueField_of_lt
    (k : Type u) [Field k] {S : Type v} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] [Algebra.FiniteType k S]
    {q q' : Ideal S} [q.IsPrime] [q'.IsPrime] (h : q < q') :
    Algebra.trdeg k q'.ResidueField < Algebra.trdeg k q.ResidueField
declarations.comment:
The residue field `κ(𝔮)` is Mathlib's `Ideal.ResidueField`, the fraction field of
`S ⧸ 𝔮`, and the comparison is a strict inequality of `Cardinal`, both degrees being finite. See
the module docstring.

declarations.name: Algebra.Generators.defaultHom_comp_defaultHom
declarations.doc:
**Functoriality of the naive cotangent complex in a square of rings** (Stacks 06RQ): given
two commutative squares of rings side by side,
```
S --φ--> S' --φ'--> S''
↑        ↑          ↑
R -----> R' ------> R''
```
a presentation `P` of `S` over `R`, a presentation `P''` of `S''` over `R''`, and the canonical
presentation `R'[S'] → S'` of the intermediate algebra, the composite of the canonical
comparison morphisms of presentations `P → R'[S']` and `R'[S'] → P''` is the canonical
comparison morphism `P → P''` of the outer square. Hence the canonical maps of naive cotangent
complexes `NL_{S/R} → NL_{S'/R'} → NL_{S''/R''}` compose to the canonical map
`NL_{S/R} → NL_{S''/R''}`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem defaultHom_comp_defaultHom (P : Generators R S ι) (P'' : Generators R'' S'' ι'') :
    (defaultHom (self R' S') P'').comp (defaultHom P (self R' S')) = defaultHom P P''
declarations.comment:
The display is the datum for functoriality of `NL`; what is stated is the
compatibility with composition of the canonical maps it produces, at the level of morphisms of
presentations. See the module docstring.

declarations.name: hensel_uniqueness
declarations.doc:
Hensel uniqueness: in a local ring, two roots of a polynomial that are
congruent modulo the maximal ideal must be equal, provided the formal
derivative at one of them is not in the maximal ideal.
declarations.statement:
theorem hensel_uniqueness {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (f : Polynomial R) (a b : R)
    (hfa : f.eval a = 0) (hfb : f.eval b = 0)
    (hab : a - b ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
    (hf' : (Polynomial.derivative f).eval a ∉ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) :
    a = b

declarations.name: henselianLocalRing_of_krullDimLE_zero
declarations.doc: **Stacks Tag 06RS / Lemma 10.153.10.** A local ring of Krull dimension `0` is henselian.
declarations.statement:
theorem henselianLocalRing_of_krullDimLE_zero (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
  [Ring.KrullDimLE 0 R] :
    HenselianLocalRing R

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.topologicalKrullDimAt_fiber_le_of_specialization
declarations.doc:
Local dimension in a fibre is monotone along a specialization of points with a common
image in the base.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ringKrullDim_fiber_stalk_lt_of_specialization
declarations.doc:
A strict specialization inside a fibre of a locally finite type morphism strictly
increases the dimension of the fibre's local ring.
declarations.statement:
public theorem ringKrullDim_fiber_stalk_lt_of_specialization
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    {x x' : X} (hxx' : x ⤳ x') (hne : x ≠ x')
    {s : S} (hx : f x = s) (hx' : f x' = s) :
    ringKrullDim ((f.fiber s).presheaf.stalk ((f.fiberHomeo s).symm ⟨x, hx⟩)) <
      ringKrullDim ((f.fiber s).presheaf.stalk ((f.fiberHomeo s).symm ⟨x', hx'⟩))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.trdeg_residueField_fiber_lt_of_specialization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RU, part (3).** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be locally of finite type and let `x ⤳ x'` be a
nontrivial specialization of points of `X` lying over the same point `s` of `S`. Then the
transcendence degree of `κ(x)` over `κ(s)` is strictly larger than that of `κ(x')`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem trdeg_residueField_fiber_lt_of_specialization (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] {x x' : X} (hxx' : x ⤳ x') (hne : x ≠ x')
    {s : S} (hx : f x = s) (hx' : f x' = s) :
    letI : Algebra (S.residueField s) (X.residueField x) :=
      ((S.residueFieldCongr hx).inv ≫ f.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra (S.residueField s) (X.residueField x') :=
      ((S.residueFieldCongr hx').inv ≫ f.residueFieldMap x').hom.toAlgebra
    Algebra.trdeg (S.residueField s) (X.residueField x') <
      Algebra.trdeg (S.residueField s) (X.residueField x)
declarations.comment:
part (3): the strict inequality of transcendence degrees
`trdeg_{κ(s)} κ(x) > trdeg_{κ(s)} κ(x')` along a nontrivial specialization `x ⤳ x'` inside a
fibre, for `f` locally of finite type. Each residue field is a `κ(s)`-algebra through
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.residueFieldMap`, and the comparison is between Mathlib's
cardinal-valued `Algebra.trdeg`. Parts (1) and (2) are
`AlgebraicGeometry.topologicalKrullDimAt_fiber_le_of_specialization` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.ringKrullDim_fiber_stalk_lt_of_specialization`.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pointsMap_injective_of_mono
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RV.** A monomorphism induces an injective map on equivalence classes of
field-valued points.
declarations.statement:
theorem pointsMap_injective_of_mono
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (f : F ⟶ G) [Mono f] :
    Function.Injective (pointsMap B S hS F f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyQuasiFinite_iff_forall_discreteTopology_fibre
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RW.** A morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` which is locally of finite type is
locally quasi-finite exactly when, for every field-valued point of its target, the point space
of the fibre over that point is discrete.

For the forward implication the fibre over a field-valued point is locally quasi-finite over
the field spectrum by Stacks 03XL, so its étale charts are discrete schemes; an étale chart is
open and surjective on points, hence the point space of the fibre is discrete.

For the converse a commuting square of étale charts of `f` is compared with the fibre product
of the chart of the target along `f`, and each point of the chart of the target is handled
through its canonical residue-field representative: the fibre of the morphism of the site over
that point is a chart of the corresponding fibre of `f`, which is discrete, so the morphism of
the site has no nontrivial specialization in that fibre and is therefore locally quasi-finite
by [Stacks Project, Tag 01TH].
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyQuasiFinite_iff_forall_discreteTopology_fibre
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hft : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f) :
    IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS f ↔
      ∀ p : FieldValuedPoint B S hS Y,
        DiscreteTopology (points B S hS (pullback (yonedaEquiv.symm p.value) f))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasTranscendenceDegreeAt_comp_iff_of_isLocallyQuasiFinite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RX.** Let `X ⟶ Y ⟶ Z` be morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` with `X ⟶ Y`
locally quasi-finite, and let `x` be a point of `X`. The transcendence degree of `x` over its
image in `Z` is the transcendence degree of the image of `x` in `Y` over that same point: on
compatible étale charts the first morphism becomes a locally quasi-finite morphism of schemes,
which contributes a finite residue-field extension and so no transcendence degree.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasTranscendenceDegreeAt_comp_iff_of_isLocallyQuasiFinite
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y Z : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hf : IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS f) (x : points B S hS X) (r : ℕ∞) :
    HasTranscendenceDegreeAt B S hS (f ≫ g) x r ↔
      HasTranscendenceDegreeAt B S hS g (pointsMap B S hS X f x) r

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.relativelyRepresentable_of_mono_to_coproduct_spec_zeroDimensional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06RZ.** A monomorphism of algebraic spaces over `S` whose target is a disjoint
union of spectra of zero-dimensional local rings is representable; equivalently its source is a
scheme.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativelyRepresentable_of_mono_to_coproduct_spec_zeroDimensional
    {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) (f : F ⟶ G)
    [Mono f] (Y : BigFppfOver B S hS) (eG : G ≅ yoneda.obj Y) (I : Type u)
    (A : I → CommRingCat.{u}) (hlocal : ∀ i, IsLocalRing (A i))
    (hdim : ∀ i, ringKrullDim (A i) = 0)
    (eY : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Y ≅ ∐ fun i : I ↦ Spec (A i)) :
    yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.tfae_isLocallyQuasiFinite_to_field
declarations.statement:
theorem tfae_isLocallyQuasiFinite_to_field {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {K : BigFppfOver B S hS} (e : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj K ≅ Spec (.of k))
    {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (g : X ⟶ yoneda.obj K) :
    [IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS g,
      IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS g ∧ dimension B S hS X hX ≤ 0,
      X.IsRepresentable ∧ IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS g,
      X.IsRepresentable ∧ IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS g ∧ dimension B S hS X hX ≤ 0,
      ∃ (Y : BigFppfOver B S hS) (eX : yoneda.obj Y ≅ X) (I : Type u) (A : I → Type u)
        (_ : ∀ i, CommRing (A i)) (_ : ∀ i, Algebra k (A i)) (_ : ∀ i, IsLocalRing (A i))
        (_ : ∀ i, IsArtinianRing (A i)) (_ : ∀ i, Module.Finite k (A i))
        (eY : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Y ≅ ∐ fun i ↦ Spec (.of (A i))),
        eY.hom ≫ Sigma.desc (fun i ↦ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (A i)))) =
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map (yoneda.preimage (eX.hom ≫ g)) ≫ e.hom].TFAE

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyQuasiFinite_of_mono_of_isLocallyQuasiFinite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06S1.** Let `k` be a field and `f : X ⟶ Y` a monomorphism of algebraic spaces over
`k`. If `Y` is locally quasi-finite over `k`, so is `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyQuasiFinite_of_mono_of_isLocallyQuasiFinite {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (e : S ≅ Spec (.of k)) {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) [Mono f]
    (hYk : IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS ((isTerminal_yoneda_obj_base B S hS).from Y)) :
    IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS ((isTerminal_yoneda_obj_base B S hS).from X)

declarations.name: Deformation.residueImageField_eq_range
declarations.doc:
For a finite map to a field, the subfield generated by its image has
underlying set equal to the image itself.
declarations.statement:
theorem residueImageField_eq_range (Λ : Type u) (k : Type v) [CommRing Λ]
    [IsNoetherianRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k] [Module.Finite Λ k] :
    (residueImageField Λ k : Set k) = Set.range (algebraMap Λ k)

declarations.name: Deformation.finrank_residueImageField_eq_quotient_ker
declarations.doc:
The degrees of `k` over the image field and over the quotient of `Λ` by the kernel of its
structural map agree.
declarations.statement:
theorem finrank_residueImageField_eq_quotient_ker
    (Λ : Type u) (k : Type v) [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    [Field k] [Algebra Λ k] [Module.Finite Λ k] :
    let f : Λ →+* k := algebraMap Λ k
    let e : Λ ⧸ RingHom.ker f ≃+* RingHom.range f :=
      RingHom.quotientKerEquivRange f
    letI : Field f.range := (range_isField Λ k).toField
    letI : Field (Λ ⧸ RingHom.ker f) :=
      ((e.toMulEquiv.isField_congr).mpr (Field.toIsField f.range)).toField
    let q : Λ ⧸ RingHom.ker f →+* k :=
      (Subring.subtype (RingHom.range f)).comp e.toRingHom
    letI : Algebra (Λ ⧸ RingHom.ker f) k := q.toAlgebra
    Module.finrank (residueImageField Λ k) k =
      Module.finrank (Λ ⧸ RingHom.ker f) k

declarations.name: Deformation.residueImageField_finite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06S2.** The extension of `k` over the image field of
a finite ring map is finite.
declarations.statement:
theorem residueImageField_finite
    (Λ : Type u) (k : Type v) [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    [Field k] [Algebra Λ k] [Module.Finite Λ k] :
    Module.Finite (residueImageField Λ k) k

declarations.name: Deformation.ArtinianLocalAlgCat.surjective_hom_iff_surjective_cotangentMap
declarations.doc:
The criterion of [Stacks, Tag 06S3] for surjectivity, read on the conormal modules of the
presentations `residueExt B` and `residueExt A`: a morphism of `𝒞_Λ` is surjective exactly when
the map it induces on `𝔪/𝔪²` is surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem surjective_hom_iff_surjective_cotangentMap (f : B ⟶ A) :
    Function.Surjective f.hom ↔
      Function.Surjective (Algebra.Extension.Cotangent.map (residueExtHom f))
declarations.comment: conditions (1) and (2), on the conormal module of a presentation

declarations.name: Deformation.ArtinianLocalAlgCat.surjective_iff_cotangentSpaceMap_surjective
declarations.doc:
A morphism of Artinian local algebras is surjective exactly when its canonical map
`m_A / m_A² → m_B / m_B²` is surjective.
declarations.statement:
public theorem surjective_iff_cotangentSpaceMap_surjective
    {A B : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    Function.Surjective f.hom ↔
      Function.Surjective
        (Ideal.mapCotangent (maximalIdeal A) (maximalIdeal B) f.hom
          (by
            let _ : IsLocalHom f.hom.toRingHom := f.isLocal
            intro x hx
            change x ∈ (maximalIdeal B).comap f.hom.toRingHom
            simpa only [maximalIdeal_comap] using hx))

declarations.name: Deformation.ArtinianLocalAlgCat.cotangentSpaceMap_surjective_iff_relativeCotangentSpaceMap_surjective
declarations.doc:
Surjectivity on `m / m²` is equivalent to surjectivity after also quotienting by the
extension of the maximal ideal of the base.
declarations.statement:
public theorem cotangentSpaceMap_surjective_iff_relativeCotangentSpaceMap_surjective
    {A B : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    Function.Surjective
        (Ideal.mapCotangent (maximalIdeal A) (maximalIdeal B) f.hom
          (by
            let _ : IsLocalHom f.hom.toRingHom := f.isLocal
            intro x hx
            change x ∈ (maximalIdeal B).comap f.hom.toRingHom
            simpa only [maximalIdeal_comap] using hx)) ↔
      Function.Surjective (relativeCotangentSpaceMap f)

declarations.name: Deformation.ArtinianLocalAlgCat.essentialSurjection_iff_mod_maximalIdeal_sq
declarations.doc: Essential surjectivity is detected modulo the maximal-ideal squares.
declarations.statement:
theorem essentialSurjection_iff_mod_maximalIdeal_sq
    {B A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k} (f : B ⟶ A) :
    let IB := maximalIdeal B ^ 2
    let IA := maximalIdeal A ^ 2
    let hB : IB ≤ maximalIdeal B := Ideal.pow_le_self (by omega : 2 ≠ 0)
    let hA : IA ≤ maximalIdeal A := Ideal.pow_le_self (by omega : 2 ≠ 0)
    let hmap : IB ≤ IA.comap f.hom := by
      let _ : IsLocalHom f.hom.toRingHom := f.isLocal
      rw [← Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, Ideal.map_pow]
      exact Ideal.pow_right_mono (map_maximalIdeal_le f.hom.toRingHom) _
    IsEssentialSurjection f ↔
    IsEssentialSurjection (idealQuotientMap f IB IA hB hA hmap)

declarations.name: Deformation.ArtinianLocalAlgCat.essentialSurjection_iff_mod_relative_maximalIdeal_sq
declarations.doc: Essential surjectivity is detected on the relative cotangent quotient.
declarations.statement:
theorem essentialSurjection_iff_mod_relative_maximalIdeal_sq
    {B A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k} (f : B ⟶ A) :
    IsEssentialSurjection f ↔
      IsEssentialSurjection
        (idealQuotientMap f
          ((RingHom.ker (algebraMap Λ k)).map (algebraMap Λ B) + maximalIdeal B ^ 2)
          ((RingHom.ker (algebraMap Λ k)).map (algebraMap Λ A) + maximalIdeal A ^ 2)
          (relativeCotangentIdeal_le_maximalIdeal B)
          (relativeCotangentIdeal_le_maximalIdeal A)
          (relativeCotangentIdeal_le_comap f))

declarations.name: Deformation.exact_cotangentSequence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06S7.** Let `Λ` be a ring, `k` a field and `A` a `Λ`-algebra with a `Λ`-algebra
surjection `A → k` with kernel `𝔪_A`. Then the four-term sequence

    H₁(L_{k/Λ}) ⟶ 𝔪_A/𝔪_A² ⟶ Ω_{A/Λ} ⊗_A k ⟶ Ω_{k/Λ} ⟶ 0

is exact: exact at `𝔪_A/𝔪_A²`, exact at `Ω_{A/Λ} ⊗_A k`, and surjective onto `Ω_{k/Λ}`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exact_cotangentSequence (h : Function.Surjective (algebraMap A k)) :
    Function.Exact (h1CotangentToCotangent Λ h)
        (KaehlerDifferential.kerCotangentToTensor Λ A k) ∧
      Function.Exact (KaehlerDifferential.kerCotangentToTensor Λ A k)
        (KaehlerDifferential.mapBaseChange Λ A k) ∧
      Function.Surjective (KaehlerDifferential.mapBaseChange Λ A k)

declarations.name: Deformation.cotangentMap_comp_h1CotangentToConormal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06S8**, left square. The two arrows out of `H₁(L_{k/Λ})` agree: pushing a class
into `𝔪_B/𝔪_B²` and then along `B → A` gives its image in `𝔪_A/𝔪_A²`.

The source leaves this horizontal arrow unlabelled. It is realized here as
`Deformation.h1CotangentToConormal`, the canonical map through the universal presentation of `k`
over `Λ`. The square for the other realization of that arrow, the one used in the four-term exact
sequence of [Stacks, Tag 06S7], is `Deformation.mapCotangent_h1CotangentToCotangent`; the two
realizations are not compared to each other, which is why the scope label names this one.
declarations.statement:
public theorem cotangentMap_comp_h1CotangentToConormal :
    Algebra.Extension.Cotangent.map (residueExtensionHom (Λ := Λ) hB hA) ∘ₗ
        h1CotangentToConormal (residueExtension Λ hB) =
      h1CotangentToConormal (residueExtension Λ hA)
declarations.comment: left square, for the canonical map through the universal presentation

declarations.name: Deformation.cotangentSpaceMap_comp_cotangentComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06S8**, middle square. The differentials `d_B : 𝔪_B/𝔪_B² → k ⊗_B Ω_{B/Λ}` and
`d_A : 𝔪_A/𝔪_A² → k ⊗_A Ω_{A/Λ}` are compatible with the maps induced by `B → A`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem cotangentSpaceMap_comp_cotangentComplex :
    Algebra.Extension.CotangentSpace.map (residueExtensionHom (Λ := Λ) hB hA) ∘ₗ
        (residueExtension Λ hB).cotangentComplex =
      (residueExtension Λ hA).cotangentComplex ∘ₗ
        Algebra.Extension.Cotangent.map (residueExtensionHom (Λ := Λ) hB hA)

declarations.name: Deformation.toKaehler_comp_cotangentSpaceMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06S8**, right square. The two arrows into `Ω_{k/Λ}` agree: the projection of
`k ⊗_B Ω_{B/Λ}` onto `Ω_{k/Λ}` factors through `k ⊗_A Ω_{A/Λ}` along `B → A`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem toKaehler_comp_cotangentSpaceMap :
    (residueExtension Λ hA).toKaehler ∘ₗ
        Algebra.Extension.CotangentSpace.map (residueExtensionHom (Λ := Λ) hB hA) =
      (residueExtension Λ hB).toKaehler

declarations.name: Deformation.mapCotangent_h1CotangentToCotangent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06S8**, left square, for the arrow `H₁(L_{k/Λ}) → 𝔪/𝔪²` of the four-term exact
sequence of [Stacks, Tag 06S7]: pushing a class of `H₁(L_{k/Λ})` into `𝔪_B/𝔪_B²` and then
along `𝔪_B → 𝔪_A` gives its image in `𝔪_A/𝔪_A²`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem mapCotangent_h1CotangentToCotangent (x : Algebra.H1Cotangent Λ k) :
    Ideal.mapCotangent (RingHom.ker (algebraMap B k)) (RingHom.ker (algebraMap A k))
        (Algebra.ofId B A)
        (ker_algebraMap_le_comap_ker (Λ := B) (S := k) (k := k) (A := A))
        (h1CotangentToCotangent Λ hB x) =
      h1CotangentToCotangent Λ hA x
declarations.comment: left square, for the arrow of the four-term sequence of 06S7

declarations.name: Deformation.conormalToH1Cotangent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06S9.** The canonical map `𝔪_Λ/𝔪_Λ² → H₁(L_{k/Λ})`, for `k'` the subfield of `k`
generated by the image of `Λ`, presented as a field `S` with `Λ → S` surjective and `S → k` an
extension: the conormal module of `Λ → S` maps to `H₁(L_{S/Λ})` and then to `H₁(L_{k/Λ})`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def conormalToH1Cotangent
    (h : Function.Surjective (algebraMap Λ S)) :
    (RingHom.ker (algebraMap Λ S)).Cotangent →ₗ[Λ] Algebra.H1Cotangent Λ k

declarations.name: Deformation.conormalToH1Cotangent_baseChange_bijective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06S9.** When `k` is separable over the image field `S = k'`, the canonical map
induces an isomorphism `𝔪_Λ/𝔪_Λ² ⊗_{k'} k = H₁(L_{k/Λ})`. The base change is written over `Λ`,
which is the same thing: the conormal module of `Λ → S` is annihilated by its kernel, hence is
a module over `Λ/𝔪_Λ = k'`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem conormalToH1Cotangent_baseChange_bijective
    (h : Function.Surjective (algebraMap Λ S))
    [Algebra.IsSeparable S k] :
    Function.Bijective
      ((conormalToH1Cotangent (Λ := Λ) (S := S) (k := k) h).liftBaseChange k)

declarations.name: Deformation.conormalToH1Cotangent_bijective_of_surjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06S9.** In the classical case `k = k'`, that is `Λ → k` surjective, the canonical
map `𝔪_Λ/𝔪_Λ² → H₁(L_{k/Λ})` is itself an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem conormalToH1Cotangent_bijective_of_surjective
    (h : Function.Surjective (algebraMap Λ k)) :
    Function.Bijective
      (conormalToH1Cotangent (Λ := Λ) (S := k) (k := k) h)

declarations.name: Deformation.conormalToH1Cotangent_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06S9.** The composite `𝔪_Λ/𝔪_Λ² → H₁(L_{k/Λ}) → H₁(L_{k/A})` is the map induced
by the structural map `𝔪_Λ → 𝔪_A`: for `A` with `Λ → A → k` and `A → k` surjective, pushing a
class of `𝔪_Λ/𝔪_Λ²` forward to `H₁(L_{k/A})` agrees with taking its image in `𝔪_A/𝔪_A²` and
applying the canonical map of `A → k`. Since the canonical map of `A → k` is an isomorphism by
`conormalToH1Cotangent_bijective_of_surjective`, this identifies the composite
`𝔪_Λ/𝔪_Λ² → H₁(L_{k/Λ}) → 𝔪_A/𝔪_A²` of the source.
declarations.statement:
public theorem conormalToH1Cotangent_comp
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [Algebra Λ A] [Algebra A k]
    [IsScalarTower Λ A k]
    (h : Function.Surjective (algebraMap Λ S))
    (hg : Function.Surjective (algebraMap A k))
    (x : (RingHom.ker (algebraMap Λ S)).Cotangent) :
    Algebra.H1Cotangent.map Λ A k k
        (conormalToH1Cotangent (Λ := Λ) (S := S) (k := k) h x) =
      conormalToH1Cotangent (Λ := A) (S := k) (k := k) hg
        (Ideal.mapCotangent (RingHom.ker (algebraMap Λ S))
          (RingHom.ker (algebraMap A k)) (Algebra.ofId Λ A)
          (ker_algebraMap_le_comap_ker (Λ := Λ) (S := S) (k := k) (A := A)) x)

declarations.name: Deformation.CompleteLocalAlgCat.hasPushouts
declarations.doc:
The category of Noetherian complete local `Λ`-algebras with residue field identified
with `k` admits pushouts.
declarations.statement:
public instance hasPushouts :
    HasPushouts (CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)

declarations.name: Deformation.derivation_module_finite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06SC.** The `k`-vector space of `Λ`-derivations from a
Noetherian local `Λ`-algebra with residue field `k` to `k` is finite-dimensional.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivation_module_finite
    {Λ : Type u} {S : Type v} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [CommRing S]
    [IsLocalRing S] [IsNoetherianRing S] [Field k] [Algebra Λ S] [Algebra Λ k]
    [Module.Finite Λ k] (e : ResidueField S ≃ₐ[Λ] k) :
    letI : Algebra S k :=
      (e.toAlgHom.comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom Λ S (ResidueField S))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    Module.Finite k (Derivation Λ S k)

declarations.name: Deformation.surjective_of_residueDerivation_comap_injective
declarations.doc:
A morphism of Noetherian complete local algebras with fixed residue field is
surjective if restriction of residue-field-valued derivations along it is injective.
declarations.statement:
public theorem surjective_of_residueDerivation_comap_injective
    {R S : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k} (f : R ⟶ S)
    (h : Function.Injective (ResidueDerivation.comap f)) :
    Function.Surjective f.hom

declarations.name: Deformation.quotient_filtration_isAdic
declarations.doc:
Let `A` be a Noetherian complete local algebra and let `J n` be a decreasing sequence of
ideals containing the `n`-th power of the maximal ideal.  In the quotient by `⋂ n, J n`, the
images of the `J n` form an adic filtration for the image of the maximal ideal.
declarations.statement:
theorem quotient_filtration_isAdic
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    (A : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k) (J : ℕ → Ideal A)
    (hJ : Antitone J) (hpow : ∀ n, maximalIdeal A ^ n ≤ J n) :
    Ideal.IsAdicFiltration
      (Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (⨅ n, J n)) (maximalIdeal A))
      (fun n ↦ Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (⨅ n, J n)) (J n))

declarations.name: Deformation.inverseLimit_isObjectOfCompleteLocalAlgCat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06SF (first assertion).** If the transition maps in a tower of
Artinian local `Λ`-algebras are surjective and the dimensions of the cotangent spaces are
bounded, then its inverse limit is a Noetherian complete local algebra whose residue field is
the specified field `k`.
declarations.statement:
theorem inverseLimit_isObjectOfCompleteLocalAlgCat
    (A : ℕ → ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (f : ∀ n, A (n + 1) ⟶ A n)
    (hsurj : ∀ n, Function.Surjective (f n).hom)
    (hbounded : ∃ d : ℕ,
      ∀ n, Module.finrank (ResidueField (A n)) (CotangentSpace (A n)) ≤ d) :
    ∃ h : IsNoetherianCompleteLocalRing (inverseLimit A f),
      letI : IsLocalRing (inverseLimit A f) := h.isLocal
      Nonempty (ResidueField (inverseLimit A f) ≃ₐ[Λ] k)

declarations.name: Deformation.kernel_projections_define_maximalIdeal_adicTopology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06SF (second assertion).** Under the same hypotheses, the kernels of
the projections from the inverse limit are cofinal with the powers of its maximal ideal, and
hence define its maximal-ideal-adic topology.
declarations.statement:
theorem kernel_projections_define_maximalIdeal_adicTopology
    (A : ℕ → ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (f : ∀ n, A (n + 1) ⟶ A n)
    (hsurj : ∀ n, Function.Surjective (f n).hom)
    (h : IsNoetherianCompleteLocalRing (inverseLimit A f)) :
    letI : IsLocalRing (inverseLimit A f) := h.isLocal
    Ideal.IsAdicFiltration (maximalIdeal (inverseLimit A f))
      (fun n ↦ RingHom.ker (inverseLimitProj A f n))
declarations.comment: projection kernels define the adic topology

declarations.name: Deformation.mvPowerSeries_bijective_of_eventually_quotient_retract
declarations.doc:
Suppose `R` is the additive direct sum of the image of `R'` and an ideal `I`, and
`x : Fin r → I` is a basis of `I / 𝔪_R I`.  The power-series map which sends `X i` to
`x i` is bijective if, in all sufficiently high degrees, its maps modulo powers of the
maximal ideals have local `Λ`-algebra retractions.
declarations.statement:
public theorem mvPowerSeries_bijective_of_eventually_quotient_retract
    {R' R : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k} (f : R' ⟶ R) (I : Ideal R)
    (hdecomp : ∀ z : R, ∃! p : R' × I, z = f.hom p.1 + p.2.1)
    {r : ℕ} (x : Fin r → I)
    (hspan : ∀ y : I, ∃ a : Fin r → R,
      y.1 - ∑ i, a i * (x i).1 ∈ maximalIdeal R * I)
    (hindep : ∀ a : Fin r → R,
      (∑ i, a i * (x i).1 ∈ maximalIdeal R * I) →
        ∀ i, a i ∈ maximalIdeal R)
    (F : MvPowerSeries (Fin r) R' →+* R)
    (hF_C : ∀ a : R', F (MvPowerSeries.C a) = f.hom a)
    (hF_X : ∀ i, F (MvPowerSeries.X i) = (x i).1)
    (hretract : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n →
      Ideal.map F (maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin r) R') ^ n) ≤
          maximalIdeal R ^ n ∧
        ∃ h : (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R ^ n) →+*
            (MvPowerSeries (Fin r) R' ⧸ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin r) R') ^ n),
          IsLocalHom h ∧
          (∀ s : MvPowerSeries (Fin r) R',
            h (Ideal.Quotient.mk (maximalIdeal R ^ n) (F s)) =
              Ideal.Quotient.mk (maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin r) R') ^ n) s) ∧
      (∀ a : Λ,
            h (Ideal.Quotient.mk (maximalIdeal R ^ n) (algebraMap Λ R a)) =
              Ideal.Quotient.mk (maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin r) R') ^ n)
                (MvPowerSeries.C (algebraMap Λ R' a)))) :
    Function.Bijective F

declarations.name: Deformation.restrictionCompletionEquivalence
declarations.doc:
Restricting the category of formal objects of a category cofibered in groupoids back
to Artinian local algebras gives a canonical equivalence with the original category.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def restrictionCompletionEquivalence
    {F : Type uF} [Category.{vF} F]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p) : RestrictionCompletionEquivalence p

declarations.name: Deformation.representableMorphismFormalObjectEquivalence
declarations.doc:
Morphisms from the restriction of the functor represented by `R` to a category
cofibered in groupoids are canonically equivalent to formal objects over `R`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def representableMorphismFormalObjectEquivalence
    {F : Type uF} [Category.{vF} F]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (R : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k) :
    RepresentableMorphismFormalObjectEquivalence p R

declarations.name: Deformation.associatedMorphism_map
declarations.doc:
A morphism of formal objects gives the canonical 2-cell between the
associated morphisms of restricted representable categories. Its component
at an Artinian point is characterized by the square with the corresponding
level map of formal objects.
declarations.statement:
public theorem associatedMorphism_map
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    {ξ η : FormalObject p} (a : ξ ⟶ η)
    (pushforwards : ChosenPushforwards p) :
    let f := restrictedRepresentableMap a.base
    let X := associatedMorphism hp ξ pushforwards
    let Y := associatedMorphism hp η pushforwards
    ∃ τ : BasedFunctor.comp f X.toBasedFunctor ≅ Y.toBasedFunctor,
      ∀ α, ∃ h : X.level (f.obj α) = Y.level α,
        X.pointInclusion (f.obj α) ≫ τ.hom.app α =
          a.app (X.level (f.obj α)) ≫
            eqToHom (congrArg η.level h) ≫ Y.pointInclusion α

declarations.name: Deformation.associatedMorphism_map_unique
declarations.doc:
The commuting square with the level map determines the canonical
Yoneda 2-cell uniquely.
declarations.statement:
public theorem associatedMorphism_map_unique
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    {ξ η : FormalObject p} (a : ξ ⟶ η)
    (pushforwards : ChosenPushforwards p) :
    let f := restrictedRepresentableMap a.base
    let X := associatedMorphism hp ξ pushforwards
    let Y := associatedMorphism hp η pushforwards
    ∀ (τ σ : BasedFunctor.comp f X.toBasedFunctor ≅ Y.toBasedFunctor),
      (∀ α, ∃ h : X.level (f.obj α) = Y.level α,
        X.pointInclusion (f.obj α) ≫ τ.hom.app α =
          a.app (X.level (f.obj α)) ≫
            eqToHom (congrArg η.level h) ≫ Y.pointInclusion α) →
      (∀ α, ∃ h : X.level (f.obj α) = Y.level α,
        X.pointInclusion (f.obj α) ≫ σ.hom.app α =
          a.app (X.level (f.obj α)) ≫
            eqToHom (congrArg η.level h) ≫ Y.pointInclusion α) →
      τ = σ

declarations.name: Deformation.smoothModel
declarations.doc: A complete local algebra realizing the smooth deformation base.
declarations.statement: public noncomputable def smoothModel : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, max u w, w} Λ k

declarations.name: Deformation.smoothModel_formallySmooth
declarations.doc:
The chosen complete local algebra is formally smooth over `Λ` for the maximal-ideal-adic
topology.

declarations.name: Deformation.smoothModel_h1Cotangent_bijective
declarations.doc:
For the chosen complete local algebra `R`, the canonical map
`H₁(L_{k/Λ}) → H₁(L_{k/R})` is bijective. Since `R → k` is surjective the target is
canonically the conormal module `𝔪_R/𝔪_R²`, so this is the conormal description of
`H₁(L_{k/Λ})`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem smoothModel_h1Cotangent_bijective :
    let R := smoothModel (Λ := Λ) (k := k)
    letI : Algebra R k := (smoothModelResidue (Λ := Λ) (k := k)).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower Λ R k :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
        (smoothModelResidue (Λ := Λ) (k := k)).comp_algebraMap.symm
    Function.Bijective (Algebra.H1Cotangent.map Λ R k k)

declarations.name: Deformation.smoothModel_mapBaseChange_bijective
declarations.doc:
For the chosen complete local algebra `R`, the canonical base-change map
`k ⊗_R Ω[R⁄Λ] → Ω[k⁄Λ]` is bijective.
declarations.statement:
public theorem smoothModel_mapBaseChange_bijective :
    let R := smoothModel (Λ := Λ) (k := k)
    letI : Algebra R k := (smoothModelResidue (Λ := Λ) (k := k)).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower Λ R k :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
        (smoothModelResidue (Λ := Λ) (k := k)).comp_algebraMap.symm
    Function.Bijective (KaehlerDifferential.mapBaseChange Λ R k)

declarations.name: Deformation.squareComparisonFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06SP.** For a pullback square of Artinian local
`Λ`-algebras with `f₂` surjective, choices of pushforwards in a category
cofibered in groupoids determine the canonical comparison functor
`F(P) ⟶ F(A₁) ×_{F(A)} F(A₂)`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def squareComparisonFunctor
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (_hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    {P A₁ A₂ A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k}
    (p₁ : P ⟶ A₁) (p₂ : P ⟶ A₂) (f₁ : A₁ ⟶ A) (f₂ : A₂ ⟶ A)
    (hP : IsPullback p₁ p₂ f₁ f₂) (_hf₂ : Function.Surjective f₂.hom)
    (P₁ : PushforwardChoice p p₁) (P₂ : PushforwardChoice p p₂)
    (F₁ : PushforwardChoice p f₁) (F₂ : PushforwardChoice p f₂)
    (Qp₁ : PushforwardFunctor P₁) (Qp₂ : PushforwardFunctor P₂)
    (Qf₁ : PushforwardFunctor F₁) (Qf₂ : PushforwardFunctor F₂) :
    SquareComparisonFunctor p p₁ p₂ f₁ f₂ P₁ P₂ F₁ F₂ Qp₁ Qp₂ Qf₁ Qf₂

declarations.name: Deformation.schlessingerConditionS1_objectsOverFunctor
declarations.doc: Condition (S1) passes to the category of objects over a fixed object.
declarations.statement:
public theorem schlessingerConditionS1_objectsOverFunctor
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k) (x : F)
    (hS1 : SchlessingerConditionS1 p) :
    SchlessingerConditionS1
      (objectsOverFunctor p x)

declarations.name: Deformation.schlessingerConditionS2_objectsOverFunctor
declarations.doc: Condition (S2) passes to the category of objects over a fixed object.
declarations.statement:
public theorem schlessingerConditionS2_objectsOverFunctor
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k) (x : F)
    (hS2 : SchlessingerConditionS2 p) :
    SchlessingerConditionS2
      (objectsOverFunctor p x)

declarations.name: Deformation.schlessingerConditionS2_isomorphismClasses_objectsOverFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06SQ.** Schlessinger's condition (S2) passes from a category
cofibered in groupoids to the associated functor of isomorphism classes of its slice
predeformation category at a point over the residue field.
declarations.statement:
theorem schlessingerConditionS2_isomorphismClasses_objectsOverFunctor
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k)
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (hS2 : SchlessingerConditionS2 p)

    SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses
        (BasedCategory.ofFunctor (objectsOverFunctor p x.1))
        (isPredeformationCategory_objectsOverFunctor p hp x).cofibered))
declarations.comment: condition (S2) for the associated functor of a slice

declarations.name: Deformation.artinianTangentSpace
declarations.doc: The tangent space of a functor on `𝒞_Λ`, through its canonical augmented-algebra model.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev artinianTangentSpace
    (F : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{s, u, u} Λ k ⥤ Type w) : Type w
declarations.comment: Definition 06IB applied to the category of augmented Artinian local algebras

declarations.name: Deformation.artinianTangentSpace_eq
declarations.doc: Evaluation on the Artinian square-zero object agrees with the Over-model tangent space.
declarations.statement:
theorem artinianTangentSpace_eq
    (F : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{s, u, u} Λ k ⥤ Type w) :
    artinianTangentSpace Λ k F =
      F.obj ((artinianSquareZeroExtensionFunctor Λ k).obj (FGModuleCat.of k k))
declarations.comment: Definition 06IB applied to the category of augmented Artinian local algebras

declarations.name: Deformation.existsUnique_derivationRelativeCotangentDualEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06SS.** For a base `Λ` whose residue field `k₀` has `k` separable over it, the
`Λ`-derivations from an object `S` of `\widehat{𝒞_Λ}` to `k` are the `k`-linear dual of the
relative cotangent space of `S` over `Λ`, by the unique `k`-linear equivalence that restricts
a derivation to the maximal ideal of `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_derivationRelativeCotangentDualEquiv
    {k₀ : Type*} [Field k₀] [Algebra Λ k₀] [Algebra k₀ k] [IsScalarTower Λ k₀ k]
    [IsLocalRing Λ] [Algebra.IsSeparable k₀ k]
    (hbase : Function.Surjective (algebraMap Λ k₀))
    (S : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k) :
    ∃ hlocal : IsLocalHom (algebraMap Λ S),
      letI := hlocal
      letI : Module k (relativeCotangentSpace (algebraMap Λ S)) :=
        Module.compHom _ S.residueEquiv.symm.toRingHom
      letI : Algebra S k := (residueHom S).toRingHom.toAlgebra
      ∃! e : Derivation Λ S k ≃ₗ[k]
          (relativeCotangentSpace (algebraMap Λ S) →ₗ[k] k),
        ∀ (D : Derivation Λ S k) (x : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S),
          e D (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = D (x : S)
declarations.comment: derivations are the dual of the relative cotangent space

declarations.name: Deformation.existsUnique_tangentSpaceRelativeCotangentDualEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06SS.** The tangent space of the functor prorepresented by `S` is the relative
tangent space of `S` over `Λ`, that is the `k`-linear dual of the relative cotangent space.
The equivalence is characterized by taking the coefficient of the square-zero coordinate of
the image of an element of the maximal ideal, and is unique with that property.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_tangentSpaceRelativeCotangentDualEquiv
    {k₀ : Type*} [Field k₀] [Algebra Λ k₀] [Algebra k₀ k] [IsScalarTower Λ k₀ k]
    [IsLocalRing Λ] [Algebra.IsSeparable k₀ k]
    (hbase : Function.Surjective (algebraMap Λ k₀))
    (S : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k) :
    ∃ hlocal : IsLocalHom (algebraMap Λ S),
      letI := hlocal
      letI : Module k (relativeCotangentSpace (algebraMap Λ S)) :=
        Module.compHom _ S.residueEquiv.symm.toRingHom
      ∃! e : tangentSpaceArtinian Λ k (restrictedCoyoneda S) ≃ₗ[k]
          (relativeCotangentSpace (algebraMap Λ S) →ₗ[k] k),
        ∀ (t : tangentSpaceArtinian Λ k (restrictedCoyoneda S))
          (x : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S),
          e t (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = (t.hom (x : S)).snd.down
declarations.comment: the tangent space is the relative tangent space

declarations.name: Deformation.existsUnique_tangentSpaceRelativeCotangentDualEquiv_of_isClassical
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06SS.** The classical case: when `Λ` is a Noetherian complete local ring with
residue field `k`, the tangent space of the functor prorepresented by `S` is the `k`-linear
dual of the relative cotangent space of `S` over `Λ`. Separability is automatic here, the
residue extension being trivial.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_tangentSpaceRelativeCotangentDualEquiv_of_isClassical
    (hΛ : IsClassical Λ k) (S : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k) :
    letI : IsLocalRing Λ := (Classical.choose hΛ).isLocal
    ∃ hlocal : IsLocalHom (algebraMap Λ S),
      letI := hlocal
      letI : Module k (relativeCotangentSpace (algebraMap Λ S)) :=
        Module.compHom _ S.residueEquiv.symm.toRingHom
      ∃! e : tangentSpaceArtinian Λ k (restrictedCoyoneda S) ≃ₗ[k]
          (relativeCotangentSpace (algebraMap Λ S) →ₗ[k] k),
        ∀ (t : tangentSpaceArtinian Λ k (restrictedCoyoneda S))
          (x : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S),
          e t (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = (t.hom (x : S)).snd.down

declarations.name: Deformation.tangentSpaceMap
declarations.doc:
The `k`-linear map on tangent spaces induced contravariantly by a morphism `f : R ⟶ S` of
complete local `Λ`-algebras, written on derivation spaces: it sends a `Λ`-derivation `S → k` to
its restriction along `f`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def tangentSpaceMap
    {R S : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k} (f : R ⟶ S) :
    letI : Algebra S k := (residueHom S).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra R k := (residueHom R).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    Derivation Λ S k →ₗ[k] Derivation Λ R k

declarations.name: Deformation.tangentSpaceMap_apply
declarations.doc:
Under the canonical identification of the tangent space with a space of derivations, the
induced tangent map is precomposition with the morphism of representing algebras.
declarations.statement:
theorem tangentSpaceMap_apply
    {R S : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k} (f : R ⟶ S)
    (d : letI : Algebra S k := (residueHom S).toRingHom.toAlgebra
      Derivation Λ S k) (r : R) :
    tangentSpaceMap f d r = d (f.hom r)

declarations.name: Deformation.tangentSpaceMapArtinian
declarations.doc:
The induced map on the tangent spaces themselves, the values of the two restricted
representable functors at the dual numbers: `tangentSpaceMap` transported along the canonical
identification with derivation spaces.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def tangentSpaceMapArtinian
    {R S : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k} (f : R ⟶ S) :
    tangentSpaceArtinian Λ k (restrictedCoyoneda S) →ₗ[k]
      tangentSpaceArtinian Λ k (restrictedCoyoneda R)
declarations.comment: linear tangent map on Artinian tangent spaces

declarations.name: Deformation.tangentSpaceMapArtinian_apply
declarations.doc:
On a tangent vector, that is on a `k[ε]`-point of the functor represented by `S`, the
induced tangent map is precomposition with the morphism of representing algebras.
declarations.statement:
theorem tangentSpaceMapArtinian_apply
    {R S : CompleteLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k} (f : R ⟶ S)
    (x : tangentSpaceArtinian Λ k (restrictedCoyoneda S)) :
    tangentSpaceMapArtinian f x = f ≫ x

registrations.name: Deformation.restrictedCoyonedaMap
registrations.comment: the transformation of functors induced by a map of representing algebras

registrations.name: Deformation.squareZeroPointsDerivationsEquiv_precomp
registrations.comment: naturality of the square-zero-point description of the tangent space

registrations.name: Deformation.tangentSpaceDerivationsLinearEquiv_precomp
