declarations.name: Deformation.action_eq_add_gamma
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06SU.** The derivation action on deformations over `k[V]` is
translation by the image of the derivation under the canonical derivation map.
declarations.statement:
theorem action_eq_add_gamma
    (𝓕 : BasedCategory.{v₁, u₁} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, w, w} Λ k))
    (h𝓕 : IsPredeformationCategory 𝓕.p)
    (hS2 : SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.cofibered)))
    (V : FGModuleCat.{w} k)
    (A₀ : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, w, w} Λ k)
    (i₀ : A₀ ≃ₐ[Λ] k)
    (hi₀ : ∀ a : A₀, A₀.residueEquiv (IsLocalRing.residue A₀ a) = i₀ a)
    (x₀ : 𝓕.obj) (hx₀ : 𝓕.p.obj x₀ = A₀)
    (hiV : ∀ a : (squareZeroExtensionArtinian.{u, w, w} Λ k).obj V,
      ((squareZeroExtensionArtinian.{u, w, w} Λ k).obj V).residueEquiv
        (IsLocalRing.residue ((squareZeroExtensionArtinian.{u, w, w} Λ k).obj V) a) =
          (TrivSqZeroExt.fstHom Λ k V) (squareZeroCoordinates.{u, w, w} V a))
    (a : DerivationMapAndAction 𝓕.p A₀
      ((squareZeroExtensionArtinian.{u, w, w} Λ k).obj V) i₀
      (squareZeroCoordinates.{u, w, w} V) hi₀ hiV x₀ hx₀)
    (D : Derivation Λ k V)
    (x : Skeleton (𝓕.p.Fiber ((squareZeroExtensionArtinian.{u, w, w} Λ k).obj V))) :
    let L := associatedTangentSpaceModuleStructureUnlifted 𝓕 h𝓕 hS2
    let e : Skeleton (𝓕.p.Fiber ((squareZeroExtensionArtinian.{u, w, w} Λ k).obj V)) ≃
        ((L.functor.obj V : ModuleCat.{u₁} k) : Type u₁) :=
      Equiv.cast (by
        calc
          Skeleton (𝓕.p.Fiber ((squareZeroExtensionArtinian.{u, w, w} Λ k).obj V)) =
              (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.cofibered).obj
                ((squareZeroExtensionArtinian.{u, w, w} Λ k).obj V) :=
            (isomorphismClasses_obj 𝓕 h𝓕.cofibered _).symm
          _ = ((L.functor.obj V : ModuleCat.{u₁} k) : Type u₁) :=
            (congrArg (fun H : FGModuleCat.{w} k ⥤ Type u₁ => H.obj V) L.forget_comp).symm)
    e (a.action D x) = e x + e (a.gamma D)

declarations.name: Deformation.derivationMap_linear
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06SU.** The map `γ_V` defined by pushforward along derivations is
linear for the canonical vector-space structure on the associated functor.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivationMap_linear
    (hS2 : SchlessingerConditionS2
      (CategoryOfElements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.cofibered)))
    (V : FGModuleCat.{w} k)
    (hiV : ∀ a : (squareZeroExtensionArtinian.{u, w, w} Λ k).obj V,
      ((squareZeroExtensionArtinian.{u, w, w} Λ k).obj V).residueEquiv
        (IsLocalRing.residue ((squareZeroExtensionArtinian.{u, w, w} Λ k).obj V) a) =
          (TrivSqZeroExt.fstHom Λ k V) (squareZeroCoordinates.{u, w, w} V a))
    (d : DerivationMapAndAction 𝓕.p A₀
      ((squareZeroExtensionArtinian.{u, w, w} Λ k).obj V) i₀
      (squareZeroCoordinates.{u, w, w} V) hi₀ hiV x₀ hx₀) :
    let L := (associatedTangentSpaceModuleStructureUnlifted 𝓕 h𝓕 hS2).functor
    let AV := (squareZeroExtensionArtinian.{u, w, w} Λ k).obj V
    let hcarrier : ((L.obj V : ModuleCat.{u₁} k) : Type u₁) =
        (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 h𝓕.cofibered).obj AV :=
      congrArg (fun H : FGModuleCat.{w} k ⥤ Type u₁ ↦ H.obj V)
        (associatedTangentSpaceModuleStructureUnlifted 𝓕 h𝓕 hS2).forget_comp
    ∃ γ : Derivation Λ k V →ₗ[k] ((L.obj V : ModuleCat.{u₁} k) : Type u₁),
      ∀ D : Derivation Λ k V,
        γ D = cast hcarrier.symm
          (cast (isomorphismClasses_obj 𝓕 h𝓕.cofibered AV).symm (d.gamma D))

declarations.name: Deformation.derivationToTangentSpace
declarations.doc: The canonical map `Der_Λ(k,k) → T𝓕`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def derivationToTangentSpace :
    Derivation Λ k k → tangentSpaceArtinian Λ k
      (isomorphismClasses (BasedCategory.ofFunctor p) hp.cofibered)

declarations.name: Deformation.derivationToTangentSpace_naturality
declarations.doc:
A morphism of predeformation categories commutes with the derivation maps on
tangent spaces.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivationToTangentSpace_naturality
    {G : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} G]
    (q : G ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k)
    (hq : IsPredeformationCategory q)
    (φ : BasedFunctor (BasedCategory.ofFunctor p) (BasedCategory.ofFunctor q))
    (D : Derivation Λ k k) :
    mapIsomorphismClasses hp.cofibered hq.cofibered φ
      (artinianDualNumbers.{u, w, v} Λ k)
      (derivationToTangentSpace p hp D) =
        derivationToTangentSpace q hq D

declarations.name: Deformation.derivationAction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06SW.** Residue-field derivations act on the tangent space of any
predeformation category by the twisting automorphisms of the dual numbers.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def derivationAction
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k)
    (hp : IsPredeformationCategory p) : DerivationActionData.{u, v, w} p hp

declarations.name: Deformation.derivationAction_natural
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06SW.** The tangent map induced by a morphism of predeformation
categories commutes with the action of residue-field derivations.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivationAction_natural
    {G : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} G]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k)
    (q : G ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k)
    (hp : IsPredeformationCategory p) (hq : IsPredeformationCategory q)
    (φ : BasedFunctor (BasedCategory.ofFunctor p) (BasedCategory.ofFunctor q))
    (D : Derivation Λ k k)
    (x : predeformationTangentSpace.{u, v, w} p hp) :
    mapIsomorphismClasses hp.cofibered hq.cofibered φ
        (artinianDualNumbers.{u, w, v} Λ k)
        ((derivationAction.{u, v, w} p hp).action (D, x)) =
      (derivationAction.{u, v, w} q hq).action
        (D, mapIsomorphismClasses hp.cofibered hq.cofibered φ
          (artinianDualNumbers.{u, w, v} Λ k) x)

declarations.name: Deformation.schlessingerConditionS1_of_versal
declarations.doc:
A predeformation category with a versal formal object satisfies
Schlessinger's condition (S1).
declarations.statement:
public theorem schlessingerConditionS1_of_versal
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type uF} [Category.{vF} F]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k)
    (hp : IsPredeformationCategory p)
    (ξ : FormalObject p)
    (hξ : IsVersal hp.cofibered ξ) :
    SchlessingerConditionS1 p

declarations.name: Deformation.exists_least_lifting_ideal
declarations.doc:
The ideals of the kernel of a surjection `B ⟶ A` over whose quotients
an object over `A` lifts have a least member when (S1) holds.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_least_lifting_ideal
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type uF} [Category.{vF} F]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (hS1 : SchlessingerConditionS1 p)
    {B : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k} (x : F)
    (f : B ⟶ p.obj x) (hf : Function.Surjective f.hom)
    (hI : maximalIdeal B * RingHom.ker f.hom.toRingHom = ⊥) :
    let lifts : Set (Ideal B) :=
      {J | J ≤ RingHom.ker f.hom.toRingHom ∧
        ∃ (C : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
          (q : B ⟶ C) (g : C ⟶ p.obj x),
          Function.Surjective q.hom ∧
          RingHom.ker q.hom.toRingHom = J ∧
          q ≫ g = f ∧
          ∃ (y : F) (hy : p.obj y = C) (a : y ⟶ x),
            p.map a = eqToHom hy ≫ g};
    ∃ J : Ideal B, J ∈ lifts ∧ (∀ K : Ideal B, K ∈ lifts → J ≤ K)

declarations.name: Deformation.exists_minimal_preimage
declarations.doc:
Every minimal descent object of `x` is, up to isomorphism, the image of a
minimal descent object of `y` when `y ⟶ x` lies over a surjection and (S1)
holds.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_minimal_preimage
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    [Field k] [Algebra Λ k] [Module.Finite Λ k]
    {F : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} F]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (hS1 : SchlessingerConditionS1 p)
    {y x : F} (g : y ⟶ x)
    (hg : Function.Surjective (p.map g).hom)
    (X : DescentObject p x) (hX : IsMinimalObject X) :
    ∃ Y : DescentObject p y,
      IsMinimalObject Y ∧ Nonempty ((descentPushforward p hp g).functor.obj Y ≅ X)

declarations.name: Deformation.isMinimal_descentPushforward
declarations.doc: Pushforward along a morphism preserves minimal descent objects under (S1).
declarations.statement:
theorem isMinimal_descentPushforward
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type uF} [Category.{vF} F]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (hS1 : SchlessingerConditionS1 p)
    {y x : F} (g : y ⟶ x)
    (X : DescentObject p y)
    (hX : IsMinimalObject X) :
    IsMinimalObject
      ((descentPushforward p hp g).functor.obj X)

declarations.name: Deformation.exists_smallestDescent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06T2.** A versal formal object of a category cofibered in groupoids
satisfying (S1) admits a smallest formal descent: a descent over a complete local subalgebra of
its base that stays minimal after every Artinian base change and admits no proper further
descent.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_smallestDescent
    [IsNoetherianRing Λ] [Module.Finite Λ k]
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (hS1 : SchlessingerConditionS1 p)
    (ξ : FormalObject p) (hξ : IsVersal hp ξ) :
    Nonempty (SmallestDescent ξ)

declarations.name: Deformation.isVersal_smallestDescent
declarations.doc:
A smallest descent of a versal formal object of a category cofibered in groupoids is again a
versal formal object.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isVersal_smallestDescent
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p) {ξ : FormalObject p} (hξ : IsVersal hp ξ)
    (d : SmallestDescent ξ) : IsVersal hp d.object

declarations.name: Deformation.exists_mvPowerSeries_algEquiv_of_smallestDescent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06T3.** The base of a versal formal object is a power series algebra
over the base of a smallest descent of it, compatibly with the descended-base inclusion: the
isomorphism carries a constant to the image of its coefficient.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_mvPowerSeries_algEquiv_of_smallestDescent
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p) (ξ : FormalObject p) (hξ : IsVersal hp ξ)
    (d : SmallestDescent ξ) :
    ∃ r : ℕ, ∃ e : MvPowerSeries (Fin r) d.object.base ≃ₐ[Λ] ξ.base,
      ∀ a : d.object.base, e (MvPowerSeries.C a) = d.inclusion.base.hom a

declarations.name: Deformation.IsMinimalVersal
declarations.doc:
A formal object is minimal versal if it is versal and every morphism from a
formal object into it is surjective on its underlying complete local algebra.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev IsMinimalVersal (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (ξ : FormalObject p) : Prop

declarations.name: Deformation.exists_minimalVersalFormalObject
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06T5.** A predeformation category with a versal formal object has a minimal
versal formal object: a smallest descent of the given versal object is one.

declarations.name: Deformation.exists_minimalVersal_powerSeries
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06T5.** Any versal formal object `ξ` of a predeformation category is the
pushforward of a minimal versal formal object `η` along a power series ring extension: there is
a morphism `η ⟶ ξ` which is strongly cocartesian over its base map, and an isomorphism of
`Λ`-algebras `η.base[[x_1, …, x_r]] ≃ ξ.base` carrying a constant to the image of its
coefficient under that base map.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_minimalVersal_powerSeries [IsNoetherianRing Λ] [Module.Finite Λ k]
    (hp : IsPredeformationCategory p) (ξ : FormalObject p) (hξ : IsVersal hp.cofibered ξ) :
    ∃ η : FormalObject p, ∃ f : η ⟶ ξ, IsMinimalVersal hp.cofibered η ∧
      (FormalObject.projection (p := p)).IsStronglyCocartesian f.base f ∧
      ∃ r : ℕ, ∃ e : MvPowerSeries (Fin r) η.base ≃ₐ[Λ] ξ.base,
        ∀ a : η.base, e (MvPowerSeries.C a) = f.base.hom a

declarations.name: Deformation.isomorphic_of_isMinimalVersal
declarations.doc: Any two minimal versal formal objects are isomorphic.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isomorphic_of_isMinimalVersal (hp : IsPredeformationCategory p)
    (ξ η : FormalObject p) (hξ : IsMinimalVersal hp.cofibered ξ)
    (hη : IsMinimalVersal hp.cofibered η) :
    Nonempty (ξ ≅ η)

declarations.name: Deformation.HasBijectiveDifferentialOnDerivationOrbits
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06T6,** the condition itself. The differential of a formal object is a
well-defined, equivariant map from derivations of its underlying algebra to the tangent space,
surjective on tangent vectors, and bijective after passing to `Der_Λ(k, k)`-orbits on both
sides. That this holds for a minimal versal formal object is Stacks 06T8,
`Deformation.minimalVersal_hasBijectiveDifferentialOnDerivationOrbits`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def HasBijectiveDifferentialOnDerivationOrbits
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k)
    (hp : IsPredeformationCategory p) (ξ : FormalObject p) : Prop
declarations.comment: the condition, as a predicate on formal objects

declarations.name: Deformation.hasBijectiveDifferentialOnDerivationOrbits_of_hasBijectiveDifferential
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06T6.** The condition holds for a formal object whose differential is
bijective: the differential of such an object is a well-defined, equivariant and surjective map
from derivations of its underlying complete local algebra to the tangent space, and it is
bijective on `Der_Λ(k, k)`-orbits.
declarations.statement:
public theorem hasBijectiveDifferentialOnDerivationOrbits_of_hasBijectiveDifferential
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k)
    (hp : IsPredeformationCategory p) (ξ : FormalObject p)
    (hbij : HasBijectiveDifferential hp.cofibered ξ) :
    HasBijectiveDifferentialOnDerivationOrbits.{u, v, w} p hp ξ
declarations.comment: the condition holds for a formal object with bijective differential

declarations.name: Deformation.minimalVersal_hasBijectiveDifferentialOnDerivationOrbits
declarations.doc:
The differential of a minimal versal formal object of a predeformation category satisfying
Schlessinger's condition (S2) is well defined, surjective and equivariant, and induces a
bijection on `Der_Λ(k, k)`-orbits.
declarations.statement:
public theorem minimalVersal_hasBijectiveDifferentialOnDerivationOrbits
    [IsNoetherianRing Λ] [Module.Finite Λ k]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k)
    (hp : IsPredeformationCategory p)
    (hS2 : SchlessingerConditionS2 p)
    (ξ : FormalObject p)
    (hξ : IsMinimalVersal hp.cofibered ξ) :
    HasBijectiveDifferentialOnDerivationOrbits.{u, v, w} p hp ξ
declarations.comment: the condition holds for a minimal versal formal object

declarations.name: Deformation.exists_versal_orbitBijective_not_schlessingerConditionS2
declarations.doc:
There is a predeformation category carrying a versal formal object whose differential is
bijective on `Der_Λ(k, k)`-orbits and which does not satisfy Schlessinger's condition (S2).
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_versal_orbitBijective_not_schlessingerConditionS2 :
    ∃ (B : BasedCategory.{0, 1} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{0, 0, 0} Lam Kay))
      (hp : IsPredeformationCategory.{0, 0, 0} B.p) (ksi : FormalObject B.p),
      IsVersal hp.cofibered ksi ∧
        HasBijectiveDifferentialOnDerivationOrbits.{0, 0, 0} B.p hp ksi ∧
          ¬ SchlessingerConditionS2 B.p

declarations.name: Deformation.minimalVersal_hasBijectiveDifferentialOnDerivationOrbits
declarations.doc:
The differential of a minimal versal formal object of a predeformation category satisfying
Schlessinger's condition (S2) is well defined, surjective and equivariant, and induces a
bijection on `Der_Λ(k, k)`-orbits.
declarations.statement:
public theorem minimalVersal_hasBijectiveDifferentialOnDerivationOrbits
    [IsNoetherianRing Λ] [Module.Finite Λ k]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k)
    (hp : IsPredeformationCategory p)
    (hS2 : SchlessingerConditionS2 p)
    (ξ : FormalObject p)
    (hξ : IsMinimalVersal hp.cofibered ξ) :
    HasBijectiveDifferentialOnDerivationOrbits.{u, v, w} p hp ξ

The base category `𝒞_Λ`, regarded through the identity functor as a category cofibered in

declarations.statement:
public theorem isPredeformationCategory_id :
    IsPredeformationCategory.{u, v, w} (𝟭 (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k))

declarations.name: Deformation.schlessingerConditionS1_id
declarations.doc: `𝒞_Λ` over itself satisfies Schlessinger's condition (S1).
declarations.statement:
public theorem schlessingerConditionS1_id :
    SchlessingerConditionS1 (𝟭 (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k))

declarations.name: Deformation.schlessingerConditionS2_id
declarations.doc: `𝒞_Λ` over itself satisfies Schlessinger's condition (S2).
declarations.statement:
public theorem schlessingerConditionS2_id :
    SchlessingerConditionS2 (𝟭 (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k))

declarations.name: Deformation.unique_predeformationTangentSpace_id
declarations.doc: The tangent space of `𝒞_Λ` over itself vanishes: it has exactly one element.

declarations.name: Deformation.isMinimalVersal_selfFormalObject_smoothModel
declarations.doc:
The object `R` constructed in Stacks 06SM carries a minimal versal formal object of `𝒞_Λ`
regarded as cofibered in groupoids over itself.
declarations.comment: the smooth model of Stacks 06SM carries a minimal versal formal object

declarations.name: Deformation.isMinimalVersal_id_base_properties
declarations.doc:
The complete local algebra `S` underlying any minimal versal formal object of `𝒞_Λ` over
itself is formally smooth over `Λ` in the `𝔪_S`-adic topology, its module of differentials
satisfies `Ω_{S/Λ} ⊗_S k = Ω_{k/Λ}`, its conormal module satisfies `H₁(L_{k/Λ}) = 𝔪_S/𝔪_S²`, and
it is isomorphic to the object constructed in Stacks 06SM.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isMinimalVersal_id_base_properties
    (ξ : FormalObject (𝟭 (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max u w, w} Λ k)))
    (hξ : IsMinimalVersal isCofiberedInGroupoids_id ξ) :
    letI : Algebra ξ.base k := (residueHom ξ.base).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower Λ ξ.base k :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (residueHom ξ.base).comp_algebraMap.symm
    RingHom.FormallySmoothNAdic.{max u w} (algebraMap Λ ξ.base) (maximalIdeal ξ.base) ∧
      Function.Bijective (KaehlerDifferential.mapBaseChange Λ ξ.base k) ∧
        Function.Bijective (Algebra.H1Cotangent.map Λ ξ.base k k) ∧
          Nonempty (ξ.base ≅ smoothModel.{u, w} (Λ := Λ) (k := k))
declarations.comment: the cotangent identifications and the comparison with Stacks 06SM

declarations.name: Deformation.liftClassesEquivSquareZeroPullback
declarations.doc:
The canonical difference isomorphism
`A' ×_A A' ≅ A' ×_k k[I]` induces a bijection of lifts of `x` over these
two objects, compatible with pushforward of each representative. The presentation
`coord` of `k[I]` respects its `Λ`-algebra map and its chosen residue-field
identification, as required for an identification in `𝒞_Λ`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem liftClassesEquivSquareZeroPullback
    {Λ : Type u} {k : Type w} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type uF} [Category.{vF} F]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k)
    (hp : IsDeformationCategory p)
    {A' A S K P Q : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k}
    (f : A' ⟶ A) (_hf : Function.Surjective f.hom)
    (hann : ∀ a : A', a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A' →
      ∀ i : RingHom.ker f.hom.toRingHom, a * (i : A') = 0)
    [Module k (RingHom.ker f.hom.toRingHom)]
    [Module kᵐᵒᵖ (RingHom.ker f.hom.toRingHom)]
    [IsCentralScalar k (RingHom.ker f.hom.toRingHom)]
    (hmodule : ∀ (a : A') (i : RingHom.ker f.hom.toRingHom),
      (A'.residueEquiv (IsLocalRing.residue A' a)) • i = a • i)
    (coord : S ≃+* TrivSqZeroExt k (RingHom.ker f.hom.toRingHom))
    (hcoordΛ : ∀ a : Λ, coord (algebraMap Λ S a) =
      TrivSqZeroExt.inl (algebraMap Λ k a))
    (hcoordResidue : ∀ s : S,
      (coord s).fst = S.residueEquiv (IsLocalRing.residue S s))
    (hK : K ≅ residueFieldObject.{u, v, w} Λ k)
    (rA : A' ⟶ K) (rS : S ⟶ K)
    (p₁ p₂ : P ⟶ A') (hP : IsPullback p₁ p₂ f f)
    (q₁ : Q ⟶ A') (q₂ : Q ⟶ S) (hQ : IsPullback q₁ q₂ rA rS)
    (x : p.Fiber A) :
    Nonempty (DifferenceLiftEquiv p f rA rS p₁ p₂ q₁ q₂ coord x)

declarations.name: Deformation.liftClassesEquivProdOfResiduePullback
declarations.doc:
For a composite of two fibre squares, lifts over the outer pullback are identified with a
lift over the inner factor and a lift over the other outer factor, via the two projections.
declarations.statement:
public theorem liftClassesEquivProdOfResiduePullback
    {Λ : Type*} {k : Type*} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    {F : Type uF} [Category.{vF} F]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat Λ k)
    (hp : IsDeformationCategory p)
    {A₁' A₁ A₂ A : ArtinianLocalAlgCat Λ k}
    {f₁ : A₁ ⟶ A} {f₂ : A₂ ⟶ A} {g : A₁' ⟶ A₁}
    (right : PullbackCone f₁ f₂) (hright : IsLimit right)
    (left : PullbackCone g right.fst) (hleft : IsLimit left)
    (hg : Function.Surjective g.hom)
    (hf₁ : Function.Surjective f₁.hom)
    (x₀ : p.Fiber A) (a₁ : Lift p f₁ x₀) :
    Nonempty (LiftProjectionEquiv p right left x₀ a₁)

declarations.name: Deformation.hasNormalizedPresentation_iff_hasMinimalPresentation_of_isSeparable
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06TE**, the separable case. When `k` is separable over the image
field of `Λ` the residue field carries no nonzero `Λ`-derivation, so a minimal smooth
prorepresentable presentation is normalized and conditions (1) and (3) agree.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasNormalizedPresentation_iff_hasMinimalPresentation_of_isSeparable
    [IsNoetherianRing Λ] [Module.Finite Λ k]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (residueImageField Λ k) k] :
    HasNormalizedPresentation.{u, v, w} p ↔ HasMinimalPresentation.{u, v, w} p
declarations.comment: the separability clause of the tag: when k' ⊂ k is separable, condition (1), a normalized smooth prorepresentable presentation, is equivalent to the other three. Proved outright. Separability is read as Algebra.IsSeparable (residueImageField Λ k) k, and the equivalence of (1) with conditions (2), (3), (4) is this equivalence with (3) together with the equivalence of (2), (3), (4) in Deformation.hasSmoothPresentation_tfae; the four-way equivalence is assembled as Deformation.tfae_of_isSeparable

declarations.name: Deformation.hasSmoothPresentation_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06TE.** Conditions (2), (3) and (4) are equivalent, and (1) implies
them; when the residue field carries no nonzero `Λ`-derivation all four are equivalent.

The implications are (1) implies (3) and (3) implies (2), from Tag 06KN and the definitions,
(4) implies (3), from Tag 06L2, and (2) implies (4), from Tag 06L8; the equivalence of (1)
and (3) under `hzero` is the other half of Tag 06KN.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasSmoothPresentation_tfae [IsNoetherianRing Λ] [Module.Finite Λ k] :
    (HasNormalizedPresentation.{u, v, w} p → HasMinimalPresentation.{u, v, w} p) ∧
      (HasSmoothPresentation.{u, v, w} p ↔ HasMinimalPresentation.{u, v, w} p) ∧
      (HasSmoothPresentation.{u, v, w} p ↔
        IsFiniteDimensionalDeformationCategory.{u, v, w} p) ∧
      ((∀ δ : Derivation Λ k k, δ = 0) →
        (HasNormalizedPresentation.{u, v, w} p ↔ HasMinimalPresentation.{u, v, w} p))
declarations.comment: the tag: for ℱ cofibered in groupoids over 𝒞_Λ, conditions (2) a smooth prorepresentable presentation, (3) a minimal one, and (4) ℱ a deformation category with dim_k Tℱ and dim_k Inf(ℱ) finite, are equivalent and implied by (1) a normalized one, and all four are equivalent when k' ⊂ k is separable. Delivered outright and with no carried hypothesis: (1) ⟹ (3), (3) ⟹ (2), (4) ⟹ (3), (2) ⟹ (4) — the last from Deformation.hasSmoothPresentation_iff_isFiniteDimensionalDeformationCategory, Stacks 06L8 — and (3) ⟺ (1) whenever Der_Λ(k, k) vanishes. Nothing is assumed: this theorem takes no hypothesis beyond the chapter's standing IsNoetherianRing Λ and Module.Finite Λ k, and the vanishing of Der_Λ(k, k) is the antecedent of the fourth conjunct, which is proved outright as an implication. Separability of k' ⊂ k supplies that vanishing, by Deformation.derivation_eq_zero_of_residueImageField_separable, so the fourth conjunct is at least as strong as the source's separable clause; that clause itself, as the four-way equivalence, is Deformation.tfae_of_isSeparable, also carrying this tag. The final uniqueness clause of the tag is not here: it is Stacks 06L3, carried by this tag's add_to_stacks on Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.nonempty_iso_of_presentations, and it too is delivered outright — the realisation of a 1-morphism of quotients by a morphism of groupoids in functors, which that proof attributes to Definition 06KB, is proved as Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.exists_hom_of_morphismOver. No part of this tag is conditional. The statement is specialised to a hom-set universe of ℱ equal to the value universe v of the groupoids in functors, which is where Stacks 06L2 and Stacks 06L3 meet

declarations.name: Deformation.tfae_of_isSeparable
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06TE**, the four-way equivalence under separability. When `k` is
separable over the image field of `Λ`, a category cofibered in groupoids over `𝒞_Λ` admits a
presentation by a normalized smooth prorepresentable groupoid in functors if and only if it
admits one by a smooth prorepresentable groupoid in functors, if and only if it admits one by
a minimal smooth prorepresentable groupoid in functors, if and only if it is a deformation
category whose tangent space and whose space of infinitesimal automorphisms are
finite dimensional over `k`.

The cycle is (1) implies (3) by Tag 06KN, (3) implies (2) by the definitions, (2) implies (4)
by Tag 06L8, and (4) implies (1) by Tag 06L2 followed by the separable half of Tag 06KN.
declarations.statement:
theorem tfae_of_isSeparable [IsNoetherianRing Λ] [Module.Finite Λ k]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (residueImageField Λ k) k] :
    List.TFAE [HasNormalizedPresentation.{u, v, w} p, HasSmoothPresentation.{u, v, w} p,
      HasMinimalPresentation.{u, v, w} p,
      IsFiniteDimensionalDeformationCategory.{u, v, w} p]
declarations.comment: the tag's final equivalence, assembled: under separability of k' ⊂ k the four conditions (1) a normalized smooth prorepresentable presentation, (2) a smooth prorepresentable one, (3) a minimal one, and (4) ℱ a deformation category with dim_k Tℱ and dim_k Inf(ℱ) finite are all equivalent. Proved outright, with no carried hypothesis. Separability is read as Algebra.IsSeparable (residueImageField Λ k) k. The statement is specialised to a hom-set universe of ℱ equal to the value universe v of the groupoids in functors, which is where Stacks 06L2 and Stacks 06L3 meet. The uniqueness clause of the tag is separate and is also delivered outright: see this tag's add_to_stacks on Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.nonempty_iso_of_presentations

registrations.name: Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.nonempty_iso_of_presentations
registrations.comment: the final uniqueness clause of the tag: the minimal smooth prorepresentable groupoids in functors which present a given category cofibered in groupoids over 𝒞_Λ are unique up to isomorphism. This is Stacks 06L3, delivered outright: the realisation it rests on — that a 1-morphism of quotients over 𝒞_Λ is, up to isomorphism of functors, the one induced by a morphism of groupoids in functors, the step the source proof attributes to Definition 06KB — is proved as Deformation.GroupoidInFunctors.exists_hom_of_morphismOver, for a prorepresentable source and a smooth target, which both presentations here supply. No part of Stacks 06TE is conditional; for the equivalence of the four conditions see Deformation.hasSmoothPresentation_tfae and Deformation.tfae_of_isSeparable

registrations.name: CategoryTheory.Functor.category
registrations.comment: (1), (2) and PSh(X): presheaves on the underlying category of X, the functor category Xᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (morphisms are natural transformations)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.presheafAdjunction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TK**, the pullback and pushforward of presheaves and their adjointness. For a
1-morphism `G : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of categories fibred in groupoids over the big fppf category of `S`, the
pullback `G^p : PSh(𝒴) ⥤ PSh(𝒳)` of presheaves of sets is precomposition with `G.op`, so that
`G^p 𝒢 (x) = 𝒢 (G x)` by definition, and the pushforward `{}_pG : PSh(𝒳) ⥤ PSh(𝒴)` is the right
Kan extension along `G.op`; `G^p` is left adjoint to `{}_pG`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def presheafAdjunction :
    (Functor.whiskeringLeft _ _ (Type max v w t)).obj (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor G).op ⊣
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor G).op.ran
declarations.comment: presheaf pullback f^p, pushforward {}_pf, and the adjunction f^p ⊣ {}_pf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.presheafPushforwardObjObjIsoLimit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TK**, the formula `({}_pG ℱ)(y) = lim_{G(x) → y} ℱ(x)` for the pushforward of a
presheaf of sets `ℱ` on `𝒳` along a 1-morphism `G : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of categories fibred in groupoids over
the big fppf category of `S`, at an object `y` of `𝒴`: the limit is indexed by the pairs of an
object `x` of `𝒳` and a morphism `G(x) → y`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def presheafPushforwardObjObjIsoLimit (ℱ : 𝒳.val.objᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (max v w t))
    (y : 𝒴.val.obj) :
    ((CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor G).op.ran.obj ℱ).obj (Opposite.op y) ≅
      Limits.limit (StructuredArrow.proj (Opposite.op y) (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor G).op ⋙
        ℱ)
declarations.comment: the formula ({}_pf F)(y) = lim_{f(x) -> y} F(x) for the pushforward

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Functor.ranOpCompIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TL**: the canonical isomorphism `{}_p(g ∘ f) ≅ {}_pg ∘ {}_pf` of functors
`PSh(𝒳) ⥤ PSh(𝒵)`, namely the comparison of the two right adjoints `{}_p(g ∘ f)` and
`{}_pg ∘ {}_pf` of `(g ∘ f)^p = f^p ∘ g^p`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def ranOpCompIso : (f ⋙ g).op.ran (H := A) ≅ f.op.ran ⋙ g.op.ran

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Functor.homEquiv_comp_ranOpCompIso_hom_app
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TL**: the isomorphism `{}_p(g ∘ f) ≅ {}_pg ∘ {}_pf` is compatible with adjointness
of `(f^p, {}_pf)`, `(g^p, {}_pg)` and `((g ∘ f)^p, {}_p(g ∘ f))`: the square of hom-set bijections
`Mor(f^p g^p K, F) = Mor(g^p K, {}_pf F) = Mor(K, {}_pg {}_pf F)` and
`Mor((g ∘ f)^p K, F) = Mor(K, {}_p(g ∘ f) F)` commutes.
declarations.statement:
theorem homEquiv_comp_ranOpCompIso_hom_app (K : Zᵒᵖ ⥤ A) (F : Xᵒᵖ ⥤ A)
    (α : (f ⋙ g).op ⋙ K ⟶ F) :
    ((f ⋙ g).op.ranAdjunction A).homEquiv K F α ≫ (ranOpCompIso A f g).hom.app F =
      (ranCompAdjunction A f.op g.op).homEquiv K F α
declarations.comment: compatibility of the canonical isomorphism with adjointness

registrations.name: CategoryTheory.Functor.whiskeringLeft_obj_comp
registrations.comment: pullback of presheaves along a composite: `(g ∘ f)^p = f^p ∘ g^p`, at `F = f.op`, `G = g.op`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CatFiberedInGroupoids.isIso_underlyingNatTrans_app
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TM.** Every component of a two-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids lies
over an identity, hence is invertible.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_underlyingNatTrans_app {f g : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴} (t : f ⟶ g) (x : 𝒳.based.obj) :
    IsIso (t.hom.toNatTrans.app x)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CatFiberedInGroupoids.pullbackIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TM.** Pullback of presheaves along the isomorphism of functors underlying a
two-morphism, contravariant in the two-morphism.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def pullbackIso :
    (whiskeringLeft 𝒳.based.objᵒᵖ 𝒴.based.objᵒᵖ A).obj
        (homFunctorOp g) ≅
      (whiskeringLeft 𝒳.based.objᵒᵖ 𝒴.based.objᵒᵖ A).obj
        (homFunctorOp f)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CatFiberedInGroupoids.pullbackIso_hom_app
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TM.** On a presheaf and an object, the restriction comparison is evaluation on
the component of the given two-morphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem pullbackIso_hom_app (P : 𝒴.based.objᵒᵖ ⥤ A) (x : 𝒳.based.obj) :
    ((pullbackIso A t).hom.app P).app (Opposite.op x) =
      P.map (t.hom.toNatTrans.app x).op

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CatFiberedInGroupoids.pullbackIso_trans
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TM.** Vertical composition of two-morphisms becomes composition of the induced
restriction isomorphisms, in reverse order.
declarations.statement:
theorem pullbackIso_trans {h : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴} (s : g ⟶ h) :
    pullbackIso A (t ≫ s) = pullbackIso A s ≪≫ pullbackIso A t

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CatFiberedInGroupoids.pullbackIso_hcomp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TM.** The restriction comparison for a horizontal composite acts pointwise by
the two component maps, in the contravariant order.
declarations.statement:
theorem pullbackIso_hcomp {𝒵 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{v₀, v₁, u₀, u₁} B}
    {h k : 𝒴 ⟶ 𝒵} (s : h ⟶ k) (P : 𝒵.based.objᵒᵖ ⥤ A) (x : 𝒳.based.obj) :
    ((pullbackIso (f := f ≫ h) (g := g ≫ k) A
      (Bicategory.whiskerRight t h ≫ Bicategory.whiskerLeft g s)).hom.app P).app
        (Opposite.op x) =
      P.map (s.hom.toNatTrans.app ((CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g).obj x)).op ≫
        P.map ((CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor h).map (t.hom.toNatTrans.app x)).op

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CatFiberedInGroupoids.pushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TM.** Direct image of presheaves along the isomorphism of functors underlying a
two-morphism, obtained as the adjoint mate of the pullback isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def pushforwardIso :
    (homFunctorOp f).ran (H := A) ≅
      (homFunctorOp g).ran (H := A)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CatFiberedInGroupoids.pushforwardIso_hom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TM.** The direct-image comparison is the mate of the restriction comparison,
expressing compatibility with both adjunctions.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushforwardIso_hom :
    (pushforwardIso A t).hom =
      conjugateEquiv ((homFunctorOp f).ranAdjunction A)
        ((homFunctorOp g).ranAdjunction A)
        (pullbackIso A t).hom

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CatFiberedInGroupoids.pushforwardIso_trans
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TM.** Vertical composition of two-morphisms becomes composition of the
corresponding direct-image isomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushforwardIso_trans {h : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴} (s : g ⟶ h)
    [∀ (F : 𝒳.based.objᵒᵖ ⥤ A),
      (homFunctorOp h).HasRightKanExtension F] :
    pushforwardIso A (t ≫ s) = pushforwardIso A t ≪≫ pushforwardIso A s

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CatFiberedInGroupoids.pushforwardIso_hcomp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TM.** The direct-image comparison for a horizontal composite, after identifying
direct images of composites with successive direct images, is the horizontal composite of the
two direct-image comparisons.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushforwardIso_hcomp {𝒵 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{v₀, v₁, u₀, u₁} B}
    {h k : 𝒴 ⟶ 𝒵} (s : h ⟶ k)
    [∀ (P : 𝒴.based.objᵒᵖ ⥤ A),
      (homFunctorOp h).HasRightKanExtension P]
    [∀ (P : 𝒴.based.objᵒᵖ ⥤ A),
      (homFunctorOp k).HasRightKanExtension P]
    [∀ (F : 𝒳.based.objᵒᵖ ⥤ A),
      (homFunctorOp (f ≫ h)).HasRightKanExtension F]
    [∀ (F : 𝒳.based.objᵒᵖ ⥤ A),
      (homFunctorOp (g ≫ k)).HasRightKanExtension F]
    [∀ (F : 𝒳.based.objᵒᵖ ⥤ A),
      ((homFunctorOp f) ⋙
        (homFunctorOp h)).HasRightKanExtension F]
    [∀ (F : 𝒳.based.objᵒᵖ ⥤ A),
      ((homFunctorOp g) ⋙
        (homFunctorOp k)).HasRightKanExtension F] :
    pushforwardIso A (Bicategory.whiskerRight t h ≫ Bicategory.whiskerLeft g s) ≪≫
        ranCompIso (homFunctorOp g)
          (homFunctorOp k) A =
      ranCompIso (homFunctorOp f)
          (homFunctorOp h) A ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerRight (pushforwardIso A t)
          ((homFunctorOp h).ran (H := A)) ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerLeft ((homFunctorOp g).ran (H := A))
        (pushforwardIso A s)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CatFiberedInGroupoids.pushforwardIsoOfSets
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TM.** The canonical isomorphism `{}_pt : {}_pf ≅ {}_pg` of direct images of
presheaves of sets induced by a two-morphism `t : f ⟶ g`, namely the mate of the restriction
comparison `t^p : g^p ≅ f^p` for the adjunctions `(f^p, {}_pf)` and `(g^p, {}_pg)`. The direct
images exist by instance search: Mathlib's pointwise right Kan extension, computed by limits in
`Type (max u₁ v₁ w)`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def pushforwardIsoOfSets :
    (homFunctorOp f).ran (H := Type (max u₁ v₁ w)) ≅ (homFunctorOp g).ran
declarations.comment: canonical isomorphism of direct images of presheaves of sets

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CatFiberedInGroupoids.pushforwardIsoOfSets_hom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TM.** The isomorphism `{}_pt` of direct images of presheaves of sets is
compatible with adjointness of `(f^p, {}_pf)` and `(g^p, {}_pg)`: it is the conjugate of
`t^p : g^p ≅ f^p` for the two adjunctions.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushforwardIsoOfSets_hom :
    (pushforwardIsoOfSets.{w} t).hom =
      conjugateEquiv ((homFunctorOp f).ranAdjunction (Type (max u₁ v₁ w)))
        ((homFunctorOp g).ranAdjunction (Type (max u₁ v₁ w)))
        (pullbackIso (Type (max u₁ v₁ w)) t).hom
declarations.comment: compatibility with adjointness, for presheaves of sets

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CatFiberedInGroupoids.pushforwardIsoOfSets_trans
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TM.** Vertical composition of two-morphisms becomes composition of the induced
isomorphisms of direct images of presheaves of sets.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushforwardIsoOfSets_trans {h : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴} (s : g ⟶ h) :
    pushforwardIsoOfSets.{w} (t ≫ s) = pushforwardIsoOfSets.{w} t ≪≫ pushforwardIsoOfSets s
declarations.comment: vertical composition on direct images of presheaves of sets

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.CatFiberedInGroupoids.pushforwardIsoOfSets_hcomp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TM.** The isomorphism of direct images of presheaves of sets induced by a
horizontal composite of two-morphisms, after identifying direct images along composites with
successive direct images, is the horizontal composite of the two induced isomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushforwardIsoOfSets_hcomp {𝒵 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{v₀, v₁, u₀, u₁} B}
    {h k : 𝒴 ⟶ 𝒵} (s : h ⟶ k) :
    pushforwardIsoOfSets.{w} (Bicategory.whiskerRight t h ≫ Bicategory.whiskerLeft g s) ≪≫
        ranCompIso (homFunctorOp g) (homFunctorOp k) (Type (max u₁ v₁ w)) =
      ranCompIso (homFunctorOp f) (homFunctorOp h) (Type (max u₁ v₁ w)) ≪≫
        isoWhiskerRight (pushforwardIsoOfSets.{w} t)
          ((homFunctorOp h).ran (H := Type (max u₁ v₁ w))) ≪≫
        isoWhiskerLeft ((homFunctorOp g).ran (H := Type (max u₁ v₁ w)))
          (pushforwardIsoOfSets.{w} s)
declarations.comment: horizontal composition on direct images of presheaves of sets

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.associatedTopology
declarations.doc:
The site associated to a category `p : 𝒳 ⥤ (Sch/S)` over the big fppf category of `S` and a
topology `τ` on the underlying category of schemes of `B`: the topology `𝒳` inherits from the
localization of `τ` at `S`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev associatedTopology {X : Type v} [Category.{w} X] (p : X ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (τ : GrothendieckTopology B.Schemes) : GrothendieckTopology X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.IsSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TR.** A presheaf of sets on a category `p : 𝒳 ⥤ (Sch/S)` over the big fppf
category of `S` is a *sheaf for the topology `τ`* when it is a sheaf on the associated site
`𝒳_τ` of Stacks 06TP. The five values of `τ` give the Zariski, étale, smooth, syntomic and
fppf sheaf conditions of the source.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsSheaf (τ : SiteKind) (F : Xᵒᵖ ⥤ Type t) : Prop
declarations.comment: sheaf conditions for the five topologies

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.AssociatedSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TR.** The category `Sh(𝒳_τ)` of sheaves of sets on the associated site `𝒳_τ`
of Stacks 06TP, for `τ` one of the five topologies. Its morphisms are morphisms of the
underlying presheaves.
declarations.statement: abbrev AssociatedSheaf (τ : SiteKind)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.isSheaf_comp_op_and_isSheaf_ran_obj
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TS**, preservation of sheaves. For a 1-morphism `G : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of categories fibred in
groupoids over the big fppf category of `S` and `τ` one of the five topologies, the pullback
`G^p 𝒢 = 𝒢 ∘ G` of a `τ` sheaf of sets `𝒢` on `𝒴` is a `τ` sheaf on `𝒳`, and the pushforward
`{}_pG ℱ`, the right Kan extension of `ℱ` along `G`, of a `τ` sheaf of sets `ℱ` on `𝒳` is a `τ`
sheaf on `𝒴`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSheaf_comp_op_and_isSheaf_ran_obj :
    (∀ 𝒢 : 𝒴.val.objᵒᵖ ⥤ Type t, IsSheaf B S hS 𝒴.val.p τ 𝒢 →
      IsSheaf B S hS 𝒳.val.p τ ((CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor G).op ⋙ 𝒢)) ∧
    ∀ ℱ : 𝒳.val.objᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (max v w t), IsSheaf B S hS 𝒳.val.p τ ℱ →
      IsSheaf B S hS 𝒴.val.p τ ((CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor G).op.ran.obj ℱ)
declarations.comment: the functors f^p and {}_pf of presheaves of sets transform tau sheaves into tau sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.morphismOfTopoi_associatedSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TS**, the morphism of topoi. A 1-morphism `G : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of categories fibred in
groupoids over the big fppf category of `S` defines, for each of the five topologies `τ`, a
morphism of topoi `f : Sh(𝒳_τ) ⟶ Sh(𝒴_τ)` between the categories of sheaves of sets of Stacks
06TR: its inverse image `f⁻¹` is the pullback `G^p` of sheaves, its direct image `f_*` is the
pushforward `{}_pG` of sheaves, `f⁻¹` is left adjoint to `f_*`, and `f⁻¹` is left exact.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def morphismOfTopoi_associatedSheaf :
    MorphismOfTopoi (AssociatedSheaf.{u, v, w, max v w t} B S hS 𝒳.val.p τ)
      (AssociatedSheaf.{u, v, w, max v w t} B S hS 𝒴.val.p τ)
declarations.comment: the morphism of topoi f : Sh(X_tau) -> Sh(Y_tau) defined by f^p and {}_pf, for sheaves of sets

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.morphismOfTopoi_associatedSheaf_pushforwardCompSheafToPresheafIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TS**, `f_* = {}_pG`. The direct image of the morphism of topoi
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.morphismOfTopoi_associatedSheaf` is the pushforward of presheaves:
on underlying presheaves it is the right Kan extension along `G.op`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def morphismOfTopoi_associatedSheaf_pushforwardCompSheafToPresheafIso :
    (morphismOfTopoi_associatedSheaf.{u, v, w, t} B S hS G τ).pushforward ⋙
        sheafToPresheaf (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒴.val.p τ) (Type max v w t) ≅
      sheafToPresheaf (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒳.val.p τ) (Type max v w t) ⋙
        (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor G).op.ran
declarations.comment: the direct image of the morphism of topoi is the pushforward {}_pf of presheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.morphismOfTopoi_associatedSheaf_inverseImageCompSheafToPresheafIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TS**, `f⁻¹ = G^p`. The inverse image of the morphism of topoi
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.morphismOfTopoi_associatedSheaf` is the pullback of presheaves:
on underlying presheaves it is precomposition with `G.op`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def morphismOfTopoi_associatedSheaf_inverseImageCompSheafToPresheafIso :
    (morphismOfTopoi_associatedSheaf.{u, v, w, t} B S hS G τ).inverseImage ⋙
        sheafToPresheaf (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒳.val.p τ) (Type max v w t) ≅
      sheafToPresheaf (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒴.val.p τ) (Type max v w t) ⋙
        (Functor.whiskeringLeft _ _ _).obj (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor G).op
declarations.comment: the inverse image of the morphism of topoi is the pullback f^p of presheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.isContinuous_and_isCocontinuous_associatedTopology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TS**, preservation of sheaves by both functors. For each of the five topologies
`τ`, the functor underlying a 1-morphism `G : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of categories fibred in groupoids over the
big fppf category of `S` is continuous and cocontinuous between the associated sites `𝒳_τ` and
`𝒴_τ` of Stacks 06TP. Continuity says that `G^p` carries `τ` sheaves on `𝒴` to `τ` sheaves on
`𝒳` and cocontinuity that `{}_pG` carries `τ` sheaves on `𝒳` to `τ` sheaves on `𝒴`, which is the
first assertion of the source.

This is the instance of **Stacks 06NW**
(`CategoryTheory.Functor.IsFibredOneMorphism.isContinuous_and_isCocontinuous_inheritedTopology`)
at the base site `(Sch/S)_{fppf}` with the localized topology of `τ`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isContinuous_and_isCocontinuous_associatedTopology (G : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (τ : SiteKind) :
    (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor G).IsContinuous
        (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒳.val.p τ) (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒴.val.p τ) ∧
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor G).IsCocontinuous
        (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒳.val.p τ) (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒴.val.p τ)
declarations.comment: preservation of sheaves by both functors

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.inverseImageCompSheafToPresheafIso_associatedTopology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TS**, `f⁻¹ = G^p`. The inverse image of the induced morphism of topoi
`Sh(𝒳_τ) ⟶ Sh(𝒴_τ)` is plain restriction along `G.op`: as a functor to presheaves on `𝒳` it is
`sheafToPresheaf` followed by precomposition with `G.op`, with no sheafification intervening.

This is the instance of **Stacks 06NW**
(`CategoryTheory.Functor.IsFibredOneMorphism.inverseImageCompSheafToPresheafIso`) at the five
associated sites.
declarations.statement:
public def inverseImageCompSheafToPresheafIso_associatedTopology :
    letI := (isContinuous_and_isCocontinuous_associatedTopology B S hS G τ).1
    (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor G).sheafPushforwardContinuous A
          (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒳.val.p τ) (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒴.val.p τ) ⋙
        sheafToPresheaf (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒳.val.p τ) A ≅
      sheafToPresheaf (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒴.val.p τ) A ⋙
        (Functor.whiskeringLeft _ _ _).obj (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor G).op

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.inverseImage_obj_obj_obj_associatedTopology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TS**, the objectwise formula `f⁻¹(𝒢)(x) = 𝒢(G x)`: the sections of the inverse
image of a `τ` sheaf `𝒢` on `𝒴` over an object `x` of `𝒳` are the sections of `𝒢` over `G x`.

This is the instance of **Stacks 06NW**
(`CategoryTheory.Functor.IsFibredOneMorphism.inverseImage_obj_obj_obj`) at the five associated
sites.
declarations.statement:
public theorem inverseImage_obj_obj_obj_associatedTopology :
    letI := (isContinuous_and_isCocontinuous_associatedTopology B S hS G τ).1
    ∀ (𝒢 : Sheaf (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒴.val.p τ) A) (x : 𝒳.val.obj),
      (((CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor G).sheafPushforwardContinuous A
            (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒳.val.p τ)
            (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒴.val.p τ)).obj 𝒢).obj.obj (Opposite.op x) =
        𝒢.obj.obj (Opposite.op ((CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor G).obj x))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.preservesFiniteLimits_inverseImage_associatedTopology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TS**, exactness of the inverse image. The inverse image of the induced morphism of
topoi preserves finite limits, which is the remaining clause in "morphism of topoi".

This is the instance of **Stacks 06NW**
(`CategoryTheory.Functor.IsFibredOneMorphism.preservesFiniteLimits_inverseImage`) at the five
associated sites.
declarations.statement:
public theorem preservesFiniteLimits_inverseImage_associatedTopology [Limits.HasFiniteLimits A] :
    letI := (isContinuous_and_isCocontinuous_associatedTopology B S hS G τ).1
    Limits.PreservesFiniteLimits ((CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor G).sheafPushforwardContinuous A
      (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒳.val.p τ) (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒴.val.p τ))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.directImageCompSheafToPresheafIso_associatedTopology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TS**, `f_* = {}_pG`. The direct image of the induced morphism of topoi is the
right Kan extension along `G.op`, taken on sheaves: as a functor to presheaves on `𝒴` it is
`sheafToPresheaf` followed by `G.op.ran`.

This is the instance of **Stacks 06NW**
(`CategoryTheory.Functor.IsFibredOneMorphism.directImageCompSheafToPresheafIso`) at the five
associated sites.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def directImageCompSheafToPresheafIso_associatedTopology
    [∀ (F : 𝒳.val.objᵒᵖ ⥤ A),
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor G).op.HasPointwiseRightKanExtension F] :
    letI := (isContinuous_and_isCocontinuous_associatedTopology B S hS G τ).2
    (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor G).sheafPushforwardCocontinuous A
          (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒳.val.p τ) (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒴.val.p τ) ⋙
        sheafToPresheaf (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒴.val.p τ) A ≅
      sheafToPresheaf (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒳.val.p τ) A ⋙
        (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor G).op.ran
declarations.comment: direct image is right Kan extension

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.sheafAdjunction_associatedTopology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TS**, the morphism of topoi itself. A 1-morphism `G : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of categories fibred
in groupoids over the big fppf category of `S` induces, for each of the five topologies `τ`, a
morphism of topoi `f : Sh(𝒳_τ) ⟶ Sh(𝒴_τ)`: this is the adjunction `f⁻¹ ⊣ f_*` between the two
associated sites of Stacks 06TP, with `f⁻¹ = G^p` the restriction and `f_* = {}_pG` the right Kan
extension. It is the actual adjunction, not an existence claim; together with
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.preservesFiniteLimits_inverseImage_associatedTopology` it is a
morphism of topoi in the source's sense.

This is the instance of **Stacks 06NW**
(`CategoryTheory.Functor.IsFibredOneMorphism.sheafAdjunctionInheritedTopology`) at the five
associated sites.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def sheafAdjunction_associatedTopology
    [∀ (F : 𝒳.val.objᵒᵖ ⥤ A),
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor G).op.HasPointwiseRightKanExtension F] :
    letI := (isContinuous_and_isCocontinuous_associatedTopology B S hS G τ).1
    letI := (isContinuous_and_isCocontinuous_associatedTopology B S hS G τ).2
    (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor G).sheafPushforwardContinuous A
        (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒳.val.p τ) (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒴.val.p τ) ⊣
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor G).sheafPushforwardCocontinuous A
        (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒳.val.p τ) (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒴.val.p τ)
declarations.comment: adjunction defining the morphism of topoi

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.sheafAdjunction_associatedSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TT.** The *associated morphism of `τ` topoi*
`f = (f⁻¹, f_*) : Sh(𝒳_τ) ⟶ Sh(𝒴_τ)` of a 1-morphism `G : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of categories fibred in
groupoids over the big fppf category of `S`, for each of the five topologies `τ` — the Zariski,
étale, smooth, syntomic and fppf ones. It is the adjunction `f⁻¹ ⊣ f_*` between the two categories
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.AssociatedSheaf` of sheaves of sets on the associated sites of
Stacks 06TP, with `f⁻¹ = G^p` the restriction along `G` and `f_* = {}_pG` the right Kan extension
along `G.op`.

The limits that compute `f_*` are supplied by
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.hasPointwiseRightKanExtension_op_homFunctor`, a `Type (max v w)`
having limits of the shapes that index them by `CategoryTheory.Limits.Types.hasLimitsOfSize`, so
the data a reader must provide to obtain this morphism of topoi is a 1-morphism of categories
fibred in groupoids over `(Sch/S)_fppf` and a choice among the five topologies, which is what the
source provides. Left exactness of `f⁻¹`,
the remaining clause of "morphism of topoi", is
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.preservesFiniteLimits_inverseImage_associatedTopology` at these
same coefficients.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def sheafAdjunction_associatedSheaf :
    letI := (isContinuous_and_isCocontinuous_associatedTopology B S hS G τ).1
    letI := (isContinuous_and_isCocontinuous_associatedTopology B S hS G τ).2
    (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor G).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type max v w)
        (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒳.val.p τ) (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒴.val.p τ) ⊣
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor G).sheafPushforwardCocontinuous (Type max v w)
        (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒳.val.p τ) (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒴.val.p τ)
declarations.comment: the associated morphism of tau topoi f = (f^{-1}, f_*), for each of the five

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.structureSheaf
declarations.doc:
The structure sheaf of a category fibred in groupoids, given by inverse image of the
commutative ring sheaf of the big site of schemes.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def structureSheaf {X : Type v} [Category.{w} X]
    (p : X ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS) (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (τ : GrothendieckTopology B.Schemes) (hτ : τ ≤ B.topology) :
    Sheaf (associatedTopology B S hS p τ) CommRingCat.{u}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FibredSite.inverseImageStructureSheaf_eq
declarations.doc:
For a 1-morphism `F` of categories fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site, the inverse
image along `F` of the structure sheaf of the target is the structure sheaf of the source, as a
sheaf of commutative rings and on the nose.
declarations.statement:
theorem inverseImageStructureSheaf_eq
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X : Type v} [Category.{w} X] {Y : Type v'} [Category.{w'} Y]
    (p : X ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (q : Y ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hq : q.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (F : X ⥤ Y) (hF : p.IsFibredOneMorphism q F)
    (τ : SiteKind) :
    letI := hp.isFibered
    letI := hq.isFibered
    letI := (hF.isContinuous_and_isCocontinuous_inheritedTopology
      ((B.baseTopology τ).over (B.obj hS))).1
    (F.sheafPushforwardContinuous CommRingCat.{u}
      (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS p τ)
      (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS q τ)).obj
        (FibredSite.structureSheaf B S hS q hq τ) =
      FibredSite.structureSheaf B S hS p hp τ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FibredSite.ringedToposMorphism
declarations.doc:
A 1-morphism `F` of categories fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site induces a morphism
of ringed topoi in the sense of `AlgebraicGeometry.RingedToposHom`, between the two associated
ringed topoi: the underlying morphism of topoi is the one `F` induces, and its structure map is
the adjoint of the canonical identification
`AlgebraicGeometry.FibredSite.inverseImageStructureSheaf_eq`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def ringedToposMorphism
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X : Type v} [Category.{w} X] {Y : Type v'} [Category.{w'} Y]
    (p : X ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (q : Y ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hq : q.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (F : X ⥤ Y) (hF : p.IsFibredOneMorphism q F)
    (τ : SiteKind)
    [∀ (G : Xᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u), F.op.HasPointwiseRightKanExtension G] :
    RingedToposHom
      (associatedRingedTopos B S hS p hp τ)
      (associatedRingedTopos B S hS q hq τ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FibredSite.ringedToposMorphism_inverseImage
declarations.doc:
The morphism of ringed topoi `AlgebraicGeometry.FibredSite.ringedToposMorphism` sits over
the morphism of topoi that `F` itself induces: its inverse image is restriction of sheaves along
`F` for the two inherited topologies.
declarations.statement:
theorem ringedToposMorphism_inverseImage
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X : Type v} [Category.{w} X] {Y : Type v'} [Category.{w'} Y]
    (p : X ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (q : Y ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hq : q.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (F : X ⥤ Y) (hF : p.IsFibredOneMorphism q F)
    (τ : SiteKind)
    [∀ (G : Xᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u), F.op.HasPointwiseRightKanExtension G] :
    letI := hp.isFibered
    letI := hq.isFibered
    letI := (hF.isContinuous_and_isCocontinuous_inheritedTopology
      ((B.baseTopology τ).over (B.obj hS))).1
    (ringedToposMorphism B S hS p q hp hq F hF τ).toToposHom.inverseImage =
      F.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
        (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS p τ)
        (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS q τ)
declarations.comment: inverse image of the underlying geometric morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FibredSite.ringedToposMorphism_fSharpInverseImage
declarations.doc:
The inverse-image form of the structure map of
`AlgebraicGeometry.FibredSite.ringedToposMorphism` is the canonical identification itself: the
comparison of the inverse image of a sheaf of commutative rings with its restriction, followed
by the equality `AlgebraicGeometry.FibredSite.inverseImageStructureSheaf_eq`.
declarations.statement:
theorem ringedToposMorphism_fSharpInverseImage
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X : Type v} [Category.{w} X] {Y : Type v'} [Category.{w'} Y]
    (p : X ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (q : Y ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hq : q.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (F : X ⥤ Y) (hF : p.IsFibredOneMorphism q F)
    (τ : SiteKind)
    [∀ (G : Xᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u), F.op.HasPointwiseRightKanExtension G] :
    letI := hp.isFibered
    letI := hq.isFibered
    letI := (hF.isContinuous_and_isCocontinuous_inheritedTopology
      ((B.baseTopology τ).over (B.obj hS))).1
    (ringedToposMorphism B S hS p q hp hq F hF τ).fSharpInverseImage =
      (restrictionCommRingIso
        (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS p τ)
        (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS q τ) F
        (FibredSite.structureSheaf B S hS q hq τ)).hom ≫
        eqToHom (inverseImageStructureSheaf_eq B S hS p q hp hq F hF τ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FibredSite.ringedToposMorphism_isIso_fSharpInverseImage
declarations.doc:
The inverse-image form of the structure map of
`AlgebraicGeometry.FibredSite.ringedToposMorphism` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem ringedToposMorphism_isIso_fSharpInverseImage
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X : Type v} [Category.{w} X] {Y : Type v'} [Category.{w'} Y]
    (p : X ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (q : Y ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hq : q.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (F : X ⥤ Y) (hF : p.IsFibredOneMorphism q F)
    (τ : SiteKind)
    [∀ (G : Xᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u), F.op.HasPointwiseRightKanExtension G] :
    IsIso (ringedToposMorphism B S hS p q hp hq F hF τ).fSharpInverseImage
declarations.comment: canonical identification gives an isomorphism of structure sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.sheafPushforwardContinuous_structureSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TW.** The inverse image of the structure sheaf of `𝒴` along a 1-morphism `F` is
the structure sheaf of `𝒳`, as an equality of sheaves of commutative rings: being a 1-morphism
means `p = F ⋙ q` on the nose, and both structure sheaves are restrictions of one and the same
structure sheaf of the base.
declarations.statement:
theorem sheafPushforwardContinuous_structureSheaf (hF : F ⋙ q = p)
    [F.IsContinuous (associatedTopology B S hS p τ) (associatedTopology B S hS q τ)] :
    (F.sheafPushforwardContinuous CommRingCat.{u} (associatedTopology B S hS p τ)
          (associatedTopology B S hS q τ)).obj (structureSheaf B S hS q hq τ hτ) =
      structureSheaf B S hS p hp τ hτ
declarations.comment: the canonical identification of structure sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.structureSheafInverseImageIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TW.** The inverse image of the structure sheaf of `𝒴` is the structure sheaf of
`𝒳`, as sheaves of commutative rings on the associated site of `𝒳`: the inverse image of a
sheaf of commutative rings along a morphism of topoi presented by restriction is restriction,
and restriction of the structure sheaf of `𝒴` along `F` is the structure sheaf of `𝒳`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def structureSheafInverseImageIso :
    (inverseImageCommRingFunctor
          (associatedToposMorphism B S hS p q F hp hq τ hF)).obj (structureSheaf B S hS q hq τ hτ) ≅
      structureSheaf B S hS p hp τ hτ
declarations.comment: the structure sheaves are identified by the morphism of topoi

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.associatedRingedToposHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TW.** The morphism of ringed topoi induced by a 1-morphism of categories fibred
in groupoids: the morphism of topoi of Stacks 06NW together with the structure map adjoint to
the identification of the structure sheaves.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def associatedRingedToposHom :
    RingedToposHom (associatedRingedTopos B S hS p hp τ hτ)
      (associatedRingedTopos B S hS q hq τ hτ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.fSharpInverseImage_associatedRingedToposHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TW.** The structure map of the induced morphism of ringed topoi is, in
inverse-image form, exactly the identification of the structure sheaves.
declarations.statement:
theorem fSharpInverseImage_associatedRingedToposHom :
    (associatedRingedToposHom B S hS p q F hp hq τ hτ hF).fSharpInverseImage =
      (structureSheafInverseImageIso B S hS p q F hp hq τ hτ hF).hom
declarations.comment: the structure map is the canonical identification

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isIso_fSharpInverseImage_associatedRingedToposHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TW.** The structure map of the induced morphism of ringed topoi is an
isomorphism, so the morphism of ringed topoi is a morphism of ringed topoi with invertible
structure map.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_fSharpInverseImage_associatedRingedToposHom :
    IsIso (associatedRingedToposHom B S hS p q F hp hq τ hτ hF).fSharpInverseImage
declarations.comment: the structure map is an isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isFlat_associatedRingedToposHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TX.** The morphism of ringed topoi `f : Sh(𝒳_τ) → Sh(𝒴_τ)` induced by a 1-morphism
of categories fibred in groupoids is flat: its structure map in inverse-image form is the
identification `f⁻¹O_𝒴 = O_𝒳` of Stacks 06TW, and an isomorphism of sheaves of commutative rings
makes its target a flat module over its source.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFlat_associatedRingedToposHom :
    RingedToposHom.IsFlat
      (X := associatedRingedTopos B S hS p hp τ hτ)
      (Y := associatedRingedTopos B S hS q hq τ hτ)
      (associatedRingedToposHom B S hS p q F hp hq τ hτ hF)
declarations.comment: flatness of the morphism of ringed topoi of a 1-morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isFlat_associatedRingedToposHom_overMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TX**, the second assertion. For a morphism `i : X ⟶ Y` of schemes over `S` the
induced morphism of ringed big `τ`-sites `i : (Sch/X)_τ → (Sch/Y)_τ` is flat, for the same reason:
the two structure sheaves are restrictions of one and the same structure sheaf of the base, so the
inverse-image structure map is an isomorphism.

The source states this for a closed immersion; no hypothesis on `i` is used, which is the point
the remark makes.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFlat_associatedRingedToposHom_overMap :
    RingedToposHom.IsFlat
      (X := associatedRingedTopos B S hS (Over.map X.hom) (.over_map X.hom) τ hτ)
      (Y := associatedRingedTopos B S hS (Over.map Y.hom) (.over_map Y.hom) τ hτ)
      (associatedRingedToposHom B S hS (Over.map X.hom) (Over.map Y.hom) (Over.map i.left)
        (.over_map X.hom) (.over_map Y.hom) τ hτ (isFibredOneMorphism_overMap X Y i))
declarations.comment: flatness of the morphism of big τ-sites of a morphism of schemes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.hasRelativeProperty_iff_of_fppfCover
declarations.doc:
Let `P` be a property of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` which is stable under base
change and local on the target for the fppf precoverage, let `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a 1-morphism of
algebraic stacks over `S` representable by algebraic spaces, and let `g : 𝒵 ⟶ 𝒴` be
representable by algebraic spaces, surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation. Then `f`
has the relative property `P` of Stacks 03YK if and only if the projection to `𝒵` of a 2-fibre
product of the cospan `(g, f)` has it.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasRelativeProperty_iff_of_fppfCover
    (P : MorphismProperty (AlgebraicSpaces B S hS))
    [P.IsStableUnderBaseChange]
    [P.IsLocalAtTarget (Space.Topology.fppf.precoverage.{u, u} B S hS)]
    {𝒳 𝒴 𝒵 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS}
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒵 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hf : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom.hom)
    (hg : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS g.hom.hom)
    (hSurj : IsSurjective B S hS g)
    (hFlat : AlgebraicStacks.IsFlat B S hS g)
    (hLfp : AlgebraicStacks.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS g)
    (Q : Bicategory.TwoCommSq g f)
    (hQ : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct Q) :
    HasRelativeProperty B S hS P f.hom hf ↔
      ∃ hfst : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS Q.fst.hom.hom,
        HasRelativeProperty B S hS P Q.fst.hom hfst

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isDM_of_isDM_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TZ, the Deligne–Mumford case.** Let `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a 1-morphism of algebraic
stacks over `S` and let `g : 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴` be surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation with
`𝒴'` representable by an algebraic space. If the base change
`f' : 𝒳 ×_{f, 𝒴, g} 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴'` of `f` by `g` is Deligne–Mumford, so is `f`.

By Stacks 04YR the relative diagonal `Δ_{f'}` is a base change of `Δ_f` along `r × r`, and
unramifiedness in the relative sense of Stacks 03YK descends along `r × r` by Stacks 045D, whose
local essential surjectivity hypothesis is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.localEssSurj_diagonalMapDiag`. The representability witness is
Stacks 04XS part (1), which holds for every 1-morphism of algebraic stacks and so is not
descended.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDM_of_isDM_baseChange (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴)
    (h𝒴' : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace B S hS 𝒴'.val)
    (hgSurj : IsSurjective B S hS g)
    (hgFlat : AlgebraicStacks.IsFlat B S hS g)
    (hgLfp : AlgebraicStacks.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS g)
    (hf' : IsDM B S hS (twoFibreProductSquareAlgebraicStacks B S hS f g).snd) :
    IsDM B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isQuasiDM_of_isQuasiDM_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TZ, the quasi-DM case.** Let `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a 1-morphism of algebraic stacks over
`S` and let `g : 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴` be surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation with `𝒴'`
representable by an algebraic space. If the base change `f' : 𝒳 ×_{f, 𝒴, g} 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴'` of `f` by
`g` is quasi-DM, so is `f`.

The relative diagonal of the base change is a base change of `Δ_f` by Stacks 04YR, and local
quasi-finiteness of the represented base changes descends by Stacks 045D.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiDM_of_isQuasiDM_baseChange (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴)
    (h𝒴' : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace B S hS 𝒴'.val)
    (hgSurj : IsSurjective B S hS g)
    (hgFlat : AlgebraicStacks.IsFlat B S hS g)
    (hgLfp : AlgebraicStacks.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS g)
    (hf' : IsQuasiDM B S hS (twoFibreProductSquareAlgebraicStacks B S hS f g).snd) :
    IsQuasiDM B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isSeparated_of_isSeparated_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TZ, the separated case.** Let `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a 1-morphism of algebraic stacks over
`S` and let `g : 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴` be surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation with `𝒴'`
representable by an algebraic space. If the base change `f' : 𝒳 ×_{f, 𝒴, g} 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴'` of `f` by
`g` is separated, so is `f`.

The relative diagonal of the base change is a base change of `Δ_f` by Stacks 04YR, and properness
of the represented base changes descends by Stacks 045D, whose target-locality hypothesis is the
fppf form of Stacks 0422.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparated_of_isSeparated_baseChange (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴)
    (h𝒴' : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace B S hS 𝒴'.val)
    (hgSurj : IsSurjective B S hS g)
    (hgFlat : AlgebraicStacks.IsFlat B S hS g)
    (hgLfp : AlgebraicStacks.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS g)
    (hf' : IsSeparated B S hS (twoFibreProductSquareAlgebraicStacks B S hS f g).snd) :
    IsSeparated B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isQuasiSeparated_of_isQuasiSeparated_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06TZ, the quasi-separated case.** Let `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a 1-morphism of algebraic
stacks over `S` and let `g : 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴` be surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation with
`𝒴'` representable by an algebraic space. If the base change `f' : 𝒳 ×_{f, 𝒴, g} 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴'` of `f`
by `g` is quasi-separated, so is `f`.

The relative diagonal of the base change is a base change of `Δ_f` by Stacks 04YR, and the
conjunction of quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness of the represented base changes descends
by Stacks 045D — applied at the *conjunction*, read as a property of morphisms of algebraic
spaces, exactly as the definition of quasi-separatedness is, with both of that conjunction's
hypotheses formed as meets.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiSeparated_of_isQuasiSeparated_baseChange (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴)
    (h𝒴' : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace B S hS 𝒴'.val)
    (hgSurj : IsSurjective B S hS g)
    (hgFlat : AlgebraicStacks.IsFlat B S hS g)
    (hgLfp : AlgebraicStacks.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS g)
    (hf' : IsQuasiSeparated B S hS (twoFibreProductSquareAlgebraicStacks B S hS f g).snd) :
    IsQuasiSeparated B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.representable_universallyOpen_iff_openMap_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06U1.** For a 1-morphism `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of algebraic stacks over `S` which is
representable by algebraic spaces, the two conditions

1. `f` is universally open in the sense of Properties of Stacks, Section 04XB, that is
   `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.UniversallyOpen`; and
2. for every 1-morphism `g : 𝒵 ⟶ 𝒴` of algebraic stacks over `S` the map `|𝒵 ×_𝒴 𝒳| → |𝒵|` on the
   points of Stacks 04XG for the topology of Stacks 04XL is open, that is
   `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.UniversallyOpen`

are equivalent.
declarations.statement:
theorem representable_universallyOpen_iff_openMap_baseChange
    {𝒳 𝒴 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hf : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom.hom) :
    UniversallyOpen B S hS f.hom ↔ AlgebraicStacks.UniversallyOpen B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.IsOpen
declarations.doc:
A 1-morphism `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of algebraic stacks over `S` *is open* when the map `|𝒳| → |𝒴|` it
induces on the topological spaces of points is an open map.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsOpen {𝒳 𝒴 : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.UniversallyOpen
declarations.doc:
A 1-morphism `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of algebraic stacks over `S` *is universally open* when, for every
1-morphism `g : 𝒵 ⟶ 𝒴` of algebraic stacks over `S`, the base change `𝒵 ×_{g, 𝒴, f} 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒵` of `f`
by `g` is open in the sense of `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.IsOpen`.
declarations.statement: abbrev UniversallyOpen {𝒳 𝒴 : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.universallyOpen_baseChange_of_isTwoFibreProduct
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06U3.** Universal openness is stable under base change: let `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a
universally open 1-morphism of algebraic stacks over `S` and let `R` be a 2-fibre product square
of the cospan `(g, f)` for some `g : 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴`. Then the base change `R.fst : R.pt ⟶ 𝒴'` of `f`
along `g` is universally open.

The square is arbitrary, so this applies to any square a consumer has already exhibited as a
2-fibre product rather than only to the canonical one of Stacks 04T2.
declarations.statement:
theorem universallyOpen_baseChange_of_isTwoFibreProduct
    {𝒳 𝒴 𝒴' : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} {f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴} {g : 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴}
    (R : Bicategory.TwoCommSq g f) (hR : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct R)
    (hf : UniversallyOpen B S hS f) :
    UniversallyOpen B S hS R.fst

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isOpen_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06U4.** The composite of two open 1-morphisms of algebraic stacks over `S` is
open.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.universallyOpen_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06U4.** The composite of two universally open 1-morphisms of algebraic stacks over
`S` is universally open.
declarations.statement:
theorem universallyOpen_comp {𝒳 𝒴 𝒵 : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS}
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒴 ⟶ 𝒵)
    (hf : UniversallyOpen B S hS f) (hg : UniversallyOpen B S hS g) :
    UniversallyOpen B S hS (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.IsSubmersive
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06U6, part (1).** A 1-morphism of algebraic stacks over `S` *is submersive* when the
map `|𝒳| → |𝒴|` it induces on the topological spaces of points of Stacks 04XG and 04XL is a
quotient map, which is submersiveness in the sense of Stacks 0406.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsSubmersive {𝒳 𝒴 : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.IsUniversallySubmersive
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06U6, part (2).** A 1-morphism `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of algebraic stacks over `S` *is
universally submersive* when, for every 1-morphism `g : 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴` of algebraic stacks over `S`, the
base change `𝒴' ×_{g, 𝒴, f} 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴'` of `f` by `g` is submersive in the sense of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.IsSubmersive`.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsUniversallySubmersive {𝒳 𝒴 : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isLocallyOfFiniteType_of_baseChange_algebraicSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06U7.** Let `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a 1-morphism of algebraic stacks over `S` and let
`g : W ⟶ 𝒴` be surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation, where `W` is an algebraic
space over `S`. If the base change `W ×_𝒴 𝒳 ⟶ W` of `f` along `g` is locally of finite type,
then so is `f`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyOfFiniteType_of_baseChange_algebraicSpace
    {𝒳 𝒴 : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (W : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hW : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS W)
    (g : Stack.algebraicSpaceStack.{u, w} B S hS W hW ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hgsurj : Stack.IsSurjective B S hS g)
    (hgflat : IsFlat B S hS g)
    (hglfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS g)
    (hbase : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS
      (Stack.twoFibreProductSquareAlgebraicStacks B S hS f g).snd) :
    IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isLocallyOfFiniteType_of_comp_of_fppf
declarations.doc:
Let `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` and `g : 𝒴 ⟶ 𝒵` be 1-morphisms of algebraic stacks over
`S`. If `f ≫ g` is locally of finite type and `f` is representable by algebraic spaces,
surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation, then `g` is locally of finite type.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyOfFiniteType_of_comp_of_fppf
    {𝒳 𝒴 𝒵 : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒴 ⟶ 𝒵)
    (hfg : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS (f ≫ g))
    (hf : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom.hom)
    (hfsurj : IsSurjective B S hS f)
    (hfflat : IsFlat B S hS f)
    (hflfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f) :
    IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS g

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isLocallyOfFiniteType_of_comp
declarations.doc:
Let `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` and `g : 𝒴 ⟶ 𝒵` be 1-morphisms of algebraic stacks over `S`. If `f ≫ g` is
locally of finite type, then so is `f`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyOfFiniteType_of_comp
    {𝒳 𝒴 𝒵 : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒴 ⟶ 𝒵)
    (hfg : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS (f ≫ g)) :
    IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isLocallyOfFiniteType_and_discreteTopology_of_isLocallyQuasiFinite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06UA, the implication (1) ⟹ (2).** A 1-morphism of algebraic stacks over `S` which is
representable by algebraic spaces and locally quasi-finite in the sense of **Stacks 04XB** is
locally of finite type, and the fibre of it over every field-valued point of the target has
discrete space of points.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyOfFiniteType_and_discreteTopology_of_isLocallyQuasiFinite
    {𝒳 𝒴 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hf : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom.hom)
    (h : IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS f.hom) :
    AlgebraicStacks.IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f ∧
      ∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] (hk : B.Contains (Spec (.of k)))
        (toBase : Spec (.of k) ⟶ S)
        (g : schemeStack.{u, w} B S hS (Over.mk (⟨toBase⟩ : B.obj hk ⟶ B.obj hS)) ⟶ 𝒴),
        DiscreteTopology
          (points B S hS (twoFibreProductSquareAlgebraicStacks B S hS f g).pt.val.val
            (twoFibreProductSquareAlgebraicStacks B S hS f g).pt.val.property)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isLocallyQuasiFinite_of_isLocallyOfFiniteType_of_discreteTopology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06UA, the implication (2) ⟹ (1).** A 1-morphism of algebraic stacks over `S` which is
representable by algebraic spaces, locally of finite type, and whose fibre over every field-valued
point of the target has discrete space of points, is locally quasi-finite in the sense of
**Stacks 04XB**.

One scheme atlas of `𝒴` suffices by **Stacks 04XD**, and for the base change of `f` along it the
criterion of **Stacks 06RW** applies: it is locally of finite type by **Stacks 04XC** and its
field-valued fibres are fibres of `f`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyQuasiFinite_of_isLocallyOfFiniteType_of_discreteTopology
    {𝒳 𝒴 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hf : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom.hom)
    (hft : AlgebraicStacks.IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f)
    (hfib : ∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] (hk : B.Contains (Spec (.of k)))
      (toBase : Spec (.of k) ⟶ S)
      (g : schemeStack.{u, w} B S hS (Over.mk (⟨toBase⟩ : B.obj hk ⟶ B.obj hS)) ⟶ 𝒴),
      DiscreteTopology
        (points B S hS (twoFibreProductSquareAlgebraicStacks B S hS f g).pt.val.val
          (twoFibreProductSquareAlgebraicStacks B S hS f g).pt.val.property)) :
    IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS f.hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isLocallyQuasiFinite_iff_isLocallyOfFiniteType_and_discreteTopology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06UA.** A 1-morphism `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of algebraic stacks over `S` which is representable
by algebraic spaces is locally quasi-finite in the sense of **Stacks 04XB** exactly when it is
locally of finite type and for every field-valued point of `𝒴` the fibre of `f` over it has
discrete space of points.

The right-hand side is the conjunction of the second and third clauses of **Stacks 06PU**.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyQuasiFinite_iff_isLocallyOfFiniteType_and_discreteTopology
    {𝒳 𝒴 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hf : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom.hom) :
