    [∀ G : 𝒳ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{t}, F.op.HasPointwiseLeftKanExtension G]
    [HasSheafify (associatedTopology B S hS q τ) AddCommGrpCat.{t}]
    [(associatedTopology B S hS q τ).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{t}]
    (I : SheafOfModules.{t} (ringStructureSheafCore B S hS q hq τ hτ)) [Injective I] :
    letI : p.IsFibered := hp.isFibered
    letI : q.IsFibered := hq.isFibered
    letI := ((hq.isFibredOneMorphism hcomp).isContinuous_and_isCocontinuous_inheritedTopology
      (τ.over (B.obj hS))).1
    Injective ((SheafOfModules.pushforward.{t}
      (ringStructureSheafCoreHom B S hS p q F τ hp hq hcomp hτ)).obj I)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isRightAdjoint_sheafOfModules_pushforward
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06X2, existence of `f_!`.** Inverse image of sheaves of modules along a
1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids over the big fppf category of a scheme has a left
adjoint `f_!`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRightAdjoint_sheafOfModules_pushforward
    [EssentiallySmall.{t} 𝒳] [EssentiallySmall.{t} 𝒴] [UnivLE.{u, t}]
    (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hq : q.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hcomp : F ⋙ q = p)
    (hτ : τ ≤ B.topology) :
    letI : p.IsFibered := hp.isFibered
    letI : q.IsFibered := hq.isFibered
    letI := ((hq.isFibredOneMorphism hcomp).isContinuous_and_isCocontinuous_inheritedTopology
      (τ.over (B.obj hS))).1
    (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{t}
      (ringStructureSheafCoreHom B S hS p q F τ hp hq hcomp hτ)).IsRightAdjoint
declarations.comment: f^* on sheaves of modules has a left adjoint f_!

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.lowerShriekModulesForgetIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06X2, comparison with abelian sheaves.** The lower shriek `f_!` of sheaves of
modules along a 1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids agrees, on underlying abelian
sheaves, with the lower shriek of abelian sheaves of Stacks 06X1.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def lowerShriekModulesForgetIso
    [EssentiallySmall.{t} 𝒳] [EssentiallySmall.{t} 𝒴] [UnivLE.{u, t}]
    (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hq : q.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hcomp : F ⋙ q = p)
    (hτ : τ ≤ B.topology) :
    letI : p.IsFibered := hp.isFibered
    letI : q.IsFibered := hq.isFibered
    letI := ((hq.isFibredOneMorphism hcomp).isContinuous_and_isCocontinuous_inheritedTopology
      (τ.over (B.obj hS))).1
    letI := isRightAdjoint_sheafOfModules_pushforward.{u, v₁, v₂, w₁, w₂, t}
      B S hS p q F τ hp hq hcomp hτ
    letI := fun G : 𝒳ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{t} ↦
      Functor.hasPointwiseLeftKanExtension_of_essentiallySmall_of_locallySmall.{t} F.op G
    letI := hasSheafify_associatedTopology_of_essentiallySmall.{u, v₂, w₂, t} B S hS q τ
    SheafOfModules.pullback.{t} (ringStructureSheafCoreHom B S hS p q F τ hp hq hcomp hτ) ⋙
        SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{t} (ringStructureSheafCore B S hS q hq τ hτ) ≅
      SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{t} (ringStructureSheafCore B S hS p hp τ hτ) ⋙
        Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback F AddCommGrpCat.{t}
          (associatedTopology B S hS p τ) (associatedTopology B S hS q τ)
declarations.comment: f_! on sheaves of modules agrees with f_! on abelian sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exactFunctor_sheafOfModules_pullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06X2, part (1).** For a faithful 1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids
whose source has equalizers, the lower shriek `f_!` of sheaves of modules is exact.
declarations.statement:
theorem exactFunctor_sheafOfModules_pullback
    [EssentiallySmall.{t} 𝒳] [EssentiallySmall.{t} 𝒴] [UnivLE.{u, t}]
    (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hq : q.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hcomp : F ⋙ q = p)
    (hτ : τ ≤ B.topology) [F.Faithful] [HasEqualizers 𝒳] :
    letI : p.IsFibered := hp.isFibered
    letI : q.IsFibered := hq.isFibered
    letI := ((hq.isFibredOneMorphism hcomp).isContinuous_and_isCocontinuous_inheritedTopology
      (τ.over (B.obj hS))).1
    letI := isRightAdjoint_sheafOfModules_pushforward.{u, v₁, v₂, w₁, w₂, t}
      B S hS p q F τ hp hq hcomp hτ
    exactFunctor _ _
      (SheafOfModules.pullback.{t}
        (ringStructureSheafCoreHom B S hS p q F τ hp hq hcomp hτ))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.injective_sheafOfModules_pushforward_obj_of_injective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06X2, part (2).** For a faithful 1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids
whose source has equalizers, the inverse image of an injective sheaf of modules is an injective
sheaf of modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem injective_sheafOfModules_pushforward_obj_of_injective
    [EssentiallySmall.{t} 𝒳] [EssentiallySmall.{t} 𝒴] [UnivLE.{u, t}]
    (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hq : q.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hcomp : F ⋙ q = p)
    (hτ : τ ≤ B.topology) [F.Faithful] [HasEqualizers 𝒳]
    (I : SheafOfModules.{t} (ringStructureSheafCore B S hS q hq τ hτ)) [Injective I] :
    letI : p.IsFibered := hp.isFibered
    letI : q.IsFibered := hq.isFibered
    letI := ((hq.isFibredOneMorphism hcomp).isContinuous_and_isCocontinuous_inheritedTopology
      (τ.over (B.obj hS))).1
    Injective ((SheafOfModules.pushforward.{t}
      (ringStructureSheafCoreHom B S hS p q F τ hp hq hcomp hτ)).obj I)

registrations.name: SheafOfModules.instIsRightAdjointPushforward
registrations.comment: the adjunction f_! ⊣ f^* on modules

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeCech.isEquivalence_fibreProductToNerve
declarations.doc:
The degree `n + 1` piece of the Čech nerve of a covering `f : U ⥤ X` is the 2-fibre product
`U ×_X U_n` of the covering with the degree `n` piece: prepending a coordinate is an equivalence
of categories.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isEquivalence_fibreProductToNerve (n : ℕ) :
    (fibreProductToNerve p f n).IsEquivalence
declarations.comment: the nerve in degree n + 1 is the 2-fibre product of the covering with degree n

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeCech.isEquivalence_coordinate_zero
declarations.doc:
The degree `0` piece of the Čech nerve of a covering `f : U ⥤ X` is the covering `U` itself:
reading off the single coordinate of a tuple is an equivalence of categories.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isEquivalence_coordinate_zero :
    (Tuple.coordinate p f (0 : Fin 1)).IsEquivalence
declarations.comment: the nerve in degree zero is the covering

declarations.name: Stacks.Cech.complexPullbackMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06X5 (1).** A `2`-commutative square of coverings over the base induces a morphism
of Čech complexes `Č(U → X, F) ⟶ Č(V → Y, e⁻¹F)`, given in degree `n` by pullback along the
induced functor `V_n ⥤ U_n` of Čech nerves.
declarations.statement: public def complexPullbackMap : complex pX f F ⟶ complex pY g (e.op ⋙ F)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cech.complexPullbackMap_π
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06X5 (1).** The morphism of Čech complexes is pullback along the induced functor of
Čech nerves, degreewise on the limit cones.
declarations.statement:
public theorem complexPullbackMap_π (n : ℕ) (a : Tuple pY g n) :
    (complexPullbackMap pX pY f g h e α he hα F).f n ≫
        limit.π ((Tuple.projection pY g n).op ⋙ e.op ⋙ F) (op a) =
      limit.π ((Tuple.projection pX f n).op ⋙ F)
        (op ((nerveMap pX pY f g h e α he hα n).obj a))

declarations.name: Stacks.Cech.isIso_complexPullbackMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06X5 (2).** If the two horizontal functors of the square are equivalences, the
morphism of Čech complexes of part (1) is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_complexPullbackMap [h.IsEquivalence] [e.IsEquivalence]
    (hpV : (g ⋙ pY).IsFiberedInGroupoids) :
    IsIso (complexPullbackMap pX pY f g h e α he hα F)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cech.nonempty_complexIso_of_natIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06X5 (3).** `2`-isomorphic coverings `f, f' : U ⥤ X` have isomorphic Čech
complexes.
declarations.statement:
public theorem nonempty_complexIso_of_natIso [Preadditive A] (p : X ⥤ C) (f f' : U ⥤ X)
    (α : f ≅ f') (hα : ∀ u : U, p.IsHomLift (𝟙 (p.obj (f.obj u))) (α.hom.app u))
    (hpU' : (f' ⋙ p).IsFiberedInGroupoids) (F : Xᵒᵖ ⥤ A)
    [∀ n : ℕ, HasLimitsOfShape (Tuple p f n)ᵒᵖ A]
    [∀ n : ℕ, HasLimitsOfShape (Tuple p f' n)ᵒᵖ A] :
    Nonempty (complex p f F ≅ complex p f' F)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cech.nonempty_homotopy_extendedComplex_id_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06X6.** If there is a `1`-morphism `s : X ⥤ U` such that `f ∘ s` is `2`-isomorphic
to `id_X`, then the extended Čech complex is homotopic to zero: its identity is homotopic to its
zero endomorphism.

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeCech.complex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06X8.** The relative Čech complex of an abelian presheaf for a functor over a
base category: the alternating-coface complex of the relative Čech cosimplicial presheaf.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def complex (F : Xᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max uU uX vX w}) :
    CochainComplex (Xᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max uU uX vX w}) ℕ

declarations.name: Stacks.presheafPullbackMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06X8.** The canonical map from the direct image of a presheaf along `f` to the
direct image along `h ⋙ f` of its restriction along `h`: the direct image of the adjunction
unit for `h`, followed by the comparison from iterated direct image to direct image along the
composite.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def presheafPullbackMap (G : Uᵒᵖ ⥤ A) :
    f.op.ran.obj G ⟶ (h.op ⋙ f.op).ran.obj (h.op ⋙ G)
declarations.comment: the pullback map on presheaf direct images

declarations.name: Stacks.presheafPullbackMap_natural
declarations.doc: **Stacks 06X8.** The presheaf pullback map is natural in the presheaf.
declarations.statement:
public theorem presheafPullbackMap_natural {G H : Uᵒᵖ ⥤ A} (α : G ⟶ H) :
    f.op.ran.map α ≫ presheafPullbackMap f h H =
      presheafPullbackMap f h G ≫
        (h.op ⋙ f.op).ran.map (Functor.whiskerLeft h.op α)
declarations.comment: naturality of the pullback map on presheaf direct images

declarations.name: Stacks.presheafPullbackMap_whiskerLeft_ranCounit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06X8.** The defining property of the presheaf pullback map against the
Kan-extension counits: restricting the counit of `f` along `h` factors through it.
declarations.statement:
public theorem presheafPullbackMap_whiskerLeft_ranCounit (G : Xᵒᵖ ⥤ A) :
    Functor.whiskerLeft h.op (f.op.ranCounit.app (f.op ⋙ G)) =
      Functor.whiskerLeft (h.op ⋙ f.op) (presheafPullbackMap f h (f.op ⋙ G)) ≫
        (h.op ⋙ f.op).ranCounit.app (h.op ⋙ f.op ⋙ G)
declarations.comment: the counit factorisation of the presheaf pullback map

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeCech.reindexMap_eq_presheafPullbackMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06X8.** Each reindexing map of the relative Čech complex of an abelian presheaf is
the canonical pullback map along the corresponding reindexing functor of relative Čech
tuples.
declarations.statement:
public theorem reindexMap_eq_presheafPullbackMap {U : Type uU} {X : Type uX} {C : Type uC}
    [Category.{vU} U] [Category.{vX} X] [Category.{vC} C] (p : X ⥤ C) (f : U ⥤ X)
    (F : Xᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max uU uX vX vU vC w}) {m n : ℕ} (φ : ⦋m⦌ ⟶ ⦋n⦌) :
    reindexMap.{vU, vX, vC, uU, uX, uC, max vU vC w} p f F φ =
      presheafPullbackMap (Tuple.projection p f m)
        (Tuple.reindex p f φ.toOrderHom) ((Tuple.projection p f m).op ⋙ F)
declarations.comment: the Čech reindexing maps are pullback maps

declarations.name: Stacks.sheafPullbackMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06X8.** The canonical map from the direct image of a sheaf along `f` to the direct
image along `h ⋙ f` of its restriction along `h`, formed from the unit of the
restriction/direct-image adjunction for `h` and the direct-image compositor.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def sheafPullbackMap (G : Sheaf K A) :
    letI := isCocontinuous_comp h f J K (L := L)
    (f.sheafPushforwardCocontinuous A K L).obj G ⟶
      ((h ⋙ f).sheafPushforwardCocontinuous A J L).obj
        ((h.sheafPushforwardContinuous A J K).obj G)
declarations.comment: the pullback map on sheaf direct images

declarations.name: Stacks.sheafPullbackMap_hom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06X8.** The underlying presheaf morphism of the sheaf pullback map is the presheaf
pullback map.
declarations.statement:
public theorem sheafPullbackMap_hom (G : Sheaf K A) :
    letI : ∀ P : Vᵒᵖ ⥤ A, (h.op ⋙ f.op).HasRightKanExtension P :=
      fun P => inferInstanceAs ((h ⋙ f).op.HasRightKanExtension P)
    (sheafPullbackMap J K L f h G).hom = presheafPullbackMap f h G.obj
declarations.comment: agreement of the sheaf and presheaf pullback maps

declarations.name: Stacks.sheafPullbackMap_natural
declarations.doc: **Stacks 06X8.** The sheaf pullback map is natural in the sheaf.
declarations.statement:
public theorem sheafPullbackMap_natural {G H : Sheaf K A} (α : G ⟶ H) :
    letI := isCocontinuous_comp h f J K (L := L)
    (f.sheafPushforwardCocontinuous A K L).map α ≫ sheafPullbackMap J K L f h H =
      sheafPullbackMap J K L f h G ≫
        ((h ⋙ f).sheafPushforwardCocontinuous A J L).map
          ((h.sheafPushforwardContinuous A J K).map α)
declarations.comment: naturality of the pullback map on sheaf direct images

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeCech.baseChangeMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06X9, part (1).** The canonical comparison is assembled from the
right-Kan-extension adjunction in each Čech degree.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def baseChangeMap
    (F : Xᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max uU uX vX uV uY vY w}) :
    (((Functor.whiskeringLeft Yᵒᵖ Xᵒᵖ
      AddCommGrpCat.{max uU uX vX uV uY vY w}).obj e.op).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj
        (complex.{vU, vX, vC, uU, uX, uC, max uV uY vY w} pX f F) ⟶
      complex.{vV, vY, vC, uV, uY, uC, max uU uX vX w}
        (e ⋙ pX) g (e.op ⋙ F)

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeCech.isIso_baseChangeMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06X9, part (2).** If the two horizontal 1-morphisms `h` and `e` of the
square are equivalences, then the base-change morphism of part (1) is an
isomorphism of complexes of abelian presheaves.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_baseChangeMap
    [h.IsEquivalence] [e.IsEquivalence]
    (hpV : (g ⋙ e ⋙ pX).IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (F : Xᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max uU uX vX uV uY vY w}) :
    IsIso (baseChangeMap pX f e g h α hα F)

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeCech.nonempty_complexIso_of_natIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06X9, part (3).** 2-isomorphic 1-morphisms `f, f' : 𝒰 ⟶ 𝒳` over the
base have isomorphic relative Čech complexes.
declarations.statement:
public theorem nonempty_complexIso_of_natIso
    {C : Type uC} {X : Type uX} {U : Type uU} [Category.{vC} C] [Category.{vX} X]
    [Category.{vU} U] (pX : X ⥤ C) (f f' : U ⥤ X) (β : f ≅ f')
    (hβ : ∀ u : U, pX.IsHomLift (𝟙 (pX.obj (f.obj u))) (β.hom.app u))
    (hpU' : (f' ⋙ pX).IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (F : Xᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max uU uX vX w}) :
    Nonempty (complex pX f F ≅ complex pX f' F)

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeCech.nonempty_homotopy_extendedSheafComplex_id_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06XA.** If there is a `1`-morphism `s : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒰` such that `f ∘ s` is `2`-isomorphic
to `id_𝒳` by a vertical `2`-isomorphism, then the extended relative Čech complex is homotopic to
zero: its identity is homotopic to its zero endomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem nonempty_homotopy_extendedSheafComplex_id_zero
    (s : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒰) (α : s ⋙ f ≅ 𝟭 𝒳)
    (hα : ∀ x : 𝒳, q.IsHomLift (𝟙 (q.obj x)) (α.hom.app x)) :
    Nonempty (Homotopy
      (𝟙 (extendedSheafComplex.{u, vᵤ, vₓ, wᵤ, wₓ, t} B S hS q f τ 𝓕)) 0)

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeCech.nerveBaseChangeEquivalence
declarations.doc:
The Čech nerve of the base change of `f` to the slice over `p(x)` is, in each degree, the base
change of the Čech nerve of `f`.
declarations.statement:
public def nerveBaseChangeEquivalence (p : X ⥤ C) (f : U ⥤ X) (c : p.ChoiceOfPullbacks)
    {V : C} (x : p.Fiber V) (n : ℕ) :
    Tuple (Over.forget V)
        (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.forget V) (f ⋙ p) p (c.sliceFunctor x) f) n ≌
      TwoFibreProductOver (Over.forget V) (Tuple.projection p f n ⋙ p) p
        (c.sliceFunctor x) (Tuple.projection p f n)

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeCech.nerveBaseChangeEquivalence_functor_comp_fst
declarations.doc:
The first projection of the base change of the Čech nerve corresponds, under the equivalence,
to the projection of the Čech nerve of the base change.
declarations.statement:
public theorem nerveBaseChangeEquivalence_functor_comp_fst (p : X ⥤ C) (f : U ⥤ X)
    (c : p.ChoiceOfPullbacks) {V : C} (x : p.Fiber V) (n : ℕ) :
    (nerveBaseChangeEquivalence p f c x n).functor ⋙
        TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.forget V) (Tuple.projection p f n ⋙ p) p
          (c.sliceFunctor x) (Tuple.projection p f n) =
      Tuple.projection (Over.forget V)
        (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.forget V) (f ⋙ p) p (c.sliceFunctor x) f) n

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeCech.nerveBaseChangeEquivalence_functor_comp_snd
declarations.doc:
The second projection of the base change of the Čech nerve corresponds, under the equivalence,
to the `1`-morphism of Čech nerves of `Stacks.Cech.nerveMap`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem nerveBaseChangeEquivalence_functor_comp_snd (p : X ⥤ C) (f : U ⥤ X)
    (c : p.ChoiceOfPullbacks) {V : C} (x : p.Fiber V) (n : ℕ) :
    (nerveBaseChangeEquivalence p f c x n).functor ⋙
        TwoFibreProductOver.snd (Over.forget V) (Tuple.projection p f n ⋙ p) p
          (c.sliceFunctor x) (Tuple.projection p f n) =
      Cech.nerveMap p (Over.forget V) f
        (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.forget V) (f ⋙ p) p (c.sliceFunctor x) f)
        (TwoFibreProductOver.snd (Over.forget V) (f ⋙ p) p (c.sliceFunctor x) f)
        (c.sliceFunctor x)
        (TwoFibreProductOver.psiIso (Over.forget V) (f ⋙ p) p (c.sliceFunctor x) f).symm
        (c.sliceFunctor_comp x)
        (isHomLift_psi_inv (Over.forget V) p (c.sliceFunctor x) f) n

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeCech.complexSectionsIso
declarations.doc:
The value at an object `x` of `𝒳` of the relative Čech complex of `f` is canonically the Čech
complex of the base change of `f` to the slice `𝒞/p(x)`, which represents `x`. This is an
isomorphism of complexes: it is compatible with the Čech differentials.
declarations.statement:
public def complexSectionsIso (p : X ⥤ C) (f : U ⥤ X) (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (c : p.ChoiceOfPullbacks) {V : C} (x : p.Fiber V)
    (F : Xᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max uU uX uC vU vX vC w}) :
    (((evaluation Xᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{max uU uX uC vU vX vC w}).obj
          (op x.1)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj
        (complex.{vU, vX, vC, uU, uX, uC, max uC vC vU w} p f F) ≅
      Cech.complex (Over.forget V)
        (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.forget V) (f ⋙ p) p (c.sliceFunctor x) f)
        ((c.sliceFunctor x).op ⋙ F)

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeCech.complexSectionsIso_π
declarations.doc:
On a Čech tuple of the base-changed covering, the identification of complexes restricts a
relative section along the chosen pullback comparison of the tuple's target and then applies the
right-Kan-extension counit.
declarations.statement:
public theorem complexSectionsIso_π (p : X ⥤ C) (f : U ⥤ X) (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (c : p.ChoiceOfPullbacks) {V : C} (x : p.Fiber V)
    (F : Xᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max uU uX uC vU vX vC w}) (n : ℕ)
    (a : Tuple (Over.forget V)
      (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.forget V) (f ⋙ p) p (c.sliceFunctor x) f) n)
    (s : (term.{vU, vX, vC, uU, uX, uC, max uC vC vU w} p f F n).obj (op x.1)) :
    ((complexSectionsIso p f hp c x F).hom.f n ≫
        limit.π ((Tuple.projection (Over.forget V)
          (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.forget V) (f ⋙ p) p (c.sliceFunctor x) f) n).op ⋙
            (c.sliceFunctor x).op ⋙ F) (op a)) s =
      ((Tuple.projection p f n).op.ranCounit.app ((Tuple.projection p f n).op ⋙ F)).app
          (op ((Cech.nerveMap p (Over.forget V) f
            (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.forget V) (f ⋙ p) p (c.sliceFunctor x) f)
            (TwoFibreProductOver.snd (Over.forget V) (f ⋙ p) p (c.sliceFunctor x) f)
            (c.sliceFunctor x)
            (TwoFibreProductOver.psiIso (Over.forget V) (f ⋙ p) p (c.sliceFunctor x) f).symm
            (c.sliceFunctor_comp x)
            (isHomLift_psi_inv (Over.forget V) p (c.sliceFunctor x) f) n).obj a))
        ((term.{vU, vX, vC, uU, uX, uC, max uC vC vU w} p f F n).map
          (c.map a.target.hom x).op s)

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeCech.complexSectionsIso_naturality
declarations.doc:
The identification commutes in every degree with a morphism of coefficient presheaves; in
particular it is natural in the abelian presheaf.
declarations.statement:
public theorem complexSectionsIso_naturality (p : X ⥤ C) (f : U ⥤ X)
    (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (c : p.ChoiceOfPullbacks) {V : C} (x : p.Fiber V)
    (F G : Xᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max uU uX uC vU vX vC w}) (η : F ⟶ G) (n : ℕ) :
    ((Tuple.projection p f n).op.ran.map
          (Functor.whiskerLeft (Tuple.projection p f n).op η)).app (op x.1) ≫
        (complexSectionsIso p f hp c x G).hom.f n =
      (complexSectionsIso p f hp c x F).hom.f n ≫
        limMap (Functor.whiskerLeft ((Tuple.projection (Over.forget V)
          (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.forget V) (f ⋙ p) p (c.sliceFunctor x) f) n) ⋙
            c.sliceFunctor x).op η)

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeCech.isIso_baseChangeMap_of_isTwoFibreProduct
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06XC.** Base change along a 2-fibre-product square induces an
isomorphism of relative Čech complexes of abelian presheaves. The comparison
with the concrete 2-fibre product is required to be an equivalence, including
when its category of objects lives in a larger universe.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_baseChangeMap_of_isTwoFibreProduct
    {X₀ : Type uX} {U₀ : Type uU} {Y₀ : Type uY} {V₀ : Type uV}
    [Category.{vX} X₀] [Category.{vU} U₀]
    [Category.{vY} Y₀] [Category.{vV} V₀]
    (pX : X₀ ⥤ C) (pU : U₀ ⥤ C) (pY : Y₀ ⥤ C) (pV : V₀ ⥤ C)
    (f₀ : U₀ ⥤ X₀) (e₀ : Y₀ ⥤ X₀) (g₀ : V₀ ⥤ Y₀) (h₀ : V₀ ⥤ U₀)
    (hf : f₀ ⋙ pX = pU) (he : e₀ ⋙ pX = pY)
    (hg : g₀ ⋙ pY = pV) (hh : h₀ ⋙ pU = pV)
    (α : h₀ ⋙ f₀ ≅ g₀ ⋙ e₀)
    (hα : ∀ v : V₀, pX.IsHomLift
      (𝟙 (pX.obj (f₀.obj (h₀.obj v)))) (α.hom.app v))
    (hpX : pX.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hpU : pU.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (hpY : pY.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hpV : pV.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (hP : (TwoFibreProductOver.lift pU pY pX f₀ e₀ pV h₀ g₀
      hh hg α (by
        intro v
        have hv : pX.obj (f₀.obj (h₀.obj v)) = pV.obj v := by
          calc
            _ = pU.obj (h₀.obj v) := Functor.congr_obj hf _
            _ = pV.obj v := Functor.congr_obj hh _
        rw [← hv]
        exact hα v)).IsEquivalence)
    (F : X₀ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max uU uX vX uV uY vY w}) :
    IsIso (baseChangeMap pX f₀ e₀ g₀ h₀ α hα F)

declarations.name: Stacks.exact_of_exact_inverseImage_of_covering_image
declarations.doc:
Exactness of a complex of abelian sheaves can be checked after pullback to
a fibred category whose image covers the target locally.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exact_of_exact_inverseImage_of_covering_image
    (B : AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {𝒰 : Type vᵤ} [Category.{wᵤ} 𝒰]
    {𝒳 : Type vₓ} [Category.{wₓ} 𝒳]
    (p : 𝒰 ⥤ AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (q : 𝒳 ⥤ AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (F : 𝒰 ⥤ 𝒳)
    (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hq : q.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (hF : p.IsFibredOneMorphism q F)
    (τ : AlgebraicGeometry.SiteKind)
    (hcover : ∀ x : 𝒳, ∃ R : Sieve x,
      R ∈ AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS q τ x ∧
        ∀ ⦃y : 𝒳⦄ (g : y ⟶ x), R g →
          ∃ z : 𝒰, Nonempty (y ≅ F.obj z))
    (C : ShortComplex (CategoryTheory.Sheaf
      (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS q τ) Ab.{a})) :
    (letI : p.IsFibered := hp.isFibered
     letI : q.IsFibered := hq.isFibered
     letI := (hF.isContinuous_and_isCocontinuous_inheritedTopology
       ((AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSite.baseTopology B τ).over (B.obj hS))).1
     letI : (F.sheafPushforwardContinuous Ab.{a}
       (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS p τ)
       (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS q τ)).PreservesZeroMorphisms :=
       ⟨by intros; rfl⟩
     (C.map (F.sheafPushforwardContinuous Ab.{a}
       (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS p τ)
       (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS q τ))).Exact) → C.Exact

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeCech.mono_sheafAugmentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06XE.** Exactness of the extended relative Čech complex at its initial term: if the
image of `f` covers every object of `𝒳` locally, the augmentation of an abelian sheaf into degree
`0` of its sheafified relative Čech complex is a monomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem mono_sheafAugmentation
    (hcover : ∀ x : 𝒳, ∃ R : Presieve x,
      Sieve.generate R ∈ AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS q τ x ∧
        ∀ ⦃y : 𝒳⦄ (g : y ⟶ x), R g → ∃ z : 𝒰, Nonempty (y ≅ f.obj z))
    [HasSheafify (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS q τ)
      AddCommGrpCat.{max vᵤ vₓ wₓ t}]
    (𝓕 : Sheaf (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS q τ)
      AddCommGrpCat.{max vᵤ vₓ wₓ t}) :
    Mono (sheafAugmentation.{u, vᵤ, vₓ, wᵤ, wₓ, t} B S hS q f τ 𝓕)

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeCech.exact_sheafAugmentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06XE.** Exactness of the extended relative Čech complex in degree zero: if `f` is a
`1`-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids whose image covers every object of `𝒳` locally,
the augmentation of an abelian sheaf is the kernel of the first differential of its sheafified
relative Čech complex.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exact_sheafAugmentation
    (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hq : q.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (hf : p.IsFibredOneMorphism q f)
    (hcover : ∀ x : 𝒳, ∃ R : Presieve x,
      Sieve.generate R ∈ AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS q τ x ∧
        ∀ ⦃y : 𝒳⦄ (g : y ⟶ x), R g → ∃ z : 𝒰, Nonempty (y ≅ f.obj z))
    [HasSheafify (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS q τ)
      AddCommGrpCat.{max vᵤ vₓ wₓ t}]
    (𝓕 : Sheaf (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS q τ)
      AddCommGrpCat.{max vᵤ vₓ wₓ t}) :
    (ShortComplex.mk (sheafAugmentation.{u, vᵤ, vₓ, wᵤ, wₓ, t} B S hS q f τ 𝓕)
      ((sheafComplex.{u, vᵤ, vₓ, wᵤ, wₓ, t} B S hS q f τ 𝓕).d 0 1)
      (sheafAugmentation_comp_d.{u, vᵤ, vₓ, wᵤ, wₓ, t} B S hS q f τ 𝓕)).Exact

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeCech.exactAt_sheafComplex_succ
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06XE.** Exactness of the extended relative Čech complex in every positive degree: if
`f` is a `1`-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids whose image covers every object of `𝒳`
locally, the sheafified relative Čech complex of an abelian sheaf is exact in every positive
degree.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exactAt_sheafComplex_succ
    (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hq : q.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (hf : p.IsFibredOneMorphism q f)
    (hcover : ∀ x : 𝒳, ∃ R : Presieve x,
      Sieve.generate R ∈ AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS q τ x ∧
        ∀ ⦃y : 𝒳⦄ (g : y ⟶ x), R g → ∃ z : 𝒰, Nonempty (y ≅ f.obj z))
    [HasSheafify (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS q τ)
      AddCommGrpCat.{max vᵤ vₓ wₓ t}]
    (𝓕 : Sheaf (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS q τ)
      AddCommGrpCat.{max vᵤ vₓ wₓ t}) (n : ℕ) :
    (sheafComplex.{u, vᵤ, vₓ, wᵤ, wₓ, t} B S hS q f τ 𝓕).ExactAt (n + 1)

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeCech.exists_spectralSequenceData
declarations.doc:
For a faithful `1`-morphism `f : 𝒰 ⥤ 𝒳` of categories fibred in groupoids over the big fppf
site of `S`, with equalizers in `𝒰` and image covering `𝒳` locally, there is a first-quadrant
spectral sequence `E₁^{i,j} = Hʲ((𝒰ᵢ)_τ, fᵢ⁻¹𝓕) ⇒ Hⁱ⁺ʲ(𝒳_τ, 𝓕)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_spectralSequenceData
    (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hq : q.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (hf : p.IsFibredOneMorphism q f) [f.Faithful] [HasEqualizers 𝒰]
    (hcover : ∀ x : 𝒳, ∃ R : Presieve x,
      Sieve.generate R ∈ BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS q τ x ∧
        ∀ ⦃y : 𝒳⦄ (g : y ⟶ x), R g → ∃ z : 𝒰, Nonempty (y ≅ f.obj z))
    [HasSheafify (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS q τ)
      AddCommGrpCat.{max vᵤ vₓ wₓ a}]
    [HasExt.{b} (Sheaf (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS q τ)
      AddCommGrpCat.{max vᵤ vₓ wₓ a})]
    [∀ n : ℕ, HasSheafify
      (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS (Tuple.projection q f n ⋙ q) τ)
        AddCommGrpCat.{max vᵤ vₓ wₓ a}]
    [∀ n : ℕ, HasExt.{b} (Sheaf
      (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS (Tuple.projection q f n ⋙ q) τ)
        AddCommGrpCat.{max vᵤ vₓ wₓ a})]
    (𝓕 : Sheaf (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS q τ)
      AddCommGrpCat.{max vᵤ vₓ wₓ a}) :
    Nonempty (SpectralSequenceData (B := B) (S := S) (hS := hS)
      (q := q) (f := f) (τ := τ) 𝓕)

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeCech.exists_moduleSpectralSequenceData
declarations.doc:
For a faithful 1-morphism `f : 𝒰 ⥤ 𝒳` of categories fibred in groupoids over `(Sch/S)_fppf`
with equalizers in `𝒰`, whose image covers `𝒳` locally in the `τ`-topology, every sheaf of
`𝒪_𝒳`-modules `𝓕` has a first-quadrant spectral sequence of `Γ(𝒪_𝒳)`-modules
`E₁^{i,j} = Hʲ((𝒰ᵢ)_τ, fᵢ^*𝓕) ⇒ Hⁱ⁺ʲ(𝒳_τ, 𝓕)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_moduleSpectralSequenceData
    (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hq : q.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (hf : p.IsFibredOneMorphism q f) [f.Faithful] [HasEqualizers 𝒰]
    (hcover : ∀ x : 𝒳, ∃ R : Presieve x,
      Sieve.generate R ∈ AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS q τ x ∧
        ∀ ⦃y : 𝒳⦄ (g : y ⟶ x), R g →
          ∃ z : 𝒰, Nonempty (y ≅ f.obj z))
    (𝓕 : SheafOfModules.{max u vᵤ vₓ wᵤ wₓ a}
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.ringStructureSheafCore B S hS q hq (B.baseTopology τ)
        (B.baseTopology_le_topology τ))) :
    Nonempty (ModuleSpectralSequenceData.{u, vᵤ, vₓ, wᵤ, wₓ, a}
      B S hS q f τ hq 𝓕)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exists_singleton_fppf_lift
declarations.doc:
Let `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a 1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of
`S` which is representable by algebraic spaces, and assume that the structure morphism of the
algebraic space representing the base change of `f` along any scheme-valued point of `𝒴` is
surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation. Then every object `y` of `𝒴` admits a
morphism `f(x) ⟶ y` from the image of an object `x` of `𝒳` whose generated sieve covers `y` in
the associated fppf site of `𝒴`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_singleton_fppf_lift
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {𝒳 𝒴 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, v, u + 1, w} (BigFppfOver B S hS)} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hf : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom)
    (hsurj : ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (q : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ 𝒴.val.obj)
      (hq : q ⋙ 𝒴.val.p = Over.map U.hom),
      Space.IsSurjective B S hS (baseChangeStructureMap B S hS f.hom hf U q hq).hom)
    (hflat : ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (q : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ 𝒴.val.obj)
      (hq : q ⋙ 𝒴.val.p = Over.map U.hom),
      Space.IsFlat B S hS (baseChangeStructureMap B S hS f.hom hf U q hq).hom)
    (hlfp : ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (q : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ 𝒴.val.obj)
      (hq : q ⋙ 𝒴.val.p = Over.map U.hom),
      Space.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS
        (baseChangeStructureMap B S hS f.hom hf U q hq).hom)
    (y : 𝒴.val.obj) :
    ∃ (x : 𝒳.val.obj) (a : (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f).obj x ⟶ y),
      Sieve.generate (Presieve.singleton a) ∈ fppfTopology B S hS 𝒴 y
declarations.comment: part (1): fppf-local lifts along a surjective flat morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exists_etaleLocalLift
declarations.doc:
Let `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a surjective smooth 1-morphism of algebraic stacks. Then every object `y`
of `𝒴` admits an object `x` of `𝒳` and a morphism `f(x) ⟶ y` whose singleton generates a covering
sieve of the étale topology that `𝒴` inherits from the site.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_etaleLocalLift {𝒳 𝒴 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS f)
    (hsmooth : AlgebraicStacks.IsSmooth B S hS f)
    (y : 𝒴.val.val.obj) :
    ∃ (x : 𝒳.val.val.obj) (a : (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom).obj x ⟶ y),
      Sieve.generate (Presieve.singleton a) ∈
        BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS 𝒴.val.val.p .etale y
declarations.comment: part (2): étale-local lifts along a surjective smooth morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exists_etaleCovering_fibre_lift
declarations.doc:
Along a surjective smooth 1-morphism of algebraic stacks, every object of the base carries a
covering sieve of the étale topology over each of whose arrows the given object of the fibre
lifts.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_etaleCovering_fibre_lift {𝒳 𝒴 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS f)
    (hsmooth : AlgebraicStacks.IsSmooth B S hS f)
    (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (y : 𝒴.val.val.p.Fiber U) :
    ∃ R ∈ BigFppfOver.baseOverTopology B S hS .etale U,
      ∀ ⦃V : BigFppfOver B S hS⦄ ⦃k : V ⟶ U⦄, R.arrows k →
        ∃ (x : 𝒳.val.val.obj) (α : (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom).obj x ⟶ y.1),
          𝒴.val.val.p.IsHomLift k α
declarations.comment: part (2): étale covering of the base with a lift over every arrow

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exists_etaleLocalLift_of_representable
declarations.doc:
Let `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a 1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of
`S` which is representable by algebraic spaces, and suppose that every algebraic space
representing the base change of `f` along a scheme-valued point of `𝒴` has surjective and smooth
structural morphism. Then every object `y` of `𝒴` admits an object `x` of `𝒳` and a morphism
`a : f(x) ⟶ y` whose singleton generates a covering sieve of the étale topology `𝒴` inherits from
the site.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_etaleLocalLift_of_representable
    {𝒳 𝒴 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, v, u + 1, w} (BigFppfOver B S hS)} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hf : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom)
    (hprop : ∀ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS)
      (yv : BigFppfOver B V.left.1 V.left.2 ⥤ 𝒴.val.obj)
      (_hyv : yv ⋙ 𝒴.val.p = Over.map V.hom)
      (F : (BigFppfOver B V.left.1 V.left.2)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
      (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B V.left.1 V.left.2 F),
      Nonempty (StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
        (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.map V.hom) 𝒳.val.p 𝒴.val.p yv
          (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f))
        (presheafOfCategories (F ⋙ typeToCat)).p) →
      (let h := (algebraicSpaceMap B S hS V
        ((spacesOverSmallerBaseFunctor B V.left.1 S V.left.2 hS V.hom).obj ⟨F, hF⟩)).hom
       Space.IsSurjective B S hS h ∧ Space.IsSmooth B S hS h))
    (y : 𝒴.val.obj) :
    ∃ (x : 𝒳.val.obj) (a : (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f).obj x ⟶ y),
      Sieve.generate (Presieve.singleton a) ∈
        BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS 𝒴.val.p .etale y
declarations.comment: part (2) in full generality: étale-local lifts along a 1-morphism of CFGs

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exists_etaleCovering_fibre_lift_of_representable
declarations.doc:
Along a 1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids representable by algebraic spaces whose
base change along every scheme-valued point is surjective and smooth, every object of the base
carries a covering sieve of the étale topology over each of whose arrows the given object of the
fibre lifts.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_etaleCovering_fibre_lift_of_representable
    {𝒳 𝒴 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, v, u + 1, w} (BigFppfOver B S hS)} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hf : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom)
    (hprop : ∀ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS)
      (yv : BigFppfOver B V.left.1 V.left.2 ⥤ 𝒴.val.obj)
      (_hyv : yv ⋙ 𝒴.val.p = Over.map V.hom)
      (F : (BigFppfOver B V.left.1 V.left.2)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
      (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B V.left.1 V.left.2 F),
      Nonempty (StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
        (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.map V.hom) 𝒳.val.p 𝒴.val.p yv
          (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f))
        (presheafOfCategories (F ⋙ typeToCat)).p) →
      (let h := (algebraicSpaceMap B S hS V
        ((spacesOverSmallerBaseFunctor B V.left.1 S V.left.2 hS V.hom).obj ⟨F, hF⟩)).hom
       Space.IsSurjective B S hS h ∧ Space.IsSmooth B S hS h))
    (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (y : 𝒴.val.p.Fiber U) :
    ∃ R ∈ BigFppfOver.baseOverTopology B S hS .etale U,
      ∀ ⦃V : BigFppfOver B S hS⦄ ⦃k : V ⟶ U⦄, R.arrows k →
        ∃ (x : 𝒳.val.obj) (α : (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f).obj x ⟶ y.1),
          𝒴.val.p.IsHomLift k α
declarations.comment: part (2) in full generality, family form: an étale covering of the base

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exists_fppfLocalLift
declarations.doc:
Let `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a 1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of
`S` which is representable by algebraic spaces, and suppose that every algebraic space
representing the base change of `f` along a scheme-valued point of `𝒴` has surjective, flat and
locally finitely presented structural morphism. Then every object `y` of `𝒴` admits an object `x`
of `𝒳` and a morphism `a : f(x) ⟶ y` whose singleton generates a covering sieve of the fppf
topology `𝒴` inherits from the site.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_fppfLocalLift
    {𝒳 𝒴 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, v, u + 1, w} (BigFppfOver B S hS)} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hf : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom)
    (hprops : ∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS)
      (y : BigFppfOver B T.left.1 T.left.2 ⥤ 𝒴.val.obj)
      (_hy : y ⋙ 𝒴.val.p = Over.map T.hom)
      (F : (BigFppfOver B T.left.1 T.left.2)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
      (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B T.left.1 T.left.2 F),
      Nonempty (StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
        (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.map T.hom) 𝒳.val.p 𝒴.val.p y
          (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f))
        (presheafOfCategories (F ⋙ typeToCat)).p) →
      (let g := (algebraicSpaceMap B S hS T
        ((spacesOverSmallerBaseFunctor B T.left.1 S T.left.2 hS T.hom).obj ⟨F, hF⟩)).hom
       Space.IsSurjective B S hS g ∧ Space.IsFlat B S hS g ∧
         Space.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS g))
    (y : 𝒴.val.obj) :
    ∃ (x : 𝒳.val.obj) (a : (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f).obj x ⟶ y),
      Sieve.generate (Presieve.singleton a) ∈
        BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS 𝒴.val.p .fppf y

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.exists_etaleCechSpectralSequence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06XJ, part (1).** Let `f : 𝒰 ⟶ 𝒳` be a `1`-morphism of algebraic stacks which is
representable by algebraic spaces, surjective and smooth, and let `𝓕` be an abelian sheaf on the
étale site of `𝒳`. Then there is a first-quadrant spectral sequence
`E₁^{p,q} = H^q_étale(𝒰ₚ, fₚ⁻¹𝓕) ⇒ H^{p+q}_étale(𝒳, 𝓕)`, where
`𝒰ₚ = 𝒰 ×_𝒳 ⋯ ×_𝒳 𝒰` (`p + 1` factors) is the degree `p` term of the relative Čech nerve of `f`
and `fₚ : 𝒰ₚ ⟶ 𝒳` its projection; the first page, the first-quadrant vanishing and the
convergence to the étale cohomology of `𝓕` are the fields of
`Stacks.RelativeCech.SpectralSequenceData`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_etaleCechSpectralSequence
    (hrep : Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom.hom)
    (hsurj : Stack.IsSurjective B S hS f) (hsmooth : IsSmooth B S hS f)
    (𝓕 : Sheaf (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p SiteKind.etale)
      AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) a}) :
    Nonempty (Stacks.RelativeCech.SpectralSequenceData B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom) SiteKind.etale 𝓕)
declarations.comment: part (1): the étale spectral sequence of a presentation which is representable by algebraic spaces, surjective and smooth

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.exists_fppfCechSpectralSequence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06XJ, part (2).** Let `f : 𝒰 ⟶ 𝒳` be a `1`-morphism of algebraic stacks which is
representable by algebraic spaces, surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation, and let
`𝓕` be an abelian sheaf on (the fppf site of) `𝒳`. Then there is a first-quadrant spectral
sequence `E₁^{p,q} = H^q_fppf(𝒰ₚ, fₚ⁻¹𝓕) ⇒ H^{p+q}_fppf(𝒳, 𝓕)`, where
`𝒰ₚ = 𝒰 ×_𝒳 ⋯ ×_𝒳 𝒰` (`p + 1` factors) is the degree `p` term of the relative Čech nerve of `f`
and `fₚ : 𝒰ₚ ⟶ 𝒳` its projection; the first page, the first-quadrant vanishing and the
convergence to the fppf cohomology of `𝓕` are the fields of
`Stacks.RelativeCech.SpectralSequenceData`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_fppfCechSpectralSequence
    (hrep : Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom.hom)
    (hsurj : Stack.IsSurjective B S hS f) (hflat : IsFlat B S hS f)
    (hlfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f)
    (𝓕 : Sheaf (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p SiteKind.fppf)
      AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) a}) :
    Nonempty (Stacks.RelativeCech.SpectralSequenceData B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom) SiteKind.fppf 𝓕)
declarations.comment: part (2): the fppf spectral sequence of a presentation which is representable by algebraic spaces, surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.SerreClassLocalization.faithful_liftOfLeKernel_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06XK.** For an exact `F : A ⥤ B` and a Serre subcategory `C ⊂ A` contained in `Ker F`,
the induced functor `F̄ : A/C ⥤ B` is faithful exactly when `C` is all of `Ker F`.
declarations.statement:
theorem faithful_liftOfLeKernel_iff (hP : P ≤ F.kernel) :
    (liftOfLeKernel L P F hP).Faithful ↔ P = F.kernel

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.SerreClassLocalization.essSurj_mapDerivedCategory
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06XL.** Let `C` be an abelian category, let `P` be a Serre class in `C`, and let
`L : C ⥤ D` be a localization of `C` at the morphisms which become isomorphisms modulo `P`,
i.e. let `D` be the quotient abelian category `C/P`. Then the induced functor
`DerivedCategory C ⥤ DerivedCategory D` is essentially surjective.
declarations.statement:
public theorem SerreClassLocalization.essSurj_mapDerivedCategory
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} C]
    {D : Type u'} [Category.{v'} D] [Abelian D] [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} D]
    (L : C ⥤ D) (P : ObjectProperty C) [P.IsSerreClass] [L.IsLocalization P.isoModSerre]
    [L.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits L] [PreservesFiniteColimits L] :
    L.mapDerivedCategory.EssSurj

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.SerreClassLocalization.isLocalization_mapDerivedCategory_of_leftAdjoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06XM.** Let `𝒜` be an abelian category, let `ℬ ⊆ 𝒜` be a Serre subcategory (a Serre
class `P` of objects of `C = 𝒜`) and let `L : 𝒜 ⥤ 𝒜/ℬ` be the quotient functor, i.e. a
localization functor for `P.isoModSerre`. Assume `L` has a left adjoint `u` with `L ∘ u ≅ 𝟭`,
equivalently `u` fully faithful. Then `D(𝒜)/D_ℬ(𝒜) = D(𝒜/ℬ)`: the induced functor
`L.mapDerivedCategory : D(𝒜) ⥤ D(𝒜/ℬ)` is a localization functor for the class of morphisms of
`D(𝒜)` whose cone has all its cohomology objects in `ℬ`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem SerreClassLocalization.isLocalization_mapDerivedCategory_of_leftAdjoint
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} C]
    {D : Type u'} [Category.{v'} D] [Abelian D] [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} D]
    (L : C ⥤ D) (P : ObjectProperty C) [P.IsSerreClass]
    [L.IsLocalization P.isoModSerre] [L.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits L] [PreservesFiniteColimits L]
    {u : D ⥤ C} [u.Full] [u.Faithful] (adj : u ⊣ L) :
    L.mapDerivedCategory.IsLocalization
      (trW (fun X : DerivedCategory C ↦
        ∀ n : ℤ, P ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor C n).obj X)))

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.SerreClassLocalization.isLocalization_mapDerivedCategoryPlus_of_leftAdjoint
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 06XM], bounded below version.** In the situation of
`isLocalization_mapDerivedCategory_of_leftAdjoint` — `L : 𝒜 ⥤ 𝒜/ℬ` the quotient by a Serre
subcategory `ℬ = P`, with a fully faithful left adjoint `u` — the induced functor
`D⁺(𝒜) ⥤ D⁺(𝒜/ℬ)` is a localization functor for the morphisms of `D⁺(𝒜)` whose cone lies in
`D⁺_ℬ(𝒜)`, i.e. `D⁺(𝒜)/D⁺_ℬ(𝒜) = D⁺(𝒜/ℬ)`.

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.SerreClassLocalization.isLocalization_mapDerivedCategoryMinus_of_leftAdjoint
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 06XM], bounded above version.** `D⁻(𝒜)/D⁻_ℬ(𝒜) = D⁻(𝒜/ℬ)`: the induced
functor `D⁻(𝒜) ⥤ D⁻(𝒜/ℬ)` is a localization functor for the morphisms of `D⁻(𝒜)` whose cone
lies in `D⁻_ℬ(𝒜)`.

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.SerreClassLocalization.isLocalization_mapDerivedCategoryBounded_of_leftAdjoint
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 06XM], bounded version.** `Dᵇ(𝒜)/Dᵇ_ℬ(𝒜) = Dᵇ(𝒜/ℬ)`: the induced functor
`Dᵇ(𝒜) ⥤ Dᵇ(𝒜/ℬ)` is a localization functor for the morphisms of `Dᵇ(𝒜)` whose cone lies in
`Dᵇ_ℬ(𝒜)`.

declarations.name: Stacks.DerivedFunctor.Computing.rightDerived_everywhereDefined_and_computes
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be a saturated multiplicative system on `D` admitting a left calculus of fractions,
and `F : D ⥤ D'` a functor. Suppose there is a subset `I ⊆ Ob(D)` such that:
1. for all `X` there is an arrow `s : X → X'` in `S` with `X' ∈ I`; and
2. for every arrow `s : X → X'` in `S` with `X, X' ∈ I`, `F.map s` is an isomorphism.

Then `RF` is everywhere defined, and every `X ∈ I` computes `RF`.
declarations.statement:
theorem rightDerived_everywhereDefined_and_computes
    (F : D ⥤ D') (S : MorphismProperty D)
    [S.HasLeftCalculusOfFractions]
    (hSat : S.IsSaturatedMultiplicative)
    (I : Set D)
    (h1 : ∀ X : D, ∃ (X' : D) (s : X ⟶ X'), S s ∧ X' ∈ I)
    (h2 : ∀ ⦃X X' : D⦄ (s : X ⟶ X'), S s → X ∈ I → X' ∈ I → IsIso (F.map s)) :
    F.IsRightDerivable S ∧ ∀ X ∈ I, F.ComputesRightDerived S X

declarations.name: Stacks.DerivedFunctor.Computing.leftDerived_everywhereDefined_and_computes
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be a saturated multiplicative system on `D` admitting a right calculus of fractions,
and `F : D ⥤ D'` a functor. Suppose there is a subset `P ⊆ Ob(D)` such that:
1. for all `X` there is an arrow `s : X' → X` in `S` with `X' ∈ P`; and
2. for every arrow `s : X → X'` in `S` with `X, X' ∈ P`, `F.map s` is an isomorphism.

Then `LF` is everywhere defined, and every `X ∈ P` computes `LF`.
declarations.statement:
theorem leftDerived_everywhereDefined_and_computes
    (F : D ⥤ D') (S : MorphismProperty D)
    [S.HasRightCalculusOfFractions]
    (hSat : S.IsSaturatedMultiplicative)
    (P : Set D)
    (h1 : ∀ X : D, ∃ (X' : D) (s : X' ⟶ X), S s ∧ X' ∈ P)
    (h2 : ∀ ⦃X X' : D⦄ (s : X ⟶ X'), S s → X ∈ P → X' ∈ P → IsIso (F.map s)) :
    F.IsLeftDerivable S ∧ ∀ X ∈ P, F.ComputesLeftDerived S X

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.DerivedCategory.Ext
declarations.doc:
The `i`-th extension group `Ext^i_𝒜(X, Y) = Hom_{D(𝒜)}(X, Y⟦i⟧)` of an object `X` of the
derived category `D(𝒜)` of an abelian category `𝒜` by an object `Y`, for `i : ℤ`. It is
canonically identified with `Hom_{D(𝒜)}(X⟦-i⟧, Y)` via the adjunction between the shifts
`⟦-i⟧ ⊣ ⟦i⟧`.
declarations.statement: public noncomputable abbrev DerivedCategory.Ext (X Y : DerivedCategory C) (i : ℤ) : Type _

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Abelian.zExt
declarations.doc:
The `i`-th extension group `Ext^i_𝒜(A, B) = Ext^i_𝒜(A[0], B[0])` of an object `A` of an
abelian category `𝒜` by an object `B`, for `i : ℤ`, where `A[0]` is the image of `A` under
`𝒜 ⥤ D(𝒜)`, the complex concentrated in degree `0`. For `i = (n : ℕ)` this is Mathlib's
`CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext A B n`, up to the equivalence `Abelian.Ext.homEquiv`.
declarations.statement: public noncomputable abbrev Abelian.zExt (A B : C) (i : ℤ) : Type _

declarations.name: DerivedCategory.surjective_extZero_comp_iff_surjective_comp
declarations.doc:
Precomposition with `ξ` is surjective on degree-zero `Ext` groups into `Y` exactly when it
is surjective on morphisms into `Y`. In degree `0` an `Ext` class *is* a morphism, by
`CategoryTheory.ShiftedHom.homEquiv`, and the identification commutes with precomposition.
declarations.statement:
public theorem surjective_extZero_comp_iff_surjective_comp
    {E X : DerivedCategory C} (ξ : E ⟶ X) (Y : DerivedCategory C) :
    Function.Surjective (fun α : DerivedCategory.Ext X Y 0 => ξ ≫ α) ↔
      Function.Surjective (fun f : X ⟶ Y => ξ ≫ f)

declarations.name: ExtByResolutions.ext_via_injective_resolution_bijective
declarations.doc:
Statement 1 (Stacks 06XR, part 1): computing Ext via an injective resolution.
Given an injective resolution `f : Y ⟶ I` (Definition 2), the canonical map
`canMapOfInjectiveResolution` (induced by `f`) is a bijection
  `Hom_{K(A)}(X, I[i]) → Hom_{D(A)}(Q(X), Q(Y)[i])`.
This is the canonical identification
  `Ext^i_A(X, Y) = Hom_{D(A)}(Q(X), Q(Y)[i]) ≅ Hom_{K(A)}(X, I[i])`.
declarations.statement:
theorem ext_via_injective_resolution_bijective
    (X Y I : CochainComplex C ℤ) (i : ℤ)
    {f : Y ⟶ I} (hf : IsInjectiveResolution f) :
    haveI := hf.quasiIso
    Function.Bijective (canMapOfInjectiveResolution X Y I i f)

declarations.name: ExtByResolutions.ext_via_projective_resolution_bijective
declarations.doc:
Statement 2 (Stacks 06XR, part 2): computing Ext via a projective resolution.
Given a projective resolution `g : P ⟶ X` (Definition 3), the canonical map
`canMapOfProjectiveResolution` (induced by `g`) is a bijection
  `Hom_{K(A)}(P[-i], Y) → Hom_{D(A)}(Q(X), Q(Y)[i])`.
This is the canonical identification
  `Ext^i_A(X, Y) = Hom_{D(A)}(Q(X), Q(Y)[i]) ≅ Hom_{K(A)}(P[-i], Y)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem ext_via_projective_resolution_bijective
    (X Y P : CochainComplex C ℤ) (i : ℤ)
    {g : P ⟶ X} (hg : IsProjectiveResolution g) :
    haveI := hg.quasiIso
    Function.Bijective (canMapOfProjectiveResolution X Y P i g)

declarations.name: DerivedCategory.bijective_homologyFunctor_shiftMap_of_isLE_of_isGE
declarations.doc:
Let `𝒜` be an abelian category and let `X`, `Y` be objects of `D(𝒜)` such that
`H^i(X) = 0` for `i > a` and `H^j(Y) = 0` for `j < b`. If `n + a = a'` and `a' ≤ b`, then taking
homology in degree `a`,
`Ext^n_𝒜(X, Y) = Hom_{D(𝒜)}(X, Y⟦n⟧) → Hom_𝒜(H^a(X), H^{a'}(Y))`,
is bijective. For `a' < b` the target is the zero group, so this says that
`Ext^n_𝒜(X, Y) = 0` for `n < b - a`; for `a' = b` it is the identification
`Ext^{b - a}_𝒜(X, Y) = Hom_𝒜(H^a(X), H^b(Y))`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem bijective_homologyFunctor_shiftMap_of_isLE_of_isGE
    (X Y : DerivedCategory C) (a b n a' : ℤ) [X.IsLE a] [Y.IsGE b]
    (ha' : n + a = a') (hab : a' ≤ b) :
    Function.Bijective (fun f : DerivedCategory.Ext X Y n ↦
      ((homologyFunctor C 0).shiftMap f a a' ha' :
        (homologyFunctor C a).obj X ⟶ (homologyFunctor C a').obj Y))

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Abelian.YonedaExtension
declarations.doc:
A *degree `n + 1` Yoneda extension of `B` by `A`* in an abelian category `𝒜` is an exact
sequence `0 → A → Z_n → Z_{n - 1} → ⋯ → Z_0 → B → 0` in `𝒜`. It is given by the sequence
`Z : Fin (n + 1) ⥤ 𝒜` of its middle terms, `Z.obj' k = Z_{n - k}`, together with the outer
maps `f : A ⟶ Z.left = Z_n` and `g : Z.right = Z_0 ⟶ B`, and by the exactness of the sequence
at each of `A`, `Z_n, …, Z_0` and `B`. For `n = 0` this is a short exact sequence
`0 → A → Z_0 → B → 0`.
declarations.statement: public structure YonedaExtension (B A : 𝒜) (n : ℕ)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Abelian.YonedaExtension.Equivalent
declarations.doc:
Two degree `n + 1` Yoneda extensions `E`, `E'` of `B` by `A` in an abelian category are
*equivalent* if there exists a degree `n + 1` Yoneda extension `E''` of `B` by `A` and maps
`φ : E''.Z ⟶ E.Z` and `ψ : E''.Z ⟶ E'.Z` of the middle terms which are compatible with the
maps from `A` and the maps to `B`, i.e. such that the two diagrams obtained by putting `E''`
between `E` and `E'` commute, with the identity on `A` and on `B`.
declarations.statement: public def YonedaExtension.Equivalent (E E' : YonedaExtension B A n) : Prop

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Abelian.eq_of_isExtClassMap
declarations.doc:
There is at most one class map: the degree `1` values are prescribed, and cutting an
extension at its left end computes the value in degree `n + 2` from a value in degree `n + 1`.
declarations.statement:
lemma eq_of_isExtClassMap
    (δ₁ δ₂ : ∀ (B A : 𝒜) (n : ℕ), YonedaExtension B A n → Ext.{w} B A (n + 1))
    (h₁ : IsExtClassMap δ₁) (h₂ : IsExtClassMap δ₂) : δ₁ = δ₂

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Abelian.extClassMap
declarations.doc:
**The class of a Yoneda extension.** It is defined by recursion on the degree: in degree `1`
it is the class `CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.ShortExact.extClass` of the short exact sequence
the extension is, and in degree `n + 2` it is the class of the extension cut at its left end
(`cut`) composed with the class of the cutting short exact sequence
(`shortExact_cut`). It is the unique such map: `isExtClassMap_extClassMap` is the pair of
properties and `eq_of_isExtClassMap` their uniqueness.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def extClassMap {B : 𝒜} :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) {A : 𝒜}, YonedaExtension B A n → Ext.{w} B A (n + 1)
declarations.comment: the class map δ itself; `isExtClassMap_extClassMap` is its two defining properties and `eq_of_isExtClassMap` their uniqueness

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Abelian.extClassMap_eq_of_equivalent
declarations.doc: Equivalent Yoneda extensions have the same class.
declarations.statement:
lemma extClassMap_eq_of_equivalent {B A : 𝒜} {n : ℕ} {E E' : YonedaExtension B A n}
    (h : E.Equivalent E') : extClassMap n E = extClassMap n E'
declarations.comment: equivalent Yoneda extensions have the same class

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Abelian.isExtClassMap_extClassMap
declarations.doc: The class map has the two properties which pin it down.
declarations.statement:
lemma isExtClassMap_extClassMap :
    IsExtClassMap (fun (_ _ : 𝒜) (n : ℕ) (E : YonedaExtension _ _ n) => extClassMap.{w} n E)
declarations.comment: the two defining properties of the class map

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Abelian.surjective_extClassMap
declarations.doc:
**The class map is surjective**: every element of `Ext^{n + 1}_𝒜(B, A)` is the class of a
degree `n + 1` Yoneda extension of `B` by `A`. The induction is on the degree: an element `ξ`
of `Ext^{n + 1}_𝒜(B, A)` is killed by a monomorphism `A ⟶ Z`
(`exists_shortExact_comp_mk₀_eq_zero`), hence, by the covariant long exact
sequence of the short exact sequence `S : 0 → A → Z → C → 0`, of the form
`ξ = η ∘ δ(S)` with `η ∈ Ext^n_𝒜(B, C)`. For `n ≥ 1` the inductive hypothesis writes
`η = δ(E')` for a degree `n` extension `E'` of `B` by `C`, and `E'` spliced with `S` is an
extension of class `ξ` (`extClassMap_splice`). For `n = 0`, `η` is a map
`u : B ⟶ C` and the pullback of `S` along `u` is a short exact sequence
`0 → A → Z ×_C B → B → 0` of class `ξ`, by naturality of
`CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.ShortExact.extClass`.
declarations.statement:
lemma surjective_extClassMap (B A : 𝒜) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (fun E : YonedaExtension B A n => extClassMap.{w} n E)
declarations.comment: every element of `Ext^{n + 1}` is the class of a degree `n + 1` Yoneda extension

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Abelian.equivalent_of_extClassMap_eq
declarations.doc: Two Yoneda extensions of the same degree with the same class are equivalent.
declarations.statement:
lemma equivalent_of_extClassMap_eq {B A : 𝒜} {n : ℕ} (E E' : YonedaExtension B A n)
    (h : extClassMap.{w} n E = extClassMap.{w} n E') : E.Equivalent E'
declarations.comment: Yoneda extensions of the same degree with the same class are equivalent

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.extClass_surjective_and_eq_iff_iso_and_baerSum
declarations.doc:
**`Ext^1` is the Ext-group of extensions.** Let `𝒜` be an abelian category and let `A`, `B`
be objects of `𝒜`. The class `δ(E) ∈ Ext^1_𝒜(B, A)` of an extension
`E : 0 → A → E → B → 0` of `B` by `A`, i.e. Mathlib's
`CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.ShortExact.extClass`, has the following three properties:

* every element of `Ext^1_𝒜(B, A)` is the class of an extension of `B` by `A`;
* two extensions of `B` by `A` have the same class if and only if they are isomorphic, i.e.
  there is an isomorphism of their middle terms compatible with the maps from `A` and to `B`;
* the class of a Baer sum is the sum of the classes: if `0 → A → T → B ⊕ B → 0` is an
  extension receiving a morphism from the direct sum extension
  `0 → A ⊕ A → E₁ ⊕ E₂ → B ⊕ B → 0` over the sum map `Σ : A ⊕ A → A`, and if
  `0 → A → E → B → 0` maps to it over the diagonal `Δ : B → B ⊕ B`, then
  `δ(E) = δ(E₁) + δ(E₂)`.

Hence `δ` induces an isomorphism from the Ext-group `Ext_𝒜(B, A)` of isomorphism classes of
extensions of `B` by `A` under Baer sum onto the group `Ext^1_𝒜(B, A)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem Ext.extClass_surjective_and_eq_iff_iso_and_baerSum (B A : 𝒜) :
    (∀ x : Ext.{w} B A 1, ∃ (E : 𝒜) (i : A ⟶ E) (p : E ⟶ B) (w : i ≫ p = 0)
        (h : (ShortComplex.mk i p w).ShortExact), h.extClass = x) ∧
    (∀ (E E' : 𝒜) (i : A ⟶ E) (p : E ⟶ B) (w : i ≫ p = 0) (i' : A ⟶ E') (p' : E' ⟶ B)
        (w' : i' ≫ p' = 0) (h : (ShortComplex.mk i p w).ShortExact)
        (h' : (ShortComplex.mk i' p' w').ShortExact),
        h.extClass = h'.extClass ↔ ∃ φ : E ≅ E', i ≫ φ.hom = i' ∧ φ.hom ≫ p' = p) ∧
    (∀ (E₁ E₂ E T : 𝒜) (i₁ : A ⟶ E₁) (p₁ : E₁ ⟶ B) (w₁ : i₁ ≫ p₁ = 0)
        (i₂ : A ⟶ E₂) (p₂ : E₂ ⟶ B) (w₂ : i₂ ≫ p₂ = 0)
        (i : A ⟶ E) (p : E ⟶ B) (w : i ≫ p = 0)
        (j : A ⟶ T) (q : T ⟶ B ⊞ B) (wT : j ≫ q = 0)
        (h₁ : (ShortComplex.mk i₁ p₁ w₁).ShortExact)
        (h₂ : (ShortComplex.mk i₂ p₂ w₂).ShortExact)
        (h : (ShortComplex.mk i p w).ShortExact)
        (_hT : (ShortComplex.mk j q wT).ShortExact)
        (u : E₁ ⊞ E₂ ⟶ T) (v : E ⟶ T),
        biprod.map i₁ i₂ ≫ u = biprod.desc (𝟙 A) (𝟙 A) ≫ j →
        u ≫ q = biprod.map p₁ p₂ →
        i ≫ v = j → v ≫ q = p ≫ biprod.lift (𝟙 B) (𝟙 B) →
          h.extClass = h₁.extClass + h₂.extClass)

declarations.name: CochainComplex.exists_sequence_quasiIso_truncLE
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06XX.** Let `A` be an abelian category and let `P` be a class of objects of `A`
which contains a zero object, is closed under finite direct sums, and is such that every object
of `A` is a quotient of an object satisfying `P`. Let `K` be a cochain complex. Then there are
complexes `Q n`, quasi-isomorphisms `f n : Q n ⟶ τ_{≤ n} K` and morphisms
`g n : Q n ⟶ Q (n + 1)` forming a commutative ladder over the canonical truncations of `K`,
such that (1) each `f n` is degreewise epimorphic, (2) each `Q n` is bounded above with all
terms satisfying `P`, and (3) each `g n` is degreewise a split injection whose cokernel
satisfies `P`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_sequence_quasiIso_truncLE (P : ObjectProperty A) [P.ContainsZero]
    (hsum : ∀ X Y : A, P X → P Y → P (X ⊞ Y))
    (hP : ∀ X : A, ∃ (Y : A) (_ : P Y) (p : Y ⟶ X), Epi p) (K : CochainComplex A ℤ) :
    ∃ (Q : ℕ → CochainComplex A ℤ) (f : ∀ n : ℕ, Q n ⟶ K.truncLE n)
      (g : ∀ n : ℕ, Q n ⟶ Q (n + 1)),
      (∀ n, QuasiIso (f n)) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), Epi ((f n).f i)) ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ, (Q n).IsStrictlyLE n) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), P ((Q n).X i)) ∧
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), ∃ (C : A) (_ : P C) (e : (Q (n + 1)).X i ≅ (Q n).X i ⊞ C),
          (g n).f i ≫ e.hom = biprod.inl) ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ, g n ≫ f (n + 1) ≫ K.ιTruncLE ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)
          = f n ≫ K.ιTruncLE ((n : ℕ) : ℤ))

declarations.name: CochainComplex.KFlat
declarations.doc:
A cochain complex `K` of `R`-modules is *K-flat* if the total complex `Tot(M ⊗_R K)` is
acyclic for every acyclic cochain complex `M` of `R`-modules. Here `⊗` is the monoidal product of
cochain complexes, i.e. the total complex of the tensor product double complex with the Koszul
sign convention.
declarations.statement: def CochainComplex.KFlat (K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) ℤ) : Prop

declarations.name: CochainComplex.KFlat.kFlat_tright_preserves_quasiIso
declarations.doc:
Tensoring with a K-flat complex and taking the total complex preserves
quasi-isomorphisms in the homotopy category.
declarations.statement:
public theorem kFlat_tright_preserves_quasiIso {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    (K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) ℤ) (hK : K.KFlat) :
    HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ≤
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).inverseImage
        (Tright K)

declarations.name: CochainComplex.KFlat.ScalarBaseChange.kFlat_extendScalars
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06Y1.** Extension of scalars along `φ : R →+* R'` carries a K-flat complex of
`R`-modules to a K-flat complex of `R'`-modules: tensoring over `R'` with the base change is,
after restriction of scalars, tensoring over `R`, and restriction of scalars reflects
acyclicity.

The two rings inhabit independent universes `uR` and `uA`, as they do in the source, where they
are related only by a ring map; the module universe `max v uR uA` is independent of both and
large enough to hold the modules of either ring. `CochainComplex.kFlat_baseChange` in
`StacksFrontier.Homology.KFlat.BaseChange` is the specialization of this statement to a single
common universe.
declarations.statement:
public lemma kFlat_extendScalars (φ : R →+* R')
    (K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max v uR uA} R) ℤ)
    (hK : CochainComplex.KFlat.{uR, max v uA} K) :
    CochainComplex.KFlat.{uA, max v uR} ((extendScalarsLarge.{v, uR, uA} φ).obj K)

declarations.name: CochainComplex.KFlat.kFlat_two_out_of_three_of_distTriang
declarations.doc:
K-flatness is a two-out-of-three property in a distinguished triangle of the homotopy
category.
declarations.statement:
theorem kFlat_two_out_of_three_of_distTriang
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {K₁ K₂ K₃ : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ}
    (f : (HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K₁ ⟶
      (HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K₂)
    (g : (HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K₂ ⟶
      (HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K₃)
    (h : (HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K₃ ⟶
      ((HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K₁)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hT : Triangle.mk f g h ∈
      distTriang (HomotopyCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))) :
    (K₂.KFlat → K₃.KFlat → K₁.KFlat) ∧
      (K₁.KFlat → K₃.KFlat → K₂.KFlat) ∧
      (K₁.KFlat → K₂.KFlat → K₃.KFlat)

declarations.name: CochainComplex.KFlat.kFlat_colimit
declarations.doc: A filtered colimit of K-flat complexes of modules is K-flat.
declarations.statement:
public theorem kFlat_colimit {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    {J : Type v} [Category.{w} J] [Small.{max u x} J] [LocallySmall.{max u x} J] [IsFiltered J]
    (K : J ⥤ CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u x} R) ℤ)
    (hK : ∀ j, (K.obj j).KFlat) : (colimit K).KFlat

declarations.name: CochainComplex.KFlat.exists_kFlat_resolution
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06Y4.** Every cochain complex of modules admits a termwise-surjective
quasi-isomorphism from a K-flat complex with flat terms.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_kFlat_resolution {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) ℤ) :
    ∃ (K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) ℤ) (f : K ⟶ M),
      K.KFlat ∧
        (∀ n : ℤ, Module.Flat R (K.X n)) ∧
        QuasiIso f ∧
        ∀ n : ℤ, Function.Surjective (f.f n).hom

declarations.name: CochainComplex.DerivedTensor.canonicalDerivedTensorChangeOfRings
declarations.doc:
The derived tensor product `- ⊗ᴸ_R N` from `D(R)` to `D(A)`, with derived extension of
scalars, derived tensoring over `A` and the change-of-rings isomorphism normalized by their
counits.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def canonicalDerivedTensorChangeOfRings
    {R : Type uR} {A : Type uA} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] (f : R →+* A)
    (N : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max v uR uA} A) ℤ)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wR} (ModuleCat.{max v uR uA} R)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (ModuleCat.{max v uR uA} A)] :
    DerivedTensorChangeOfRings f N

declarations.name: main_left
declarations.doc:
**Statement 1.**  For a fixed complex `G`, the functor
`Tleft G : F ↦ Tot(G ⊗ F)` on `K(Mod(O_X))` can be equipped with a functorial isomorphism
`ξ` (a `CommShift ℤ` datum) making it an *exact functor of triangulated categories* (Stacks
Tag 06Y8, left version).

Here `ξ` is the canonical comparison isomorphism `Tot(G ⊗ F[1]) ≅ Tot(G ⊗ F)[1]` of Stacks
Tag 0FNG, and `Functor.IsTriangulated` packages exactly the requirement of Definition 3: the
`CommShift` natural isomorphism together with preservation of distinguished triangles.

Note the descent of the functor to `K(Mod(O_X))` is *asserted as content* (via `Tleft`,
which is built from `TleftCochain_preservesHomotopyRel`), not assumed as a hypothesis.

declarations.name: main_right
declarations.doc:
**Statement 2.**  For a fixed complex `G`, the functor
`Tright G : F ↦ Tot(F ⊗ G)` on `K(Mod(O_X))` can be equipped with a functorial isomorphism
`ξ` making it an exact functor of triangulated categories (Stacks Tag 06Y8, right version).
This is genuinely distinct from `main_left` (the two differ by the commutativity isomorphism
with its sign `(-1)^{pq}`).

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsKFlat
declarations.doc:
A cochain complex `K` of sheaves of `R`-modules is **K-flat** if `Tot(F ⊗_R K)` is acyclic
for every acyclic cochain complex `F`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev IsKFlat
    (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf R)) ℤ) : Prop

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsKFlat.quasiIso_le_inverseImage
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 06YA].** For a K-flat complex `K` of `𝒪`-modules, the exact functor
`F ↦ Tot(F ⊗_𝒪 K)` of `K(Mod(𝒪))` carries quasi-isomorphisms to quasi-isomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsKFlat.quasiIso_le_inverseImage
    (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf R)) ℤ)
    (hK : IsKFlat R K) :
    HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
        (SheafOfModules (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf R)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ≤
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
          (SheafOfModules (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf R))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).inverseImage
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.Reduction.bifunctorPhiR
          (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor R) K)
declarations.comment: on the homotopy category, as the tag states it

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsKFlat.quasiIso_rightTensorComplex_map
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 06YA] at the level of complexes.** For a K-flat complex `K` of `𝒪`-modules
and a quasi-isomorphism `f : F₁ ⟶ F₂` of complexes of `𝒪`-modules, the induced morphism
`Tot(F₁ ⊗_𝒪 K) ⟶ Tot(F₂ ⊗_𝒪 K)` is a quasi-isomorphism.

The hypothesis is explicit rather than an instance: with the tensor-total functor applied to a
consumer's own factorization, an instance argument is synthesized at a different spelling of the
same type.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsKFlat.quasiIso_rightTensorComplex_map
    (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf R)) ℤ)
    (hK : IsKFlat R K)
    {F₁ F₂ : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf R)) ℤ}
    (f : F₁ ⟶ F₂) (hf : QuasiIso f) :
    QuasiIso ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.rightTensorComplex R K).map f)
declarations.comment: at the level of complexes rather than of the homotopy category

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.KFlatStalkCriterion.kFlat_iff_stalkwise
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06YB.** A complex of sheaves of modules on a ringed space is K-flat if and only if
its complex of stalks at every point is K-flat over the stalk of the structure sheaf.
declarations.statement:
theorem kFlat_iff_stalkwise
    (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf.{u, u, u} R)) ℤ)
      :
    letI := fun (left : SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf R)) =>
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor_obj_additive.{u, u, u, u, u} R left
    letI : ∀ (left right : CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf R)) ℤ),
        HomologicalComplex.HasMapBifunctor left right
          (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor.{u, u, u, u, u} R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) :=
      fun left right => Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.hasMapBifunctor_sheafTensor R left right
    Stacks.SheafOfModules.KFlat.KFlat.{u, u, u} R K ↔ KFlatStalkwise R K

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.KFlatPullback.kFlat_pullback_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06YC.** The degreewise pullback of a K-flat complex of `𝒪_Y`-modules along
a morphism of ringed spaces is a K-flat complex of `𝒪_X`-modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem kFlat_pullback_unconditional {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.{u, u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.sheaf)) ℤ)
    (hK : Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsKFlat Y.sheaf K) :
    Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsKFlat X.sheaf
      (((RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.modulePullback f).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K)

registrations.comment: ringed space case of the ringed site statement

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.kFlat_colimit
declarations.doc: A sequential colimit of K-flat complexes of sheaves of modules is K-flat.
declarations.statement:
theorem kFlat_colimit

    (hK : ∀ n : ℕ, IsKFlat R (K.obj n)) :
    IsKFlat R (colimit K)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.exists_isKFlat_isFlat_quasiIso_epi
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 06YF.** Every cochain complex `G` of `𝒪_X`-modules on a ringed space receives a
termwise surjective quasi-isomorphism from a K-flat complex whose terms are flat `𝒪_X`-modules.

A ringed space is a ringed site, and this is the resolution built there
([Stacks, Tag 06YS]).
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isKFlat_isFlat_quasiIso_epi
    (G : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) ℤ) :
    ∃ (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) ℤ)
      (s : K ⟶ G),
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsKFlat X.sheaf K ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFlat.{u, u, u, u} (O := X.sheaf) (K.X i)) ∧
      QuasiIso s ∧ ∀ i : ℤ, Epi (s.f i)

registrations.comment: ringed space case of the ringed site statement
