declarations.name: AdequateFunctor.subsingleton_zExt_moduleExtension_of_finitePresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06ZG.** For `A`-modules `M` and `P` with `P` of finite presentation,
`Ext^i(P̲, M̲) = 0` for every `i > 0` in the category of module-valued functors on the commutative
`A`-algebras, where `X̲` is `B ↦ B ⊗[A] X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem subsingleton_zExt_moduleExtension_of_finitePresentation
    (M P : ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) (v + 1) w} A) [Module.FinitePresentation A P]
    (i : ℤ) (hi : 0 < i) :
    Subsingleton (Abelian.zExt (moduleExtension.{max (u + 1) (v + 1) w, v} A P)
      (moduleExtension.{max (u + 1) (v + 1) w, v} A M) i)
declarations.comment: every degree i > 0; the published proof via Tag 06ZA is replaced by the transfer along phi_N^* -| psi_N^* and a dual-number scaling argument

declarations.name: AdequateFunctor.subsingleton_zExt_moduleExtension_three
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06ZG in degree three.** For an `A`-module `P` of finite
presentation, `Ext³` from the module-valued functor `B ↦ B ⊗[A] P` to `B ↦ B ⊗[A] M` vanishes
in the category of module-valued functors on the commutative `A`-algebras.
declarations.statement:
theorem subsingleton_zExt_moduleExtension_three [Module.FinitePresentation A P] :
    Subsingleton (Abelian.zExt (moduleExtension.{max u v w, v} A P)
      (moduleExtension.{max u v w, v} A M) 3)
declarations.comment: degree 3, by a double dimension shift to Ext¹ out of a linearly adequate functor, which vanishes by Tag 06V7

declarations.name: AdequateFunctor.subsingleton_zExt_moduleExtension_one
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06ZG in degree one.**  For an `A`-module `P` of finite
presentation, `Ext¹` from the module-valued functor `B ↦ B ⊗[A] P` to `B ↦ B ⊗[A] M` vanishes
in the category of module-valued functors on the commutative `A`-algebras.
declarations.statement:
theorem subsingleton_zExt_moduleExtension_one [Module.FinitePresentation A P] :
    Subsingleton (Abelian.zExt (moduleExtension.{max u v w, v} A P)
      (moduleExtension.{max u v w, v} A M) 1)
declarations.comment: degree 1, via the universal section over the square-zero extension by the cokernel of the transpose of a presentation

declarations.name: AdequateFunctor.subsingleton_zExt_moduleExtension_two_large
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06ZG in degree two.**  For an `A`-module `P` of finite presentation,
`Ext²` from the module-valued functor `B ↦ B ⊗[A] P` to `B ↦ B ⊗[A] M` vanishes in the
category of module-valued functors on the commutative `A`-algebras.
declarations.statement:
theorem subsingleton_zExt_moduleExtension_two_large [Module.FinitePresentation A P] :
    Subsingleton (Abelian.zExt (moduleExtension.{max u v w, v} A P)
      (moduleExtension.{max u v w, v} A M) 2)
declarations.comment: degree 2, via Tag 06V0 and projectivity of the free module functors

declarations.name: AdequateFunctor.subsingleton_zExt_moduleExtension_two
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06ZG in degree two.**  For an `A`-module `P` of finite presentation,
`Ext²` from the module-valued functor `B ↦ B ⊗[A] P` to `B ↦ B ⊗[A] M` vanishes in the
category of module-valued functors on the commutative `A`-algebras.
declarations.statement:
theorem subsingleton_zExt_moduleExtension_two [Module.FinitePresentation A P] :
    Subsingleton (Abelian.zExt (moduleExtension.{max u v, v} A P)
      (moduleExtension.{max u v, v} A M) 2)
declarations.comment: degree 2, via Tag 06V0 and projectivity of the free module functors

declarations.name: AdequateFunctor.subsingleton_zExt_isLinearlyAdequate_moduleExtension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06ZH.** Let `A` be a ring, `M` an `A`-module and `L` a linearly adequate
module-valued functor on the commutative `A`-algebras. Then `Ext^i(L, M̲) = 0` for every `i > 0`,
where `M̲` is `B ↦ B ⊗[A] M`.
declarations.statement:
theorem subsingleton_zExt_isLinearlyAdequate_moduleExtension
    (L : ModuleValuedFunctor.{max (u + 1) (v + 1) w, v} A) (hL : IsLinearlyAdequate (𝟭 _) L)
    (M : ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) (v + 1) w} A) (i : ℤ) (hi : 0 < i) :
    Subsingleton (Abelian.zExt L (moduleExtension.{max (u + 1) (v + 1) w, v} A M) i)
declarations.comment: every degree i > 0, by the source's two dimension shifts from Tag 06ZG

declarations.name: AdequateFunctor.subsingleton_zExt_of_isLinearlyAdequate
declarations.doc:
Let `A` be a commutative ring, `M` an `A`-module and `L` a linearly adequate module-valued
functor on the commutative `A`-algebras. Then `Ext^i(L, M̲)` vanishes for `i > 0`, where `M̲`
is the module-valued functor `B ↦ B ⊗[A] M`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem subsingleton_zExt_of_isLinearlyAdequate {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    (L : ModuleValuedFunctor.{max u v w, v} A) (hL : IsLinearlyAdequate (𝟭 _) L)
    (M : ModuleCat.{max u v w} A)
    (hM : ∀ P : ModuleCat.{max u v w} A, Module.FinitePresentation A P → ∀ j : ℤ, 0 < j →
      Subsingleton (Abelian.zExt (moduleExtension.{max u v w, v} A P)
        (moduleExtension.{max u v w, v} A M) j))
    (i : ℤ) (hi : 0 < i) :
    Subsingleton (Abelian.zExt L (moduleExtension.{max u v w, v} A M) i)
declarations.comment: The positive-degree vanishing for the functor of a finitely presented module, Tag 06ZG, is a hypothesis. Only its degree-two case is proved in this library, in `AdequateFunctor.subsingleton_zExt_moduleExtension_two`, while this proof needs degrees at least three: both short exact sequences used here are flanked by projective objects, so the degree shift along them is an isomorphism and those degrees of Tag 06ZG carry the content of this tag itself. The source derives Tag 06ZG from Tag 06ZA, which is false as stated and is refuted by `AdequateFunctor.not_forall_hasRightExactTangentFunctor_of_injective`.

declarations.name: AdequateFunctor.isZero_rightDerivedPlus_adequateCoreflection_of_isAdequate
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06ZI.** The higher right derived functors of the coreflection `Q` onto
the adequate module-valued functors vanish: `R^p Q(F) = 0` for every `p > 0` and every adequate
functor `F`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_rightDerivedPlus_adequateCoreflection_of_isAdequate
    (F : ModuleValuedFunctor.{max (u + 1) (v + 1) w, v} A) (hF : IsAdequate (𝟭 _) F)
    (p : ℤ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    IsZero (((adequateCoreflection.{u, v, w} A).rightDerivedPlus p).obj F)
declarations.comment: every degree p > 0 and every adequate F

declarations.name: AdequateFunctor.isZero_rightDerivedPlus_one_adequateCoreflection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06ZI in degree one.** The first right derived functor of the
coreflection `Q` onto the adequate module-valued functors vanishes on every adequate functor `F`.
On an injective resolution `F → I ⁎`, a degree-one cycle of `Q(I ⁎)` restricted along a linearly
adequate functor `L` is a boundary, because `Ext¹(L, F)` vanishes by Tag 06V7; the linearly
adequate functors cover every adequate functor by Tag 06UX.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isZero_rightDerivedPlus_one_adequateCoreflection
    (F : ModuleValuedFunctor.{max (u + 1) (v + 1) w, v} A) (hF : IsAdequate (𝟭 _) F) :
    IsZero (((adequateCoreflection.{u, v, w} A).rightDerivedPlus 1).obj F)
declarations.comment: degree 1, from Tag 06V7 and the covering of Tag 06UX

declarations.name: AdequateFunctor.isZero_rightDerivedPlus_adequateCoreflection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 06ZI.** The higher right derived functors of the coreflection `Q` onto
the adequate module-valued functors vanish in positive degrees on every adequate functor.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isZero_rightDerivedPlus_adequateCoreflection
    (hFP : ∀ M P : ModuleCat.{max (u + 1) (v + 1) w} A, Module.FinitePresentation A P →
      ∀ j : ℤ, 0 < j → Subsingleton (Abelian.zExt
        (moduleExtension.{max (u + 1) (v + 1) w, v} A P)
        (moduleExtension.{max (u + 1) (v + 1) w, v} A M) j))
    (F : ModuleValuedFunctor.{max (u + 1) (v + 1) w, v} A) (hF : IsAdequate (𝟭 _) F)
    (p : ℤ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    IsZero (((adequateCoreflection.{u, v, w} A).rightDerivedPlus p).obj F)
declarations.comment: the positive-degree vanishing of the extension groups between extensions of modules, one finitely presented, is a hypothesis: that is Tag 06ZG, which is absent from this library.

declarations.name: Stacks.Adequate.isEquivalence_adequateComparison
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 06ZJ].** For `S = Spec A` affine, the comparison functor
`𝓕 ↦ F_{𝓕, A}` from the category `Adeq(𝒪)` of adequate `𝒪`-modules on `(Sch/S)_τ` to the
category of adequate module-valued functors on the `A`-algebras of the site is an equivalence
of categories. So the two categories are equivalent, by the source's own comparison.

Full faithfulness is full faithfulness of the affine-section functor over an affine base and
essential surjectivity is the quasi-inverse
`Stacks.Adequate.exists_isAdequate_affineSectionsFunctor_iso`, which builds the adequate
`𝒪`-module from an exact sequence `0 → F → M̲ → N̲` as `Ker(M^a → N^a)`; both are packaged in
`Stacks.Adequate.isEquivalence_of_affineSectionsFunctor`, and
`Stacks.Adequate.adequateComparison_ι` is the identification that theorem asks for.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isEquivalence_adequateComparison {τ : CoveringTopology} {A : CommRingCat.{u}}
    (B : BigSite τ (Spec A)) : (adequateComparison.{u, u} B).IsEquivalence
declarations.comment:
the equivalence itself: the comparison functor 𝓕 ↦ F_{𝓕, A} from adequate
𝒪-modules on (Sch/Spec A)_τ to adequate module-valued functors on the A-algebras of the site is
an equivalence of categories, with no hypothesis, at the value universe u of the site. The
functor is `Stacks.Adequate.adequateComparison`, which carries the tag for the functor alone;
full faithfulness and essential surjectivity are
`Stacks.Adequate.fullyFaithful_of_affineSectionsFunctor` and
`Stacks.Adequate.essSurj_of_affineSectionsFunctor`, the latter being the quasi-inverse the
source builds from an exact sequence 0 → F → M̲ → N̲

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsParasitic
declarations.doc:
A presheaf of modules is *parasitic* when its sections vanish on every object of the site
which is flat over the base scheme.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev IsParasitic (S : Scheme.{u}) {C : Type (u + 1)} [Category.{u} C]
    (toOver : C ⥤ Over S) {𝒪 : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ RingCat.{u}} (F : PresheafOfModules.{u} 𝒪) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsParasiticFor
declarations.doc:
A presheaf of modules is *parasitic for a topology* when its sections vanish on every
member of every covering family of the base scheme.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev IsParasiticFor (S : Scheme.{u}) {C : Type (u + 1)} [Category.{u} C]
    (toOver : C ⥤ Over S) (isCovering : Covering C → Prop)
    {𝒪 : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ RingCat.{u}} (F : PresheafOfModules.{u} 𝒪) : Prop

declarations.name: Stacks.Adequate.tfae_isZero_restrictModule_of_isAdequate
declarations.statement:
public theorem tfae_isZero_restrictModule_of_isAdequate (B : BigSite τ S)
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} B.structureSheaf) (hF : IsAdequate B F) :
    List.TFAE
      [IsZero (B.zariskiRestrictModule.obj F),
        IsParasitic S B.toOver F.val,
        IsParasiticFor.{u, w} S B.toOver (isTauCovering.{u, w} B) F.val,
        ∀ U : S.Opens, Subsingleton (F.val.obj (op (B.opensToBig.obj U))),
        ∃ (I : Type u) (U : I → S.Opens), (∀ i, IsAffineOpen (U i)) ∧ (⨆ i, U i) = ⊤ ∧
          ∀ i, Subsingleton (F.val.obj (op (B.opensToBig.obj (U i))))]

declarations.name: Stacks.Adequate.BigSite.isSerreClass_parasiticAdequate
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 06ZN], the Serre subcategory.** The parasitic adequate `𝒪`-modules form a
Serre subcategory `𝒞` of `Adeq(𝒪)`: it is the kernel of the exact functor
`v : Adeq(𝒪) ⥤ QCoh(𝒪_S)` (`Stacks.Adequate.BigSite.parasiticAdequate_eq_kernel`, which is
[Stacks, Tag 06ZM]), and the kernel of an exact functor is a Serre subcategory
([Stacks, Tag 02MQ]). `v` is exact by
`Stacks.Adequate.BigSite.preservesFiniteLimits_restrictModuleQCoh` and
`Stacks.Adequate.BigSite.preservesFiniteColimits_restrictModuleQCoh`. The abelian structure on
`Adeq(𝒪)` is [Stacks, Tag 06VQ] (1), `Stacks.Adequate.abelian_adequate`.
declarations.statement: public instance BigSite.isSerreClass_parasiticAdequate : B.parasiticAdequate.IsSerreClass
declarations.comment: the subcategory of parasitic adequate modules is a Serre subcategory

declarations.name: Stacks.Adequate.BigSite.isLocalization_restrictModuleQCoh
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 06ZN], the quotient equivalence.** The functor `v : Adeq(𝒪) ⥤ QCoh(𝒪_S)`
induces an equivalence `Adeq(𝒪)/𝒞 ≌ QCoh(𝒪_S)`, where `𝒞` is the Serre subcategory of
parasitic adequate modules and `Adeq(𝒪)/𝒞` is the Serre quotient, the localization of `Adeq(𝒪)`
at the morphisms which are isomorphisms modulo `𝒞` ([Stacks, Tag 02MS]): `v` is a localization
functor for that class of morphisms.

The proof is the source's. `v` is exact, its kernel is `𝒞`, so the morphisms inverted by `v`
are those which are isomorphisms modulo `𝒞`; and `v` has the fully faithful left adjoint
`u : QCoh(𝒪_S) ⥤ Adeq(𝒪)` of [Stacks, Tag 06VN] (`Stacks.Adequate.BigSite.adeqAdjunction`,
the unit `𝓕 → vu𝓕` being an isomorphism), which makes the induced functor `v̄` essentially
surjective and fully faithful (`CategoryTheory.Adjunction.isLocalization'`).
declarations.statement:
public instance BigSite.isLocalization_restrictModuleQCoh :
    B.restrictModuleQCoh.IsLocalization B.parasiticAdequate.isoModSerre
declarations.comment:
the functor `v` induces an equivalence `Adeq(𝒪)/𝒞 = QCoh(𝒪_S)`: `v` is a
localization functor for the isomorphisms modulo the Serre subcategory `𝒞`

declarations.name: Stacks.Adequate.isAdequate_and_isParasitic_directImage_ofAmbient
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 06ZP].** Let `f : T ⟶ S` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of
schemes and let `𝓕` be a parasitic adequate `𝒪_T`-module on `(Sch/T)_τ`, for `τ` any of the five
topologies `Zar`, `étale`, `smooth`, `syntomic`, `fppf`. Then the pushforward `f_*𝓕` and every
higher direct image `R^i f_*𝓕` are parasitic adequate `𝒪_S`-modules on `(Sch/S)_τ`.

`(Sch/S)_τ` and `(Sch/T)_τ` are the localizations at `S` and at `T` of one ambient big `τ`-site
`𝒮`, as they are in the source (`Stacks.Adequate.BigSite.ofAmbient`; by
`Stacks.Adequate.BigSite.exists_eq_ofAmbient` every chosen big site is one). `f_*` is the direct
image of [Stacks, Tag 06VR] along the base change `V ↦ V ×_S T`
(`Stacks.Adequate.ambientBaseChange`) with its first projection, and `R^i f_*` is its `i`-th right
derived functor; nothing is assumed about either, since
`Stacks.Adequate.isContinuous_ambientBaseChange` and
`Stacks.Adequate.isBaseChangeAlong_ambientBaseChange` supply what Tag 06VR needs. The proof is
`Stacks.Adequate.isAdequate_and_isParasitic_directImage`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isAdequate_and_isParasitic_directImage_ofAmbient
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (BigSite.ofAmbient 𝒮 T hT).structureSheaf)
    (hF : IsAdequate (BigSite.ofAmbient 𝒮 T hT) F)
    (hpar : IsParasitic T (BigSite.ofAmbient 𝒮 T hT).toOver F.val)
    (hqc : QuasiCompact f) (hqs : QuasiSeparated f) :
    (IsAdequate (BigSite.ofAmbient 𝒮 S hS)
        ((directImage.{u, u} (BigSite.ofAmbient 𝒮 S hS) (BigSite.ofAmbient 𝒮 T hT)
          (ambientBaseChange 𝒮 hS hT f) (ambientBaseChangeFst 𝒮 hS hT f)).obj F) ∧
      IsParasitic S (BigSite.ofAmbient 𝒮 S hS).toOver
        ((directImage.{u, u} (BigSite.ofAmbient 𝒮 S hS) (BigSite.ofAmbient 𝒮 T hT)
          (ambientBaseChange 𝒮 hS hT f) (ambientBaseChangeFst 𝒮 hS hT f)).obj F).val) ∧
      ∀ i : ℕ, IsAdequate (BigSite.ofAmbient 𝒮 S hS)
          ((higherDirectImage.{u, u} (BigSite.ofAmbient 𝒮 S hS) (BigSite.ofAmbient 𝒮 T hT)
            (ambientBaseChange 𝒮 hS hT f) (ambientBaseChangeFst 𝒮 hS hT f) i).obj F) ∧
        IsParasitic S (BigSite.ofAmbient 𝒮 S hS).toOver
          ((higherDirectImage.{u, u} (BigSite.ofAmbient 𝒮 S hS) (BigSite.ofAmbient 𝒮 T hT)
            (ambientBaseChange 𝒮 hS hT f) (ambientBaseChangeFst 𝒮 hS hT f) i).obj F).val

declarations.name: Stacks.Adequate.BigSite.isLocalization_mapDerivedCategory_restrictModuleQCoh
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 06ZQ].** `D(Adeq(𝒪))/D_𝒞(Adeq(𝒪)) = D(QCoh(𝒪_S))`: the functor
`D(v) : D(Adeq(𝒪)) ⥤ D(QCoh(𝒪_S))` is a localization functor for the morphisms whose cone has
all its cohomology objects in the Serre subcategory `𝒞` of parasitic adequate modules. This is
[Stacks, Tag 06XM] applied to `v`, which realises the Serre quotient by `𝒞`
(`Stacks.Adequate.BigSite.isLocalization_restrictModuleQCoh`, [Stacks, Tag 06ZN]) and has the
fully faithful left adjoint `u` of [Stacks, Tag 06VN].
declarations.statement:
public theorem BigSite.isLocalization_mapDerivedCategory_restrictModuleQCoh
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} (adequate.{u, u} B).FullSubcategory]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w₂} (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent S.ringCatSheaf).FullSubcategory] :
    B.restrictModuleQCoh.mapDerivedCategory.IsLocalization
      (ObjectProperty.trW (fun X : DerivedCategory (adequate.{u, u} B).FullSubcategory =>
        ∀ n : ℤ, B.parasiticAdequate
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (adequate.{u, u} B).FullSubcategory n).obj X)))

declarations.name: Stacks.Adequate.BigSite.isLocalization_mapDerivedCategoryPlus_restrictModuleQCoh
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 06ZQ], bounded below version.**
`D⁺(Adeq(𝒪))/D⁺_𝒞(Adeq(𝒪)) = D⁺(QCoh(𝒪_S))`: the functor
`D⁺(v) : D⁺(Adeq(𝒪)) ⥤ D⁺(QCoh(𝒪_S))` is a localization functor for the morphisms of
`D⁺(Adeq(𝒪))` whose cone has all its cohomology objects in the Serre subcategory `𝒞` of
parasitic adequate modules.

declarations.name: Stacks.Adequate.BigSite.isLocalization_mapDerivedCategoryMinus_restrictModuleQCoh
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 06ZQ], bounded above version.**
`D⁻(Adeq(𝒪))/D⁻_𝒞(Adeq(𝒪)) = D⁻(QCoh(𝒪_S))`: the functor
`D⁻(v) : D⁻(Adeq(𝒪)) ⥤ D⁻(QCoh(𝒪_S))` is a localization functor for the morphisms of
`D⁻(Adeq(𝒪))` whose cone has all its cohomology objects in the Serre subcategory `𝒞` of
parasitic adequate modules.

declarations.name: Stacks.Adequate.BigSite.isLocalization_mapDerivedCategoryBounded_restrictModuleQCoh
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 06ZQ], bounded version.**
`Dᵇ(Adeq(𝒪))/Dᵇ_𝒞(Adeq(𝒪)) = Dᵇ(QCoh(𝒪_S))`: the functor
`Dᵇ(v) : Dᵇ(Adeq(𝒪)) ⥤ Dᵇ(QCoh(𝒪_S))` is a localization functor for the morphisms of
`Dᵇ(Adeq(𝒪))` whose cone has all its cohomology objects in the Serre subcategory `𝒞` of
parasitic adequate modules.

declarations.name: Stacks.Adequate.BigSite.isLocalization_mapHomotopyCategoryPlus_associatedModuleAdeq_affine
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 06ZR] over an affine base, unconditionally.** Over an affine scheme
`U = Spec A` the bounded below derived category `D⁺(Adeq(𝒪))` is the localization of
`K⁺(QCoh(𝒪_U))` at the universal quasi-isomorphisms.

This is `BigSite.isLocalization_mapHomotopyCategoryPlus_associatedModuleAdeq_of_allAlgebras` with
its single hypothesis discharged by
`Stacks.Adequate.BigSite.universallyAcyclic_eq_inverseImage_qcohAllAlgebraSections`.
declarations.comment:
over an affine base `U = Spec A`, with no hypothesis: `D⁺(Adeq(𝒪))`, taken as the
source does as the localization of `K⁺(Adeq(𝒪))` at the quasi-isomorphisms, is the localization
of `K⁺(QCoh(𝒪_U))` at the universal quasi-isomorphisms along `u`. `(Sch/U)_fppf` is rendered as
a chosen big fppf site containing `Spec A`

declarations.name: Stacks.Adequate.exists_adequator
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 06ZS].** Let `U = Spec A` be an affine scheme. The inclusion functor
`Adeq(𝒪) → Mod((Sch/U)_τ, 𝒪)` has a right adjoint, and the adjunction mapping `A(𝓕) → 𝓕` is
an isomorphism for every adequate module `𝓕`.

The right adjoint is `Stacks.Adequate.affineAdequator`, with adjunction
`Stacks.Adequate.affineAdequatorAdjunction`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_adequator :
    ∃ (R : SheafOfModules.{u} B.structureSheaf ⥤ (adequate.{u, u} B).FullSubcategory)
      (adjR : (adequate.{u, u} B).ι ⊣ R),
      ∀ F : SheafOfModules.{u} B.structureSheaf, IsAdequate B F → IsIso (adjR.counit.app F)

declarations.name: Stacks.Adequate.adequateComparisonSquare
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 06ZT]**, the commutative square in the proof of [Stacks, Tag 06ZS]: the
inclusion of `Adeq(𝒪)` followed by the affine-section functor into the module-valued functors on
the `A`-algebras of the site equals the comparison functor of [Stacks, Tag 06ZJ] followed by the
inclusion of the adequate module-valued functors. It commutes by definitional unfolding, which
is `Stacks.Adequate.adequateComparison_ι`.
declarations.comment:
the commutativity of the square, with the comparison functor of Tag 06ZJ
as its left vertical arrow; that it is an identification is
`Stacks.Adequate.isEquivalence_adequateComparison`

declarations.name: Stacks.Adequate.adequateDiagramSquare
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 06ZT], the commutativity of the diagram**, at an arbitrary module universe:
`k`, then the inclusion `j` of sheaves into presheaves, then the right vertical arrow, is the left
vertical arrow (the comparison functor of [Stacks, Tag 06ZJ]) followed by the inclusion
`i : 𝒜 → 𝒫`. Both sides restrict sections to spectra and scalars along `B ≅ 𝒪(Spec B)`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def adequateDiagramSquare :
    adequateToAffineModules.{u, m} B ⋙ SheafOfModules.forget _ ⋙
        affinePresheafModulesToModuleValued.{u, m} B ≅
      adequateComparison.{u, m} B ⋙ (adequateOn.{u, max u m} A (schemeSizeBelow B.cutoff)).ι
declarations.comment:
the commutativity of the diagram, with k, j and the right vertical arrow
written out, at an arbitrary module universe

declarations.name: Stacks.Adequate.adequateAffineDiagram
declarations.statement:
public theorem adequateAffineDiagram :
    (adequateComparison.{u, u} B).IsEquivalence ∧
      (affinePresheafModulesToModuleValued.{u, u} B).IsEquivalence ∧
      Nonempty (adequateToAffineModules.{u, u} B ⋙ SheafOfModules.forget _ ⋙
          affinePresheafModulesToModuleValued.{u, u} B ≅
        adequateComparison.{u, u} B ⋙ (adequateOn.{u, u} A (schemeSizeBelow B.cutoff)).ι) ∧
      Nonempty (adequateToAffineModules.{u, u} B).FullyFaithful ∧
      Nonempty (SheafOfModules.forget.{u} (DenseSubsiteModules.ringRestriction
        (affineSubsiteTopology B) B.topology (affineSpecOver B A (𝟙 (Spec A)))
        B.structureSheaf)).FullyFaithful ∧
      (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} (𝟙 (DenseSubsiteModules.ringRestriction
        (affineSubsiteTopology B) B.topology (affineSpecOver B A (𝟙 (Spec A)))
        B.structureSheaf))).IsEquivalence ∧
      (affineSpecOver B A (𝟙 (Spec A))).Full ∧ (affineSpecOver B A (𝟙 (Spec A))).Faithful ∧
      ∀ X : B.category, IsAffine X.left.obj ↔ (affineSpecOver B A (𝟙 (Spec A))).essImage X
declarations.comment:
the whole diagram: both vertical arrows are equivalences, it commutes, k and j
are fully faithful, and its middle category is modules on the affine objects of the site

registrations.name: isEquivalence_adequateComparison
registrations.comment:
the left vertical arrow of the square is an identification; the source reads
it off Tag 06ZJ, and this is that tag

declarations.name: Stacks.Adequate.exactAt_mapHomologicalComplex_of_coreflection
declarations.doc:
**The homological core of [Stacks, Tag 06ZU].** Let `i ⊣ Q` be an adjunction with `i`
additive, let `G` be a fully faithful additive functor preserving injective objects which
carries an injective resolution `I` of `X` to a resolution of `G(X)`, and let `P` be a
separating family in the domain of `i` whose objects have no degree-`n` extensions into `G(X)`.
Then `Q(I^•)` is exact in degree `n > 0`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exactAt_mapHomologicalComplex_of_coreflection [HasExt.{w} E]
    (i : D ⥤ C) (Q : C ⥤ D) [i.Additive] [Q.Additive] (adj : i ⊣ Q)
    (G : C ⥤ E) [G.Additive] [G.Full] [G.Faithful] [G.PreservesInjectiveObjects]
    (P : ObjectProperty D) (hP : P.IsSeparating)
    {X : C} (I : InjectiveResolution X)
    [QuasiIso ((G.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map I.ι)]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hExt : ∀ L : D, P L → Subsingleton (Abelian.Ext.{w} (G.obj (i.obj L)) (G.obj X) n)) :
    ((Q.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex).ExactAt n

declarations.name: Stacks.Adequate.isZero_rightDerived_of_coreflection
declarations.doc:
**The homological core of [Stacks, Tag 06ZU]**, read as the vanishing of a right derived
functor of the right adjoint: under the hypotheses of
`Stacks.Adequate.exactAt_mapHomologicalComplex_of_coreflection`, `R^n Q(X) = 0`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isZero_rightDerived_of_coreflection [EnoughInjectives C] [HasExt.{w} E]
    (i : D ⥤ C) (Q : C ⥤ D) [i.Additive] [Q.Additive] (adj : i ⊣ Q)
    (G : C ⥤ E) [G.Additive] [G.Full] [G.Faithful] [G.PreservesInjectiveObjects]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits G]
    (P : ObjectProperty D) (hP : P.IsSeparating) (X : C)
    (hacyclic : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < k → IsZero ((G.rightDerived k).obj X))
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hExt : ∀ L : D, P L → Subsingleton (Abelian.Ext.{w} (G.obj (i.obj L)) (G.obj X) n)) :
    IsZero ((Q.rightDerived n).obj X)
declarations.comment:
the same step read as the vanishing of the right derived functors of the right
adjoint; stated for an arbitrary adjunction

declarations.name: Stacks.Adequate.isZero_rightDerived_adequator
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 06ZU].** For `U = Spec A` affine, every object `𝓕` of `Adeq(𝒪)` and every
`p > 0`, the `p`-th right derived functor of the adequator of [Stacks, Tag 06ZS] vanishes at
`𝓕`: the adequator of an injective resolution of `𝓕` is exact in positive degrees.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isZero_rightDerived_adequator
    (adj : (adequateOn.{u, max u m} A (schemeSizeBelow B.cutoff)).ι ⊣ Q)
    (hj : (affineSectionsFunctor.{u, max u m} B A (𝟙 (Spec A))).FullyFaithful)
    (comm : E.functor ⋙ (adequateOn.{u, max u m} A (schemeSizeBelow B.cutoff)).ι ≅
      (adequate.{u, max u m} B).ι ⋙ affineSectionsFunctor.{u, max u m} B A (𝟙 (Spec A)))
    (F : (adequate.{u, max u m} B).FullSubcategory) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (hacyclic : AffineSectionsAcyclic.{u, m} B A (𝟙 (Spec A)) F.obj)
    (P : ObjectProperty (adequate.{u, max u m} B).FullSubcategory) (hP : P.IsSeparating)
    (hExt : AffineSectionsExtVanishing.{u, m, w} B P F.obj p) :
    letI : (adequator.{u, max u m} B Q E).Additive := additive_adequator B Q E adj hj comm
    IsZero (((adequator.{u, max u m} B Q E).rightDerived p).obj F.obj)
declarations.comment:
the full statement, `R^p A(F) = 0` for every `p > 0` and every object of
`Adeq(O)`, for the named adequator of Tag 06ZS. Assumed: that adequator's own inputs (`Q`, `E`,
`adj` from Tags 06Z6 and 06ZJ over the algebras of the site, `hj` and `comm` from Tag 06ZT),
right acyclicity of the affine-section functor (`hacyclic`, Tags 06YK and 06VM), the
positive-degree Ext vanishing along a separating family (`hP` and `hExt`, Tag 06ZI), the three
closure properties of Tag 06VQ (1) and `EnoughInjectives` for the sheaves of modules on the
site. Preservation of injective objects by the affine-section functor is proved, through Tag 03FB
on the affine subsite

declarations.name: Stacks.Adequate.isZero_rightDerived_affineAdequator
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 06ZU].** Let `U = Spec A` be an affine scheme. For every object `𝓕` of
`Adeq(𝒪)` and every `p > 0`, `R^p A(𝓕) = 0`, where `A` is the adequator
`Stacks.Adequate.affineAdequator` of [Stacks, Tag 06ZS], the right adjoint of the inclusion
`Adeq(𝒪) → Mod((Sch/U)_τ, 𝒪)`.

The `letI` preamble is not a list of hypotheses: it is the abelian structure of `Adeq(𝒪)`
(Tag 06VQ (1)) and the additivity of the adequator, which is a right adjoint of an additive
functor.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isZero_rightDerived_affineAdequator
    (F : (adequate.{u, u} B).FullSubcategory) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    letI := adequate_isClosedUnderKernels.{u, u} B
    letI := adequate_isClosedUnderCokernels.{u, u} B
    letI := adequate_isClosedUnderFiniteProducts.{u, u} B
    letI : Abelian (adequate.{u, u} B).FullSubcategory := abelian_adequate B
    letI : (affineAdequator B).Additive :=
      (affineAdequatorAdjunction B).right_adjoint_additive
    IsZero (((affineAdequator B).rightDerived p).obj F.obj)

declarations.name: Stacks.Adequate.isEquivalence_adequateBoundedBelowComparison
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 06ZV].** For `U = Spec A` affine, the canonical comparison functor
`D⁺(Adeq(𝒪)) ⥤ D⁺_{Adeq}(𝒪)` — the inclusion `Adeq(𝒪) ⥤ Mod(𝒪)` applied degreewise to
complexes — is an equivalence.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isEquivalence_adequateBoundedBelowComparison :
    (DerivedCategoryB.boundedBelowComparison (adequate.{u, m} B)).IsEquivalence
declarations.comment:
the full statement, that the canonical comparison functor
`D⁺(Adeq(𝒪)) ⥤ D⁺_Adeq(𝒪)` of the equation (46.7.5.1) of Tag 06VV is an equivalence. Assumed:
a right adjoint `Ψ` of the derived inclusion on bounded below objects together with its
preservation of boundedness below (`adj`, `hΨ`), which is the source's `RA`, available because
the adequator of Tag 06ZS is left exact and `Mod(𝒪)` has enough injectives; the source's key
fact that the adjunction maps are quasi-isomorphisms on the SINGLE modules (`hunit`,
`hcounit`), which is Tag 06ZU together with the moreover clause of Tag 06ZS; and the closure of
adequacy under kernels, cokernels and finite products, Tag 06VQ (1), which makes `Adeq(𝒪)`
abelian. The passage from the key fact on single modules to all of `D⁺`, which is the source's
spectral sequence argument via Tag 015J, is proved

declarations.name: Stacks.Adequate.adequateBoundedBelowEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 06ZV]** as an equivalence of categories:
`D⁺(Adeq(𝒪)) ≌ D⁺_{Adeq}(𝒪)` for `U = Spec A` affine.
declarations.comment:
the equivalence as data, `D⁺(Adeq(𝒪)) ≌ D⁺_Adeq(𝒪)`, under the hypotheses of
`Stacks.Adequate.isEquivalence_adequateBoundedBelowComparison`; its functor is the canonical
comparison functor by `Stacks.Adequate.adequateBoundedBelowEquivalence_functor`

declarations.name: Stacks.Adequate.isEquivalence_boundedBelowComparison_adequate
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 06ZV].** Let `U = Spec A` be an affine scheme. The canonical functor
`D⁺(Adeq(𝒪)) ⥤ D⁺_{Adeq}(𝒪)`, the inclusion `Adeq(𝒪) ⥤ Mod((Sch/U)_τ, 𝒪)` applied
degreewise to bounded below complexes, is an equivalence onto the bounded below objects of
`D(𝒪)` whose cohomology sheaves are adequate.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isEquivalence_boundedBelowComparison_adequate
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} B.structureSheaf)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (adequate.{u, u} B).FullSubcategory] :
    (DerivedCategoryB.boundedBelowComparison (adequate.{u, u} B)).IsEquivalence

declarations.name: Stacks.Adequate.bijective_mapExtAddHom_ι_adequate_zero
declarations.doc:
For `U = Spec A` affine and adequate `𝒪`-modules `𝓕`, `𝓖`, the natural map
`Ext^0_{Adeq(𝒪)}(𝓕, 𝓖) ⟶ Ext^0_{Mod((Sch/U)_τ, 𝒪)}(𝓕, 𝓖)` is bijective.
declarations.statement:
public theorem bijective_mapExtAddHom_ι_adequate_zero :
    letI := adequate_isClosedUnderKernels.{u, u} B
    letI := adequate_isClosedUnderCokernels.{u, u} B
    letI := adequate_isClosedUnderFiniteProducts.{u, u} B
    letI : Abelian (adequate.{u, u} B).FullSubcategory := abelian_adequate B
    letI : PreservesFiniteLimits (adequate.{u, u} B).ι := (exact_ι_adequate B).1
    letI : PreservesFiniteColimits (adequate.{u, u} B).ι := (exact_ι_adequate B).2
    letI : HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (SheafOfModules.{u} B.structureSheaf) :=
      HasDerivedCategory.standard _
    letI : HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (adequate.{u, u} B).FullSubcategory :=
      HasDerivedCategory.standard _
    letI : HasExt.{u + 1} (SheafOfModules.{u} B.structureSheaf) :=
      hasExt_of_hasDerivedCategory _
    letI : HasExt.{u + 1} (adequate.{u, u} B).FullSubcategory :=
      hasExt_of_hasDerivedCategory _
    ∀ (F G : (adequate.{u, u} B).FullSubcategory),
      Function.Bijective ((adequate.{u, u} B).ι.mapExtAddHom.{u + 1, u + 1} F G 0)
declarations.comment: degree 0, where the comparison is the map on Hom and the inclusion of the strictly full subcategory of adequate modules is fully faithful; every degree is bijective_mapExtAddHom_ι_adequate in HigherExtsAdequate/AdequateExtComparisonAll

declarations.name: Stacks.Adequate.bijective_mapExtAddHom_ι_adequate_one
declarations.doc:
For `U = Spec A` affine and adequate `𝒪`-modules `𝓕`, `𝓖`, the natural map
`Ext^1_{Adeq(𝒪)}(𝓕, 𝓖) ⟶ Ext^1_{Mod((Sch/U)_τ, 𝒪)}(𝓕, 𝓖)` is bijective.
declarations.statement:
public theorem bijective_mapExtAddHom_ι_adequate_one :
    letI := adequate_isClosedUnderKernels.{u, u} B
    letI := adequate_isClosedUnderCokernels.{u, u} B
    letI := adequate_isClosedUnderFiniteProducts.{u, u} B
    letI : Abelian (adequate.{u, u} B).FullSubcategory := abelian_adequate B
    letI : PreservesFiniteLimits (adequate.{u, u} B).ι := (exact_ι_adequate B).1
    letI : PreservesFiniteColimits (adequate.{u, u} B).ι := (exact_ι_adequate B).2
    letI : HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (SheafOfModules.{u} B.structureSheaf) :=
      HasDerivedCategory.standard _
    letI : HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (adequate.{u, u} B).FullSubcategory :=
      HasDerivedCategory.standard _
    letI : HasExt.{u + 1} (SheafOfModules.{u} B.structureSheaf) :=
      hasExt_of_hasDerivedCategory _
    letI : HasExt.{u + 1} (adequate.{u, u} B).FullSubcategory :=
      hasExt_of_hasDerivedCategory _
    ∀ (F G : (adequate.{u, u} B).FullSubcategory),
      Function.Bijective ((adequate.{u, u} B).ι.mapExtAddHom.{u + 1, u + 1} F G 1)
declarations.comment: degree 1, where the comparison is bijective because the adequate modules are closed under extensions, Tag 06VQ (3), and Ext^1 is the group of Yoneda extensions; every degree is bijective_mapExtAddHom_ι_adequate in HigherExtsAdequate/AdequateExtComparisonAll

declarations.name: Stacks.Adequate.bijective_mapExtAddHom_ι_adequate
declarations.doc:
Let `U = Spec A` be affine and `𝓕`, `𝓖` adequate `𝒪`-modules. For every `i ≥ 0` the natural map
`Ext^i_{Adeq(𝒪)}(𝓕, 𝓖) ⟶ Ext^i_{Mod(𝒪)}(𝓕, 𝓖)`, induced by the exact inclusion of the adequate
modules, is bijective.

The `letI` preamble is not a list of hypotheses: it is the abelian structure of `Adeq(𝒪)`
(Tag 06VQ (1)), the exactness of its inclusion (Tag 06VQ (2)) and the standard derived-category
and `Ext` choices, spelled exactly as in `bijective_mapExtAddHom_ι_adequate_zero`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem bijective_mapExtAddHom_ι_adequate :
    letI := adequate_isClosedUnderKernels.{u, u} B
    letI := adequate_isClosedUnderCokernels.{u, u} B
    letI := adequate_isClosedUnderFiniteProducts.{u, u} B
    letI : Abelian (adequate.{u, u} B).FullSubcategory := abelian_adequate B
    letI : PreservesFiniteLimits (adequate.{u, u} B).ι := (exact_ι_adequate B).1
    letI : PreservesFiniteColimits (adequate.{u, u} B).ι := (exact_ι_adequate B).2
    letI : HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (SheafOfModules.{u} B.structureSheaf) :=
      HasDerivedCategory.standard _
    letI : HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (adequate.{u, u} B).FullSubcategory :=
      HasDerivedCategory.standard _
    letI : HasExt.{u + 1} (SheafOfModules.{u} B.structureSheaf) :=
      hasExt_of_hasDerivedCategory _
    letI : HasExt.{u + 1} (adequate.{u, u} B).FullSubcategory :=
      hasExt_of_hasDerivedCategory _
    ∀ (F G : (adequate.{u, u} B).FullSubcategory) (n : ℕ),
      Function.Bijective ((adequate.{u, u} B).ι.mapExtAddHom.{u + 1, u + 1} F G n)

declarations.name: Module.PureInjective
declarations.doc:
An `A`-module `I` is *pure injective* if applying `Hom_A(-, I)` to every
universally exact short exact sequence of `A`-modules gives a short exact
sequence.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev PureInjective (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Type v)
    [AddCommGroup I] [Module A I] : Prop

declarations.name: Module.PureProjective
declarations.doc:
An `A`-module `P` is *pure projective* if applying `Hom_A(P, -)` to every
universally exact short exact sequence of `A`-modules gives a short exact
sequence.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev PureProjective (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (P : Type v)
    [AddCommGroup P] [Module A P] : Prop

declarations.name: Module.pureProjective_iff_directSum_finitelyPresented_retract
declarations.doc:
An `A`-module is pure projective if and only if it is a retract of a direct
sum of finitely presented `A`-modules.
declarations.statement:
public theorem pureProjective_iff_directSum_finitelyPresented_retract
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] :
    Module.PureProjective A M ↔
      ∃ (ι : Type (max u v)) (Q : ι → Type (max u v))
        (_ : (i : ι) → AddCommGroup (Q i))
        (_ : (i : ι) → Module A (Q i)),
        (∀ i, Module.FinitePresentation A (Q i)) ∧
          ∃ (s : M →ₗ[A] ⨁ i, Q i) (r : (⨁ i, Q i) →ₗ[A] M),
            r.comp s = LinearMap.id

declarations.name: Module.exists_pureProjective_universallyExact_presentation
declarations.doc:
Every module is the quotient of a pure projective module in a universally exact short
exact sequence.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_pureProjective_universallyExact_presentation
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] :
    ∃ (N P : Type (max u v))
      (_ : AddCommGroup N) (_ : Module A N)
      (_ : AddCommGroup P) (_ : Module A P)
      (f : N →ₗ[A] P) (g : P →ₗ[A] M),
      Function.Injective f ∧
        Function.Surjective g ∧
          LinearMap.range f = LinearMap.ker g ∧
            UniversallyInjective f ∧
              Module.PureProjective A P
